const fetcher = (url: string) => fetch(url).then((r) => r.json());

function getProductStatus(stock: number): ProductStatus {
  if (stock <= 0) return "Out of Stock";
  if (stock <= 5) return "Low Stock";
  return "In Stock";
}

function getMaterialStatus(
  stock: number,
  reorderPoint: number,
): MaterialStatus {
  if (stock <= 0) return "Out";
  if (stock <= reorderPoint) return "Low";
  return "Available";
}

function toProductSlug(name: string): string {
  return (
    name
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "") || "product"
  );
}

function normalizeStoragePath(raw: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!raw) return "";
  if (raw.startsWith("http")) {
    const marker = "/storage/v1/object/public/products/";
    const idx = raw.indexOf(marker);
    return idx !== -1
      ? raw.slice(idx + marker.length).replace(/^products\
      : raw;
  }
  return raw.replace(/^products\
}

function initViewDetails(): ViewDetailState[] {
  return PRODUCT_VIEW_SLOTS.map(({ label, sort_order }) => ({

    imagePreview: null,
    existingStoragePath: null,

}

function buildPrimaryStoragePath(
  productId: string,
  productSlug: string,
): string {
  return `${productId}/primary-${productSlug}.webp`;
}

function buildHoverStoragePath(productId: string, productSlug: string): string {
  return `${productId}/hover-${productSlug}.webp`;
}

function buildViewStoragePath(
  productId: string,
  label: ProductViewLabel,
  productSlug: string,
): string {
  return `${productId}/${VIEW_FILE_SLUG[label]}-${productSlug}.webp`;
}

async function uploadProductImage(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createClient>,
  storagePath: string,
  file: File,
): Promise<string> {
  const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
    .from("products")
    .upload(storagePath, file, {
      upsert: true,
      contentType: file.type || "image/webp",
    });

  if (uploadError) {
    throw new Error(uploadError.message);
  }

  const { data: urlData } = supabase.storage
    .from("products")
    .getPublicUrl(storagePath);

  return bustCache(urlData.publicUrl);
}

function stripCacheBuster(url: string): string {
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    u.search = "";
    return u.toString();
  } catch {
    return url;
  }
}

function bustCache(url: string): string {
  return `${stripCacheBuster(url)}?v=${Date.now()}`;
}

type ProductImageOrientation = "portrait" | "landscape";

function productImageAspectRatio(orientation: ProductImageOrientation): string {
  return orientation === "landscape" ? "8 / 5" : "3 / 4";
}

export default function InventoryAdmin({
  initialProducts,
  initialMaterials,
  initialStockouts = [],
}: {
  initialProducts: ProductRow[];
  initialMaterials: MaterialRow[];
  initialStockouts?: StockoutRow[];
}) {
  const [isSubdomain, setIsSubdomain] = useState(false);
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    setIsSubdomain(window.location.hostname.startsWith("admin."));
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);
  const router = useRouter();
  const { mutate } = useSWRConfig();

  const { data: inventoryData, mutate: mutateInventory } = useSWR<{
    products: ProductRow[];
    materials: MaterialRow[];
  }>("/api/admin/inventory", fetcher, {
    fallbackData: { products: initialProducts, materials: initialMaterials },
    revalidateOnMount: true,
  });

  useRealtimeOrders({
    enabled: true,
    onUpdate: () => {
      mutateInventory();
      mutateStockouts();
    },
  });

  const currentProducts = (
    mounted && inventoryData?.products
      ? inventoryData.products
      : initialProducts
  ).map((p) => ({
    ...p,
    available_stock: Math.max(0, (p.stock ?? 0) - (p.reserved_stock ?? 0)),
  }));
  const currentMaterials =
    mounted && inventoryData?.materials
      ? inventoryData.materials
      : initialMaterials;

  const { data: stockoutsData, mutate: mutateStockouts } = useSWR<{
    stockouts: StockoutRow[];
  }>("/api/admin/inventory/stockout", fetcher, {
    fallbackData: { stockouts: initialStockouts },
    revalidateOnMount: true,
    refreshInterval: 10000,
  });

  const stockouts =
    mounted && stockoutsData?.stockouts
      ? stockoutsData.stockouts
      : (stockoutsData?.stockouts ?? initialStockouts);

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<
    "products" | "materials" | "deductions"
  >("products");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [productSearch, setProductSearch] = useState("");
  const [productCategoryFilter, setProductCategoryFilter] =
    useState<string>("All");
  const [productStatusFilter, setProductStatusFilter] = useState<string>("All");

  const [materialSearch, setMaterialSearch] = useState("");
  const [materialCategoryFilter, setMaterialCategoryFilter] =
    useState<string>("All");
  const [materialStatusFilter, setMaterialStatusFilter] =
    useState<string>("All");

  const [stockoutSearch, setStockoutSearch] = useState("");
  const [stockoutTypeFilter, setStockoutTypeFilter] = useState<string>("All");
  const [stockoutReasonFilter, setStockoutReasonFilter] =
    useState<string>("All");

  const [showAddProduct, setShowAddProduct] = useState(false);
  const [showEditProduct, setShowEditProduct] = useState(false);
  const [showAddMaterial, setShowAddMaterial] = useState(false);
  const [showEditMaterial, setShowEditMaterial] = useState(false);
  const [showRecordStockout, setShowRecordStockout] = useState(false);
  const [editProduct, setEditProduct] = useState<ProductRow | null>(null);
  const [editMaterial, setEditMaterial] = useState<MaterialRow | null>(null);
  const [pendingArchive, setPendingArchive] = useState<PendingArchive | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [reorderMaterial, setReorderMaterial] = useState<MaterialRow | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [soldProduct, setSoldProduct] = useState<ProductRow | null>(null);
  const [restockProduct, setRestockProduct] = useState<ProductRow | null>(null);
  const [selectedDeduction, setSelectedDeduction] =
    useState<StockoutRow | null>(null);

  const OLD_PRODUCT_NAMES = [
    "dining table",
    "dining chair",
    "panel door",
    "storage cabinet",
    "queen bedframe",
  ];

  const filteredProducts = useMemo(
    () => {
      const list = currentProducts.filter((p) => {
        const search = p.name
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(productSearch.toLowerCase());
        const category =
          productCategoryFilter === "All" ||
          p.category === productCategoryFilter;
        const status =
          productStatusFilter === "All" || p.status === productStatusFilter;
        return search && category && status;
      });

      return [...list].sort((a, b) => {
        const aName = a.name.trim().toLowerCase();
        const bName = b.name.trim().toLowerCase();

        const aIdx = OLD_PRODUCT_NAMES.findIndex(
          (name) => aName === name || aName.includes(name),
        );
        const bIdx = OLD_PRODUCT_NAMES.findIndex(
          (name) => bName === name || bName.includes(name),
        );

        if (aIdx !== -1 && bIdx !== -1) return aIdx - bIdx;
        if (aIdx !== -1) return -1;
        if (bIdx !== -1) return 1;
        return 0;
      });
    },
    [
      currentProducts,
      productSearch,
      productCategoryFilter,
      productStatusFilter,
    ],
  );

  const filteredMaterials = useMemo(
    () =>
      currentMaterials.filter((m) => {
        const search = m.name
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(materialSearch.toLowerCase());
        const category =
          materialCategoryFilter === "All" ||
          m.category === materialCategoryFilter;
        const status =
          materialStatusFilter === "All" || m.status === materialStatusFilter;
        return search && category && status;
      }),
    [
      currentMaterials,
      materialSearch,
      materialCategoryFilter,
      materialStatusFilter,
    ],
  );

  const filteredStockouts = useMemo(() => {
    return stockouts.filter((s) => {
      const matchesSearch =
        !stockoutSearch.trim() ||
        s.item_name.toLowerCase().includes(stockoutSearch.toLowerCase()) ||
        (s.recipient_name &&
          s.recipient_name
            .toLowerCase()
            .includes(stockoutSearch.toLowerCase())) ||
        (s.notes &&
          s.notes.toLowerCase().includes(stockoutSearch.toLowerCase())) ||
        s.admin_name.toLowerCase().includes(stockoutSearch.toLowerCase());

      const matchesType =
        stockoutTypeFilter === "All" || s.item_type === stockoutTypeFilter;

      const matchesReason =
        stockoutReasonFilter === "All" || s.reason === stockoutReasonFilter;

      return matchesSearch && matchesType && matchesReason;
    });
  }, [stockouts, stockoutSearch, stockoutTypeFilter, stockoutReasonFilter]);

  const lowStockProducts = currentProducts.filter(
    (p) => p.status === "Low Stock" || p.status === "Out of Stock",
  );
  const lowStockAlerts = currentMaterials.filter(
    (m) => m.status === "Low" || m.status === "Out",
  );

  async function handleProductSubmit(
    productId: string | null,
    method: "POST" | "PATCH",
    payload: {
      name: string;
      category: ProductCategory;
      stock: number;
      price: number;
      description: string;
      status: ProductStatus;
      primary_image_url: string | null;
      hover_image_url: string | null;
      has_hover: boolean;
      is_wide: boolean;
      vehicle_slots: number;
      material: string;
      partner_id: string | null;
      primaryFile: File | null;
      hoverFile: File | null;
      viewDetails: ViewDetailState[];
    },
    successMessage: string,
    onSuccess: () => void,
  ) {
    setBusy(true);
    const supabase = createClient();

    const {
      data: { session },
    } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    if (!session) {
      toast.error("Session expired. Please refresh the page and try again.");
      setBusy(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      let resolvedProductId = productId;

      if (method === "POST") {
        const createRes = await fetch("/api/admin/products", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            name: payload.name,
            category: payload.category,
            stock: payload.stock,
            price: payload.price,
            description: payload.description,
            status: payload.status,
            has_hover: payload.has_hover,
            is_wide: payload.is_wide,
            vehicle_slots: payload.vehicle_slots,
            material: payload.material,
            partner_id: payload.partner_id,
            _createOnly: true,
          }),
        });

        const createJson = (await createRes.json().catch(() => null)) as {
          id?: string;
          error?: string;
        } | null;
        if (!createRes.ok || !createJson?.id) {
          throw new Error(createJson?.error || "Failed to create product");
        }
        resolvedProductId = createJson.id;
      }

      if (!resolvedProductId) throw new Error("Product ID is missing");

      const productSlug = toProductSlug(payload.name);

      let resolvedPrimaryUrl = payload.primary_image_url;
      if (payload.primaryFile) {
        try {
          resolvedPrimaryUrl = await uploadProductImage(
            supabase,
            buildPrimaryStoragePath(resolvedProductId, productSlug),
            payload.primaryFile,
          );
        } catch (e) {
          throw new Error(
            `Failed to upload primary image: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown error"}`,
          );
        }
      } else if (method === "POST") {
        throw new Error("Primary image is required.");
      }

      let resolvedHoverUrl = payload.hover_image_url;
      if (payload.hoverFile) {
        try {
          resolvedHoverUrl = await uploadProductImage(
            supabase,
            buildHoverStoragePath(resolvedProductId, productSlug),
            payload.hoverFile,
          );
        } catch (e) {
          throw new Error(
            `Failed to upload hover image: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown error"}`,
          );
        }
      }

      const uploadedDetails: {
        label: ProductViewLabel;
        sort_order: number;
        image_url: string;
        storage_path: string;
        price_adjustment: number;
      }[] = [];

      for (const detail of payload.viewDetails) {
        if (detail.imageFile) {
          const storagePath = buildViewStoragePath(
            resolvedProductId,
            detail.label,
            productSlug,
          );

          try {
            const imageUrl = await uploadProductImage(
              supabase,
              storagePath,
              detail.imageFile,
            );
            uploadedDetails.push({
              label: detail.label,
              sort_order: detail.sort_order,
              image_url: imageUrl,
              storage_path: storagePath,
              price_adjustment: 0,
            });
          } catch (e) {
            throw new Error(
              `Failed to upload ${detail.label}: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown error"}`,
            );
          }
        } else if (detail.existingStoragePath && detail.existingImageUrl) {
          uploadedDetails.push({
            label: detail.label,
            sort_order: detail.sort_order,
            image_url: detail.existingImageUrl,
            storage_path: detail.existingStoragePath,
            price_adjustment: 0,
          });
        }
      }

      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/products/${resolvedProductId}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: payload.name,
          category: payload.category,
          price: payload.price,
          description: payload.description,
          status: payload.status,
          primary_image_url: resolvedPrimaryUrl,
          hover_image_url: resolvedHoverUrl,
          has_hover: payload.has_hover,
          is_wide: payload.is_wide,
          vehicle_slots: payload.vehicle_slots,
          material: payload.material,
          partner_id: payload.partner_id,
          details: uploadedDetails,
        }),
      });

      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as {
        error?: string;
      } | null;
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json?.error || "Request failed");

      toast.success(successMessage);
      mutate("/api/admin/inventory");
      router.refresh();
      onSuccess();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Something went wrong.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function callApi(
    path: string,
    method: "POST" | "PATCH" | "DELETE",
    body?: object,
    successMessage?: string,
  ) {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(path, {
        method,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
      });
      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as {
        error?: string;
      } | null;
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json?.error || "Request failed");
      if (successMessage) toast.success(successMessage);
      mutate("/api/admin/inventory");
      router.refresh();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Something went wrong.");
      return false;
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function confirmArchive() {
    if (!pendingArchive) return;
    const { path, itemName } = pendingArchive;
    await callApi(
      path,
      "PATCH",
      { archive: true },
      `${itemName} has been archived.`,
    );
    setPendingArchive(null);
  }
