              <table className="w-full text-base text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-border text-muted-foreground text-sm font-semibold bg-muted/40">
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                      Date & Time
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                      Type
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                      Item Name
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                      Deducted Qty
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                      Stock Transition
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap text-right">
                      Action
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-border text-foreground">
                  {filteredStockouts.length === 0 ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td
                        colSpan={6}
                        className="px-4 py-14 text-center text-base text-muted-foreground"
                      >
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                          <History className="h-9 w-9 text-muted-foreground/50" />
                          <p className="font-bold text-foreground text-lg">
                            No deductions recorded
                          </p>
                          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            Manual sales and material deductions will appear
                            here.
                          </p>
                          <Button
                            variant="outline"
                            className="mt-2 h-9 px-4 text-sm font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                            onClick={() => setShowRecordStockout(true)}
                          >
                            Record First Deduction
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : (
                    filteredStockouts.map((s) => (
                      <tr
                        key={s.id}
                        className="hover:bg-muted/40 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-muted-foreground font-medium text-base align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span>
                              {new Date(s.created_at).toLocaleDateString(
                                "en-PH",
                                {
                                  month: "short",
                                  day: "numeric",
                                  year: "numeric",
                                  hour: "numeric",
                                  minute: "2-digit",
                                  hour12: true,
                                },
                              )}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                          <span
                            className={cn(
                              "inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 text-base font-semibold rounded-lg border",
                              s.item_type === "product"
                                ? "bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30"
                                : "bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30",
                            )}
                          >
                            {s.item_type === "product"
                              ? "Product"
                              : "Raw Material"}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td
                          className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold text-foreground align-middle whitespace-nowrap text-base"
                          title={s.item_name}
                        >
                          {s.item_name}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 align-middle whitespace-nowrap text-base tabular-nums">
                          -{s.quantity}{" "}
                          {s.item_type === "product" ? "pcs" : "bf"}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-muted-foreground font-medium align-middle whitespace-nowrap text-base tabular-nums">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <span>{s.stock_before}</span>
                            <ArrowRight
                              size={13}
                              className="text-muted-foreground/50"
                            />
                            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                              {s.stock_after}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap text-right">
                          <Button
                            variant="outline"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-9 px-3 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"
                            onClick={() => setSelectedDeduction(s)}
                          >
                            View
                          </Button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </Tabs>

      {soldProduct && (
        <SoldDetailsModal
          product={soldProduct}
          onClose={() => setSoldProduct(null)}
          onRestock={(p) => {
            setSoldProduct(null);
            setRestockProduct(p);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {restockProduct && (
        <ProductRestockModal
          product={restockProduct}
          onClose={() => setRestockProduct(null)}
          onUpdated={() => mutate("/api/admin/inventory")}
        />
      )}

      {selectedDeduction && (
        <DeductionDetailsModal
          deduction={selectedDeduction}
          onClose={() => setSelectedDeduction(null)}
        />
      )}

      {showRecordStockout && (
        <RecordStockoutModal
          products={currentProducts}
          materials={currentMaterials}
          onClose={() => setShowRecordStockout(false)}
          onSuccess={() => {
            mutate("/api/admin/inventory");
            mutateStockouts();
          }}
        />
      )}

      {reorderMaterial && (
        <ReorderHistoryModal
          material={reorderMaterial}
          onClose={() => setReorderMaterial(null)}
          onUpdated={() => mutate("/api/admin/inventory")}
        />
      )}

      {}
      {showAddProduct && (
        <Modal
          title="Add New Product"
          onClose={() => !busy && setShowAddProduct(false)}
        >
          <ProductForm
            onCancel={() => setShowAddProduct(false)}
            busy={busy}
            partnerOptions={currentProducts}
            onSubmit={(payload) =>
              handleProductSubmit(
                null,
                "POST",
                payload,
                `${payload.name} has been added successfully.`,
                () => setShowAddProduct(false),
              )
            }
          />
        </Modal>
      )}

      {}
      {showEditProduct && editProduct && (
        <Modal
          title="Edit Product"
          onClose={() => {
            if (!busy) {
              setShowEditProduct(false);
              setEditProduct(null);
            }
          }}
        >
          <ProductForm
            initial={editProduct}
            busy={busy}
            partnerOptions={currentProducts.filter(
              (p) => p.id !== editProduct.id,
            )}
            onCancel={() => {
              setShowEditProduct(false);
              setEditProduct(null);
            }}
            onSubmit={(payload) =>
              handleProductSubmit(
                editProduct.id,
                "PATCH",
                payload,
                `${editProduct.name} has been updated successfully.`,
                () => {
                  setShowEditProduct(false);
                  setEditProduct(null);
                },
              )
            }
          />
        </Modal>
      )}

      {}
      {showAddMaterial && (
        <Modal
          title="Add New Material"
          onClose={() => !busy && setShowAddMaterial(false)}
        >
          <MaterialForm
            onCancel={() => setShowAddMaterial(false)}
            busy={busy}
            onSubmit={(payload) =>
              callApi(
                "/api/admin/materials",
                "POST",
                payload,
                `${payload.name} has been added successfully.`,
              ).then(() => setShowAddMaterial(false))
            }
          />
        </Modal>
      )}

      {}
      {showEditMaterial && editMaterial && (
        <Modal
          title="Edit Material"
          onClose={() => {
            if (!busy) {
              setShowEditMaterial(false);
              setEditMaterial(null);
            }
          }}
        >
          <MaterialForm
            initial={editMaterial}
            busy={busy}
            onCancel={() => {
              setShowEditMaterial(false);
              setEditMaterial(null);
            }}
            onSubmit={(payload) =>
              callApi(
                `/api/admin/materials/${editMaterial.id}`,
                "PATCH",
                payload,
                `${editMaterial.name} has been updated successfully.`,
              ).then(() => {
                setShowEditMaterial(false);
                setEditMaterial(null);
              })
            }
          />
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ViewImageSlot({
  label,
  preview,
  orientation,
  onSelect,
}: {
  label: string;
  preview: string | null;
  orientation: ProductImageOrientation;
  onSelect: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
}) {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  return (
    <div>
      <label className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground block mb-1.5">
        {label}
      </label>
      <div
        onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}
        className="relative w-full border-2 border-dashed rounded-lg flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 transition-all overflow-hidden group"
        style={{ aspectRatio: productImageAspectRatio(orientation) }}
      >
        {preview ? (
          <Image
            src={preview}
            alt={label}
            fill
            sizes="300px"
            className="object-cover"
            unoptimized
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-muted-foreground gap-2">
            <ImageIcon size={24} strokeWidth={1.5} />
            <p className="text-xs font-medium">Upload</p>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
          <Upload className="text-white" size={18} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <input
        type="file"
        ref={inputRef}
        className="hidden"
        accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/gif,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp,.gif"
        onChange={onSelect}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function ProductForm({
  initial,
  onSubmit,
  onCancel,
  busy,
  partnerOptions,
}: {
  initial?: ProductRow;
  onSubmit: (payload: {
    name: string;
    category: ProductCategory;
    stock: number;
    price: number;
    description: string;
    status: ProductStatus;
    primary_image_url: string | null;
    hover_image_url: string | null;
    has_hover: boolean;
    is_wide: boolean;
    vehicle_slots: number;
    material: string;
    partner_id: string | null;
    primaryFile: File | null;
    hoverFile: File | null;
    viewDetails: ViewDetailState[];
  }) => Promise<void>;
  onCancel: () => void;
  busy: boolean;
  partnerOptions: ProductRow[];
}) {
  const isAddMode = !initial;
  const [name, setName] = useState(initial?.name ?? "");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<ProductCategory | "">(
    initial?.category ?? "",
  );
  const [stock, setStock] = useState(initial ? String(initial.stock) : "");
  const [price, setPrice] = useState(initial ? String(initial.price) : "");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState(initial?.description ?? "");
  const [loadingExisting, setLoadingExisting] = useState(!!initial);
  const [viewDetails, setViewDetails] =
    useState<ViewDetailState[]>(initViewDetails);
  const [hasHover, setHasHover] = useState(initial?.has_hover ?? false);
  const [isWide, setIsWide] = useState(initial?.is_wide ?? false);
  const [orientation, setOrientation] = useState<"portrait" | "landscape">(
    initial?.is_wide ? "landscape" : "portrait",
  );
  const [vehicleSlots, setVehicleSlots] = useState(
    initial ? String(initial.vehicle_slots) : "",
  );
  const [material, setMaterial] = useState(initial?.material ?? "");
  const [partnerId, setPartnerId] = useState<string>(
    initial ? (initial.partner_id ?? "none") : "",
  );
  const [primaryFile, setPrimaryFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [primaryPreview, setPrimaryPreview] = useState<string | null>(
    initial?.primary_image_url ? getImageUrl(initial.primary_image_url) : null,
  );
  const primaryInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const [hoverFile, setHoverFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [hoverPreview, setHoverPreview] = useState<string | null>(
    initial?.hover_image_url ? getImageUrl(initial.hover_image_url) : null,
  );
  const hoverInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const computedStatus = isAddMode
    ? getProductStatus(Number(stock) || 0)
    : (initial?.status ?? "In Stock");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initial?.id) return;
    let isCancelled = false;
    async function loadExisting() {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from("product_details")
        .select("label, storage_path, image_url, sort_order")
        .eq("product_id", initial!.id)
        .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });
      if (!isCancelled && data && data.length > 0) {
        setViewDetails((prev) =>
          prev.map((vd) => {
            const existing = data.find(
              (d: { label: string | null }) => d.label === vd.label,
            );
            if (!existing) return vd;
            const cleanPath = normalizeStoragePath(existing.storage_path);
            const previewUrl =
              existing.image_url ||
              (() => {
                const { data: urlData } = supabase.storage
                  .from("products")
                  .getPublicUrl(cleanPath);
                return urlData.publicUrl;
              })();
            return {
              ...vd,
              sort_order: existing.sort_order ?? vd.sort_order,
              imagePreview: getImageUrl(previewUrl),
              existingStoragePath: cleanPath,
              existingImageUrl: existing.image_url,
            };
          }),
        );
      }
      if (!isCancelled) setLoadingExisting(false);
    }
    void loadExisting();
    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
    };
  }, [initial?.id]);

  function validateAdminImageFile(file: File): boolean {
    const ALLOWED_TYPES = [
      "image/jpeg",
      "image/png",
      "image/webp",
      "image/gif",
    ];
    const ALLOWED_EXTS = ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "webp", "gif"];
    const MAX_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

    const ext = file.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
    if (!ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type) || !ALLOWED_EXTS.includes(ext)) {
      toast.error(
        `"${file.name}" is not allowed. Only JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF images are accepted.`,
      );
      return false;
    }
    if (file.size > MAX_SIZE) {
      toast.error(`"${file.name}" exceeds the 5MB size limit.`);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  function isDuplicateProductImage(
    file: File,
    currentSlot: "primary" | "hover" | ProductViewLabel,
  ): boolean {
    const activeFiles: { file: File; slot: string }[] = [];
    if (primaryFile && currentSlot !== "primary") {
      activeFiles.push({ file: primaryFile, slot: "Primary" });
    }
    if (hoverFile && currentSlot !== "hover") {
      activeFiles.push({ file: hoverFile, slot: "Hover" });
    }
    for (const vd of viewDetails) {
      if (vd.imageFile && currentSlot !== vd.label) {
        activeFiles.push({ file: vd.imageFile, slot: vd.label });
      }
    }
    const dup = activeFiles.find(
      (item) => item.file.name === file.name && item.file.size === file.size,
    );
    if (dup) {
      toast.error(
        `"${file.name}" is already selected as the ${dup.slot} image. Duplicate image ignored.`,
      );
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function handlePrimaryChange(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (
      !validateAdminImageFile(file) ||
      isDuplicateProductImage(file, "primary")
    ) {
      e.target.value = "";
      return;
    }
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      setPrimaryFile(file);
      setPrimaryPreview(reader.result as string);
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  function handleViewChange(
    label: ProductViewLabel,
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>,
  ) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!validateAdminImageFile(file) || isDuplicateProductImage(file, label)) {
      e.target.value = "";
      return;
    }
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      setViewDetails((prev) =>
        prev.map((vd) =>
          vd.label === label
            ? { ...vd, imageFile: file, imagePreview: reader.result as string }
            : vd,
        ),
      );
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  function handleHoverChange(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (
      !validateAdminImageFile(file) ||
      isDuplicateProductImage(file, "hover")
    ) {
      e.target.value = "";
      return;
    }
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      setHoverFile(file);
      setHoverPreview(reader.result as string);
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  const allViewImagesReady = viewDetails.every((v) => v.imagePreview !== null);

  const hasChanges = useMemo(() => {
    if (isAddMode) return true;
    return (
      name.trim() !== (initial?.name ?? "").trim() ||
      category !== initial?.category ||
      Number(price) !== (initial?.price ?? 0) ||
      description.trim() !== (initial?.description ?? "").trim() ||
      hasHover !== (initial?.has_hover ?? false) ||
      isWide !== (initial?.is_wide ?? false) ||
      Number(vehicleSlots) !== (initial?.vehicle_slots ?? 1) ||
      material.trim() !== (initial?.material ?? "").trim() ||
      (partnerId === "none" || !partnerId ? null : partnerId) !==
        (initial?.partner_id ?? null) ||
      primaryFile !== null ||
      hoverFile !== null ||
      viewDetails.some((v) => v.imageFile !== null)
    );
  }, [
    isAddMode,
    name,
    category,
    price,
    description,
    hasHover,
    isWide,
    vehicleSlots,
    material,
    partnerId,
    primaryFile,
    hoverFile,
    viewDetails,
    initial,
  ]);

  const isNameValid = name.trim().length >= 2 && name.trim().length <= 20;
  const isCategoryValid = category !== "";
  const isMaterialValid =
    material.trim().length >= 2 && material.trim().length <= 20;
  const isDescriptionValid =
    description.trim().length >= 4 && description.trim().length <= 1500;
  const isPriceValid =
    price !== "" && !isNaN(Number(price)) && Number(price) >= 1;
  const isStockValid =
    stock !== "" &&
    !isNaN(Number(stock)) &&
    Number(stock) >= 0 &&
    Number(stock) <= 999 &&
    stock.length <= 3;
  const isVehicleSlotsValid =
    vehicleSlots !== "" &&
    !isNaN(Number(vehicleSlots)) &&
    Number(vehicleSlots) >= 1 &&
    Number(vehicleSlots) <= 999 &&
    vehicleSlots.length <= 3;

  const isFormFilled =
    isNameValid &&
    isCategoryValid &&
    isMaterialValid &&
    isDescriptionValid &&
    isPriceValid &&
    (isAddMode ? isStockValid : true) &&
    isVehicleSlotsValid;

  const canSave = isAddMode
    ? isFormFilled && primaryPreview !== null && hasChanges
    : isFormFilled && hasChanges;

  if (loadingExisting) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-12">
        <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "space-y-5",
        busy && "cursor-wait opacity-80 pointer-events-none",
      )}
    >
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
            Product Images & Layout
          </p>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
            {isAddMode
              ? "Primary image is required. Hover is optional when enabled."
              : "Update primary or hover as needed. Leave empty to keep existing files."}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block">
            Product Layout / Orientation
          </label>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setOrientation("portrait");
                setIsWide(false);
              }}
              className={cn(
                "flex-1 py-2 px-3 text-sm rounded-md border transition-colors text-center font-medium cursor-pointer",
                orientation === "portrait"
                  ? "border-foreground bg-foreground text-background"
                  : "border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:border-foreground/50",
              )}
            >
              Portrait (1 Column, 3:4 Ratio)
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setOrientation("landscape");
                setIsWide(true);
              }}
              className={cn(
                "flex-1 py-2 px-3 text-sm rounded-md border transition-colors text-center font-medium cursor-pointer",
                orientation === "landscape"
                  ? "border-foreground bg-foreground text-background"
                  : "border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:border-foreground/50",
              )}
            >
              Landscape (2 Columns, 8:5 Ratio)
            </button>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {orientation === "landscape"
              ? "Best for wide furniture like tables, TV consoles, or cabinets."
              : "Best for standard/upright furniture like chairs, bedside drawers, or bedframes."}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <div>
            <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block mb-1.5">
              Primary Image
            </label>
            <div
              onClick={() => primaryInputRef.current?.click()}
              className="relative w-full border-2 border-dashed rounded-lg flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 transition-all overflow-hidden group"
              style={{ aspectRatio: productImageAspectRatio(orientation) }}
            >
              {primaryPreview ? (
                <Image
                  src={primaryPreview}
                  alt="Primary"
                  fill
                  sizes="300px"
                  className="object-cover"
                  unoptimized
                />
              ) : (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-muted-foreground gap-2">
                  <ImageIcon size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} />
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">Upload primary</p>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-card flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                <Upload className="text-white" size={20} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <input
              type="file"
              ref={primaryInputRef}
              className="hidden"
              accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/gif,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp,.gif"
              onChange={handlePrimaryChange}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
              <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block">
                Hover Image
              </label>
              <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-muted-foreground cursor-pointer select-none">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={hasHover}
                  onChange={(e) => setHasHover(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-4 h-4 rounded-sm border-input cursor-pointer"
                />
                Has hover
              </label>
            </div>
            <div
              onClick={() => hasHover && hoverInputRef.current?.click()}
              className={cn(
                "relative w-full border-2 border-dashed rounded-lg flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition-all overflow-hidden group",
                hasHover
                  ? "cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50"
                  : "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed bg-muted/10",
              )}
              style={{ aspectRatio: productImageAspectRatio(orientation) }}
            >
              {hoverPreview ? (
                <Image
                  src={hoverPreview}
                  alt="Hover"
                  fill
                  sizes="300px"
                  className="object-cover"
                  unoptimized
                />
              ) : (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-muted-foreground gap-2">
                  <ImageIcon size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} />
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">Upload hover</p>
                </div>
              )}
              {hasHover && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-card flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                  <Upload className="text-white" size={20} />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <input
              type="file"
              ref={hoverInputRef}
              className="hidden"
              accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/gif,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp,.gif"
              onChange={handleHoverChange}
              disabled={!hasHover}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="border-t" />

      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <Field label="Product name">
            <Input
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter product name"
              maxLength={20}
              className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
                name.length > 0 && !isNameValid
                  ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                  : ""
              }`}
            />
            {name.length > 0 && !isNameValid && (
              <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
                Must be 2 to 20 characters.
              </p>
            )}
          </Field>
          <Field label="Material">
            <Input
              value={material}
              onChange={(e) => setMaterial(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter material name"
              maxLength={20}
              className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
                material.length > 0 && !isMaterialValid
                  ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                  : ""
              }`}
            />
            {material.length > 0 && !isMaterialValid && (
              <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
                Must be 2 to 20 characters.
              </p>
            )}
          </Field>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div>
            <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
              Product Views (Optional)
            </p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
              Upload any view image (Front, Side, Top, Back). All view slots are
              open.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {viewDetails.map((view) => (
              <ViewImageSlot
                key={view.label}
                label={view.label}
                preview={view.imagePreview}
                orientation={orientation}
                onSelect={(e) => handleViewChange(view.label, e)}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <Field label="Category">
            <Select
              value={category || undefined}
              onValueChange={(v) => setCategory(v as ProductCategory)}
            >
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full h-10 text-base cursor-pointer">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Choose category" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {productCategories.map((c) => (
                  <SelectItem key={c} value={c} className="text-base py-2">
                    {c}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Vehicle Slots">
            <Input
              type="text"
              inputMode="numeric"
              maxLength={4}
              value={vehicleSlots}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setVehicleSlots(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4))
              }
              placeholder="1"
              className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
                vehicleSlots.length > 0 && !isVehicleSlotsValid
                  ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                  : ""
              }`}
            />
            {vehicleSlots.length > 0 && !isVehicleSlotsValid && (
              <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
                Must be 1 to 999 (max 3 digits).
              </p>
            )}
          </Field>
        </div>

        {isAddMode ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <Field label="Stock">
              <Input
                type="text"
                inputMode="numeric"
                maxLength={4}
                value={stock}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setStock(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4))
                }
                placeholder="0"
                className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
                  stock.length > 0 && !isStockValid
                    ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                    : ""
                }`}
              />
              {stock.length > 0 && !isStockValid && (
                <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
                  Must be 0 to 999 (max 3 digits).
                </p>
              )}
            </Field>
            <Field label="Base Price (₱)">
              <Input
                type="text"
                inputMode="numeric"
                value={price}
                onChange={(e) => setPrice(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ""))}
                placeholder="0.00"
                className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
                  price.length > 0 && !isPriceValid
                    ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                    : ""
                }`}
              />
              {price.length > 0 && !isPriceValid && (
                <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
                  Must be greater than 0.
                </p>
              )}
            </Field>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Field label="Base Price (₱)">
            <Input
              type="text"
              inputMode="numeric"
              value={price}
              onChange={(e) => setPrice(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ""))}
              placeholder="0.00"
              className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
                price.length > 0 && !isPriceValid
                  ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                  : ""
              }`}
            />
            {price.length > 0 && !isPriceValid && (
              <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
                Must be greater than 0.
              </p>
            )}
          </Field>
        )}

        <Field label="Description">
          <Textarea
            value={description}
            onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
            rows={4}
            maxLength={1500}
            placeholder="Enter product description"
            className={`h-[90px] resize-y text-base placeholder:text-base ${
              description.length > 0 && !isDescriptionValid
                ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                : ""
            }`}
          />
          {description.length > 0 && !isDescriptionValid && (
            <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
              Must be 4 to 1500 characters.
            </p>
          )}
        </Field>

        <Field label="Partner Product (Complete the Look)">
          <Select value={partnerId || undefined} onValueChange={setPartnerId}>
            <SelectTrigger className="w-full h-10 text-base cursor-pointer">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Choose partner" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="none" className="text-base py-2">
                None / No partner
              </SelectItem>
              {partnerOptions.map((p) => (
                <SelectItem key={p.id} value={p.id} className="text-base py-2">
                  {p.name} ({p.category})
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </Field>

        <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-3.5 -mb-0.5 border-t border-border">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
            onClick={onCancel}
            disabled={busy}
            type="button"
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
            disabled={busy || !canSave}
            onClick={() =>
              onSubmit({
                name: name.trim(),
                category: category as ProductCategory,
                stock: Number(stock) || 0,
                price: Number(price) || 0,
                description,
                status: computedStatus,
                primary_image_url: initial?.primary_image_url ?? null,
                hover_image_url: initial?.hover_image_url ?? null,
                has_hover: hasHover,
                is_wide: isWide,
                vehicle_slots: Number(vehicleSlots) || 1,
                material: material.trim(),
                partner_id:
                  !partnerId || partnerId === "none" ? null : partnerId,
                primaryFile,
                hoverFile,
                viewDetails,
              })
            }
            type="button"
          >
            {busy && (
              <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
            )}
            {isAddMode ? "Add Product" : "Save Changes"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MaterialForm({
  initial,
  onSubmit,
  onCancel,
  busy,
}: {
  initial?: MaterialRow;
  onSubmit: (payload: {
    name: string;
    category: MaterialCategory;
    stock: number;
    reorder_point: number;
    cost_per_unit: number;
    status: MaterialStatus;
  }) => Promise<void>;
  onCancel: () => void;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(initial?.name ?? "");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<MaterialCategory | "">(
    initial?.category ?? "",
  );
  const [cost, setCost] = useState(
    initial ? String(initial.cost_per_unit) : "",
  );
  const [reorderPoint, setReorderPoint] = useState(
    initial ? String(initial.reorder_point) : "",
  );

  const isAddMode = !initial;

  const [initialStock, setInitialStock] = useState(
    initial ? String(initial.stock) : "",
  );

  const computedStatus = getMaterialStatus(
    isAddMode ? Number(initialStock) || 0 : initial!.stock,
    Number(reorderPoint) || 0,
  );

  const hasChanges = isAddMode
    ? name.trim() !== ""
    : name.trim() !== initial.name.trim() ||
      category !== initial.category ||
      Number(cost) !== (initial.cost_per_unit ?? 0) ||
      Number(reorderPoint) !== (initial.reorder_point ?? 0);

  const isNameValid = name.trim().length >= 2 && name.trim().length <= 20;
  const isCategoryValid = category !== "";
  const isCostValid =
    cost !== "" &&
    !isNaN(Number(cost)) &&
    Number(cost) >= 1 &&
    Number(cost) <= 999 &&
    cost.length <= 3;
  const isReorderPointValid =
    reorderPoint !== "" &&
    !isNaN(Number(reorderPoint)) &&
    Number(reorderPoint) >= 0 &&
    Number(reorderPoint) <= 999 &&
    reorderPoint.length <= 3;
  const isInitialStockValid =
    initialStock !== "" &&
    !isNaN(Number(initialStock)) &&
    Number(initialStock) >= 0 &&
    Number(initialStock) <= 999 &&
    initialStock.length <= 3;

  const isFormFilled =
    isNameValid &&
    isCategoryValid &&
    isCostValid &&
    isReorderPointValid &&
    (isAddMode ? isInitialStockValid : true);

  const canSave = isFormFilled && hasChanges;

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "space-y-4",
        busy && "cursor-wait opacity-80 pointer-events-none",
      )}
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <Field label="Material name">
          <Input
            value={name}
            onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Enter material name"
            maxLength={20}
            className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
              name.length > 0 && !isNameValid
                ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                : ""
            }`}
          />
          {name.length > 0 && !isNameValid && (
            <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
              Must be 2 to 20 characters.
            </p>
          )}
        </Field>

        <Field label="Reorder Point">
          <Input
            type="text"
            inputMode="numeric"
            maxLength={4}
            value={reorderPoint}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setReorderPoint(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4))
            }
            className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
              reorderPoint.length > 0 && !isReorderPointValid
                ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                : ""
            }`}
            placeholder="0"
          />
          {reorderPoint.length > 0 && !isReorderPointValid && (
            <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
              Must be 0 to 999 (max 3 digits).
            </p>
          )}
        </Field>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <Field label="Category">
          <Select
            value={category || undefined}
            onValueChange={(v) => setCategory(v as MaterialCategory)}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-full h-10 text-base cursor-pointer">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Choose category" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {materialCategories.map((c) => (
                <SelectItem key={c} value={c} className="text-base py-2">
                  {c}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Cost/Unit (₱)">
          <Input
            type="text"
            inputMode="numeric"
            maxLength={4}
            value={cost}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setCost(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4))
            }
            placeholder="0.00"
            className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
              cost.length > 0 && !isCostValid
                ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                : ""
            }`}
          />
          {cost.length > 0 && !isCostValid && (
            <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
              Must be 1 to 999 (max 3 digits).
            </p>
          )}
        </Field>
      </div>

      {}
      {isAddMode && (
        <Field label="Initial Stock">
          <Input
            type="text"
            inputMode="numeric"
            maxLength={4}
            value={initialStock}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setInitialStock(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4))
            }
            className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
              initialStock.length > 0 && !isInitialStockValid
                ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                : ""
            }`}
            placeholder="0"
          />
          {initialStock.length > 0 && !isInitialStockValid && (
            <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
              Must be 0 to 999 (max 3 digits).
            </p>
          )}
        </Field>
      )}

      <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-3.5 -mb-0.5 border-t border-border">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
          onClick={onCancel}
          disabled={busy}
          type="button"
        >
          Cancel
        </Button>
        <Button
          className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
          disabled={busy || !canSave}
          onClick={() =>
            onSubmit({
              name: name.trim(),
              category: category as MaterialCategory,
              stock: isAddMode ? Number(initialStock) || 0 : initial!.stock,
              reorder_point: Number(reorderPoint) || 0,
              cost_per_unit: Number(cost) || 0,
              status: computedStatus,
            })
          }
          type="button"
        >
          {busy && (
            <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
          )}
          {isAddMode ? "Add Material" : "Save Changes"}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type ReorderMovement = {
  id: string;
  quantity_change: number;
  stock_after: number | null;
  cost_per_unit: number | null;
  supplier: string | null;
  notes: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

function ReorderHistoryModal({
  material,
  onClose,
  onUpdated,
}: {
  material: MaterialRow;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdated: () => void;
}) {
  const {
    data: historyData,
    isLoading: loading,
    mutate: mutateHistory,
  } = useSWR<{ movements: ReorderMovement[] }>(
    `/api/admin/materials/${material.id}/reorders`,
    fetcher,
    {
      revalidateOnFocus: false,
      dedupingInterval: 60000,
      keepPreviousData: true,
    },
  );
  const movements = historyData?.movements ?? [];

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"reorder" | "history">("reorder");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState("");
  const [costPerUnit, setCostPerUnit] = useState("");
  const [supplier, setSupplier] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const canReorder = Number(quantity) > 0;

  async function handleAddReorder() {
    const qty = Number(quantity);
    if (!qty || qty <= 0) {
      toast.error("Enter a valid quantity.");
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/materials/${material.id}/reorders`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          quantity: qty,
          cost_per_unit: costPerUnit ? Number(costPerUnit) : undefined,
          supplier: supplier || undefined,
          notes: notes || undefined,
        }),
      });
      const json = await res.json().catch(() => null);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json?.error || "Failed to add reorder.");
      toast.success(`Restocked ${qty} unit(s) of ${material.name}.`);
      setQuantity("");
      setCostPerUnit("");
      setSupplier("");
      setNotes("");
      await mutateHistory();
      onUpdated();
      setActiveTab("history");
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Something went wrong.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal title={`Reorder — ${material.name}`} onClose={onClose}>
      <Tabs
        value={activeTab}
        onValueChange={(v) => setActiveTab(v as "reorder" | "history")}
        className="w-full space-y-4"
      >
        <TabsList className="w-full grid grid-cols-2 h-11 p-1 bg-muted rounded-xl border-0">
          <TabsTrigger
            value="reorder"
            className="text-base font-semibold h-9 rounded-lg data-[state=active]:bg-card data-[state=active]:text-foreground data-[state=active]:shadow-xs cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center transition-all"
          >
            Reorder
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger
            value="history"
            className="text-base font-semibold h-9 rounded-lg data-[state=active]:bg-card data-[state=active]:text-foreground data-[state=active]:shadow-xs cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all"
          >
            <span>Reorder History</span>
            {movements.length > 0 && (
              <span className="text-muted-foreground font-normal">
                ({movements.length})
              </span>
            )}
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="reorder" className="space-y-4 mt-0">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 p-3 bg-muted/50 rounded-lg">
            <div className="text-center">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Current Stock</p>
              <p className="text-base font-semibold tabular-nums">
                {material.stock}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Reorder Point</p>
              <p className="text-base font-semibold tabular-nums">
                {material.reorder_point}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Total Used</p>
              <p className="text-base font-semibold tabular-nums">
                {material.total_used ?? 0}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <Field label="Quantity (bf)">
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  maxLength={4}
                  value={quantity}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setQuantity(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4))
                  }
                  className="h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base"
                  placeholder="50"
                />
              </Field>
              <Field label="Cost/Unit (Optional)">
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  maxLength={5}
                  value={costPerUnit}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setCostPerUnit(
                      e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 5),
                    )
                  }
                  className="h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base"
                  placeholder="200"
                />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <Field label="Supplier (Optional)">
              <Input
                value={supplier}
                onChange={(e) => setSupplier(e.target.value)}
                className="h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base"
                placeholder="ABC Lumber Supply"
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Notes / Remarks (Optional)">
              <Textarea
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                rows={2}
                className="resize-none h-18 text-base placeholder:text-base"
                placeholder="Add restock notes"
              />
            </Field>

            <div className="-mb-4 flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-3.5 border-t border-border">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={submitting}
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="button"
                className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                onClick={handleAddReorder}
                disabled={submitting || !canReorder}
              >
                {submitting && (
                  <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
                )}
                Add Reorder
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="history" className="space-y-3 mt-0">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-10">
              <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin" />
            </div>
          ) : movements.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-10 space-y-2">
              <History className="size-8 text-muted-foreground/50 mx-auto" />
              <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                No reorders logged yet
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Reorder history entries will appear here whenever new material
                stock is added.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2.5 max-h-[420px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {movements.map((m) => (
                <div
                  key={m.id}
                  className="p-3 border rounded-lg bg-card/60 hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors space-y-1.5"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-sm font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 tabular-nums">
                        +{m.quantity_change} bf
                      </span>
                      {m.supplier && (
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          from{" "}
                          <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                            {m.supplier}
                          </span>
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {new Date(m.created_at).toLocaleDateString("en-PH", {
                        month: "short",
                        day: "numeric",
                        year: "numeric",
                        hour: "numeric",
                        minute: "2-digit",
                        hour12: true,
                      })}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span>Stock after:</span>
                      <span className="tabular-nums font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        {m.stock_after} bf
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {m.cost_per_unit && (
                      <span className="tabular-nums text-sm font-medium">
                        ₱{Number(m.cost_per_unit).toLocaleString()}/unit
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {m.notes && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground/80 bg-muted/60 rounded px-2.5 py-1 mt-1 italic border border-border/40">
                      &ldquo;{m.notes}&rdquo;
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </Modal>
  );
}

function SoldDetailsModal({
  product,
  onClose,
  onRestock,
}: {
  product: ProductRow;
  onClose: () => void;
  onRestock?: (product: ProductRow) => void;
}) {
  const { data, isLoading } = useSWR(
    `/api/admin/products/${product.id}/sold`,
    fetcher,
    {
      revalidateOnFocus: false,
      dedupingInterval: 60000,
      keepPreviousData: true,
    },
  );

  return (
    <Modal title={`Sold — ${product.name}`} onClose={onClose}>
      <div className="space-y-5">
        {}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 p-3 bg-muted/50 rounded-lg">
          <div className="text-center">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Total Sold</p>
            <p className="text-base font-semibold tabular-nums">
              {isLoading ? 0 : (data?.total_sold ?? 0)}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="text-center">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Available</p>
            <p className="text-base font-semibold tabular-nums">
              {product.available_stock}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="text-center">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Reserved</p>
            <p className="text-base font-semibold tabular-nums">
              {product.reserved_stock ?? 0}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 bg-muted/40 rounded-lg border border-border">
          <div>
            <p className="text-base font-semibold">
              Add stock or view restock history
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button
            type="button"
            className="h-9 px-4 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"
            onClick={() => {
              onClose();
              onRestock?.(product);
            }}
          >
            <PackagePlus size={16} />
            Restock
          </Button>
        </div>

        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="flex justify-center py-8">
            <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin" />
          </div>
        ) : !data || !data.recent || data.total_sold === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground text-center py-6">
            No sales recorded yet.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
              Recent Orders
            </p>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              {data.recent.map(
                (r: {
                  order_number: string;
                  quantity: number;
                  created_at: string;
                }) => (
                  <div
                    key={r.order_number}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between border rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <p className="font-medium text-base">{r.order_number}</p>
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        {new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString("en-PH", {
                          month: "short",
                          day: "numeric",
                          year: "numeric",
                        })}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium tabular-nums">
                      ×{r.quantity}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ),
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

interface ProductRestockItem {
  id: string;
  product_id: string;
  quantity_added: number;
  stock_before: number;
  stock_after: number;
  notes: string | null;
  created_by: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  profiles?: {
    full_name: string | null;
    email: string | null;
  } | null;
}

function ProductRestockModal({
  product,
  onClose,
  onUpdated,
}: {
  product: ProductRow;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdated: () => void;
}) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"restock" | "history">("restock");
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const {
    data,
    isLoading,
    mutate: mutateHistory,
  } = useSWR<{
    restocks: ProductRestockItem[];
  }>(`/api/admin/products/${product.id}/restock`, fetcher, {
    revalidateOnMount: true,
  });

  const restocks = data?.restocks ?? [];
  const canRestock = Number(quantity) > 0;

  async function handleAddRestock() {
    const qty = Number(quantity);
    if (!qty || qty <= 0) {
      toast.error("Enter a valid quantity greater than 0.");
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/products/${product.id}/restock`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          quantity: qty,
          notes: notes.trim() || undefined,
        }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as {
        error?: string;
      } | null;
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json?.error || "Failed to restock product.");

      toast.success(`Restocked ${qty} unit(s) of ${product.name}.`);
      setQuantity("");
      setNotes("");
      await mutateHistory();
      onUpdated();
      setActiveTab("history");
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Something went wrong.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal title={`Restock — ${product.name}`} onClose={onClose}>
      <Tabs
        value={activeTab}
        onValueChange={(v) => setActiveTab(v as "restock" | "history")}
        className="w-full space-y-4"
      >
        <TabsList className="w-full grid grid-cols-2 h-11 p-1 bg-muted rounded-xl border-0">
          <TabsTrigger
            value="restock"
            className="text-base font-semibold h-9 rounded-lg data-[state=active]:bg-card data-[state=active]:text-foreground data-[state=active]:shadow-xs cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center transition-all"
          >
            Restock
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger
            value="history"
            className="text-base font-semibold h-9 rounded-lg data-[state=active]:bg-card data-[state=active]:text-foreground data-[state=active]:shadow-xs cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all"
          >
            <span>Restock History</span>
            {restocks.length > 0 && (
              <span className="text-muted-foreground font-normal">
                ({restocks.length})
              </span>
            )}
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="restock" className="space-y-4 mt-0">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 p-3 bg-muted/50 rounded-lg">
            <div className="text-center">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Sold</p>
              <p className="text-base font-semibold tabular-nums">
                {product.total_sold ?? 0}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Current Stock</p>
              <p className="text-base font-semibold tabular-nums">
                {product.available_stock}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Reserved</p>
              <p className="text-base font-semibold tabular-nums">
                {product.reserved_stock ?? 0}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3">
            <Field label="Quantity to Add (pcs)">
              <Input
                type="text"
                inputMode="numeric"
                maxLength={4}
                value={quantity}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setQuantity(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4))
                }
                className="h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base"
                placeholder="10"
              />
            </Field>

            <Field label="Notes / Remarks (Optional)">
              <Textarea
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                rows={3}
                className="resize-none text-base placeholder:text-base"
                placeholder="Add restock notes (e.g. Finished batch from workshop)"
              />
            </Field>

            <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-3.5 -mb-4 border-t border-border">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={submitting}
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="button"
                className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                onClick={handleAddRestock}
                disabled={submitting || !canRestock}
              >
                {submitting && (
                  <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
                )}
                Restock Product
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="history" className="space-y-3 mt-0">
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-10">
              <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin" />
            </div>
          ) : restocks.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-10 space-y-2">
              <History className="size-8 text-muted-foreground/50 mx-auto" />
              <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                No restocks recorded yet
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Restock history entries will appear here whenever new stock is
                added.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2.5 max-h-[420px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {restocks.map((item) => {
                return (
                  <div
                    key={item.id}
                    className="p-3 border rounded-lg bg-card/60 hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors space-y-1.5"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-sm font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 tabular-nums">
                          +{item.quantity_added} pcs
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        {new Date(item.created_at).toLocaleDateString("en-PH", {
                          month: "short",
                          day: "numeric",
                          year: "numeric",
                          hour: "numeric",
                          minute: "2-digit",
                          hour12: true,
                        })}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      <span>Stock transition:</span>
                      <span className="tabular-nums font-medium text-foreground">
                        {item.stock_before}
                      </span>
                      <ArrowRight
                        size={13}
                        className="text-muted-foreground/60"
                      />
                      <span className="tabular-nums font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        {item.stock_after}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {item.notes && (
                      <p className="text-sm text-foreground/80 bg-muted/60 rounded px-2.5 py-1 mt-1  border border-border/40">
                        &ldquo;{item.notes}&rdquo;
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </Modal>
  );
}

function DeductionDetailsModal({

function RecordStockoutModal({
  products,
  materials,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}: {
  products: ProductRow[];
  materials: MaterialRow[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: () => void;
}) {
  const [itemType, setItemType] = useState<"product" | "material">("product");
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string>("");
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState<number>(1);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState<string>("");
  const [recipientName, setRecipientName] = useState<string>("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<string>("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const selectedProduct = products.find((p) => p.id === selectedId);
  const selectedMaterial = materials.find((m) => m.id === selectedId);

  const availableMax =
    itemType === "product"
      ? (selectedProduct?.available_stock ?? 0)
      : (selectedMaterial?.stock ?? 0);

  const unitLabel = itemType === "product" ? "pcs" : "bf";

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedId) {
      toast.error(
        `Please select a ${itemType === "product" ? "product" : "raw material"}.`,
      );
      return;
    }
    if (!reason) {
      toast.error("Please choose a deduction reason.");
      return;
    }
    if (quantity <= 0) {
      toast.error("Quantity must be at least 1.");
      return;
    }
    if (quantity > availableMax) {
      toast.error(
        `Quantity cannot exceed available stock (${availableMax} ${unitLabel}).`,
      );
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/inventory/stockout", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          item_type: itemType,
          item_id: selectedId,
          quantity,
          reason,
          recipient_name: recipientName,
          notes,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.error || "Failed to record deduction.");
      }

      toast.success(data.message || "Deduction recorded successfully.");
      onSuccess();
      onClose();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "An error occurred.";
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal title="Record Manual Deduction" onClose={() => !busy && onClose()}>
      <form
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className={cn(
          "space-y-4",
          busy && "cursor-wait opacity-80 pointer-events-none",
        )}
      >
        {}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <Field label="Item Classification">
            <Select
              value={itemType || undefined}
              onValueChange={(val) => {
                const nextType = val as "product" | "material";
                setItemType(nextType);
                setSelectedId("");
                setQuantity(1);
              }}
            >
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full h-10 text-base cursor-pointer">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Choose classification" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="product" className="text-base py-2">
                  Finished Product
                </SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="material" className="text-base py-2">
                  Raw Material (Lumber)
                </SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </Field>

          <Field label="Deduction Reason">
            <Select value={reason || undefined} onValueChange={setReason}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full h-10 text-base cursor-pointer">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Choose reason" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem
                  value="Physical Store Sale"
                  className="text-base py-2"
                >
                  Physical Store Sale (Walk-in)
                </SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="Worker Borrowed" className="text-base py-2">
                  Worker Borrowed / Workshop
                </SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="Workshop Use" className="text-base py-2">
                  Workshop Production Use
                </SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="Damaged / Defect" className="text-base py-2">
                  Damaged / Waste / Defect
                </SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="Other" className="text-base py-2">
                  Other / Manual Adjustment
                </SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </Field>
        </div>

        {}
        <Field label={itemType === "product" ? "Product" : "Raw Material"}>
          <Select
            value={selectedId || undefined}
            onValueChange={(val) => {
              setSelectedId(val);
              setQuantity(1);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-full h-10 text-base cursor-pointer">
              <SelectValue
                placeholder={
                  itemType === "product"
                    ? "Choose product"
                    : "Choose raw material"
                }
              />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent className="max-h-64">
              {itemType === "product"
                ? products.map((p) => (
                    <SelectItem
                      key={p.id}
                      value={p.id}
                      className="text-base py-2"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full gap-4">
                        <span className="font-semibold">{p.name}</span>
                        <span
                          className={cn(
                            "text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-medium",
                            p.available_stock > 5
                              ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                              : p.available_stock > 0
                                ? "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"
                                : "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive",
                          )}
                        >
                          {p.available_stock} available
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))
                : materials.map((m) => (
                    <SelectItem
                      key={m.id}
                      value={m.id}
                      className="text-base py-2"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full gap-4">
                        <span className="font-semibold">{m.name}</span>
                        <span
                          className={cn(
                            "text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-medium",
                            m.stock > 10
                              ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                              : m.stock > 0
                                ? "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"
                                : "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive",
                          )}
                        >
                          {m.stock} bf in stock
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </Field>

        {}
        {selectedId && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 p-3 bg-muted/50 rounded-lg">
            <div className="text-center">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Available Stock</p>
              <p className="text-base font-semibold tabular-nums text-foreground mt-0.5">
                {availableMax} {unitLabel}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">After Deduction</p>
              <p
                className={cn(
                  "text-base font-semibold tabular-nums mt-0.5",
                  availableMax - quantity < 0
                    ? "text-destructive"
                    : "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
                )}
              >
                {Math.max(0, availableMax - quantity)} {unitLabel}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <Field label={`Quantity to Deduct `}>
            <Input
              type="text"
              inputMode="numeric"
              maxLength={4}
              value={quantity || ""}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const val = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4);
                setQuantity(val === "" ? 0 : parseInt(val, 10));
              }}
              placeholder="1"
              className={cn(
                "h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base",
                selectedId && (quantity <= 0 || quantity > availableMax)
                  ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                  : "",
              )}
              required
            />
            {selectedId && quantity > availableMax && (
              <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
                Exceeds available stock ({availableMax} {unitLabel}).
              </p>
            )}
            {selectedId && quantity <= 0 && (
              <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
                Quantity must be at least 1.
              </p>
            )}
          </Field>

          <Field label="Name of Customer or Worker">
            <Input
              type="text"
              placeholder={
                itemType === "product"
                  ? "Enter Customer Name"
                  : "Enter Worker Name"
              }
              value={recipientName}
              onChange={(e) => setRecipientName(e.target.value)}
              className="h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base"
            />
          </Field>
        </div>

        {}
        <Field label="Notes / Remarks (Optional)">
          <Textarea
            placeholder="Add transaction reference or specific notes"
            value={notes}
            onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
            rows={2}
            className="resize-none h-18 text-base placeholder:text-base"
          />
        </Field>

        {}
        <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-3.5 -mb-0.5 border-t border-border">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={busy}
            className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="submit"
            disabled={
              busy ||
              !selectedId ||
              !reason ||
              availableMax <= 0 ||
              quantity <= 0 ||
              quantity > availableMax
            }
            className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
          >
            {busy && (
              <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
            )}
            Record Deduction
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}
