```typescript
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import InventoryAdmin from "@/components/admin-compo/inventory-admin";
import { expireAndCleanupPendingOrders } from "@/lib/supabase/stock";

import type { Metadata } from "next";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Inventory | Admin",
  description: "Manage products and raw materials",
};

export default async function InventoryPage() {

  await expireAndCleanupPendingOrders().catch(console.error);

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();

  const [{ data: products }, { data: materials }, { data: stockouts }] =
    await Promise.all([
      supabase
        .from("products")
        .select(
          `id,name,category,price,stock,reserved_stock,status,description,
     primary_image_url,hover_image_url,has_hover,is_wide,vehicle_slots,
     material,partner_id,created_at,updated_at,
     order_items:order_details(quantity,orders:orders(order_status,payment_status))`,
        )
        .eq("is_archived", false)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false }),
      supabase
        .from("raw_materials")
        .select(
          "id,name,category,stock,reorder_point,status,cost_per_unit,created_at,updated_at",
        )
        .eq("is_archived", false)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false }),
      supabase
        .from("inventory_stockouts")
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(200),
    ]);

  const productsWithAvailable = (products ?? []).map((p) => {
    const items = (p.order_items ?? []) as unknown as Array<{
      quantity: number;
      orders: { order_status: string; payment_status: string } | null;
    }>;

    const total_sold = items
      .filter(
        (i) =>
          i.orders?.payment_status === "Paid" &&
          i.orders?.order_status !== "Cancelled",
      )
      .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.quantity ?? 0), 0);

    const { order_items: _, ...rest } = p;

    return {
      ...rest,
      available_stock: Math.max(0, (p.stock ?? 0) - (p.reserved_stock ?? 0)),
      total_sold,
    };
  });

  return (
    <InventoryAdmin
      initialProducts={productsWithAvailable}
      initialMaterials={materials ?? []}
      initialStockouts={stockouts ?? []}
    />
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { expireAndCleanupPendingOrders } from "@/lib/supabase/stock";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/supabase/auth-guard";

type MaterialStatus = "Available" | "Low" | "Out";
type ProductStatus = "In Stock" | "Low Stock" | "Out of Stock";

function getMaterialStatus(
  stock: number,
  reorderPoint: number,
): MaterialStatus {
  if (stock <= 0) return "Out";
  if (stock <= reorderPoint) return "Low";
  return "Available";
}

function getProductStatus(availableStock: number): ProductStatus {
  if (availableStock <= 0) return "Out of Stock";
  if (availableStock <= 5) return "Low Stock";
  return "In Stock";
}

export async function GET() {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized: Admin privileges required." }, { status: 401 });
  }

  await expireAndCleanupPendingOrders().catch(console.error);

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();

  const [
    { data: products, error: pError },
    { data: materials, error: mError },
  ] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from("products")
      .select(
        `id,name,category,price,stock,reserved_stock,status,description,
     primary_image_url,hover_image_url,has_hover,is_wide,vehicle_slots,
     material,partner_id,created_at,updated_at,
     order_items:order_details(quantity,orders:orders(order_status,payment_status))`,
      )
      .eq("is_archived", false)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false }),
    supabase
      .from("raw_materials")
      .select(
        "id,name,category,stock,reorder_point,status,cost_per_unit,total_used,created_at,updated_at",
      )
      .eq("is_archived", false)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false }),
  ]);

  if (pError || mError) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: pError?.message || mError?.message },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }

  const productsWithAvailable = (products || []).map((p) => {
    const items = (p.order_items ?? []) as unknown as Array<{
      quantity: number;
      orders: { order_status: string; payment_status: string } | null;
    }>;

    const total_sold = items
      .filter(
        (i) =>
          i.orders?.payment_status === "Paid" &&
          i.orders?.order_status !== "Cancelled",
      )
      .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.quantity ?? 0), 0);

    const { order_items: _, ...rest } = p;

    const availableStock = Math.max(
      0,
      (p.stock ?? 0) - (p.reserved_stock ?? 0),
    );

    return {
      ...rest,
      available_stock: availableStock,
      status: getProductStatus(availableStock),
      total_sold,
    };
  });

  const materialsWithComputedStatus = (materials || []).map((m) => ({
    ...m,
    status: getMaterialStatus(
      Number(m.stock) || 0,
      Number(m.reorder_point) || 0,
    ),
  }));

  return NextResponse.json({
    products: productsWithAvailable,
    materials: materialsWithComputedStatus,
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { logAdminAction } from "@/lib/supabase/admin-logs";

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { supabase, ok: false as const, user: null, adminName: "Admin" };

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role, full_name, email")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  const adminName =
    profile?.full_name || profile?.email || user.email || "Admin";

  return {
    supabase,
    ok: profile?.role === "admin",
    user,
    adminName,
  };
}

export async function GET() {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const serviceClient = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data, error } = await serviceClient
    .from("inventory_stockouts")
    .select("*")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(200);

  if (error) {

    console.warn("Notice querying inventory_stockouts:", error.message);
    return NextResponse.json({ stockouts: [] });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ stockouts: data ?? [] });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok || !admin.user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const body = (await request.json()) as {
      item_type: "product" | "material";
      item_id: string;
      quantity: number;
      reason: string;
      recipient_name?: string;
      notes?: string;
    };

    const { item_type, item_id, quantity, reason, recipient_name, notes } =
      body;

    if (!item_id || !quantity || quantity <= 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Please provide a valid item and quantity to deduct." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const serviceClient = createServiceRoleClient();

    if (item_type === "product") {

      const { data: product, error: fetchErr } = await serviceClient
        .from("products")
        .select("id, name, category, stock, reserved_stock, material")
        .eq("id", item_id)
        .single();

      if (fetchErr || !product) {
        console.error("Error fetching product for stockout:", fetchErr);
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Product not found." },
          { status: 404 },
        );
      }

      const currentStock = Number(product.stock) || 0;
      const reservedStock = Number(product.reserved_stock) || 0;
      const availableStock = Math.max(0, currentStock - reservedStock);

      if (quantity > availableStock) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error: `Cannot deduct ${quantity} units. Only ${availableStock} available in stock (Stock: ${currentStock}, Reserved: ${reservedStock}).`,
          },
          { status: 400 },
        );
      }

      const newStock = Math.max(0, currentStock - quantity);
      const isPhysicalSale =
        reason === "Physical Store Sale" ||
        reason.toLowerCase().includes("physical") ||
        reason.toLowerCase().includes("sold");

      const newStatus =
        newStock <= 0
          ? "Out of Stock"
          : newStock - reservedStock <= 5
            ? "Low Stock"
            : "In Stock";

      const { error: updateErr } = await serviceClient
        .from("products")
        .update({
          stock: newStock,
          status: newStatus,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq("id", product.id);

      if (updateErr) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: `Failed to update product stock: ${updateErr.message}` },
          { status: 500 },
        );
      }

      if (product.material && isPhysicalSale) {
        const cleanWood = product.material.replace(/Lumber|Wood/gi, "").trim();
        const { data: mat } = await serviceClient
          .from("raw_materials")
          .select("id, stock, total_used, reorder_point, name")
          .ilike("name", `%${cleanWood}%`)
          .eq("is_archived", false)
          .limit(1)
          .maybeSingle();

        if (mat) {
          const bfToDeduct = 15 * quantity;
          const currentMatStock = Number(mat.stock) || 0;
          const currentMatUsed = Number(mat.total_used) || 0;
          const reorderPoint = Number(mat.reorder_point) || 10;
          const updatedMatStock = Math.max(0, currentMatStock - bfToDeduct);
          const updatedMatUsed = currentMatUsed + bfToDeduct;
          const newMatStatus =
            updatedMatStock <= 0
              ? "Out"
              : updatedMatStock <= reorderPoint
                ? "Low"
                : "Available";

          await serviceClient
            .from("raw_materials")
            .update({
              stock: updatedMatStock,
              total_used: updatedMatUsed,
              status: newMatStatus,
              updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            })
            .eq("id", mat.id);
        }
      }

      const { error: insertErr } = await serviceClient
        .from("inventory_stockouts")
        .insert({
          item_type: "product",
          item_id: product.id,
          item_name: product.name,
          category: product.category,
          quantity,
          stock_before: currentStock,
          stock_after: newStock,
          reason,
          recipient_name: recipient_name?.trim() || null,
          notes: notes?.trim() || null,
          admin_id: admin.user.id,
          admin_name: admin.adminName,
        });

      if (insertErr) {
        console.warn("Could not insert to inventory_stockouts:", insertErr.message);
      }

      await logAdminAction({
        action: "UPDATE",
        entity: `Product Stockout: ${product.name}`,
        details: `Deducted ${quantity} unit(s) of ${product.name}. Previous: ${currentStock}, Now: ${newStock}. Reason: ${reason}${recipient_name ? ` (To/By: ${recipient_name})` : ""}.`,
      });

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message: `Successfully deducted ${quantity} unit(s) of ${product.name}.`,
        item_id: product.id,
        stock_before: currentStock,
        stock_after: newStock,
      });
    } else {

      const { data: material, error: fetchErr } = await serviceClient
        .from("raw_materials")
        .select("id, name, category, stock, reorder_point, total_used")
        .eq("id", item_id)
        .single();

      if (fetchErr || !material) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Raw material not found." },
          { status: 404 },
        );
      }

      const currentStock = Number(material.stock) || 0;
      const reorderPoint = Number(material.reorder_point) || 10;
      const totalUsed = Number(material.total_used) || 0;

      if (quantity > currentStock) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error: `Cannot deduct ${quantity} bf. Only ${currentStock} bf available in stock.`,
          },
          { status: 400 },
        );
      }

      const newStock = Math.max(0, currentStock - quantity);
      const newTotalUsed = totalUsed + quantity;
      const newStatus =
        newStock <= 0
          ? "Out"
          : newStock <= reorderPoint
            ? "Low"
            : "Available";

      const { error: updateErr } = await serviceClient
        .from("raw_materials")
        .update({
          stock: newStock,
          total_used: newTotalUsed,
          status: newStatus,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq("id", material.id);

      if (updateErr) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: `Failed to update material stock: ${updateErr.message}` },
          { status: 500 },
        );
      }

      const { error: insertErr } = await serviceClient
        .from("inventory_stockouts")
        .insert({
          item_type: "material",
          item_id: material.id,
          item_name: material.name,
          category: material.category,
          quantity,
          stock_before: currentStock,
          stock_after: newStock,
          reason,
          recipient_name: recipient_name?.trim() || null,
          notes: notes?.trim() || null,
          admin_id: admin.user.id,
          admin_name: admin.adminName,
        });

      if (insertErr) {
        console.warn("Could not insert to inventory_stockouts:", insertErr.message);
      }

      await logAdminAction({
        action: "UPDATE",
        entity: `Material Stockout: ${material.name}`,
        details: `Deducted ${quantity} BF of ${material.name}. Previous: ${currentStock} BF, Now: ${newStock} BF. Total used: ${newTotalUsed} BF. Reason: ${reason}${recipient_name ? ` (Worker/Recipient: ${recipient_name})` : ""}.`,
      });

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message: `Successfully deducted ${quantity} BF of ${material.name}.`,
        item_id: material.id,
        stock_before: currentStock,
        stock_after: newStock,
      });
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Internal server error";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { logAdminAction } from "@/lib/supabase/admin-logs";

type MaterialStatus = "Available" | "Low" | "Out";
type MaterialCategory = "Wood & Board" | "Other";

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { supabase, ok: false as const };

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();
  return { supabase, ok: profile?.role === "admin" };
}

export async function PATCH(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  const { id } = await params;

  const body = (await request.json()) as {
    name?: string;
    category?: MaterialCategory;
    stock?: number;
    reorder_point?: number;
    status?: MaterialStatus;
    cost_per_unit?: number;
    archive?: boolean;
    restore?: boolean;
  };

  const { data: prev } = await admin.supabase
    .from("raw_materials")
    .select("name, category, stock, reorder_point, status, cost_per_unit")
    .eq("id", id)
    .single();

  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.archive) patch.is_archived = true;
  if (body.restore) patch.is_archived = false;
  if (typeof body.name === "string") patch.name = body.name.trim();
  if (typeof body.category === "string") patch.category = body.category;
  if (typeof body.stock === "number") patch.stock = body.stock;
  if (typeof body.reorder_point === "number")
    patch.reorder_point = body.reorder_point;
  if (typeof body.status === "string") patch.status = body.status;
  if (typeof body.cost_per_unit === "number")
    patch.cost_per_unit = body.cost_per_unit;

  const { error } = await admin.supabase
    .from("raw_materials")
    .update(patch)
    .eq("id", id);
  if (error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });

  const matName =
    (typeof body.name === "string" ? body.name : prev?.name) ||
    `Material ID ${id}`;

  if (body.archive) {
    await logAdminAction({
      action: "ARCHIVE",
      entity: "Materials",
      details: `Archived material: ${matName}`,
    });
  } else if (body.restore) {
    await logAdminAction({
      action: "RESTORE",
      entity: "Materials",
      details: `Restored material: ${matName}`,
    });
  } else if (prev) {
    const changes: string[] = [];
    if (body.name && body.name !== prev.name)
      changes.push(`Name: "${prev.name}" → "${body.name}"`);
    if (body.category && body.category !== prev.category)
      changes.push(`Category: "${prev.category}" → "${body.category}"`);
    if (typeof body.stock === "number" && body.stock !== prev.stock)
      changes.push(`Stock: ${prev.stock} → ${body.stock}`);
    if (
      typeof body.reorder_point === "number" &&
      body.reorder_point !== prev.reorder_point
    )
      changes.push(
        `Reorder point: ${prev.reorder_point} → ${body.reorder_point}`,
      );
    if (body.status && body.status !== prev.status)
      changes.push(`Status: "${prev.status}" → "${body.status}"`);
    if (
      typeof body.cost_per_unit === "number" &&
      body.cost_per_unit !== prev.cost_per_unit
    )
      changes.push(
        `Cost/unit: ₱${prev.cost_per_unit} → ₱${body.cost_per_unit}`,
      );

    const details =
      changes.length > 0
        ? `Updated ${matName}: ${changes.join(", ")}`
        : `Updated ${matName} (no field changes detected)`;

    await logAdminAction({ action: "UPDATE", entity: "Materials", details });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

export async function DELETE(
  _request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  const { id } = await params;

  const { data: mat } = await admin.supabase
    .from("raw_materials")
    .select("name")
    .eq("id", id)
    .single();
  const matName = mat?.name || `Material ID ${id}`;

  const { error } = await admin.supabase
    .from("raw_materials")
    .delete()
    .eq("id", id);
  if (error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });

  await logAdminAction({
    action: "DELETE",
    entity: "Materials",
    details: `Permanently deleted material: ${matName}`,
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { logAdminAction } from "@/lib/supabase/admin-logs";

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();

    data: { user },

    .single();

}

export async function GET(
  _request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  const { id } = await params;

  const { data, error } = await admin.supabase
    .from("material_stock_movements")
    .select(
      "id, quantity_change, stock_after, cost_per_unit, supplier, notes, created_at",
    )
    .eq("material_id", id)
    .eq("movement_type", "reorder")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });
  return NextResponse.json(
    { movements: data ?? [] },
    {
      headers: {
        "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=15, stale-while-revalidate=30",
      },
    },
  );
}

export async function POST(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  const { id } = await params;

  const body = (await request.json()) as {
    quantity: number;
    cost_per_unit?: number;
    supplier?: string;
    notes?: string;
  };

  if (!body.quantity || body.quantity <= 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Quantity must be greater than 0." },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }

  const { data: material, error: matErr } = await admin.supabase
    .from("raw_materials")
    .select("name, stock, reorder_point")
    .eq("id", id)
    .single();

  if (matErr || !material) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Material not found." }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const newStock = Number(material.stock) + Number(body.quantity);
  const newStatus =
    newStock <= 0
      ? "Out"
      : newStock <= material.reorder_point
        ? "Low"
        : "Available";

  const updatePatch: Record<string, unknown> = {
    stock: newStock,
    status: newStatus,
  };

  const { error: updateErr } = await admin.supabase
    .from("raw_materials")
    .update(updatePatch)
    .eq("id", id);
  if (updateErr)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: updateErr.message }, { status: 400 });

  const { error: insertErr } = await admin.supabase
    .from("material_stock_movements")
    .insert({
      material_id: id,
      movement_type: "reorder",
      quantity_change: body.quantity,
      stock_after: newStock,
      cost_per_unit: body.cost_per_unit ?? null,
      supplier: body.supplier?.trim() || null,
      notes: body.notes?.trim() || null,
      created_by: admin.userId,
    });
  if (insertErr)
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { logAdminAction } from "@/lib/supabase/admin-logs";

type ProductStatus = "In Stock" | "Low Stock" | "Out of Stock";
type ProductCategory = "Chair" | "Table" | "Cabinet" | "Bedframe" | "Door";
interface ProductDetailBody {
  price_adjustment: number;
  image_url: string;
  storage_path: string;
  label?: string | null;
  sort_order?: number;
}

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { supabase, ok: false as const };

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();
  return { supabase, ok: profile?.role === "admin" };
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const body = (await request.json()) as {
    name: string;
    category: ProductCategory;
    stock: number;
    price: number;
    status: ProductStatus;
    description?: string;
    primary_image_url?: string | null;
    hover_image_url?: string | null;
    has_hover?: boolean;
    is_wide?: boolean;
    vehicle_slots?: number;
    material?: string;
    partner_id?: string | null;

    _createOnly?: boolean;
    details?: ProductDetailBody[];
  };

  const { data: product, error: productError } = await admin.supabase
    .from("products")
    .insert({
      name: body.name.trim(),
      category: body.category,
      stock: body.stock,
      price: body.price,
      status: body.status,
      description: body.description?.trim() || null,
      is_archived: false,
      primary_image_url: body.primary_image_url || null,
      hover_image_url: body.hover_image_url || null,
      has_hover: body.has_hover ?? false,
      is_wide: body.is_wide ?? false,
      vehicle_slots: body.vehicle_slots ?? 1,
      material: body.material?.trim() || null,
      partner_id: body.partner_id || null,
    })
    .select("id")
    .single();

  if (productError || !product) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: productError?.message ?? "Failed to create product" },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }

  if (body._createOnly) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, id: product.id });
  }

  if (body.details && body.details.length > 0) {
    const detailsPayload = body.details.map((d) => ({
      product_id: product.id,
      image_url: d.image_url,

      storage_path: d.storage_path.startsWith("http")
        ? (d.storage_path.split("/storage/v1/object/public/products/")[1] ??
          d.storage_path)
        : d.storage_path,
      label: d.label ?? null,
      sort_order: d.sort_order ?? 0,
    }));

    const { error: detailsError } = await admin.supabase
      .from("product_details")
      .insert(detailsPayload);

    if (detailsError) {

      await admin.supabase.from("products").delete().eq("id", product.id);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: detailsError.message },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }
  }

  await logAdminAction({
    action: "CREATE",
    entity: "Products",
    details: `Added new product: ${body.name} (${body.category})`,
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, id: product.id });
}
```

```typescript
export async function PATCH(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const supabaseAdmin = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { id } = await params;

  const body = (await request.json()) as {
    name?: string;

    archive?: boolean;
    restore?: boolean;
    primary_image_url?: string | null;
    hover_image_url?: string | null;
    has_hover?: boolean;
    is_wide?: boolean;
    vehicle_slots?: number;
    material?: string | null;
    partner_id?: string | null;

    details?: ProductDetailBody[];
  };

  const { data: prev } = await supabaseAdmin
    .from("products")
    .select(
      "name, category, stock, price, status, description, primary_image_url, hover_image_url, has_hover, is_wide, vehicle_slots, material, partner_id",
    )
    .eq("id", id)
    .single();

  const { data: existingDetailsBefore, error: detailsErr } =
    await supabaseAdmin
      .from("product_details")
      .select(
        "id, storage_path, image_url, label, sort_order",
      )
      .eq("product_id", id);

  if (detailsErr) {
    console.error("existingDetailsBefore select error:", detailsErr);
  }

  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.archive) patch.is_archived = true;
  if (body.restore) patch.is_archived = false;
  if (typeof body.name === "string") patch.name = body.name.trim();
  if (typeof body.category === "string") patch.category = body.category;
  if (typeof body.stock === "number") patch.stock = body.stock;
  if (typeof body.price === "number") patch.price = body.price;
  if (typeof body.status === "string") patch.status = body.status;
  if (typeof body.description === "string")
    patch.description = body.description.trim() || null;
  if (body.primary_image_url !== undefined)
    patch.primary_image_url = body.primary_image_url;
  if (body.hover_image_url !== undefined)
    patch.hover_image_url = body.hover_image_url;
  if (body.has_hover !== undefined) patch.has_hover = body.has_hover;
  if (body.is_wide !== undefined) patch.is_wide = body.is_wide;
  if (body.vehicle_slots !== undefined)
    patch.vehicle_slots = body.vehicle_slots;
  if (body.material !== undefined)
    patch.material = body.material?.trim() || null;
  if (body.partner_id !== undefined) patch.partner_id = body.partner_id;

  const { error } = await supabaseAdmin
    .from("products")
    .update(patch)
    .eq("id", id);

  if (error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });

  if (body.details && Array.isArray(body.details) && body.details.length > 0) {
    for (const detail of body.details) {
      const existing = existingDetailsBefore?.find((d) => {
        if (detail.label && d.label) {
          return d.label.trim().toLowerCase() === detail.label.trim().toLowerCase();
        }
        return false;
      });

      const cleanStoragePath = detail.storage_path.startsWith("http")
        ? (detail.storage_path.split(
            "/storage/v1/object/public/products/",
          )[1] ?? detail.storage_path)
        : detail.storage_path.replace(/^products\

      if (existing) {

        const { error: updateErr } = await supabaseAdmin
          .from("product_details")
          .update({
            image_url: detail.image_url,
            storage_path: cleanStoragePath,
            label: detail.label ?? existing.label,
            sort_order: detail.sort_order ?? existing.sort_order,
          })
          .eq("id", existing.id);

        if (updateErr) {
          console.error(
            `Failed to update detail for ${detail.label}:`,
            updateErr,
          );
        }
      } else {

        const { error: insertErr } = await supabaseAdmin
          .from("product_details")
          .insert({
            product_id: id,
            image_url: detail.image_url,
            storage_path: cleanStoragePath,
            label: detail.label ?? null,
            sort_order: detail.sort_order ?? 0,
          });

        if (insertErr) {
          console.error(
            `Failed to insert detail for ${detail.label ?? "detail"}:`,
            insertErr,
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const prodName =
    (typeof body.name === "string" ? body.name : prev?.name) ||
    `Product ID ${id}`;

  if (body.archive) {
    await logAdminAction({
      action: "ARCHIVE",
      entity: "Products",
      details: `Archived product: ${prodName}`,
    });
  } else if (body.restore) {
    await logAdminAction({
      action: "RESTORE",
      entity: "Products",
      details: `Restored product: ${prodName}`,
    });
  } else if (prev) {
    const changes: string[] = [];
    if (body.name && body.name !== prev.name)
      changes.push(`Name: "${prev.name}" → "${body.name}"`);
    if (body.description !== undefined && body.description !== prev.description)
      changes.push(`Description updated`);
    if (body.category && body.category !== prev.category)
      changes.push(`Category: "${prev.category}" → "${body.category}"`);
    if (typeof body.stock === "number" && body.stock !== prev.stock)
      changes.push(`Stock: ${prev.stock} → ${body.stock}`);
    if (typeof body.price === "number" && body.price !== prev.price)
      changes.push(`Price: ₱${prev.price} → ₱${body.price}`);
    if (typeof body.status === "string" && body.status !== prev.status)
      changes.push(`Status: "${prev.status}" → "${body.status}"`);
    if (
      body.primary_image_url !== undefined &&
      body.primary_image_url !== prev.primary_image_url
    )
      changes.push(`Primary image updated`);
    if (
      body.hover_image_url !== undefined &&
      body.hover_image_url !== prev.hover_image_url
    )
      changes.push(`Hover image updated`);
    if (body.has_hover !== undefined && body.has_hover !== prev.has_hover)
      changes.push(`Has hover: ${prev.has_hover} → ${body.has_hover}`);
    if (body.is_wide !== undefined && body.is_wide !== prev.is_wide)
      changes.push(`Is wide: ${prev.is_wide} → ${body.is_wide}`);
    if (
      body.vehicle_slots !== undefined &&
      body.vehicle_slots !== prev.vehicle_slots
    )
      changes.push(
        `Vehicle slots: ${prev.vehicle_slots} → ${body.vehicle_slots}`,
      );
    if (body.material !== undefined && body.material !== prev.material)
      changes.push(`Material: "${prev.material}" → "${body.material}"`);
    if (body.partner_id !== undefined && body.partner_id !== prev.partner_id)
      changes.push(`Partner ID: "${prev.partner_id}" → "${body.partner_id}"`);
    if (body.details) {
      for (const incoming of body.details) {
        const before = existingDetailsBefore?.find((d) => {
          if (incoming.label && d.label) {
            return d.label.trim().toLowerCase() === incoming.label.trim().toLowerCase();
          }
          return false;
        });
        const nameKey = incoming.label ?? "detail";
        if (!before) {
          changes.push(`Added: ${nameKey}`);
        } else {

          const newBase = incoming.image_url.split("?")[0];
          const oldBase = (before.image_url ?? "").split("?")[0];
          if (newBase !== oldBase) changes.push(`${nameKey} image updated`);
        }
      }
    }
    const details =
      changes.length > 0
        ? `Updated ${prodName}: ${changes.join(", ")}`
        : `Updated ${prodName} (no field changes detected)`;
    await logAdminAction({ action: "UPDATE", entity: "Products", details });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { logAdminAction } from "@/lib/supabase/admin-logs";

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user)
    return { supabase, ok: false as const, userId: null as string | null };

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  return { supabase, ok: profile?.role === "admin", userId: user.id };
}

export async function GET(
  _request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const serviceSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();

  const { data, error } = await serviceSupabase
    .from("product_restocks")
    .select(
      "id, product_id, quantity_added, stock_before, stock_after, notes, created_by, created_at, profiles:created_by ( full_name, email )",
    )
    .eq("product_id", id)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) {

    if (
      error.code === "PGRST205" ||
      error.message?.includes("product_restocks")
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json({ restocks: [] });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(
    { restocks: data ?? [] },
    {
      headers: {
        "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=15, stale-while-revalidate=30",
      },
    },
  );
}

export async function POST(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const body = (await request.json()) as {
    quantity: number;
    notes?: string;
  };

  const qty = Number(body.quantity);
  if (!qty || isNaN(qty) || qty <= 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Quantity must be greater than 0." },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }

  const serviceSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();

  const { data: product, error: prodErr } = await serviceSupabase
    .from("products")
    .select("id, name, stock, reserved_stock, status")
    .eq("id", id)
    .single();

  if (prodErr || !product) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found." }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const stockBefore = Number(product.stock) || 0;
  const stockAfter = stockBefore + qty;
  const reserved = Number(product.reserved_stock) || 0;
  const availableStock = Math.max(0, stockAfter - reserved);

  const newStatus =
    availableStock <= 0
      ? "Out of Stock"
      : availableStock <= 5
        ? "Low Stock"
        : "In Stock";

  const { error: updateErr } = await serviceSupabase
    .from("products")
    .update({
      stock: stockAfter,
      status: newStatus,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq("id", id);

  if (updateErr) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: updateErr.message }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const { error: insertErr } = await serviceSupabase
    .from("product_restocks")
    .insert({
      product_id: id,
      quantity_added: qty,
      stock_before: stockBefore,
      stock_after: stockAfter,
      notes: body.notes?.trim() || null,
      created_by: admin.userId,
    });

  if (insertErr) {
    console.warn("Could not insert product_restocks record:", insertErr.message);
  }

  await logAdminAction({
    action: "UPDATE",
    entity: "Products",
    details: `Restocked ${qty} unit(s) of ${product.name}. Stock updated from ${stockBefore} to ${stockAfter}.`,
  });

  return NextResponse.json({
    ok: true,
    stock: stockAfter,
    available_stock: availableStock,
    status: newStatus,
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

export async function GET(
  _req: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();
  if (profile?.role !== "admin")
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;

  const adminSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data: items } = await adminSupabase
    .from("order_details")
    .select(
      `
    quantity,
    orders!inner(order_number, created_at, order_status, payment_status)
  `,
    )
    .eq("product_id", id);

  type OrderJoin = {
    order_number: string;
    created_at: string;
    order_status: string;
    payment_status: string;
  };

  const validItems = (items ?? []).filter(
    (i): i is typeof i & { orders: OrderJoin } =>
      i.orders !== null &&
      !Array.isArray(i.orders) &&
      (i.orders as OrderJoin).payment_status === "Paid" &&
      (i.orders as OrderJoin).order_status !== "Cancelled",
  );

  const total_sold = validItems.reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.quantity ?? 0), 0);

  const recent = validItems
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        new Date(b.orders.created_at).getTime() -
        new Date(a.orders.created_at).getTime(),
    )
    .slice(0, 10)
    .map((i) => ({
      order_number: i.orders.order_number,
      quantity: i.quantity,
      created_at: i.orders.created_at,
    }));

  return NextResponse.json(
    { total_sold, recent },
    {
      headers: {
        "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=15, stale-while-revalidate=30",
      },
    },
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "./service-role";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { logSystemEvent } from "./admin-logs";

export async function checkAvailableStock(
  productId: string,
  requiredQuantity: number,
): Promise<{
  available: boolean;
  availableStock: number;
  productName?: string;
}> {
  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("stock, reserved_stock, name")
    .eq("id", productId)
    .single();

  if (error || !data) {
    return { available: false, availableStock: 0 };
  }

  const availableStock = (data.stock ?? 0) - (data.reserved_stock ?? 0);
  return {
    available: availableStock >= requiredQuantity,
    availableStock,
    productName: data.name,
  };
}

export async function reserveStock(
  productId: string,
  quantity: number,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
    try {
      const { data, error: fetchError } = await supabase
        .from("products")
        .select("stock, reserved_stock")
        .eq("id", productId)
        .single();

      if (fetchError || !data) {
        console.error(
          `Error fetching stock for product ${productId}:`,
          fetchError,
        );
        return false;
      }

      const currentReserved = data.reserved_stock ?? 0;
      const currentStock = data.stock ?? 0;
      const availableStock = currentStock - currentReserved;

      if (availableStock < quantity) {
        console.warn(
          `Cannot reserve stock for ${productId}: only ${availableStock} available, requested ${quantity}.`,
        );
        return false;
      }

      const newReserved = currentReserved + quantity;

      const { data: updated, error: updateError } = await supabase
        .from("products")
        .update({ reserved_stock: newReserved })
        .eq("id", productId)
        .eq("reserved_stock", currentReserved)
        .select("id")
        .maybeSingle();

      if (!updateError && updated) {
        return true;
      }

      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50 * (attempt + 1)));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`Unexpected error reserving stock for ${productId}:`, err);
      return false;
    }
  }

  return false;
}

export async function releaseStock(
  productId: string,
  quantity: number,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();

  try {
    const { data, error: fetchError } = await supabase
      .from("products")
      .select("reserved_stock")
      .eq("id", productId)
      .single();

    if (fetchError || !data) {
      console.error(
        `Error fetching reserved_stock for product ${productId}:`,
        fetchError,
      );
      return false;
    }

    const newReserved = Math.max(0, (data.reserved_stock ?? 0) - quantity);

    const { error: updateError } = await supabase
      .from("products")
      .update({ reserved_stock: newReserved })
      .eq("id", productId);

    if (updateError) {
      console.error(
        `Error releasing stock for product ${productId}:`,
        updateError,
      );
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`Unexpected error releasing stock for ${productId}:`, err);
    return false;
  }
}

export async function deductStock(
  productId: string,
  quantity: number,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();

  try {
    const { data, error: fetchError } = await supabase
      .from("products")
      .select("stock, reserved_stock, material, name")
      .eq("id", productId)
      .single();

    if (fetchError || !data) {
      console.error(
        `Error fetching stock for product ${productId}:`,
        fetchError,
      );
      return false;
    }

    const newStock = Math.max(0, (data.stock ?? 0) - quantity);
    const newReserved = Math.max(0, (data.reserved_stock ?? 0) - quantity);

    const { error: updateError } = await supabase
      .from("products")
      .update({ stock: newStock, reserved_stock: newReserved })
      .eq("id", productId);

    if (updateError) {
      console.error(
        `Error deducting stock for product ${productId}:`,
        updateError,
      );
      return false;
    }

    if (data.material) {
      const cleanWood = data.material.replace(/Lumber|Wood/gi, "").trim();
      const { data: mat } = await supabase
        .from("raw_materials")
        .select("id, stock, total_used, reorder_point, name")
        .ilike("name", `%${cleanWood}%`)
        .eq("is_archived", false)
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (mat) {
        const bfToDeduct = 15 * quantity;
        const currentMatStock = Number(mat.stock) || 0;
        const currentMatUsed = Number(mat.total_used) || 0;
        const reorderPoint = Number(mat.reorder_point) || 10;

        const updatedMatStock = Math.max(0, currentMatStock - bfToDeduct);
        const updatedMatUsed = currentMatUsed + bfToDeduct;
        const newStatus =
          updatedMatStock <= 0
            ? "Out"
            : updatedMatStock <= reorderPoint
              ? "Low"
              : "Available";

        await supabase
          .from("raw_materials")
          .update({
            stock: updatedMatStock,
            total_used: updatedMatUsed,
            status: newStatus,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          })
          .eq("id", mat.id);

        console.log(
          `Deducted ${bfToDeduct} BF of ${mat.name} for product purchase ${data.name}. Total used: ${updatedMatUsed}`,
        );
      }
    }

    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`Unexpected error deducting stock for ${productId}:`, err);
    return false;
  }
}

export async function expireAndCleanupPendingOrders(): Promise<{
  expired: number;
  orderNumbers: string[];
}> {
  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();

  try {
    const { data: expiredOrders, error: fetchError } = await supabase
      .from("orders")
      .select("id, order_number, customer_name, voucher_code")
      .eq("payment_status", "Pending Payment")
      .lt("created_at", cutoff);

    if (fetchError || !expiredOrders || expiredOrders.length === 0) {
      return { expired: 0, orderNumbers: [] };
    }

    const expiredIds = expiredOrders.map((o) => o.id);

    const { data: orderItems, error: itemsError } = await supabase
      .from("order_details")
      .select("order_id, product_id, quantity")
      .in("order_id", expiredIds);

    if (itemsError) {
      console.error(
        "Failed to fetch order items for expired orders:",
        itemsError,
      );
    }

    if (orderItems && orderItems.length > 0) {
      await Promise.allSettled(
        orderItems.map((item) =>
          item.product_id
            ? releaseStock(item.product_id, item.quantity)
            : Promise.resolve(),
        ),
      );
    }

    const voucherCodes = expiredOrders
      .map((o) => o.voucher_code)
      .filter((code): code is string => !!code);

    if (voucherCodes.length > 0) {
      const { error: voucherError } = await supabase
        .from("vouchers")
        .update({ is_used: false })
        .in("code", voucherCodes)
        .eq("is_used", true);

      if (voucherError) {
        console.error(
          "Failed to revert vouchers for expired orders:",
          voucherError,
        );
      }
    }

    await supabase.from("order_details").delete().in("order_id", expiredIds);
    await supabase.from("orders").delete().in("id", expiredIds);

    revalidatePath("/admin/orders");
    revalidatePath("/admin/inventory");
    revalidatePath("/profile");
    revalidatePath("/");
    revalidatePath("/furniture");
    revalidatePath("/chairs");
    revalidatePath("/tables");
    revalidatePath("/cabinets");
    revalidatePath("/bed-frames");
    revalidatePath("/doors");

    const orderNumbers = expiredOrders.map((o) => o.order_number);
    await logSystemEvent({
      action: "DELETE",
      entity: "Orders",
      details: `Auto-cancelled and removed ${expiredOrders.length} expired pending order(s) (>24h unpaid). Stock retrieved: ${orderNumbers.join(", ")}`,
    });

    console.log(
      `Auto-cancelled & deleted ${expiredOrders.length} expired pending orders:`,
      orderNumbers,
    );
    return { expired: expiredOrders.length, orderNumbers };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Error executing expireAndCleanupPendingOrders:", err);
    return { expired: 0, orderNumbers: [] };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { cache } from "react";
import { createClient } from "./server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "./service-role";

export type ProductCategory = "Chair" | "Table" | "Cabinet" | "Bedframe" | "Door";
export type ProductStatus = "In Stock" | "Low Stock" | "Out of Stock";

export interface Product {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: ProductCategory;
  price: number;
  stock: number;
  status: ProductStatus;
  description: string | null;
  is_archived: boolean;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  primary_image_url?: string | null;
  hover_image_url?: string | null;
  subtitle?: string | null;
  is_wide?: boolean;
  material?: string | null;
  partner_id?: string | null;
  has_hover?: boolean;
  average_rating?: number;
  sold_count?: number;
  reserved_stock?: number;
  available_stock?: number;
}

export interface ProductDetail {
  id: string;
  product_id: string;
  image_url: string;
  storage_path: string;
  price_adjustment: number;
  sort_order: number;
  label: string | null;
  created_at: string;
}

export interface ProductWithDetails extends Product {
  details: ProductDetail[];
}

export interface ProductReview {
  id: string;
  rating: number;
  comment: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  customer: { full_name: string | null } | null;
}

export const getProductReviews = cache(async function getProductReviews(productId: string): Promise<ProductReview[]> {
  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("reviews")
    .select("id, rating, comment, created_at, customer:profiles(full_name)")
    .eq("product_id", productId)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching product reviews:", error);
    return [];
  }

  return (data ?? []).map((item) => ({
    id: item.id,
    rating: item.rating,
    comment: item.comment,
    created_at: item.created_at,
    customer: (item.customer as unknown as { full_name: string | null }) ?? null,
  })) as ProductReview[];
});

export const getProducts = cache(async function getProducts(category?: ProductCategory): Promise<Product[]> {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  let query = supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("*")
    .eq("is_archived", false)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

  if (category) query = query.eq("category", category);

  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error || !data) {
    console.error("Error fetching products:", error);
    return [];
  }

  const products = data as Product[];
  if (products.length === 0) return [];

  const productIds = products.map((p) => p.id);

  const serviceSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const [{ data: reviews }, { data: orderItems }] = await Promise.all([
    serviceSupabase
      .from("reviews")
      .select("product_id, rating")
      .in("product_id", productIds),
    serviceSupabase
      .from("order_details")
      .select("product_id, quantity, orders!inner(payment_status)")
      .in("product_id", productIds)
      .eq("orders.payment_status", "Paid"),
  ]);

  const statsMap: Record<string, { totalRating: number; reviewCount: number; soldCount: number }> = {};

  (reviews || []).forEach((r: { product_id: string | null; rating: number }) => {
    if (!r.product_id) return;
    if (!statsMap[r.product_id]) {
      statsMap[r.product_id] = { totalRating: 0, reviewCount: 0, soldCount: 0 };
    }
    statsMap[r.product_id].totalRating += Number(r.rating) || 0;
    statsMap[r.product_id].reviewCount += 1;
  });

  (orderItems || []).forEach((item: { product_id: string | null; quantity: number }) => {
    if (!item.product_id) return;
    if (!statsMap[item.product_id]) {
      statsMap[item.product_id] = { totalRating: 0, reviewCount: 0, soldCount: 0 };
    }
    statsMap[item.product_id].soldCount += Number(item.quantity) || 0;
  });

  return products.map((p) => {
    const stat = statsMap[p.id];
    const avg = stat && stat.reviewCount > 0 ? stat.totalRating / stat.reviewCount : 5.0;
    const sold = stat ? stat.soldCount : 0;
    const available = Math.max(0, (p.stock ?? 0) - (p.reserved_stock ?? 0));
    return {
      ...p,
      average_rating: Math.round(avg * 10) / 10,
      sold_count: sold,
      reserved_stock: p.reserved_stock ?? 0,
      available_stock: available,
      status: (available <= 0 ? "Out of Stock" : available <= 5 ? "Low Stock" : "In Stock") as ProductStatus,
    };
  });
});

export const getProductById = cache(async function getProductById(id: string): Promise<ProductWithDetails | null> {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const { data: product, error } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("*")
    .eq("id", id)
    .eq("is_archived", false)
    .single();

  if (error || !product) return null;

  const { data: details } = await supabase
    .from("product_details")
    .select("*")
    .eq("product_id", id)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

  const available = Math.max(0, (product.stock ?? 0) - (product.reserved_stock ?? 0));

  return {
    ...(product as Product),
    reserved_stock: product.reserved_stock ?? 0,
    available_stock: available,
    status: (available <= 0 ? "Out of Stock" : available <= 5 ? "Low Stock" : "In Stock") as ProductStatus,
    details: (details ?? []) as ProductDetail[],
  };
});

export const getPartnerProduct = cache(async function getPartnerProduct(partnerId: string): Promise<Product | null> {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("*")
    .eq("id", partnerId)
    .eq("is_archived", false)
    .single();

  if (error || !data) return null;
  const available = Math.max(0, (data.stock ?? 0) - (data.reserved_stock ?? 0));
  return {
    ...(data as Product),
    reserved_stock: data.reserved_stock ?? 0,
    available_stock: available,
    status: (available <= 0 ? "Out of Stock" : available <= 5 ? "Low Stock" : "In Stock") as ProductStatus,
  };
});

export function formatPrice(price: number): string {
  return `PHP ${price.toLocaleString("en-PH", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

export function calculateFinalPrice(
  basePrice: number,
  priceAdjustment: number
): number {
  return basePrice + priceAdjustment;
}
```

```typescript
interface FurnitureComponent {
  name: string;
  thickness: string;
  width: string;
  height: string;
  qty: string;
}

function sanitizeNumericInput(val: string, allowDecimal = true): string {
  let sanitized = val.replace(/-/g, "");
  if (allowDecimal) {
    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, "");
    const parts = sanitized.split(".");
    if (parts.length > 2) {
      sanitized = parts[0] + "." + parts.slice(1).join("");
    }
  } else {
    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
  }
  return sanitized;
}

const COMPONENT_LINE_REGEX =
  /(.+?)\s*\((\d+(?:\.\d+)?)"?[xX×](\d+(?:\.\d+)?)"?[xX×](\d+(?:\.\d+)?)"?\s*[xX×](\d+)\):\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*BF/i;

function parseComponentLine(line: string): FurnitureComponent | null {
  const cleaned = line.replace(/^\s*[•\-*]\s*/, "").trim();
  const match = cleaned.match(COMPONENT_LINE_REGEX);
  if (!match) return null;
  return {
    name: match[1].trim(),
    thickness: match[2],
    width: match[3],
    height: match[4],
    qty: match[5],
  };
}

function parseComponentsFromReasoning(
  reasoning: string | null,
): FurnitureComponent[] {
  if (!reasoning) return [];

  const list: FurnitureComponent[] = [];

  // Current format from /api/estimate
  const newFormatMatch = reasoning.match(
    /COMPONENTS BREAKDOWN[^:]*:([\s\S]*?)(?:\n\s*[•\-*]\s*Waste \(10%\)|LABOR ALLOCATION|$)/i,
  );
  if (newFormatMatch) {
    for (const line of newFormatMatch[1].split("\n")) {
      const parsed = parseComponentLine(line);
      if (parsed) list.push(parsed);
    }
    if (list.length > 0) return list;
  }

  // Legacy format: "material breakdown:" with pipe-separated segments
  const legacyParts = reasoning.split(/material breakdown:/i);
  if (legacyParts.length >= 2) {
    const breakdownPart = legacyParts[1].split("Waste (10%)")[0];
    for (const seg of breakdownPart.split("|")) {
      const parsed = parseComponentLine(seg);
      if (parsed) list.push(parsed);
    }
  }

  return list;
}

  const hasEditHistory =
    (req.edit_count ?? 0) > 0 ||

  );
}

): string {

  return String(value);
```
