  >("");

  // Worker selection state
  const [selectedSkilledWorkers, setSelectedSkilledWorkers] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedHelperWorkers, setSelectedHelperWorkers] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isWorkerSelectionOpen, setIsWorkerSelectionOpen] = useState(false);
  const [workerSearchQuery, setWorkerSearchQuery] = useState("");
  // Dynamically compute all available wood types from DB materials + defaults
  const allWoodTypes = useMemo(() => {
    const listSet = new Set<string>();

    if (woodMaterials && woodMaterials.length > 0) {
      woodMaterials.forEach((m) => {
        const clean =
          m.cleanName ||
          m.name.replace(/\s*(Lumber|Wood|Plywood|Board)$/i, "").trim();
        if (clean) listSet.add(clean);
      });
    }

    if (archivedMaterialNames && archivedMaterialNames.length > 0) {
      archivedMaterialNames.forEach((n) => {
        const clean = n.replace(/\s*(Lumber|Wood|Plywood|Board)$/i, "").trim();
        if (clean) listSet.add(clean);
      });
    }

    DEFAULT_WOOD_TYPES.forEach((w) => listSet.add(w));

    return Array.from(listSet);
  }, [woodMaterials, archivedMaterialNames]);

  // enabledWoods comes from DB — this is now the source of truth
  const [enabledWoods, setEnabledWoods] = useState<string[]>(
    initialSettings?.enabled_wood_types ?? allWoodTypes,
  );
  const [savingSettings, setSavingSettings] = useState(false);
  const [confirmSettings, setConfirmSettings] = useState(false);

  const hasSettingsChanges = useMemo(
    () =>
      laborRate !== String(initialSettings?.labor_rate_per_day ?? 750) ||
      helperRate !== String(initialSettings?.helper_rate_per_day ?? 450) ||
      markupPct !== String(initialSettings?.markup_percent ?? 30) ||
      JSON.stringify([...enabledWoods].sort()) !==
        JSON.stringify(
          [...(initialSettings?.enabled_wood_types ?? allWoodTypes)].sort(),
        ),
    [
      laborRate,
      helperRate,
      markupPct,
      enabledWoods,
      initialSettings,
      allWoodTypes,
    ],
  );

  // ── Workers State ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [workerSearch, setWorkerSearch] = useState("");
  const [workerStatusFilter, setWorkerStatusFilter] = useState<
    "all" | "available" | "in_use"
  >("all");
  const [isAddWorkerOpen, setIsAddWorkerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [addWorkerName, setAddWorkerName] = useState("");
  const [addWorkerPhone, setAddWorkerPhone] = useState("");
  const [addWorkerCategory, setAddWorkerCategory] = useState<
    "skilled" | "helper"
  >("skilled");
  const [addWorkerBusy, setAddWorkerBusy] = useState(false);
  const [addWorkerError, setAddWorkerError] = useState("");
  const [selectedWorkerForView, setSelectedWorkerForView] = useState<{
    id: string;
    full_name: string;
    phone: string;
    category: "skilled" | "helper";
    created_at?: string;
    activeCount: number;
    completedCount: number;
    totalAssigned: number;
    is_in_use: boolean;
    allAssignments: Array<{
      id: string;
      requestNumber: string;
      customerName: string;
      furnitureDescription: string;
      assignedAt: string;
      completedAt?: string | null;
      skilledWorkersCount: number;
      helperWorkersCount: number;
      rawRequest?: any;
    }>;
  } | null>(null);

  // ── Workers SWR list ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: workersData, mutate: refreshWorkers } = useSWR<{
    workers: Array<{
      id: string;
      full_name: string;
      phone: string;
      category: "skilled" | "helper";
      created_at?: string;
      active_assignments: number;
      completed_assignments: number;
      total_assigned: number;
      is_in_use: boolean;
    }>;
  }>(
    "/api/admin/workers",
    (url: string) => fetch(url).then((res) => res.json()),
    {
      fallbackData: { workers: [] },
      revalidateOnFocus: true,
      revalidateOnMount: true,
      refreshInterval: 5000, // Refresh every 5 seconds for real-time updates
    },
  );
  const registeredWorkers = workersData?.workers ?? [];

  // ── Worker Assignments SWR ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: assignmentsData, mutate: refreshAssignments } = useSWR<{
    assignments: Array<{
      id: string;
      worker_id: string;
      customize_request_id: string;
      assigned_at: string;
      released_at: string | null;
      status: "assigned" | "released";
      workers: {
        id: string;
        full_name: string;
        phone: string;
        category: "skilled" | "helper";
      };
      customize_requests: {
        id: string;
        request_number: string;
        customer_name: string;
        furniture_description: string;
        status: string;
      };
    }>;
  }>(
    "/api/admin/worker-assignments",
    (url: string) => fetch(url).then((res) => res.json()),
    {
      fallbackData: { assignments: [] },
      revalidateOnFocus: true,
      revalidateOnMount: true,
      refreshInterval: 5000, // Refresh every 5 seconds for real-time updates
    },
  );

  // ── Worker Availability SWR ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: availabilityData, mutate: refreshAvailability } = useSWR<{
    workers: Array<{
      id: string;
      full_name: string;
      phone: string;
      category: "skilled" | "helper";
      active_assignments: number;
      is_available: boolean;
    }>;
    statistics: {
      total_workers: number;
      total_skilled: number;
      total_helpers: number;
      available_skilled: number;
      available_helpers: number;
      in_use_count: number;
    };
  }>(
    "/api/admin/workers/availability",
    (url: string) => fetch(url).then((res) => res.json()),
    {
      fallbackData: {
        workers: [],
        statistics: {
          total_workers: 0,
          total_skilled: 0,
          total_helpers: 0,
          available_skilled: 0,
          available_helpers: 0,
          in_use_count: 0,
        }
      },
      revalidateOnFocus: true,
      revalidateOnMount: true,
      refreshInterval: 5000, // Refresh every 5 seconds for real-time updates
    },
  );

  // ── Compute worker statistics and active assignments ───────────────────────
  const workerStatsList = useMemo(() => {
    return registeredWorkers.map((worker) => {
      // Get actual assignments for this worker from the API data
      const workerAssignments = assignmentsData?.assignments?.filter(
        (a) => a.worker_id === worker.id
      ) || [];

      const allAssignments = workerAssignments.map((assignment) => ({
        id: assignment.id,
        requestNumber: assignment.customize_requests.request_number,
        customerName: assignment.customize_requests.customer_name,
        furnitureDescription: assignment.customize_requests.furniture_description || "Custom furniture",
        assignedAt: assignment.assigned_at,
        completedAt: assignment.released_at,
        skilledWorkersCount: 0, // Will be populated from request data if needed
        helperWorkersCount: 0, // Will be populated from request data if needed
        rawRequest: assignment.customize_requests,
      }));

      const activeAssignments = allAssignments.filter((a) => !a.completedAt);
      const completedAssignments = allAssignments.filter((a) => a.completedAt);

      return {
        id: worker.id,
        full_name: worker.full_name,
        phone: worker.phone,
        category: worker.category,
        created_at: worker.created_at,
        allAssignments,
        activeAssignments,
        completedAssignments,
        activeCount: activeAssignments.length,
        completedCount: completedAssignments.length,
        totalAssigned: allAssignments.length,
        is_in_use: activeAssignments.length > 0,
      };
    });
  }, [registeredWorkers, assignmentsData]);

  // Filtered workers for the workers tab
  const filteredWorkers = useMemo(() => {
    return workerStatsList.filter((w) => {
      const q = workerSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesSearch =
        !q ||
        w.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        w.phone?.toLowerCase().includes(q);

      if (!matchesSearch) return false;

      if (workerStatusFilter === "in_use") return w.is_in_use;
      if (workerStatusFilter === "available") return !w.is_in_use;
      return true;
    });
  }, [workerStatsList, workerSearch, workerStatusFilter]);

  // Overall worker statistics metrics - computed from real-time data
  const totalRegisteredWorkers = registeredWorkers.length;
  const totalSkilledWorkers = registeredWorkers.filter((w) => w.category === "skilled").length;
  const totalHelperWorkers = registeredWorkers.filter((w) => w.category === "helper").length;
  const workersInUseCount = workerStatsList.filter((w) => w.is_in_use).length;
  const totalActiveAssignments = workerStatsList.reduce(
    (acc, w) => acc + w.activeCount,
    0,
  );
  const totalCompletedAssignments = workerStatsList.reduce(
    (acc, w) => acc + w.completedCount,
    0,
  );

  // Worker availability statistics - computed from real-time data
  const availableSkilledWorkers = registeredWorkers.filter(
    (w) => w.category === "skilled" && !w.is_in_use
  ).length;
  const availableHelperWorkers = registeredWorkers.filter(
    (w) => w.category === "helper" && !w.is_in_use
  ).length;

  // Check if sufficient workers are available for the current calculation
  const isWorkerSufficient =
    numSkilledWorkers <= availableSkilledWorkers &&
    numHelperWorkers <= availableHelperWorkers;

  // Add worker handlers
  const handleOpenAddWorker = () => {
    setAddWorkerName("");
    setAddWorkerPhone("");
    setAddWorkerCategory("skilled");
    setAddWorkerError("");
    setIsAddWorkerOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCreateWorker = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const trimmedName = addWorkerName.trim();
    const trimmedPhone = addWorkerPhone.trim();

    if (!trimmedName || !trimmedPhone) {
      setAddWorkerError("All fields are required.");
      return;
    }

    if (trimmedName.length < 2 || !/^[a-zA-ZñÑ\s.'-]+$/.test(trimmedName)) {
      setAddWorkerError(
        "Full name must have at least 2 characters with letters only.",
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!/^09\d{9}$/.test(trimmedPhone)) {
      setAddWorkerError(
        "Phone number must start with 09 and be exactly 11 digits.",
      );
      return;
    }

    setAddWorkerBusy(true);
    setAddWorkerError("");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/workers", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          fullName: trimmedName,
          phone: trimmedPhone,
          category: addWorkerCategory,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        setAddWorkerError(data.error || "Failed to create worker.");
        setAddWorkerBusy(false);
        return;
      }

      toast.success(`Worker ${trimmedName} added successfully!`);
      setIsAddWorkerOpen(false);
      await refreshWorkers();
    } catch {
      setAddWorkerError("An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setAddWorkerBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const settingsChangeSummary = useMemo(() => {
    const lines: {
      label: string;
      from: React.ReactNode;
      to: React.ReactNode;
    }[] = [];
    const prevLabor = String(initialSettings?.labor_rate_per_day ?? 750);
    const prevMarkup = String(initialSettings?.markup_percent ?? 30);
    const prevWoods = [
      ...(initialSettings?.enabled_wood_types ?? allWoodTypes),
    ].sort();
    const nextWoods = [...enabledWoods].sort();

    if (laborRate !== prevLabor)
      lines.push({
        label: "Labor Rate / Day",
        from: `₱${prevLabor}`,
        to: `₱${laborRate}`,
      });
    if (markupPct !== prevMarkup)
      lines.push({
        label: "Markup %",
        from: `${prevMarkup}%`,
        to: `${markupPct}%`,
      });
    if (JSON.stringify(prevWoods) !== JSON.stringify(nextWoods)) {
      const removed = prevWoods.filter((w) => !nextWoods.includes(w));
      const added = nextWoods.filter((w) => !prevWoods.includes(w));
      const ICON_X = <X size={16} className="text-red-600 dark:text-red-400" />;
      if (removed.length > 0)
        lines.push({
          label: "Removed Wood Types",
          from: removed.join(", "),
          to: ICON_X,
        });
      if (added.length > 0)
        lines.push({
          label: "Added Wood Types",
          from: ICON_X,
          to: added.join(", "),
        });
    }
    return lines;
  }, [laborRate, markupPct, enabledWoods, initialSettings]);

  const filtered = useMemo(
    () =>
      requests.filter((r) => {
        const q = search.toLowerCase();
        const matchSearch =
          r.customer_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          r.request_number.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (r.furniture_description ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          r.item.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchStatus = statusFilter === "All" || r.status === statusFilter;
        return matchSearch && matchStatus;
      }),
    [requests, search, statusFilter],
  );

  // Auto-open modal when deep-linked with ?request=REQ-xxx
  useEffect(() => {
    const requestNumber = searchParams.get("request");
    if (!requestNumber) return;
    const match = initialRequests.find(
      (r) => r.request_number === requestNumber,
    );
    if (match) {
      openRequest(match);
      router.replace(
        window.location.hostname.startsWith("admin.")
          ? "/customize-furniture"
          : "/admin/customize-furniture",
        { scroll: false },
      );
    }
  }, [searchParams, initialRequests, router]);

  const pendingCount = requests.filter(
    (r) => r.status === "Pending Review",
  ).length;

  // ── Handlers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function openRequest(req: CustomizeRequest) {
    const retainSpecInputs = shouldRetainReviewSpecInputs(req);

    setSelectedRequest(req);
    setQuoteInput(req.quote_amount ? String(req.quote_amount) : "");
    setDimDraft({
      width: req.dim_width ?? "",
      depth: req.dim_depth ?? "",
      height: req.dim_height ?? "",
    });
    setAdminBreakdown(null);
    setCustomReasoning(retainSpecInputs ? (req.ai_reasoning ?? "") : "");
    setComplexityLevel(
      retainSpecInputs
        ? ((req.complexity_level as "Standard" | "Moderate" | "Complex" | "") ??
          "")
        : "",
    );
    setComplexityReasoning(
      retainSpecInputs ? (req.complexity_reasoning ?? "") : "",
    );
    setComplexityFee(
      retainSpecInputs && req.complexity_fee
        ? String(req.complexity_fee)
        : "",
    );
    setFurnitureSize(
      retainSpecInputs
        ? req.furniture_size === "small" || req.furniture_size === "sm"
          ? "sm"
          : req.furniture_size === "medium" || req.furniture_size === "md"
            ? "md"
            : req.furniture_size === "large" || req.furniture_size === "lg"
              ? "lg"
              : req.furniture_size === "xlarge" || req.furniture_size === "xl"
                ? "xl"
                : ""
        : "",
    );
    setPriceGenError("");
    setShowRejectInput(false);
    setRejectionReason("");

    setSkilledWorkersCount(
      formatWorkerField(req.skilled_workers_count, retainSpecInputs),
    );
    setSkilledDays(formatWorkerField(req.skilled_days, retainSpecInputs));
    setHelperWorkersCount(
      formatWorkerField(req.helper_workers_count, retainSpecInputs),
    );
    setHelperDays(formatWorkerField(req.helper_days, retainSpecInputs));

    const prevSkilledWorkers = formatWorkerField(
      req.skilled_workers_count,
      retainSpecInputs,
    );
    const prevSkilledDays = formatWorkerField(req.skilled_days, retainSpecInputs);
    const prevHelperWorkers = formatWorkerField(
      req.helper_workers_count,
      retainSpecInputs,
    );
    const prevHelperDays = formatWorkerField(req.helper_days, retainSpecInputs);

    // Reconstruct project cost breakdown only when a valid quote still exists
    const savedFinalPrice = req.quote_amount ?? req.final_price;
    const hasSavedQuote =
      Boolean(savedFinalPrice) &&
      (req.ai_material_cost_per_unit != null ||
        req.ai_labor_cost_per_unit != null);
    if (hasSavedQuote) {
      const qty = req.quantity || 1;
      const matUnit = req.ai_material_cost_per_unit ?? 0;
      const laborUnit = req.ai_labor_cost_per_unit ?? 0;
      const matTotal = matUnit * qty;
      const laborTotal = laborUnit * qty;
      const subtotal = matTotal + laborTotal;
      const markup =
        req.markup_amount ??
        Math.round(subtotal * ((req.markup_percent_used ?? 30) / 100));

      setAdminBreakdown({
        materialCost: matTotal,
        laborCost: laborTotal,
        subtotal,
        markup,
        rushFee: req.rush_fee ?? 0,
        finalPrice: savedFinalPrice ?? 0,
        isRush: Boolean(req.is_rush),
        reasoning: req.ai_reasoning ?? "",
        laborRate: req.labor_rate_used ?? (Number(laborRate) || 680),
        helperRate: req.helper_rate_used ?? (Number(helperRate) || 480),
        markupPercent: req.markup_percent_used ?? (Number(markupPct) || 30),
        boardFeet: req.board_feet_per_unit,
        totalBoardFeet:
          req.total_board_feet ??
          (req.board_feet_per_unit ? req.board_feet_per_unit * qty : null),
        skilledWorkersCount: Number(prevSkilledWorkers) || 0,
        skilledDays: Number(prevSkilledDays) || 0,
        helperWorkersCount: Number(prevHelperWorkers) || 0,
        helperDays: Number(prevHelperDays) || 0,
      });

      setCalculatedInputs(
        `${prevSkilledWorkers}-${prevSkilledDays}-${prevHelperWorkers}-${prevHelperDays}-${req.complexity_level ?? ""}-${req.complexity_reasoning ?? ""}-${req.complexity_fee ?? 0}`,
      );
    } else {
      setAdminBreakdown(null);
      setCalculatedInputs(null);
    }

    setComponentErrors({});
    setComponents(
      retainSpecInputs
        ? parseComponentsFromReasoning(req.ai_reasoning)
        : [],
    );

    // Reset worker selection when opening a request
    setSelectedSkilledWorkers([]);
    setSelectedHelperWorkers([]);
  }

  function closeRequest() {
    setSelectedRequest(null);
    setDimDraft({ width: "", depth: "", height: "" });
    setAdminBreakdown(null);
    setCustomReasoning("");
    setComplexityLevel("");
    setComplexityReasoning("");
    setComplexityFee("");
    setFurnitureSize("");
    setPriceGenError("");
    setShowRejectInput(false);
    setRejectionReason("");
    setSkilledWorkersCount("");
    setSkilledDays("");
    setHelperWorkersCount("");
    setHelperDays("");
    setCalculatedInputs(null);
    setComponents([]);
    setComponentErrors({});
    setSelectedSkilledWorkers([]);
    setSelectedHelperWorkers([]);
  }

  async function handleUpdateStatus(
    id: string,
    status: CustomizeRequestStatus,
    quoteAmount?: number,
    rejectionReason?: string,
  ) {
    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { status };

    if (quoteAmount !== undefined) {
      payload.quote_amount = quoteAmount;
    }

    if (rejectionReason !== undefined) {
      payload.rejection_reason = rejectionReason;
    }

    if (adminBreakdown) {
      payload.dim_width = dimDraft.width || null;
      payload.dim_depth = dimDraft.depth || null;
      payload.dim_height = dimDraft.height || null;
      payload.final_price = adminBreakdown.finalPrice;
      const qty = selectedRequest?.quantity ?? 1;
      payload.ai_material_cost_per_unit = Math.round(
        adminBreakdown.materialCost / qty,
      );
      payload.ai_labor_cost_per_unit = Math.round(
        adminBreakdown.laborCost / qty,
      );
      payload.ai_reasoning = customReasoning || adminBreakdown.reasoning;
      payload.markup_amount = adminBreakdown.markup;
      payload.labor_rate_used = adminBreakdown.laborRate;
      payload.helper_rate_used = Number(helperRate) || 450;
      payload.markup_percent_used = adminBreakdown.markupPercent;
      payload.skilled_workers_count = Number(skilledWorkersCount) || 0;
      payload.skilled_days = Number(skilledDays) || 0;
      payload.helper_workers_count = Number(helperWorkersCount) || 0;
      payload.helper_days = Number(helperDays) || 0;
      payload.board_feet_per_unit = adminBreakdown.boardFeet;
      payload.total_board_feet =
        adminBreakdown.totalBoardFeet ?? (adminBreakdown.boardFeet ?? 0) * qty;

      // Save pre-selected workers (optional)
      payload.preselected_skilled_workers = selectedSkilledWorkers.length > 0 ? selectedSkilledWorkers : null;
      payload.preselected_helper_workers = selectedHelperWorkers.length > 0 ? selectedHelperWorkers : null;
    }

    // Always save complexity and furniture size fields regardless of whether breakdown was generated
    payload.complexity_level = complexityLevel || null;
    payload.complexity_reasoning = complexityReasoning || null;
    payload.complexity_fee = Number(complexityFee) || 0;
    payload.furniture_size = furnitureSize || null;

    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/customize-requests/${id}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error();

      refreshRequests();
      setSelectedRequest((prev) =>
        prev ? ({ ...prev, ...payload } as CustomizeRequest) : null,
      );

      // Refresh worker data when status changes that affect worker assignments
      if (status === "Production Done" || status === "Completed" || status === "In Production") {
        refreshWorkers();
        refreshAssignments();
      }

      toast.success("Status updated.");
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to update status.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleGeneratePriceAdmin() {
    if (!selectedRequest) return;

    const reqW = String(selectedRequest.dim_width ?? "").trim();
    const reqD = String(selectedRequest.dim_depth ?? "").trim();
    const reqH = String(selectedRequest.dim_height ?? "").trim();

    const hasEmptyField = components.some(
      (c) =>
        !c.name.trim() ||
        !c.thickness.trim() ||
        !c.width.trim() ||
        !c.height.trim() ||
        !c.qty.trim(),
    );
    const hasZeroField = components.some(
      (c) =>
        parseFloat(c.thickness) <= 0 ||
        parseFloat(c.width) <= 0 ||
        parseFloat(c.height) <= 0 ||
        parseInt(c.qty) <= 0,
    );

    if (components.length === 0 || hasEmptyField || hasZeroField) {
      toast.error(
        "Please fill in all component fields with valid positive numbers.",
      );
      return;
    }

    const draftW = dimDraft.width ? String(dimDraft.width).trim() : reqW;
    const draftD = dimDraft.depth ? String(dimDraft.depth).trim() : reqD;
    const draftH = dimDraft.height ? String(dimDraft.height).trim() : reqH;

    setIsGeneratingPrice(true);
    setPriceGenError("");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/estimate", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          furnitureType: selectedRequest.furniture_type,
          furnitureDescription: selectedRequest.furniture_description,
          woodType: selectedRequest.wood_type,
          dimensions: {
            width: draftW,
            depth: draftD,
            height: draftH,
          },
          quantity: selectedRequest.quantity,
          skilledWorkersCount: Number(skilledWorkersCount) || 0,
          skilledDays: Number(skilledDays) || 0,
          helperWorkersCount: Number(helperWorkersCount) || 0,
          helperDays: Number(helperDays) || 0,
          components,
          complexityLevel: complexityLevel || undefined,
          complexityReasoning: complexityReasoning || undefined,
          complexityFee: Number(complexityFee) || 0,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || data.error) {
        setPriceGenError(data.error ?? "Failed to generate estimate.");
        return;
      }

      const qty = selectedRequest.quantity || 1;
      const materialCost =
        data.material_cost_total ?? data.material_cost_per_unit * qty;
      const laborCost = data.labor_cost_total ?? data.labor_cost_per_unit * qty;
      const subtotal = materialCost + laborCost;
      const markupPctNum = (data.markup_percent ?? 30) / 100;
      const markup = Math.round(subtotal * markupPctNum);
      const complexityFeeNum = data.complexity_fee ?? 0;
      const finalPrice = subtotal + markup + complexityFeeNum;

      if (selectedRequest) {
        selectedRequest.board_feet_per_unit = data.board_feet_per_unit;
        selectedRequest.total_board_feet =
          data.total_board_feet ?? data.board_feet_per_unit * qty;
      }

      setAdminBreakdown({
        materialCost,
        laborCost,
        subtotal,
        markup,
        rushFee: 0,
        finalPrice,
        isRush: false,
        reasoning: data.reasoning,
        laborRate: data.skilled_labor_rate,
        helperRate: data.helper_labor_rate,
        markupPercent: data.markup_percent,
        boardFeet: data.board_feet_per_unit,
        totalBoardFeet: data.total_board_feet ?? data.board_feet_per_unit * qty,
        skilledWorkersCount: data.skilled_workers_count,
        skilledDays: data.skilled_days,
        helperWorkersCount: data.helper_workers_count,
        helperDays: data.helper_days,
      });

      setCustomReasoning(data.reasoning);
      setQuoteInput(String(finalPrice));
      setCalculatedInputs(
        `${skilledWorkersCount}-${skilledDays}-${helperWorkersCount}-${helperDays}-${complexityLevel}-${complexityReasoning}-${complexityFee}`,
      );
    } catch {
      setPriceGenError("Something went wrong. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingPrice(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleAnalyzeComponents() {
    if (!selectedRequest) return;
    setIsAnalyzing(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/analyze-components", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          furnitureType: selectedRequest.furniture_type,
          furnitureDescription: selectedRequest.furniture_description,
          dimensions: {
            width: dimDraft.width || selectedRequest.dim_width,
            depth: dimDraft.depth || selectedRequest.dim_depth,
            height: dimDraft.height || selectedRequest.dim_height,
          },
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || data.error) {
        toast.error(data.error ?? "Failed to analyze components.");
        return;
      }
      setComponents(data.components || []);
      toast.success("Components generated successfully!");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error("Failed to analyze components.");
    } finally {
      setIsAnalyzing(false);
    }
  }

  function updateComponent(
    index: number,
    field: keyof FurnitureComponent,
    value: string,
  ) {
    setCalculatedInputs(null);
    let sanitized = value;
    let hasError = false;
    let errMsg = "";

    if (field === "thickness" || field === "width" || field === "height") {
      sanitized = sanitizeNumericInput(value, true);
      if (sanitized.length > 4) {
        sanitized = sanitized.slice(0, 4);
        hasError = true;
        errMsg = "Max of 4 digits.";
      }
    } else if (field === "qty") {
      sanitized = sanitizeNumericInput(value, false);
      if (sanitized.length > 4) {
        sanitized = sanitized.slice(0, 4);
        hasError = true;
        errMsg = "Max of 4 digits.";
      }
    }

    const errKey = `${index}-${field}`;
    if (hasError) {
      setComponentErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, [errKey]: errMsg }));
      setTimeout(() => {
        setComponentErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, [errKey]: "" }));
      }, 3000);
    } else {
      setComponentErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, [errKey]: "" }));
    }

    setComponents((prev) =>
      prev.map((c, i) => {
        if (i === index) {
          return { ...c, [field]: sanitized };
        }
        return c;
      }),
    );
  }

  function addComponent() {
    setCalculatedInputs(null);
    setComponents((prev) => [
      {
        name: "New Component",
        thickness: "1",
        width: "1",
        height: "1",
        qty: "1",
      },
      ...prev,
    ]);
  }

  function removeComponent(index: number) {
    setCalculatedInputs(null);
    setComponents((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  }

  const ALLOWED_TYPES = [
    "image/jpeg",
    "image/png",
    "image/webp",
    "image/gif",
    "image/heic",
    "image/heif",
  ];
  const ALLOWED_EXTS = ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "webp", "gif", "heic", "heif"];
  const MAX_SINGLE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB

  function handleProofFilesSelected(slot: 1 | 2, fileList: FileList) {
    const validFiles: File[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < fileList.length; i++) {
      const file = fileList[i];
      const ext = (file.name.split(".").pop() || "").toLowerCase();

      if (!ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type) && !ALLOWED_EXTS.includes(ext)) {
        toast.error(
          `"${file.name}" is not a supported image format. Allowed: JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, HEIC.`,
        );
        continue;
      }

      if (file.size > MAX_SINGLE_SIZE) {
        toast.error(`"${file.name}" exceeds the 10MB size limit.`);
        continue;
      }

      validFiles.push(file);
    }

    if (validFiles.length === 0) return;

    // Batch assignment if 2 files selected simultaneously
    if (validFiles.length >= 2) {
      if (previewUrl1) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl1);
      if (previewUrl2) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl2);

      setProof1File(validFiles[0]);
      setPreviewUrl1(URL.createObjectURL(validFiles[0]));
      setProof2File(validFiles[1]);
      setPreviewUrl2(URL.createObjectURL(validFiles[1]));
      toast.success("2 production proof photos loaded.");
      return;
    }

    // Single file assigned to targeted slot
    if (slot === 1) {
      if (previewUrl1) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl1);
      setProof1File(validFiles[0]);
      setPreviewUrl1(URL.createObjectURL(validFiles[0]));
    } else {
      if (previewUrl2) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl2);
      setProof2File(validFiles[0]);
      setPreviewUrl2(URL.createObjectURL(validFiles[0]));
    }
  }

  function handleClearProofImage(slot: 1 | 2) {
    if (slot === 1) {
      if (previewUrl1) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl1);
      setProof1File(null);
      setPreviewUrl1(null);
    } else {
      if (previewUrl2) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl2);
      setProof2File(null);
      setPreviewUrl2(null);
    }
  }

  function resetProofState() {
    if (previewUrl1) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl1);
    if (previewUrl2) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl2);
    setProof1File(null);
    setProof2File(null);
    setPreviewUrl1(null);
    setPreviewUrl2(null);
  }

  async function uploadProofImage(
    file: File,
    suffix: string,
    requestId: string,
  ): Promise<string> {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", file);
    formData.append("requestId", requestId);
    formData.append("suffix", suffix);

    const uploadRes = await fetch("/api/admin/customize/upload-proof", {
      method: "POST",
      body: formData,
    });

    const uploadData = await uploadRes.json();
    if (!uploadRes.ok || !uploadData.proofUrl) {
      throw new Error(uploadData.error || `Failed to upload photo ${suffix}.`);
    }

    return uploadData.proofUrl;
  }

  async function handleConfirmProductionComplete() {
    if (!selectedRequest) return;

    if (!proof1File || !proof2File) {
      toast.error(
        "Please upload both production proof photos (Photo 1 and Photo 2).",
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsSendingProdComplete(true);
    try {
      // 1. Upload both photos in parallel to Supabase Storage
      const [url1, url2] = await Promise.all([
        uploadProofImage(proof1File, "1", selectedRequest.id),
        uploadProofImage(proof2File, "2", selectedRequest.id),
      ]);

      // 2. Complete production status with proof URLs
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/customize/production-complete", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          requestId: selectedRequest.id,
          productionProofUrl: url1,
          productionProofUrl2: url2,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || data.error) {
        throw new Error(data.error ?? "Failed to mark production as complete.");
      }

      const is7030 = selectedRequest.payment_option === "70-30";
      toast.success(
        is7030
          ? "Production marked as complete! 30% balance request email sent to client."
          : "Production marked as complete! Finished proof email sent to client.",
      );
      setSelectedRequest((prev) =>
        prev
          ? {
              ...prev,
              status: "Production Done",
              production_proof_url: url1,
              production_proof_url_2: url2,
            }
          : null,
      );
      resetProofState();
      setProductionProofModalOpen(false);
      refreshRequests();
      // Force immediate refresh of worker data
      await refreshWorkers();
      await refreshAvailability();
      await refreshAssignments();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Failed to trigger production completion.",
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSendingProdComplete(false);
    }
  }

  // Function to retroactively release workers for existing completed requests
  async function releaseWorkersForCompletedRequest(requestId: string) {
    try {
      const assignmentsRes = await fetch(`/api/admin/worker-assignments?request_id=${requestId}&status=assigned`);
      const assignmentsData = await assignmentsRes.json();

      if (assignmentsData.assignments && assignmentsData.assignments.length > 0) {
        const releasePromises = assignmentsData.assignments.map((assignment: any) =>
          fetch(`/api/admin/worker-assignments/${assignment.id}`, {
            method: "PATCH",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ status: "released" }),
          })
        );
        await Promise.all(releasePromises);
        refreshAvailability();
        refreshWorkers();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to release workers for completed request:", error);
    }
  }

    setSavingSettings(true);

      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/customize-settings", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          labor_rate_per_day: Number(laborRate),
          helper_rate_per_day: Number(helperRate),
          markup_percent: Number(markupPct),

      toast.success("Settings saved.");

      toast.error("Failed to save settings.");

    }
  }
