                    const enabled = enabledWoods.includes(wood);
                    const isArchived = archivedMaterialNames.some(
                      (n) => n.toLowerCase() === wood.toLowerCase(),
                    );
                    return (
                      <label
                        key={wood}
                        className={cn(
                          "flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border select-none transition-colors",
                          isArchived
                            ? "border-border opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed bg-muted/20"
                            : enabled
                              ? "border-foreground/30 bg-muted/30 cursor-pointer"
                              : "border-border opacity-50 cursor-pointer",
                        )}
                      >
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={enabled}
                          onChange={() => !isArchived && toggleWood(wood)}
                          disabled={isArchived}
                          className="size-4 rounded disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer"
                        />
                        <span
                          className="size-4 rounded-full border border-black/10 shrink-0"
                          style={{
                            backgroundColor: woodHex[wood] || "#A0724A",
                          }}
                        />
                        <span className="text-base font-medium flex-1 text-foreground">
                          {wood}
                        </span>
                        {isArchived && (
                          <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                            Archived
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </label>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              <Button
                className="w-full h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                onClick={() => setConfirmSettings(true)}
                disabled={savingSettings || !hasSettingsChanges}
              >
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  Review &amp; Save Settings
                </span>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ── WORKERS TAB ── */}
        {activeTab === "workers" && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* ── Worker Metrics Cards ── */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              <div className="border border-border bg-card p-5 rounded-xl space-y-2 shadow-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <h2 className="text-muted-foreground text-base font-semibold">
                    Total Workers
                  </h2>
                  <div className="bg-muted/80 p-2 rounded-lg">
                    <Users
                      size={16}
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      className="text-muted-foreground"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-2xl font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {totalRegisteredWorkers}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="border border-border bg-card p-5 rounded-xl space-y-2 shadow-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <h2 className="text-muted-foreground text-base font-semibold">
                    Skilled Workers
                  </h2>
                  <div className="bg-muted/80 p-2 rounded-lg">
                    <User
                      size={16}
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      className="text-muted-foreground"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-2xl font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {totalSkilledWorkers}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="border border-border bg-card p-5 rounded-xl space-y-2 shadow-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <h2 className="text-muted-foreground text-base font-semibold">
                    Helper Workers
                  </h2>
                  <div className="bg-muted/80 p-2 rounded-lg">
                    <User
                      size={16}
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      className="text-muted-foreground"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-2xl font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {totalHelperWorkers}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="border border-border bg-card p-5 rounded-xl space-y-2 shadow-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <h2 className="text-muted-foreground text-base font-semibold">
                    Currently In Use
                  </h2>
                  <div className="bg-muted/80 p-2 rounded-lg">
                    <Hammer
                      size={16}
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      className="text-muted-foreground"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-2xl font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {workersInUseCount}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ── Workers Table ── */}
            <div className="border border-border bg-card rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
              <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-base text-left">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-border text-muted-foreground text-sm font-semibold bg-muted/40">
                      <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                        Full Name
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                        Category
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                        Contact Number
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                        Status
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                        Active Assignments
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                        Completed
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap align-middle">
                        Actions
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-border text-foreground">
                    {filteredWorkers.length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td
                          colSpan={7}
                          className="px-4 py-14 text-center text-muted-foreground text-base"
                        >
                          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                            <Users
                              size={36}
                              className="text-muted-foreground/50"
                            />
                            <p className="font-bold text-foreground text-lg">
                              No workers found
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                              {workerSearch
                                ? `No worker matching "${workerSearch}". Try another search term.`
                                : "No registered workers available yet."}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      filteredWorkers.map((worker) => (
                        <tr
                          key={worker.id}
                          className="hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors"
                        >
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                            <div className="font-semibold text-foreground text-base">
                              {worker.full_name}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-muted-foreground font-semibold text-base align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                            <span
                              className={cn(
                                "inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 text-base font-semibold rounded-lg border",
                                worker.category === "skilled"
                                  ? "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30"
                                  : "bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30",
                              )}
                            >
                              {worker.category === "skilled" ? "Skilled" : "Helper"}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-muted-foreground font-semibold text-base align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                            {worker.phone || "—"}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                            <span
                              className={cn(
                                "inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 text-base font-semibold rounded-lg border",
                                worker.is_in_use
                                  ? "bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30"
                                  : "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30",
                              )}
                            >
                              {worker.is_in_use ? "In Use" : "Available"}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-muted-foreground font-semibold text-base align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                            {worker.activeCount}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-muted-foreground font-semibold text-base align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                            {worker.completedCount}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap align-middle">
                            <Button
                              variant="outline"
                              className="h-9 px-3 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                              onClick={() => setSelectedWorkerForView(worker)}
                            >
                              View
                            </Button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </Tabs>

      {/* ── MODAL ── */}
      {selectedRequest && (
        <Modal
          title={`Request Details - ${selectedRequest.request_number}`}
          onClose={closeRequest}
        >
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <CustomizeDetailPreview
              request={selectedRequest}
              isAdmin={true}
              initialDamageReports={damageReportsMap ? [] : undefined}
              onRefresh={() => {
                mutateDamageReports();
                refreshRequests();
              }}
              onActionSuccess={async (actionType?: "approve" | "decline") => {
                if (
                  actionType === "approve" &&
                  selectedRequest.pending_edit_request
                ) {
                  const changes =
                    selectedRequest.pending_edit_request.changes || {};
                  const nextEditCount =
                    Number(selectedRequest.edit_count ?? 0) + 1;
                  const retainSpecInputs =
                    hadPreviousProjectReview(selectedRequest);
                  const updated: CustomizeRequest = {
                    ...selectedRequest,
                    edit_count: nextEditCount,
                    pending_edit_request: {
                      ...selectedRequest.pending_edit_request,
                      status: "approved",
                      approved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
                    },
                    status: "Pending Review",
                    needs_quote: true,
                    payment_status: "Unpaid",
                    paymongo_link_id: null,
                    paymongo_checkout_url: null,
                    paymongo_reference: null,
                    // Clear previous project cost breakdown — admin must recalculate
                    quote_amount: null,
                    final_price: null,
                    ai_material_cost_per_unit: null,
                    ai_labor_cost_per_unit: null,
                    markup_amount: null,
                    markup_percent_used: null,
                    labor_rate_used: null,
                    helper_rate_used: null,
                    board_feet_per_unit: null,
                    total_board_feet: null,
                    // Retain reviewing-spec inputs only for previously reviewed requests
                    ai_reasoning: retainSpecInputs
                      ? selectedRequest.ai_reasoning
                      : null,
                    complexity_level: retainSpecInputs
                      ? selectedRequest.complexity_level
                      : null,
                    complexity_reasoning: retainSpecInputs
                      ? selectedRequest.complexity_reasoning
                      : null,
                    complexity_fee: retainSpecInputs
                      ? selectedRequest.complexity_fee
                      : null,
                    furniture_size: retainSpecInputs
                      ? selectedRequest.furniture_size
                      : null,
                    skilled_workers_count: retainSpecInputs
                      ? selectedRequest.skilled_workers_count
                      : null,
                    skilled_days: retainSpecInputs
                      ? selectedRequest.skilled_days
                      : null,
                    helper_workers_count: retainSpecInputs
                      ? selectedRequest.helper_workers_count
                      : null,
                    helper_days: retainSpecInputs
                      ? selectedRequest.helper_days
                      : null,
                    furniture_type:
                      changes.furniture_type?.new ??
                      selectedRequest.furniture_type,
                    furniture_description:
                      changes.furniture_description?.new ??
                      selectedRequest.furniture_description,
                    wood_type:
                      changes.wood_type?.new ?? selectedRequest.wood_type,
                    quantity: changes.quantity?.new ?? selectedRequest.quantity,
                    dim_width: changes.dim_width
                      ? changes.dim_width.new
                      : selectedRequest.dim_width,
                    dim_depth: changes.dim_depth
                      ? changes.dim_depth.new
                      : selectedRequest.dim_depth,
                    dim_height: changes.dim_height
                      ? changes.dim_height.new
                      : selectedRequest.dim_height,
                    target_date: changes.target_date
                      ? changes.target_date.new
                      : selectedRequest.target_date,
                    message: changes.message
                      ? changes.message.new
                      : selectedRequest.message,
                  };

                  // 1. Instant 0ms update in modal & re-sync reviewing inputs
                  openRequest(updated);
                  setDimDraft({
                    width: updated.dim_width || "",
                    depth: updated.dim_depth || "",
                    height: updated.dim_height || "",
                  });

                  // 2. Instant 0ms SWR cache mutation
                  refreshRequests(
                    (current: any) => {
                      if (!current?.requests) return current;
                      return {
                        ...current,
                        requests: current.requests.map((r: CustomizeRequest) =>
                          r.id === selectedRequest.id ? updated : r,
                        ),
                      };
                    },
                    { revalidate: true },
                  );
                  return;
                }

                if (actionType === "decline") {
                  const nextEditCount = Math.max(
                    1,
                    Number(selectedRequest.edit_count ?? 0) + 1,
                  );
                  const updated: CustomizeRequest = {
                    ...selectedRequest,
                    edit_count: nextEditCount,
                    pending_edit_request: selectedRequest.pending_edit_request
                      ? {
                          ...selectedRequest.pending_edit_request,
                          status: "declined",
                          declined_at: new Date().toISOString(),
                        }
                      : null,
                  };

                  // 1. Instant 0ms update in modal
                  setSelectedRequest(updated);

                  // 2. Instant 0ms SWR cache mutation
                  refreshRequests(
                    (current: any) => {
                      if (!current?.requests) return current;
                      return {
                        ...current,
                        requests: current.requests.map((r: CustomizeRequest) =>
                          r.id === selectedRequest.id ? updated : r,
                        ),
                      };
                    },
                    { revalidate: true },
                  );
                  return;
                }

                await refreshRequests();
                try {
                  const res = await fetch("/api/admin/customize-requests");
                  const json = await res.json();
                  if (json.success && json.requests) {
                    const updated = json.requests.find(
                      (r: CustomizeRequest) => r.id === selectedRequest.id,
                    );
                    if (updated) {
                      setSelectedRequest(updated);
                      setDimDraft({
                        width: updated.dim_width || "",
                        depth: updated.dim_depth || "",
                        height: updated.dim_height || "",
                      });
                    }
                  }
                } catch (e) {
                  console.error("Error refreshing selected request:", e);
                }
              }}
            />

            {/* ── Approved banner ── */}
            {selectedRequest.status === "Approved" &&
              (!selectedRequest.pending_edit_request ||
                selectedRequest.pending_edit_request.status === "declined") && (
                <div className="-mb-0.5 flex items-start gap-2 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-600 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 animate-in fade-in">
                  <ThumbsUp size={16} className="shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-base font-semibold">
                      This request has been approved.
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                      The customer has been notified. Proceed to production when
                      the payment is ready.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

            {/* ── Actions section ── */}
            {!isTerminal(selectedRequest.status as CustomizeRequestStatus) && (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {/* ── Pending Review: Admin Quote Estimator ── */}
                {selectedRequest.status === "Pending Review" && (
                  <>
                    <div className="border rounded-xl bg-muted/30 p-4 space-y-4">
                      {/* Component Board Feet Calculator Section */}
                      <div className="space-y-4 border-b pb-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-base text-foreground">
                            Component Sizing Breakdown
                          </span>
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            variant="outline"
                            className="h-8 px-3 text-base font-semibold min-w-[150px] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"
                            onClick={handleAnalyzeComponents}
                            disabled={isAnalyzing || adminBreakdown !== null}
                          >
                            {isAnalyzing ? (
                              <Loader2 className="size-5 animate-spin" />
                            ) : (
                              <span>Analyze Components</span>
                            )}
                          </Button>
                        </div>

                        {components.length > 0 ? (
                          <div className="space-y-3">
                            {/* Column headers */}
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-1 text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground border-b pb-1.5 select-none">
                              <div className="flex-1 min-w-[140px]">
                                Component Name
                              </div>
                              <div className="w-[75px] text-center">
                                Thick (in)
                              </div>
                              <div className="w-[75px] text-center">
                                Width (in)
                              </div>
                              <div className="w-[110px] text-center">
                                Length/Height (in)
                              </div>
                              <div className="w-[60px] text-center">Qty</div>
                              <div className="w-[70px] text-right">BF</div>
                              <div className="w-8"></div>
                            </div>

                            <ScrollArea
                              className="h-[240px] pr-2"
                              type="always"
                            >
                              <div className="space-y-2.5 p-1">
                                {components.map((comp, idx) => {
                                  const t = parseFloat(comp.thickness) || 0;
                                  const w = parseFloat(comp.width) || 0;
                                  const h = parseFloat(comp.height) || 0;
                                  const q = parseInt(comp.qty) || 0;
                                  const bf = (t * w * h * q) / 144;
                                  return (
                                    <div
                                      key={idx}
                                      className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-border/50 pb-2.5 last:border-0 last:pb-0"
                                    >
                                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-[140px]">
                                        <Input
                                          type="text"
                                          value={comp.name}
                                          onChange={(e) =>
                                            updateComponent(
                                              idx,
                                              "name",
                                              e.target.value,
                                            )
                                          }
                                          placeholder="Component Name"
                                          className={cn(
                                            "h-9 text-base font-medium",
                                            !comp.name.trim() &&
                                              "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive bg-destructive/5",
                                          )}
                                        />
                                      </div>
                                      <div className="w-[75px]">
                                        <Input
                                          type="text"
                                          value={comp.thickness}
                                          onChange={(e) =>
                                            updateComponent(
                                              idx,
                                              "thickness",
                                              e.target.value,
                                            )
                                          }
                                          className={cn(
                                            "h-9 text-base px-2 text-center",
                                            (!comp.thickness ||
                                              parseFloat(comp.thickness) <= 0 ||
                                              componentErrors[
                                                `${idx}-thickness`
                                              ]) &&
                                              "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive bg-destructive/5",
                                          )}
                                        />
                                      </div>
                                      <div className="w-[75px]">
                                        <Input
                                          type="text"
                                          value={comp.width}
                                          onChange={(e) =>
                                            updateComponent(
                                              idx,
                                              "width",
                                              e.target.value,
                                            )
                                          }
                                          className={cn(
                                            "h-9 text-base px-2 text-center",
                                            (!comp.width ||
                                              parseFloat(comp.width) <= 0 ||
                                              componentErrors[
                                                `${idx}-width`
                                              ]) &&
                                              "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive bg-destructive/5",
                                          )}
                                        />
                                      </div>
                                      <div className="w-[110px]">
                                        <Input
                                          type="text"
                                          value={comp.height}
                                          onChange={(e) =>
                                            updateComponent(
                                              idx,
                                              "height",
                                              e.target.value,
                                            )
                                          }
                                          className={cn(
                                            "h-9 text-base px-2 text-center",
                                            (!comp.height ||
                                              parseFloat(comp.height) <= 0 ||
                                              componentErrors[
                                                `${idx}-height`
                                              ]) &&
                                              "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive bg-destructive/5",
                                          )}
                                        />
                                      </div>
                                      <div className="w-[60px]">
                                        <Input
                                          type="text"
                                          value={comp.qty}
                                          onChange={(e) =>
                                            updateComponent(
                                              idx,
                                              "qty",
                                              e.target.value,
                                            )
                                          }
                                          className={cn(
                                            "h-9 text-base px-2 text-center",
                                            (!comp.qty ||
                                              parseInt(comp.qty) <= 0 ||
                                              componentErrors[`${idx}-qty`]) &&
                                              "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive bg-destructive/5",
                                          )}
                                        />
                                      </div>
                                      <div className="w-[70px] text-right text-base font-mono font-medium">
                                        {bf.toFixed(1)} BF
                                      </div>
                                      <Button
                                        type="button"
                                        variant="ghost"
                                        size="sm"
                                        className="size-9 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive cursor-pointer"
                                        onClick={() => removeComponent(idx)}
                                      >
                                        <Trash2 className="size-4" />
                                      </Button>
                                    </div>
                                  );
                                })}
                              </div>
                            </ScrollArea>
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t pt-2.5 pb-1">
                              <Button
                                type="button"
                                variant="ghost"
                                className="h-9 text-base font-medium gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                                onClick={addComponent}
                              >
                                <Plus className="size-4" /> Add Component
                              </Button>

                              {Object.values(componentErrors).some(
                                (err) => err,
                              ) && (
                                <p className="text-sm text-red-500 font-semibold animate-in fade-in select-none">
                                  {Object.values(componentErrors).find(
                                    (err) => err,
                                  )}
                                </p>
                              )}

                              <div className="text-base text-muted-foreground">
                                Subtotal:{" "}
                                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                                  {components
                                    .reduce((sum, c) => {
                                      const t = parseFloat(c.thickness) || 0;
                                      const w = parseFloat(c.width) || 0;
                                      const h = parseFloat(c.height) || 0;
                                      const q = parseInt(c.qty) || 0;
                                      return sum + (t * w * h * q) / 144;
                                    }, 0)
                                    .toFixed(1)}{" "}
                                  BF
                                </span>{" "}
                                (+10% Waste:{" "}
                                <span className="font-semibold text-green-600 dark:text-green-400">
                                  {(
                                    components.reduce((sum, c) => {
                                      const t = parseFloat(c.thickness) || 0;
                                      const w = parseFloat(c.width) || 0;
                                      const h = parseFloat(c.height) || 0;
                                      const q = parseInt(c.qty) || 0;
                                      return sum + (t * w * h * q) / 144;
                                    }, 0) * 1.1
                                  ).toFixed(1)}{" "}
                                  BF
                                </span>
                                )
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">
                            No components analyzed yet. Click Analyze Components
                            or add one manually.
                          </p>
                        )}
                        {components.length === 0 && (
                          <div className="flex justify-center">
                            <Button
                              type="button"
                              variant="ghost"
                              className="h-9 text-base font-medium gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                              onClick={addComponent}
                            >
                              <Plus className="size-4" /> Add Component
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* ── Design Complexity Block (Optional) ── */}
                      <div className="space-y-3 border border-border p-4 rounded-xl">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                              Design Complexity
                            </p>
                            <span className="text-base font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                              (Optional)
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            variant="outline"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8 px-3 text-base font-medium cursor-pointer"
                            onClick={() => setPricingGuideOpen(true)}
                          >
                            Pricing Guide
                          </Button>
                          {complexityLevel && (
                            <Button
                              type="button"
                              variant="outline"
                              size="sm"
                              className="h-8 px-3 cursor-pointer text-base hover:text-destructive gap-1"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setCalculatedInputs(null);
                                setComplexityLevel("");
                                setComplexityReasoning("");
                                setComplexityFee("");
                              }}
                              title="Unselect complexity level"
                            >
                              Unselect
                            </Button>
                          )}
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Complexity Level — 3 pill buttons */}
                        <div className="flex gap-2.5">
                          {(["Standard", "Moderate", "Complex"] as const).map(
                            (level) => (
                              <button
                                key={level}
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setCalculatedInputs(null);
                                  setComplexityLevel((prev) =>
                                    prev === level ? "" : level,
                                  );
                                }}
                                className={cn(
                                  "flex-1 h-10 rounded-lg border text-base font-semibold transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer",
                                  complexityLevel === level
                                    ? level === "Standard"
                                      ? "bg-green-500/20 border-green-500 text-green-700 dark:text-green-400"
                                      : level === "Moderate"
                                        ? "bg-amber-500/20 border-amber-500 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400"
                                        : "bg-red-500/20 border-red-500 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400"
                                    : "bg-transparent border-border text-muted-foreground hover:border-foreground/40",
                                )}
                              >
                                <span>{level}</span>
                              </button>
                            ),
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {complexityLevel && (
                          <div className="space-y-3 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-150">
                            <Textarea
                              rows={2}
                              placeholder={`Why is this ${complexityLevel.toLowerCase()} complexity? (design details, multiple design elements, detailed craftsmanship, etc)`}
                              value={complexityReasoning}
                              onChange={(e) => {
                                setCalculatedInputs(null);
                                setComplexityReasoning(e.target.value);
                              }}
                              className="text-base placeholder:text-base h-18"
                            />
                            <div className="relative">
                              <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground text-base">
                                ₱
                              </span>
                              <Input
                                type="number"
                                min="0"
                                placeholder="Price added for complexity"
                                value={complexityFee}
                                onChange={(e) => {
                                  setCalculatedInputs(null);
                                  setComplexityFee(
                                    sanitizeNumericInput(e.target.value, false),
                                  );
                                }}
                                className="pl-7 h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base"
                              />
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* ── Furniture Size Tier Block (For Shipping Slot Calculation) ── */}
                      <div className="space-y-3 border border-border p-4 rounded-xl">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                              Furniture Size
                            </p>

                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
                          {(
                            [
                              {
                                key: "sm",
                                label: "Small",
                                desc: "1 slot",
                              },
                              {
                                key: "md",
                                label: "Medium",
                                desc: "2 slots",
                              },
                              {
                                key: "lg",
                                label: "Large",
                                desc: "6 slots",
                              },
                              {
                                key: "xl",
                                label: "Extra Large",
                                desc: "12 slots",
                              },
                            ] as const
                          ).map((tier) => (
                            <button
                              key={tier.key}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() =>
                                setFurnitureSize((prev) =>
                                  prev === tier.key ? "" : tier.key,
                                )
                              }
                              className={cn(
                                "flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 rounded-lg border text-center transition-colors cursor-pointer",
                                furnitureSize === tier.key
                                  ? "bg-primary/10 border-primary text-primary font-semibold"
                                  : "bg-transparent border-border text-muted-foreground hover:border-foreground/40",
                              )}
                            >
                              <span className="text-smm font-semibold">
                                {tier.label}
                              </span>
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* ── Worker Assignment Block ── */}
                      <div className="space-y-3 border border-border p-4 rounded-xl">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                              Available Workers
                            </p>
                            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                              ({availableSkilledWorkers + availableHelperWorkers})
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          {(numSkilledWorkers > 0 || numHelperWorkers > 0) && (
                            <Button
                              type="button"
                              variant="outline"
                              className="h-8 px-3 text-sm font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setWorkerSearchQuery("");
                                setIsWorkerSelectionOpen(true);
                              }}
                            >
                              {selectedSkilledWorkers.length > 0 || selectedHelperWorkers.length > 0
                                ? `Selected (${selectedSkilledWorkers.length + selectedHelperWorkers.length})`
                                : "Select Workers (Optional)"}
                            </Button>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5 text-base">
                          <div>
                            <label className="font-medium text-foreground block mb-1.5 text-base">
                              Skilled Workers
                            </label>
                            <Input
                              type="number"
                              min="1"
                              max="10"
                              placeholder="0"
                              value={skilledWorkersCount}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                setSkilledWorkersCount(e.target.value)
                              }
                              className="h-10 text-base"
                              disabled={components.length === 0}
                            />
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-1">
                              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                Available: {availableSkilledWorkers}
                              </span>
                              {numSkilledWorkers > 0 && numSkilledWorkers > availableSkilledWorkers && (
                                <span className="text-sm text-destructive font-medium">
                                  Insufficient
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            {numSkilledDays > 0 && numSkilledWorkers === 0 && (
                              <p className="text-sm text-destructive mt-1 font-medium">
                                Worker count required
                              </p>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <label className="font-medium text-foreground block mb-1.5 text-base">
                              Work Days
                            </label>
                            <Input
                              type="number"
                              min="1"
                              max="60"
                              placeholder="0"
                              value={skilledDays}
                              onChange={(e) => setSkilledDays(e.target.value)}
                              className="h-10 text-base"
                              disabled={components.length === 0}
                            />
                            {numSkilledWorkers > 0 && numSkilledDays === 0 && (
                              <p className="text-sm text-destructive mt-1 font-medium">
                                Work days required
                              </p>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <label className="font-medium text-foreground block mb-1.5 text-base">
                              Helper Workers
                            </label>
                            <Input
                              type="number"
                              min="0"
                              max="10"
                              placeholder="0"
                              value={helperWorkersCount}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                setHelperWorkersCount(e.target.value)
                              }
                              className="h-10 text-base"
                              disabled={components.length === 0}
                            />
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-1">
                              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                Available: {availableHelperWorkers}
                              </span>
                              {numHelperWorkers > 0 && numHelperWorkers > availableHelperWorkers && (
                                <span className="text-sm text-destructive font-medium">
                                  Insufficient
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            {numHelperDays > 0 && numHelperWorkers === 0 && (
                              <p className="text-sm text-destructive mt-1 font-medium">
                                Helper count required
                              </p>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <label className="font-medium text-foreground block mb-1.5 text-base">
                              Work Days
                            </label>
                            <Input
                              type="number"
                              min="0"
                              max="60"
                              placeholder="0"
                              value={helperDays}
                              onChange={(e) => setHelperDays(e.target.value)}
                              className="h-10 text-base"
                              disabled={components.length === 0}
                            />
                            {numHelperWorkers > 0 && numHelperDays === 0 && (
                              <p className="text-xs text-destructive mt-1 font-medium">
                                Work days required
                              </p>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="outline"
                        className="w-full h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                        onClick={handleGeneratePriceAdmin}
                        disabled={
                          isGeneratingPrice ||
                          components.length === 0 ||
                          !isCalculatorValid ||
                          !furnitureSize ||
                          !isWorkerSufficient ||
                          (calculatedInputs !== null &&
                            calculatedInputs ===
                              `${skilledWorkersCount}-${skilledDays}-${helperWorkersCount}-${helperDays}-${complexityLevel}-${complexityReasoning}-${complexityFee}`)
                        }
                      >
                        {isGeneratingPrice ? (
                          <span>
                            <Loader2 className="size-5 animate-spin" />
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          "Calculate"
                        )}
                      </Button>

                      {priceGenError && (
                        <p className="text-sm text-destructive text-center font-medium">
                          {priceGenError}
                        </p>
                      )}

                      {adminBreakdown && (
                        <div className="p-4 bg-card border rounded-xl space-y-2.5 text-base">
                          <div className="flex justify-between text-muted-foreground">
                            <span>
                              Material Cost (Wood
                              {(selectedRequest?.quantity ?? 1) > 1
                                ? ` for ${selectedRequest?.quantity} units`
                                : ""}
                              ):
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                              ₱{adminBreakdown.materialCost.toLocaleString()}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex justify-between text-muted-foreground">
                            <span>
                              Labor Cost (Skilled & Helper
                              {(selectedRequest?.quantity ?? 1) > 1
                                ? ` for ${selectedRequest?.quantity} units`
                                : ""}
                              ):
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                              ₱{adminBreakdown.laborCost.toLocaleString()}
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <div className="flex justify-between text-muted-foreground">
                            <span>
                              Design Complexity ({complexityLevel || "Standard"}
                              ):
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                              {Number(complexityFee) > 0
                                ? `₱${Number(complexityFee).toLocaleString()}`
                                : "₱0"}
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <div className="flex justify-between text-muted-foreground">
                            <span>
                              Markup ({adminBreakdown.markupPercent}%):
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                              ₱{adminBreakdown.markup.toLocaleString()}
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <div className="flex justify-between border-t pt-2.5 font-bold text-base">
                            <span>Total Amount:</span>
                            <span className="text-green-600 dark:text-green-400">
                              ₱{adminBreakdown.finalPrice.toLocaleString()}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {adminBreakdown &&
                        (() => {
                          const selectedWoodType =
                            selectedRequest?.wood_type ?? "";
                          const cleanSelectedWood = selectedWoodType
                            .replace(/Lumber|Wood/gi, "")
                            .trim()
                            .toLowerCase();

                          const matchedWoodMaterial = woodMaterials.find(
                            (w) =>
                              w.cleanName.toLowerCase() === cleanSelectedWood ||
                              w.name.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSelectedWood),
                          );

                          const currentWoodStock = matchedWoodMaterial
                            ? matchedWoodMaterial.stock
                            : 0;
                          const woodNameDisplay = matchedWoodMaterial
                            ? matchedWoodMaterial.cleanName ||
                              matchedWoodMaterial.name
                            : selectedWoodType || "Wood";

                          return (
                            <div className="space-y-2">
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-1">
                                <label className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                                  Reasoning Breakdown
                                </label>
                                <span className="text-base font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                                  (For {woodNameDisplay} we have{" "}
                                  {currentWoodStock} stocks)
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              <Textarea
                                rows={2}
                                value={customReasoning}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                  setCustomReasoning(e.target.value)
                                }
                                className="text-base"
                                placeholder="Explain your quotation"
                              />
                            </div>
                          );
                        })()}

                      {showRejectInput && (
                        <div className="pt-3 border-t space-y-3">
                          <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                              <label className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                                Reason for Rejection
                              </label>
                              <span className="text-base text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                                {rejectionReason.length}/300
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <Textarea
                              placeholder="Type reason why rejecting this request"
                              value={rejectionReason}
                              maxLength={300}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                setRejectionReason(e.target.value)
                              }
                              className="text-base h-18 placeholder:text-base"
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* ── Modal Footer Buttons (Outside the card) ── */}
                    {(() => {
                      const selectedWoodType = selectedRequest?.wood_type ?? "";
                      const cleanSelectedWood = selectedWoodType
                        .replace(/Lumber|Wood/gi, "")
                        .trim()
                        .toLowerCase();

                      const matchedWoodMaterial = woodMaterials.find(
                        (w) =>
                          w.cleanName.toLowerCase() === cleanSelectedWood ||
                          w.name.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSelectedWood),
                      );

                      const currentWoodStock = matchedWoodMaterial
                        ? matchedWoodMaterial.stock
                        : 0;

                      const requiredBoardFeet = Math.ceil(
                        (adminBreakdown?.boardFeet ??
                          selectedRequest.board_feet_per_unit ??
                          0) * (selectedRequest.quantity || 1),
                      );

                      const isStockInsufficient =
                        requiredBoardFeet > 0 &&
                        (currentWoodStock < requiredBoardFeet ||
                          matchedWoodMaterial?.status === "Out");

                      return showRejectInput ? (
                        <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-2">
                          <Button
                            variant="outline"
                            type="button"
                            className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setShowRejectInput(false);
                              setRejectionReason("");
                            }}
                          >
                            Cancel
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            variant="destructive"
                            type="button"
                            className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setConfirmAction({
                                status: "Rejected",
                                rejectionReason,
                              });
                            }}
                            disabled={!rejectionReason.trim()}
                          >
                            Confirm Reject
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-2">
                          <Button
                            variant="destructive"
                            className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                            onClick={() => setShowRejectInput(true)}
                            disabled={busy}
                          >
                            Reject
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            className={
                              isStockInsufficient
                                ? "h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center border border-red-500 bg-red-500/10 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/20"
                                : "h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                            }
                            variant={
                              isStockInsufficient ? "outline" : "default"
                            }
                            onClick={() => {
                              if (isStockInsufficient) return;
                              const amount = parseFloat(quoteInput);
                              if (!amount || isNaN(amount)) {
                                toast.error("Enter a valid quote amount.");
                                return;
                              }
                              setConfirmAction({
                                status: "Approved",
                                quoteAmount: amount,
                              });
                            }}
                            disabled={
                              busy ||
                              !quoteInput ||
                              !adminBreakdown ||
                              isStockInsufficient
                            }
                          >
                            {isStockInsufficient
                              ? "Insufficient Stock"
                              : "Approve & Send Quote"}
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })()}
                  </>
                )}

                {/* In Production, Production Done, or Fully Paid */}
                {(selectedRequest.status === "In Production" ||
                  selectedRequest.status === "Production Done" ||
                  selectedRequest.status === "Fully Paid") && (
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    {selectedRequest.payment_option === "70-30" ? (
                      selectedRequest.status === "In Production" ? (
                        <>
                          <div className="border rounded-xl bg-muted/30 p-4 space-y-2">
                            <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                              Production in Progress
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">
                              The 70% downpayment has been received. Once the
                              production is complete, click the button below to
                              notify the customer and request the remaining 30%
                              balance.
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-3.5 -mb-0.5 border-t border-border">
                            <Button
                              type="button"
                              className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-800 text-white"
                              onClick={() => setProductionProofModalOpen(true)}
                              disabled={busy || isSendingProdComplete}
                            >
                              {isSendingProdComplete ? (
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                  <Loader2 className="size-5 animate-spin" />
                                </div>
                              ) : (
                                "Production Complete, Request Remaining 30% Balance"
                              )}
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        (() => {
                          const finalPrice =
                            selectedRequest.quote_amount ??
                            selectedRequest.final_price ??
                            0;
                          const totalAmount =
                            finalPrice + (selectedRequest.shipping_fee ?? 0);
                          const actualPaid = selectedRequest.amount_paid ?? 0;
                          const is30PercentPaid =
                            selectedRequest.status === "Fully Paid" ||
                            (actualPaid >= totalAmount && totalAmount > 0);

                          return is30PercentPaid ? (
                            <>
                              <div className="flex items-start gap-2 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-600 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 animate-in fade-in">
                                <ThumbsUp
                                  size={18}
                                  className="shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-emerald-600"
                                />
                                <div className="min-w-0">
                                  <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                                    Remaining 30% Balance Paid
                                  </p>
                                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                                    The client has paid the remaining 30%
                                    balance in full. You may now mark this order
                                    as completed.
                                  </p>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                              <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-3.5 -mb-0.5 border-t border-border">
                                <Button
                                  className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                                  onClick={() =>
                                    setConfirmAction({ status: "Completed" })
                                  }
                                  disabled={busy}
                                >
                                  Mark as Completed
                                </Button>
                              </div>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <div className="border rounded-xl bg-muted/30 p-4 space-y-3">
                              <p className="text-base text-foreground">
                                Email notification has been sent to{" "}
                                <span className="font-semibold">
                                  {selectedRequest.customer_name}
                                </span>
                                . Waiting for customer to pay the remaining 30%
                                balance checkout.
                              </p>

                              {/* Uploaded Production Proof Photos */}
                              {(selectedRequest.production_proof_url ||
                                selectedRequest.production_proof_url_2) && (
                                <div className="pt-3 border-t border-border space-y-2">
                                  <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                                    Uploaded Production Proof Photos
                                  </p>
                                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 max-w-sm">
                                    {selectedRequest.production_proof_url && (
                                      <div className="space-y-1">
                                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                                          Photo 1 (Finished item)
                                        </p>
                                        <div
                                          className="relative h-28 w-full rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border bg-muted shadow-xs cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90 transition-all"
                                          onClick={() =>
                                            setSelectedProofLightboxUrl(
                                              selectedRequest.production_proof_url!,
                                            )
                                          }
                                        >
                                          <Image
                                            src={
                                              selectedRequest.production_proof_url
                                            }
                                            alt="Production Proof 1"
                                            fill
                                            className="object-cover"
                                            unoptimized
                                          />
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                    )}
                                    {selectedRequest.production_proof_url_2 && (
                                      <div className="space-y-1">
                                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                                          Photo 2 (Detail / Angle)
                                        </p>
                                        <div
                                          className="relative h-28 w-full rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border bg-muted shadow-xs cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90 transition-all"
                                          onClick={() =>
                                            setSelectedProofLightboxUrl(
                                              selectedRequest.production_proof_url_2!,
                                            )
                                          }
                                        >
                                          <Image
                                            src={
                                              selectedRequest.production_proof_url_2
                                            }
                                            alt="Production Proof 2"
                                            fill
                                            className="object-cover"
                                            unoptimized
                                          />
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          );
                        })()
                      )
                    ) : selectedRequest.status === "In Production" ? (
                      <>
                        <div className="border rounded-xl bg-muted/30 p-4 space-y-2">
                          <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                            Production in Progress
                          </p>
                          <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">
                            The full payment (100%) has been received. Once the
                            production is complete, click the button below to
                            upload the finished furniture photos and notify the
                            customer.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-3.5 -mb-0.5 border-t border-border">
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-800 text-white"
                            onClick={() => setProductionProofModalOpen(true)}
                            disabled={busy || isSendingProdComplete}
                          >
                            {isSendingProdComplete ? (
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <Loader2 className="size-5 animate-spin" />
                              </div>
                            ) : (
                              "Production Complete, Send Finished Proof"
                            )}
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <div className="space-y-3">
                          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-600 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 animate-in fade-in">
                            <ThumbsUp
                              size={18}
                              className="shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-emerald-600"
                            />
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                                Full Payment Settled &amp; Production Complete
                              </p>
                              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                                The order is fully paid and finished proof has

                      <p className="text-muted-foreground">

                      if (addWorkerError) setAddWorkerError("");

                  );
                }}
                className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
              >
                Save Selection

            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

}

                    "space-y-1.5",
                    !isCheckout && "border-r pr-2 border-border/50",
                  )}
                >
                  {request.wood_type && (
                    <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">
                      Wood:{" "}
                      <span className="text-foreground font-medium">
                        {request.wood_type}
                        {woodCostPerBf !== null
                          ? ` (₱${woodCostPerBf}/bf)`
                          : ""}
                      </span>
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {request.quantity && (
                    <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">
                      Qty:{" "}
                      <span className="text-foreground font-medium">
                        {request.quantity}
                      </span>
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {(request.dim_width ||
                    request.dim_depth ||
                    request.dim_height) && (
                    <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">
                      Size:{" "}
                      <span className="text-foreground font-medium">
                        {request.dim_width || "?"} W ×{" "}
                        {request.dim_height || "?"} H ×{" "}
                        {request.dim_depth || "?"} L
                      </span>
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {request.furniture_size && (
                    <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">
