                      <span className="text-foreground font-semibold ">
                        {request.furniture_size === "sm" ||
                        request.furniture_size === "small"
                          ? "Small"
                          : request.furniture_size === "md" ||
                              request.furniture_size === "medium"
                            ? "Medium"
                            : request.furniture_size === "lg" ||
                                request.furniture_size === "large"
                              ? "Large"
                              : "Extra Large"}
                      </span>
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {request.target_date &&
                    (() => {
                      const targetDate = new Date(request.target_date);
                      const formattedDate = targetDate.toLocaleDateString(
                        "en-PH",
                        {
                          month: "long",
                          day: "numeric",
                          year: "numeric",
                        },
                      );
                      const today = new Date();
                      today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
                      const tDate = new Date(targetDate);
                      tDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
                      const diffDays = Math.round(
                        (tDate.getTime() - today.getTime()) /
                          (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24),
                      );

                      let leadDays = 7;
                      if (request.target_date && request.created_at) {
                        const created = new Date(request.created_at);
                        created.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
                        const diff = Math.round(
                          (tDate.getTime() - created.getTime()) /
                            (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24),
                        );
                        if (diff > 0) leadDays = diff;
                      }

                      if (request.status === "Pending Review") {
                        return (
                          <div className="space-y-1.5">

                              </span>
                            </p>

                                24h Review Window (Timeline paused until

                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>

                      }

                      if (request.status === "Approved") {

                              </span>
                            </p>
                            {!isCheckout && (

                                Cost breakdown sent. {leadDays}-day production
                                countdown begins upon payment
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        );
                      }

                      return (
                        <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">
                          Target Completion Date:{" "}
                          <span className="text-foreground font-medium">
                            {formattedDate} (
                            {diffDays >= 0
                              ? `${diffDays}d remaining`
                              : `${Math.abs(diffDays)}d overdue`}
                            )
                          </span>
                        </p>
                      );
                    })()}
                </div>

                {}
                {!isCheckout && (
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-start justify-center gap-1.5 h-full">
                    {request.needs_quote ? (
                      <>
                        <span className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-100 dark:bg-green-900/40 text-green-800 dark:text-green-300 font-semibold text-sm border border-green-300/40">
                          Submitted With Consultation
                        </span>
                        {isAdmin && (
                          <div className="text-base text-muted-foreground space-y-1 text-left">
                            <p>
                              Name:{" "}
                              <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                                {request.customer_name || "Customer"}
                              </span>
                            </p>
                            <p>
                              Contact:{" "}
                              <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                                {request.customer_phone ||
                                  request.customer_email ||
                                  "N/A"}
                              </span>
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-start w-full h-full">
                        <span className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 font-semibold text-sm text-center border border-blue-300/40">
                          Submitted Without Consultation
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {}
              {isAdmin &&
              ["Approved", "In Production", "Completed"].includes(
                request.status,
              ) ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-base border-t pt-2">
                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground font-semibold">
                        Final Quoted Amount:
                      </span>
                      <span className="tabular-nums font-semibold text-base text-green-600 dark:text-green-400">
                        ₱{Number(finalPrice).toLocaleString()}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {}
        {!!(request.quote_amount || request.final_price) && !isCheckout && (
          <div className="w-full border rounded-lg p-4 bg-card shadow-sm">
            {}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-base text-foreground">

              </h3>
              <Button

            {}
            {isReasoningExpanded && (

                <div className="p-4 bg-muted/20 border rounded-lg space-y-2 text-base">

                      )}
                    </div>

                  {}
                  <div className="space-y-2.5">
                    <p className="text-base font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                      Payment Summary

                    <div className="space-y-2 text-base">
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                          Payment Option
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-semibold text-primary">
                          {request.payment_option === "70-30"
                            ? "70/30 Split Downpayment"
                            : "Full Payment"}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {materialCost > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex justify-between">
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                            Material Cost
                          </span>

                            ₱{materialCost.toLocaleString()}

                      {laborCost > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex justify-between">
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">

                      {(materialCost > 0 || laborCost > 0) && (

                      {overhead > 0 && (

                            Shipping Fee
                          </span>
                          <span className="tabular-nums font-medium text-foreground">
                            ₱{request.shipping_fee.toLocaleString()}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      ) : null}
                      <div className="flex justify-between font-bold border-t pt-2.5 mt-1 text-base text-foreground">
                        <span>Total Amount</span>
                        <span className="tabular-nums">
                          ₱{Number(total).toLocaleString()}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {(() => {
                        const actualPaid =
                          request.amount_paid && request.amount_paid > 0
                            ? request.amount_paid
                            : request.payment_status === "Paid"
                              ? request.payment_option === "70-30"
                                ? Math.round(finalPrice * 0.7) +
                                  (request.shipping_fee ?? 0)
                                : total
                              : 0;

                        const isFullyPaid =
                          request.payment_status === "Paid" &&
                          (actualPaid >= total ||
                            request.payment_option === "full");

                        const balanceDue =
                          request.payment_option === "70-30" && !isFullyPaid
                            ? Math.max(0, Math.round(finalPrice * 0.3))
                            : 0;

                        const displayPaymentStatus =
                          request.payment_status === "Paid"
                            ? isFullyPaid
                              ? "Paid in Full"
                              : "Downpayment Paid (70%)"
                            : (request.payment_status ?? "Unpaid");

                        return (
                          <>
                            <div className="flex justify-between border-t border-dashed pt-2 text-base text-muted-foreground">
                              <span>Amount Paid</span>
                              <span className="font-semibold text-green-600 dark:text-green-400">
                                ₱{Number(actualPaid).toLocaleString()}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            {request.payment_option === "70-30" && (
                              <div className="flex justify-between text-base text-muted-foreground">
                                <span className="text-amber-600 font-medium">
                                  Balance Due
                                </span>
                                <span className="font-semibold text-amber-600">
                                  ₱{Number(balanceDue).toLocaleString()}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            )}
                            <div className="text-base text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-2">
                              Payment Status:{" "}
                              <span
                                className={cn(
                                  "font-semibold",
                                  isFullyPaid
                                    ? "text-green-600 dark:text-green-400"
                                    : request.payment_status === "Paid"
                                      ? "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"
                                      : "text-amber-500",
                                )}
                              >
                                {displayPaymentStatus}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </>
                        );
                      })()}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {}
        {isAdmin && (
          <DamageBanner
            deliveryId={request.id}
            type="custom"
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            isAdmin={true}
            initialDamageReports={initialDamageReports}
          />
        )}

        {}
        {isAdmin &&
          (request.proof_of_delivery_url ||
            request.proof_of_delivery_url_2) && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                {request.shipping_method === "pickup"
                  ? "Proof of Pickup Photos"
                  : "Proof of Delivery Photos"}
              </p>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 max-w-sm">
                {request.proof_of_delivery_url && (

                    className="relative aspect-[16/10] w-full rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border bg-muted shadow-xs cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90 transition-all"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setSelectedProofUrl(request.proof_of_delivery_url!)

                  >
                    <Image
                      src={request.proof_of_delivery_url}
                      alt="Proof of Delivery 1"
                      fill

                      unoptimized
                    />
                  </div>

                {request.proof_of_delivery_url_2 && (
                  <div

                    onClick={() =>
                      setSelectedProofUrl(request.proof_of_delivery_url_2!)
                    }
                  >
                    <Image
                      src={request.proof_of_delivery_url_2}
                      alt="Proof of Delivery 2"
                      fill
                      className="object-cover"
                      unoptimized
                    />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
      </div>

      {}
      {selectedProofUrl && (
        <Dialog
          open
          onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setSelectedProofUrl(null)}
        >
          <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-xl max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] p-0 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-background">
            <VisuallyHidden>
              <DialogTitle>Proof of Delivery Photo</DialogTitle>
            </VisuallyHidden>
            <div className="relative aspect-square w-full bg-black/5 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Image
                src={selectedProofUrl}
                alt="Proof of Delivery Fullscreen"
                fill
                className="object-contain"
                unoptimized
              />
            </div>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

    <Dialog open onOpenChange={(open) => !open && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent
        className="!max-w-xl w-full p-0 rounded-sm overflow-hidden"
        showCloseButton={false}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
          <VisuallyHidden>
            <DialogTitle>{title}</DialogTitle>
          </VisuallyHidden>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 border-b shrink-0">
            <h2 className="font-semibold text-base md:text-lg text-foreground">
              {title}
            </h2>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              className="size-8 p-0 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted cursor-pointer transition-colors"
              onClick={onClose}
              type="button"
            >
              <X className="size-5 shrink-0" />
              <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
          <ScrollArea className="flex-1" type="always">
            <div className="px-6 py-4 text-base">{children}</div>
          </ScrollArea>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function ArchiveConfirmModal({
  presetName,
  onConfirm,
  onClose,
  busy,
}: {
  presetName: string;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={(open) => !open && !busy && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent
        className="max-w-sm gap-0 p-0 rounded-sm"
        showCloseButton={false}
      >
        <DialogHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 border-b space-y-0">
          <DialogTitle className="font-semibold text-base md:text-lg text-foreground">
            Archive Preset
          </DialogTitle>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            className="size-8 p-0 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted cursor-pointer transition-colors"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={busy}
            type="button"
          >
            <X className="size-5 shrink-0" />
            <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
          </Button>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="px-6 py-4 space-y-4 text-base">
          <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">
            Archive{" "}
            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
              {presetName}?{" "}
            </span>
            It will no longer appear for customers. You can restore it later.
          </p>
          <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-3.5 -mb-0.5 border-t border-border">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              className="h-9 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
              onClick={onClose}
              disabled={busy}
              type="button"
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              className="h-9 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
              variant="destructive"
              onClick={onConfirm}
              disabled={busy}
              type="button"
            >
              {busy && (
                <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
              )}
              Archive
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function Field({
  label,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block">
        {label}
      </label>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function CustomizePresetsAdmin({
  initialTemplates,
}: {
  initialTemplates: CustomizePresetTemplateRow[];
}) {
  const { data, mutate, isLoading } = useSWR<CustomizePresetTemplateRow[]>(
    "/api/admin/customize-presets",
    fetcher,
    { fallbackData: initialTemplates },
  );
  const templates = data ?? initialTemplates;

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState<string>("All");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>("All");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [seeding, setSeeding] = useState(false);

  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<PresetFormState>(emptyForm());
  const [pendingArchive, setPendingArchive] =
    useState<CustomizePresetTemplateRow | null>(null);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const result = templates.filter((t) => {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      const matchSearch =
        !q ||
        t.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        t.description.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchCat =
        categoryFilter === "All" || t.category === categoryFilter;
      const matchStatus =
        statusFilter === "All" ||
        (statusFilter === "Active" ? t.is_active : !t.is_active);
      return matchSearch && matchCat && matchStatus;
    });

    return result.sort((a, b) => {
      const dateA = new Date(a.updated_at).getTime();
      const dateB = new Date(b.updated_at).getTime();
      return dateB - dateA;
    });
  }, [templates, search, categoryFilter, statusFilter]);

  function openCreate() {
    setEditingId(null);
    setForm(emptyForm());
    setShowForm(true);
  }

  function openEdit(row: CustomizePresetTemplateRow) {
    setEditingId(row.id);
    setForm({
      category: row.category,
      label: row.label,
      description: row.description,
      wood_type: row.wood_type ?? "",
      dim_width: row.dim_width,
      dim_height: row.dim_height,
      dim_depth: row.dim_depth,
      complexity_level: row.complexity_level ?? "",
      is_active: row.is_active,
      sort_order: String(row.sort_order ?? 0),
    });
    setShowForm(true);
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        category: form.category,
        label: form.label.trim(),
        description: form.description.trim(),
        wood_type: form.wood_type.trim() || null,
        dim_width: form.dim_width.trim(),
        dim_height: form.dim_height.trim(),
        dim_depth: form.dim_depth.trim(),
        complexity_level: form.complexity_level || null,
        is_active: form.is_active,
        sort_order: Number(form.sort_order) || 0,
      };

      const url = editingId
        ? `/api/admin/customize-presets/${editingId}`
        : "/api/admin/customize-presets";
      const res = await fetch(url, {
        method: editingId ? "PATCH" : "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const json = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Failed to save");

      toast.success(editingId ? "Preset updated." : "Preset created.");
      setShowForm(false);
      mutate();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to save preset.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function confirmArchive() {
    if (!pendingArchive) return;
    const row = pendingArchive;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/customize-presets/${row.id}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ archive: true }),
      });
      const json = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Failed to archive");
      toast.success("Preset archived.");
      setPendingArchive(null);
      mutate();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to archive.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleImportDefaults() {
    setSeeding(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/customize-presets/seed", {
        method: "POST",
      });
      const json = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Import failed");
      toast.success(`Imported ${json.inserted} default presets.`);
      mutate();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Import failed.");
    } finally {
      setSeeding(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5 pb-6">
      {}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
            Customize Preset Templates
          </h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-base mt-0.5">
            Manage quick-fill presets shown on the customer customize form.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          {templates.length === 0 && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
              disabled={seeding}
              onClick={handleImportDefaults}
              type="button"
            >
              {seeding ? (
                <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
              ) : null}
              Import default catalog
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold gap-2 cursor-pointer"
            onClick={openCreate}
            type="button"
          >
            Add Preset
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2.5 w-full">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0">
          <Search
            size={16}
            className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
          />
          <Input
            type="search"
            placeholder="Search presets"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            className="pl-9 h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base w-full"
          />
        </div>
        <Select value={categoryFilter} onValueChange={setCategoryFilter}>
          <SelectTrigger className="cursor-pointer w-full sm:w-[170px] h-11 shrink-0 text-base">
            <SelectValue placeholder="All Categories" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="All" className="text-base">
              All Categories
            </SelectItem>
            {CUSTOMIZE_FURNITURE_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
              <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id} className="text-base">
                {c.label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <Select value={statusFilter} onValueChange={setStatusFilter}>
          <SelectTrigger className="cursor-pointer w-full sm:w-[170px] h-11 shrink-0 text-base">
            <SelectValue placeholder="All Status" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="Active" className="text-base">
              Active
            </SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="Inactive" className="text-base">
              Inactive
            </SelectItem>
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      {}
      <div className="border border-border bg-card rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
        <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-base text-left">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-border text-muted-foreground text-sm font-semibold bg-muted/40">
                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                  Preset Name
                </th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                  Category
                </th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                  Status
                </th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  Actions
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-border text-foreground">
              {isLoading && templates.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td
                    colSpan={4}
                    className="px-4 py-14 text-center text-base text-muted-foreground"
                  >
                    <Loader2 className="size-6 animate-spin mx-auto" />
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td
                    colSpan={4}
                    className="px-4 py-14 text-center text-base text-muted-foreground"
                  >
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                      <SwatchBook className="h-9 w-9 text-muted-foreground/50" />
                      <p className="font-bold text-foreground text-base">
                        No presets found
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        Try adjusting your search query or filters.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filtered.map((row) => (
                  <tr
                    key={row.id}
                    className="hover:bg-muted/40 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 font-medium text-foreground align-middle whitespace-nowrap text-base">
                      {row.label}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-muted-foreground font-medium text-base align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                      {CUSTOMIZE_PRESET_CATEGORY_LABELS[row.category] ??
                        row.category}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                      <span
                        className={cn(
                          "inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 text-base font-semibold rounded-lg border",
                          row.is_active
                            ? presetStatusStyles.active
                            : presetStatusStyles.inactive,
                        )}
                      >
                        {row.is_active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap align-middle">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                        <Button
                          variant="outline"
                          className="h-9 px-3 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                          onClick={() => openEdit(row)}
                          disabled={busy}
                          type="button"
                        >
                          Edit
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="destructive"
                          className="h-9 px-3 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                          onClick={() => setPendingArchive(row)}
                          disabled={busy}
                          type="button"
                        >
                          Archive
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showForm && (
        <Modal
          title={editingId ? "Edit Preset" : "Add Preset"}
          onClose={() => !busy && setShowForm(false)}
        >
          <PresetFormBody
            form={form}
            setForm={setForm}
            isAddMode={editingId === null}
            busy={busy}
            onCancel={() => !busy && setShowForm(false)}
            onSubmit={handleSave}
          />
        </Modal>
      )}

      {pendingArchive && (
        <ArchiveConfirmModal
          presetName={pendingArchive.label}
          onConfirm={confirmArchive}
          onClose={() => !busy && setPendingArchive(null)}
          busy={busy}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function PresetFormBody({
  form,
  setForm,
  isAddMode,
  busy,
  onCancel,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  form: PresetFormState;
  setForm: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<PresetFormState>>;
  isAddMode: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onSubmit: () => void;
}) {
  const [initialForm] = useState<PresetFormState>(() => ({ ...form }));

  const isLabelValid =
    form.label.trim().length >= 3 && form.label.trim().length <= 80;
  const isCategoryValid = form.category !== "";
  const isDescriptionValid = form.description.length <= 500;

  const isDimValid = (raw: string) => {
    const v = raw.trim();
    if (v === "") return true;
    const n = Number(v);
    return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 && n <= 1000;
  };
  const isWidthValid = isDimValid(form.dim_width);
  const isHeightValid = isDimValid(form.dim_height);
  const isDepthValid = isDimValid(form.dim_depth);

  const isSortOrderValid =
    form.sort_order.trim() === "" ||
    (Number.isInteger(Number(form.sort_order)) && Number(form.sort_order) >= 0);

  const isFormFilled =
    isLabelValid &&
    isCategoryValid &&
    isDescriptionValid &&
    isWidthValid &&
    isHeightValid &&
    isDepthValid &&
    isSortOrderValid;

  const hasChanges = isAddMode
    ? form.label.trim() !== ""
    : (Object.keys(form) as Array<keyof PresetFormState>).some(
        (key) => form[key] !== initialForm[key],
      );

  const canSave = isFormFilled && hasChanges;

  const dimError = "Must be a number greater than 0 (max 1000).";

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "space-y-4",
        busy && "cursor-wait opacity-80 pointer-events-none",
      )}
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <Field label="Preset name">
          <Input
            value={form.label}
            onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, label: e.target.value }))}
            placeholder="Standard Dining Chair"
            maxLength={80}
            className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
              form.label.length > 0 && !isLabelValid
                ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                : ""
            }`}
          />
          {form.label.length > 0 && !isLabelValid && (
            <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
              Must be 3 to 80 characters.
            </p>
          )}
        </Field>

        <Field label="Category">
          <Select
            value={form.category || undefined}
            onValueChange={(v) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, category: v }))}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-full h-10 text-base cursor-pointer">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Choose category" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {CUSTOMIZE_FURNITURE_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id} className="text-base py-2">
                  {c.label}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </div>

      <Field label="Description">
        <Textarea
          rows={3}
          value={form.description}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setForm((f) => ({ ...f, description: e.target.value }))
          }
          placeholder="Auto-fills customer description when preset is selected"
          maxLength={500}
          className={`text-base placeholder:text-base ${
            !isDescriptionValid
              ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
              : ""
          }`}
        />
        {!isDescriptionValid && (
          <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
            Must be 500 characters or less.
          </p>
        )}
      </Field>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <Field label="Default wood type (optional)">
          <Input
            value={form.wood_type}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm((f) => ({ ...f, wood_type: e.target.value }))
            }
            placeholder="Mahogany"
            maxLength={60}
            className="h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base"
          />
        </Field>

        <Field label="Complexity (optional)">
          <Select
            value={form.complexity_level || "__none__"}
            onValueChange={(v) =>
              setForm((f) => ({
                ...f,
                complexity_level: v === "__none__" ? "" : v,
              }))
            }
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-full h-10 text-base cursor-pointer">
              <SelectValue placeholder="None" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="__none__" className="text-base py-2">
                None
              </SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="Simple" className="text-base py-2">
                Simple
              </SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="Moderate" className="text-base py-2">
                Moderate
              </SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="Complex" className="text-base py-2">
                Complex
              </SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Field label="Width (in)">
          <Input
            inputMode="decimal"
            value={form.dim_width}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm((f) => ({ ...f, dim_width: e.target.value }))
            }
            placeholder="0"
            className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
              form.dim_width.length > 0 && !isWidthValid
                ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                : ""
            }`}
          />
          {form.dim_width.length > 0 && !isWidthValid && (
            <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
              {dimError}
            </p>
          )}
        </Field>
        <Field label="Height (in)">
          <Input
            inputMode="decimal"
            value={form.dim_height}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm((f) => ({ ...f, dim_height: e.target.value }))
            }
            placeholder="0"
            className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
              form.dim_height.length > 0 && !isHeightValid
                ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                : ""
            }`}
          />
          {form.dim_height.length > 0 && !isHeightValid && (
            <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
              {dimError}
            </p>
          )}
        </Field>
        <Field label="Length (in)">
          <Input
            inputMode="decimal"
            value={form.dim_depth}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm((f) => ({ ...f, dim_depth: e.target.value }))
            }
            placeholder="0"
            className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
              form.dim_depth.length > 0 && !isDepthValid
                ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                : ""
            }`}
          />
          {form.dim_depth.length > 0 && !isDepthValid && (
            <p className="text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 animate-in fade-in">
              {dimError}
            </p>
          )}
        </Field>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <Field label="Sort order">
          <Input
            type="text"
            inputMode="numeric"
            maxLength={3}
            value={form.sort_order}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm((f) => ({
                ...f,
                sort_order: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 3),
              }))
            }
            placeholder="0"
            className={`h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base ${
              !isSortOrderValid
                ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                : ""
            }`}
          />
        </Field>

        <div className="flex items-end pb-1">
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer h-10">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={form.is_active}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm((f) => ({ ...f, is_active: e.target.checked }))
              }
              className="size-4 accent-primary"
            />
            <span className="text-base font-medium">
              Active (visible to customers)
            </span>
          </label>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-3.5 -mb-0.5 border-t border-border">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
          onClick={onCancel}
          disabled={busy}
          type="button"
        >
          Cancel
        </Button>
        <Button
          className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
          disabled={busy || !canSave}
          onClick={onSubmit}
          type="button"
        >
          {busy && (
            <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
          )}
          {isAddMode ? "Add Preset" : "Save Changes"}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import {

};

export default async function CustomizePage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const [requests, settings, woodMaterials, { data: archivedMaterials }] =
    await Promise.all([
      getCustomizeRequestsForAdmin(),
      getCustomizeSettings(),
      getActiveWoodMaterials(),

      supabase
        .from("raw_materials")
        .select("name")
        .eq("is_archived", true),
    ]);

  const archivedMaterialNames = (archivedMaterials ?? []).map((m) => {

    return m.name.replace(/\s*(Lumber|Wood|Plywood|Board)$/i, "").trim();
  });

  return (
    <CustomizeAdmin
      initialRequests={requests}
      initialSettings={settings}
      archivedMaterialNames={archivedMaterialNames}
      woodMaterials={woodMaterials}
    />
  );
}

export default function Customize({

  function handlePresetSelect(presetLabel: string) {
    setSelectedPreset(presetLabel);

    const currentPresets = categoryPresets[furnitureType] || [];
    const found = currentPresets.find((p) => p.label === presetLabel);
    if (found) {

      if (found.woodType && standardWoodTypes.includes(found.woodType)) {

  const [dimensionErrors, setDimensionErrors] = useState<{

  }>({});
  const [quantityError, setQuantityError] = useState<string>("");

  function handleDimensionChange(

  ) {

    let val = rawValue.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, "");
    if (val.startsWith(".")) val = "";

    }

    dimensions.length.trim() !== "" &&

  async function compressImage(file: File): Promise<File> {

    if (file.size <= 400 * 1024 || file.type === "image/gif") {
      return file;
    }

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const img = new Image();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      img.onload = () => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        let { width, height } = img;
        const maxDim = 1600;

        if (width > maxDim || height > maxDim) {
          if (width > height) {
            height = Math.round((height * maxDim) / width);
            width = maxDim;
          } else {
            width = Math.round((width * maxDim) / height);
            height = maxDim;
          }
        }

        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        if (!ctx) {
          resolve(file);
          return;
        }

        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
        canvas.toBlob(
          (blob) => {
            if (!blob || blob.size >= file.size) {
              resolve(file);
            } else {
              const compressedFile = new File(
                [blob],
                file.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, ".jpg"),
                {
                  type: "image/jpeg",
                  lastModified: Date.now(),
                },
              );
              resolve(compressedFile);
            }
          },
          "image/jpeg",
          0.82,
        );
      };
      img.onerror = () => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        resolve(file);
      };
      img.src = url;
    });
  }

  function handleSlotClick(index: number) {

  async function handleSlotFiles(files: FileList) {
    const ALLOWED_TYPES = [
      "image/jpeg",
      "image/png",
      "image/webp",
      "image/gif",
      "image/heic",
      "image/heif",
    ];
    const ALLOWED_EXTS = ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "webp", "gif", "heic", "heif"];
    const MAX_SINGLE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
    const MAX_TOTAL_SIZE = 4 * 1024 * 1024;

    const existingFileKeys = new Set(
      images.map((item) => `${item.file.name}_${item.file.size}`),
    );
    const seenBatchKeys = new Set<string>();

    const validFiles = Array.from(files)
      .filter((file) => {
        const ext = file.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
        const mimeOk =
          file.type === ""
            ? ALLOWED_EXTS.includes(ext)
            : ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type);
        const extOk = ALLOWED_EXTS.includes(ext) || file.type === "";
        if (!mimeOk || (!extOk && file.type !== "")) {
          toast.error(
            `"${file.name}" is not allowed. Only JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF images are accepted.`,
          );
          return false;
        }
        if (file.size > MAX_SINGLE_SIZE) {
          toast.error(`"${file.name}" exceeds 10MB.`);
          return false;
        }
        const fileKey = `${file.name}_${file.size}`;
        if (existingFileKeys.has(fileKey) || seenBatchKeys.has(fileKey)) {
          toast.error(
            `"${file.name}" has already been attached. Duplicate image ignored.`,
          );
          return false;
        }
        seenBatchKeys.add(fileKey);
        return true;
      })
      .slice(0, 5);

    if (validFiles.length === 0) return;

    const compressedFiles = await Promise.all(
      validFiles.map((f) => compressImage(f)),
    );

    setImages((prev) => {
      const updated = [...prev];
      let fileIdx = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < 5 && fileIdx < compressedFiles.length; i++) {
        if (!updated[i]) {
          const file = compressedFiles[fileIdx++];
          updated[i] = { file, preview: URL.createObjectURL(file) };
        }
      }

      const nextImages = updated.slice(0, 5);
      const totalSize = nextImages.reduce(
        (acc, img) => acc + (img.file.size || 0),
        0,
      );
      if (totalSize > MAX_TOTAL_SIZE) {
        toast.warning(
          "Total size of reference images is approaching 4MB. Uploaded images were compressed.",
        );
      }
      return nextImages;
    });
  }

  function handleRemoveImage(index: number) {

    if (!isFormReady) return;
    if (leadMode === "custom") {

      );

        "Total image payload exceeds 4MB. Please remove or upload smaller images.",

    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setSubmitError("");

      const formData = new FormData();

      formData.append("furnitureType", furnitureType);
      formData.append("furnitureDescription", furnitureDescription);
      formData.append("woodType", woodType);
      formData.append("dimWidth", dimensions.width || "");
      formData.append("dimHeight", dimensions.height || "");
      formData.append("dimDepth", dimensions.length || "");
      formData.append("quantity", quantity);
      formData.append("targetDate", computedTargetDate);
      formData.append("leadTimeDays", String(selectedLeadDays));
      formData.append("needsQuote", String(needsQuote));

      images.forEach((img) => formData.append("images", img.file));

      const res = await fetch("/api/client/customize", {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });

      if (res.status === 413) {
        setSubmitError(
          "Total request payload is too large (exceeds Vercel's 4.5MB limit). Please upload smaller or fewer reference images.",
        );
        toast.error("Upload size too large (413). Please use smaller images.");
        return;
      }

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
        setSubmitError(
          data.error ?? "Failed to submit request. Please try again.",
        );
        return;
      }

      mutate("/api/client/customize/requests");
      router.refresh();
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      setSubmitted(true);
    } catch {
      setSubmitError("Something went wrong. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  function resetForm() {
    setFurnitureType("");
    setFurnitureDescription("");
    setWoodType("");
    setDimensions({ width: "", height: "", length: "" });
    setQuantity("1");
    setLeadMode("standard");
    setCustomDays("10");
    images.forEach((img) => URL.revokeObjectURL(img.preview));
    setImages([]);
    setNeedsQuote(true);
    setSubmitted(false);

    setSubmitError("");
  }

  return (
    <>
      {isSubmitting && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] cursor-wait pointer-events-auto" />
      )}
      <main className="min-h-screen pb-20 animate-in fade-in duration-700">
        <div className="text-center pt-10 pb-4 max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6">

          </h2>

          {}

                ) : (

                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {}
      <CustomizationGuidelinesModal
        open={guidelinesOpen}
        onClose={handleCloseGuidelines}
      />
    </>
  );
}
