```typescript
      setSelectedPreset("");
      setFurnitureType(request.furniture_type || "tables");
      setFurnitureDescription(request.furniture_description || "");
      setWoodType(request.wood_type || "Mahogany");
      setQuantity(String(request.quantity || 1));
      setQuantityError("");
      setDimensions({
        width: request.dim_width || "",
        height: request.dim_height || "",
        length: request.dim_depth || "",
      });
      setDimensionErrors({});

      if (request.target_date && request.created_at) {
        const created = new Date(request.created_at);
        created.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        const target = new Date(request.target_date);
        target.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        const diffDays = Math.round(
          (target.getTime() - created.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24),
        );
        if (diffDays === 7 || diffDays <= 0) {
          setLeadMode("standard");
          setCustomDays("10");
        } else {
          setLeadMode("custom");
          setCustomDays(String(Math.max(3, Math.min(90, diffDays))));
        }
      } else {
        setLeadMode("standard");
        setCustomDays("10");
      }

      setReason("");
    }
  }, [open, request]);

  const handlePresetSelect = (presetLabel: string) => {
    setSelectedPreset(presetLabel);
    if (!presetLabel) return;
    const presets = categoryPresets[furnitureType] || [];
    const found = presets.find((p) => p.label === presetLabel);
    if (found) {
      setFurnitureDescription(found.description);
      if (found.dimensions) {
        setDimensions(found.dimensions);
        setActiveFields((prev) =>
          prev.includes("dimensions") ? prev : [...prev, "dimensions"],
        );
      }
      if (found.woodType) {
        if (dynamicWoodMeta[found.woodType]?.isOutOfStock) {
          toast.warning(
            `${found.woodType} is currently out of stock for this preset. Please select an available wood type.`,
          );
        } else {
          setWoodType(found.woodType);
          setActiveFields((prev) =>
            prev.includes("wood_type") ? prev : [...prev, "wood_type"],
          );
        }
      }
      toast.info(`Preset applied: "${found.label}"`);
    }
  };

  const addField = (field: FieldKey) => {
    if (!activeFields.includes(field)) {
      setActiveFields((prev) => [...prev, field]);
    }
  };

  const removeField = (field: FieldKey) => {
    setActiveFields((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f !== field));
  };

  function handleDimensionChange(
    dim: "width" | "height" | "length",
    rawValue: string,
  ) {
    let val = rawValue.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, "");
    if (val.startsWith(".")) val = "";
    if (val.length > 1 && val.startsWith("0") && val[1] !== ".") {
      val = val.replace(/^0+/, "");
    }
    const parts = val.split(".");
    if (parts.length > 2) {
      val = parts[0] + "." + parts.slice(1).join("");
    }
    if (parts[0].length > 3) {
      parts[0] = parts[0].slice(0, 3);
      val = parts.join(".");
      setDimensionErrors((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [dim]: "Max of 3 digits.",
      }));
      setTimeout(() => {
        setDimensionErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, [dim]: undefined }));
      }, 3000);
    } else {
      setDimensionErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, [dim]: undefined }));
    }
    setDimensions((prev) => ({ ...prev, [dim]: val }));
  }

  function handleQuantityChange(rawValue: string) {
    let val = rawValue.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "").replace(/^0+/, "");
    if (val.length > 3) {
      val = val.slice(0, 3);
      setQuantityError("Max of 3 digits.");
      setTimeout(() => {
        setQuantityError("");
      }, 3000);
    } else {
      setQuantityError("");
    }
    setQuantity(val);
  }

  function handleCustomDaysChange(rawValue: string) {
    let val = rawValue.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
    if (val.length > 3) {
      val = val.slice(0, 3);
    }
    setCustomDays(val);
  }

  const customDaysNum = parseInt(customDays);
  const customDaysError = useMemo(() => {
    if (leadMode !== "custom") return "";
    if (!customDays || customDays.trim() === "") {
      return "Crafting days is required (min 5, max 31 days).";
    }
    if (isNaN(customDaysNum)) {
      return "Please enter a valid number of days.";
    }
    if (customDaysNum < 5) {
      return "Minimum crafting time is 5 days.";
    }
    if (customDaysNum > 31) {
      return "Maximum crafting time is 31 days.";
    }
    return "";
  }, [leadMode, customDays, customDaysNum]);

  const selectedLeadDays =
    leadMode === "standard"
      ? 7
      : Math.min(90, Math.max(3, isNaN(customDaysNum) ? 7 : customDaysNum));

  const computedTargetDate = useMemo(() => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + selectedLeadDays);
    return d.toISOString().split("T")[0];
  }, [selectedLeadDays]);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (activeFields.length === 0) {
      toast.error("Please select at least one specification to edit.");
      return;
    }

    const changes: CustomizePendingEdit["changes"] = {};

    if (activeFields.includes("furniture_type_and_desc")) {
      const cleanDesc = furnitureDescription.trim();
      if (!cleanDesc) {
        toast.error("Please provide a description for the furniture.");
        return;
      }
      if (cleanDesc.length < 8) {
        toast.error("Furniture description must be at least 8 characters.");
        return;
      }
      if (cleanDesc.length > 300) {
        toast.error("Furniture description cannot exceed 300 characters.");
        return;
      }
      changes.furniture_type = {
        old: request.furniture_type,
        new: furnitureType,
      };
      changes.furniture_description = {
        old: request.furniture_description,
        new: cleanDesc,
      };
    }

    if (activeFields.includes("wood_type")) {
      if (!woodType) {
        toast.error("Please select a wood type.");
        return;
      }
      if (dynamicWoodMeta[woodType]?.isOutOfStock) {
        toast.error(
          `The selected wood (${woodType}) is currently out of stock. Please choose an available wood.`,
        );
        return;
      }
      changes.wood_type = {
        old: request.wood_type,
        new: woodType,
      };
    }

    if (activeFields.includes("quantity")) {
      const qtyNum = parseInt(quantity);
      if (isNaN(qtyNum) || qtyNum < 1 || qtyNum > 100) {
        toast.error("Quantity must be between 1 and 100 units.");
        return;
      }
      changes.quantity = {
        old: request.quantity,
        new: qtyNum,
      };
    }

    if (activeFields.includes("dimensions")) {
      const w = dimensions.width.trim();
      const d = dimensions.length.trim();
      const h = dimensions.height.trim();

      if (!w && !d && !h) {
        toast.error("Please enter at least one dimension specification.");
        return;
      }

      changes.dim_width = {
        old: request.dim_width,
        new: w || null,
      };
      changes.dim_depth = {
        old: request.dim_depth,
        new: d || null,
      };
      changes.dim_height = {
        old: request.dim_height,
        new: h || null,
      };
    }

    if (activeFields.includes("lead_time")) {
      if (leadMode === "custom") {
        if (isNaN(customDaysNum) || customDaysNum < 3 || customDaysNum > 90) {
          toast.error("Crafting days must be between 3 and 90 days.");
          return;
        }
      }
      changes.target_date = {
        old: request.target_date,
        new: computedTargetDate,
      };
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await requestCustomizeEditAction(
          request.id,
          changes,
          reason.trim() || undefined,
        );

        if (res.success) {
          toast.success(
            "Specification edit request submitted. Our team will review your changes.",
          );
          onSuccess?.(changes, reason.trim() || undefined);
          onClose();
        } else {
          toast.error(res.error || "Failed to submit edit request.");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Submit edit request error:", err);
        toast.error("An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.");
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && !isPending && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="!max-w-4xl w-[95vw] max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col p-0 gap-0 overflow-hidden border border-border rounded-lg bg-card shadow-lg">
        {}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3.5 border-b border-border bg-card shrink-0">
          <DialogTitle className="font-semibold text-base md:text-lg text-foreground">
            Request Specification Edit
          </DialogTitle>
        </div>

        {}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex flex-col flex-1 min-h-0">
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 py-5 space-y-6">
            {}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground block">
                Select Specifications to Edit
              </label>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2.5">
                {AVAILABLE_FIELDS.map((f) => {
                  const isSelected = activeFields.includes(f.key);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={f.key}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        isSelected ? removeField(f.key) : addField(f.key)
                      }
                      className={cn(
                        "px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-base font-medium border transition-colors cursor-pointer",
                        isSelected
                          ? "border-primary bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold shadow-xs"
                          : "border-border bg-muted/30 text-foreground hover:bg-muted/70 hover:border-foreground/30",
                      )}
                    >
                      {f.label} {isSelected ? "" : "+"}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {}
            {activeFields.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="border border-dashed border-border rounded-lg p-8 text-center text-base text-muted-foreground">
                Select one or more specifications above to customize your
                changes.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-5">
                {activeFields.map((fieldKey) => {

                  if (fieldKey === "furniture_type_and_desc") {
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={fieldKey}
                        className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card overflow-hidden"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3 border-b border-border bg-muted/20">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-base text-foreground">
                            Furniture Type
                          </span>
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8 px-3 text-base text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive cursor-pointer"
                            onClick={() => removeField(fieldKey)}
                          >
                            Remove
                          </Button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="p-5 space-y-4">
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                            <div className="space-y-1.5">
                              <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block">
                                Furniture Type
                              </label>
                              <Select
                                value={furnitureType}
                                onValueChange={(val) => {
                                  setFurnitureType(val);
                                  setSelectedPreset("");
                                }}
                              >
                                <SelectTrigger className="w-full !h-11 h-11 text-base">
                                  <SelectValue placeholder="What are we building?" />
                                </SelectTrigger>
                                <SelectContent>
                                  {FURNITURE_TYPES.map((t) => (
                                    <SelectItem
                                      key={t.value}
                                      value={t.value}
                                      className="text-base"
                                    >
                                      {t.label}
                                    </SelectItem>
                                  ))}
                                </SelectContent>
                              </Select>
                            </div>

                            {furnitureType &&
                              categoryPresets[furnitureType]?.length > 0 && (
                                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                                  <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block">
                                    Quick Preset Template{" "}
                                    <span className="text-muted-foreground font-normal">
                                      (Optional)
                                    </span>
                                  </label>
                                  <Select
                                    value={selectedPreset}
                                    onValueChange={handlePresetSelect}
                                  >
                                    <SelectTrigger className="w-full !h-11 h-11 text-base">
                                      <SelectValue placeholder="Pick a standard preset template to auto-fill" />
                                    </SelectTrigger>
                                    <SelectContent>
                                      {categoryPresets[furnitureType].map(
                                        (preset) => (
                                          <SelectItem
                                            key={preset.label}
                                            value={preset.label}
                                            className="text-base"
                                          >
                                            {preset.label}
                                          </SelectItem>
                                        ),
                                      )}
                                    </SelectContent>
                                  </Select>
                                </div>
                              )}
                          </div>

                          <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                              <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block">
                                {furnitureType === "chairs"
                                  ? "Describe Your Chair"
                                  : furnitureType === "tables"
                                    ? "Describe Your Table"
                                    : furnitureType === "cabinets"
                                      ? "Describe Your Cabinet"
                                      : furnitureType === "bed-frames"
                                        ? "Describe Your Bed Frame"
                                        : "Describe Your Furniture"}
                              </label>
                              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground/70 font-normal">
                                {furnitureDescription.length}/300
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <Textarea
                              value={furnitureDescription}
                              onChange={(e) => {
                                setFurnitureDescription(e.target.value);
                                setSelectedPreset("");
                              }}
                              placeholder="Pick a preset template above or type your custom furniture specifications here"
                              rows={3}
                              className={cn(
                                "resize-none text-base placeholder:text-base transition-colors",
                                furnitureDescription.length > 0 &&
                                  furnitureDescription.trim().length < 8 &&
                                  "border-destructive text-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive bg-destructive/5",
                              )}
                              maxLength={300}
                            />
                            {furnitureDescription.length > 0 &&
                              furnitureDescription.trim().length < 8 && (
                                <p className="text-sm text-destructive font-medium animate-in fade-in">
                                  Must be 8 to 300 characters.
                                </p>
                              )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  }

                  if (fieldKey === "wood_type") {
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={fieldKey}
                        className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card overflow-hidden"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3 border-b border-border bg-muted/20">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-base text-foreground">
                            Wood Type (Kindry)
                          </span>
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8 px-3 text-base text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive cursor-pointer"
                            onClick={() => removeField(fieldKey)}
                          >
                            Remove
                          </Button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="p-5 space-y-2">
                          <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block">
                            Wood Type{" "}
                            <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                              (Kindry)
                            </span>
                          </label>
                          <Select
                            value={woodType}
                            onValueChange={setWoodType}
                            onOpenChange={(open) => {
                              if (!open) setHoveredWood(null);
                            }}
                          >
                            <SelectTrigger className="w-full !h-11 h-11 text-base">
                              <SelectValue placeholder="Select wood type" />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent className="overflow-visible">
                              <div className="flex">
                                <div className="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
                                  {standardWoodTypes.map((w) => {
                                    const isOut =
                                      dynamicWoodMeta[w]?.isOutOfStock;
                                    return (
                                      <SelectItem
                                        key={w}
                                        value={w}
                                        disabled={isOut}
                                        className="text-base cursor-pointer"
                                        onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredWood(w)}
                                      >
                                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                          <span
                                            className={cn(
                                              isOut && "text-muted-foreground",
                                            )}
                                          >
                                            {w}
                                          </span>
                                          {dynamicWoodMeta[w] && (
                                            <span
                                              className={cn(
                                                "text-sm",
                                                isOut
                                                  ? "text-red-500 font-semibold"
                                                  : "text-muted-foreground",
                                              )}
                                            >
                                              [{dynamicWoodMeta[w].label}]
                                            </span>
                                          )}
                                        </div>
                                      </SelectItem>
                                    );
                                  })}
                                </div>

                                {}
                                {hoveredWood && (
                                  <div className="hidden sm:flex flex-col w-48 border-l border-border bg-muted/20 p-2.5 justify-center gap-2 shrink-0 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
                                    <div className="relative w-full h-32 rounded-md overflow-hidden bg-muted border border-border/60 shadow-xs">
                                      <img
                                        src={getWoodImageUrl(hoveredWood)}
                                        alt={hoveredWood}
                                        className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                                        onError={(e) => {
                                          (
                                            e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                                          ).style.display = "none";
                                        }}
                                      />
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="text-center space-y-1">
                                      <p className="text-base font-bold text-foreground leading-tight">
                                        {hoveredWood}
                                      </p>
                                      {dynamicWoodMeta[hoveredWood]
                                        ?.description && (
                                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-snug">
                                          {
                                            dynamicWoodMeta[hoveredWood]
                                              .description
                                          }
                                        </p>
                                      )}
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </SelectContent>
                          </Select>
                          {woodType &&
                            dynamicWoodMeta[woodType]?.isOutOfStock && (
                              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-destructive animate-in fade-in">
                                The selected wood is currently out of stock.
                                Please choose another wood.
                              </p>
                            )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  }

                  if (fieldKey === "quantity") {
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={fieldKey}
                        className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card overflow-hidden"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3 border-b border-border bg-muted/20">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-base text-foreground">
                            Quantity
                          </span>
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8 px-3 text-base text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive cursor-pointer"
                            onClick={() => removeField(fieldKey)}
                          >
                            Remove
                          </Button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="p-5 space-y-2 max-w-sm">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block">
                              Quantity
                            </label>
                            {quantityError && (
                              <p className="text-destructive font-medium animate-in fade-in text-sm">
                                {quantityError}
                              </p>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <Input
                            type="text"
                            inputMode="numeric"
                            placeholder="How many units?"
                            value={quantity}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              handleQuantityChange(e.target.value)
                            }
                            onKeyDown={(e) => {
                              if (
                                ["-", "+", "e", "E", ".", ","].includes(e.key)
                              )
                                e.preventDefault();
                            }}
                            className={cn(
                              "!h-11 h-11 text-base placeholder:text-base transition-colors",
                              quantityError &&
                                "border-destructive text-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive",
                            )}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  }

                  if (fieldKey === "dimensions") {
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={fieldKey}
                        className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card overflow-hidden"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3 border-b border-border bg-muted/20">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-base text-foreground">
                            Dimensions (Inches)
                          </span>
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8 px-3 text-base text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive cursor-pointer"
                            onClick={() => removeField(fieldKey)}
                          >
                            Remove
                          </Button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="p-5 space-y-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block">
                              Dimensions{" "}
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                                (Inches)
                              </span>
                            </label>
                            {(dimensionErrors.width ||
                              dimensionErrors.height ||
                              dimensionErrors.length) && (
                              <p className="text-destructive font-medium animate-in fade-in text-sm">
                                {dimensionErrors.width ||
                                  dimensionErrors.height ||
                                  dimensionErrors.length}
                              </p>
                            )}
                          </div>

                          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                            {(["width", "height", "length"] as const).map(
                              (dim) => (
                                <div key={dim} className="space-y-1.5">
                                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground capitalize">
                                    {dim}
                                  </p>
                                  <Input
                                    type="text"
                                    inputMode="decimal"
                                    placeholder='0"'
                                    value={dimensions[dim]}
                                    onChange={(e) =>
                                      handleDimensionChange(dim, e.target.value)
                                    }
                                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                                      if (["-", "+", "e", "E"].includes(e.key))
                                        e.preventDefault();
                                    }}
                                    className={cn(
                                      "!h-11 h-11 text-base placeholder:text-base transition-colors",
                                      dimensionErrors[dim] &&
                                        "border-destructive text-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive",
                                    )}
                                  />
                                </div>
                              ),
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  }

                  if (fieldKey === "lead_time") {
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={fieldKey}
                        className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card overflow-hidden"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3 border-b border-border bg-muted/20">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-base text-foreground">
                            Production Lead Time
                          </span>
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8 px-3 text-base text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive cursor-pointer"
                            onClick={() => removeField(fieldKey)}
                          >
                            Remove
                          </Button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="p-5 space-y-4">
                          <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block">
                            Production Lead Time
                          </label>

                          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setLeadMode("standard")}
                              className={cn(
                                "!h-11 h-11 px-4 rounded-lg border text-base font-medium flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer truncate",
                                leadMode === "standard"
                                  ? "border-primary bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold shadow-xs"
                                  : "border-border hover:border-foreground/40 text-muted-foreground",
                              )}
                            >
                              {leadMode === "standard" && (
                                <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0 text-primary" />
                              )}
                              <span className="truncate">
                                Standard (7 Days)
                              </span>
                            </button>

                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setLeadMode("custom")}
                              className={cn(
                                "!h-11 h-11 px-4 rounded-lg border text-base font-medium flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer truncate",
                                leadMode === "custom"
                                  ? "border-primary bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold shadow-xs"
                                  : "border-border hover:border-foreground/40 text-muted-foreground",
                              )}
                            >
                              {leadMode === "custom" && (
                                <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0 text-primary" />
                              )}
                              <span className="truncate">Custom Days</span>
                            </button>
                          </div>

                          {leadMode === "custom" && (
                            <div className="animate-in fade-in space-y-2 pt-1">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                                <Input
                                  type="number"
                                  min={5}
                                  max={31}
                                  value={customDays}
                                  onChange={(e) =>
                                    handleCustomDaysChange(e.target.value)
                                  }
                                  placeholder="10"
                                  className={cn(
                                    "!h-11 h-11 text-base w-36 font-semibold placeholder:text-base tabular-nums",
                                    customDaysError &&
                                      "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive text-destructive",
                                  )}
                                />
                                <span className="text-base font-medium text-foreground">
                                  crafting days
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              {customDaysError ? (
                                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-destructive animate-in fade-in">
                                  {customDaysError}
                                </p>
                              ) : (
                                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">

                  }

                })}
              </div>
            )}

            {}
            <div className="space-y-2 pt-1">
              <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block">
                Reason for Changes{" "}
                <span className="text-muted-foreground text-base font-normal">
                  (Optional)
                </span>
              </label>
              <Textarea
                value={reason}
                onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Let our craftsmen know the reason for your change"
                rows={3}
                className="resize-none text-base placeholder:text-base"
                maxLength={300}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {}
          <div className="px-6 py-4 border-t border-border bg-card flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0">
            <span className="text-base text-muted-foreground">
              Edit {currentEditCount + 1} of 2{" "}
              {remainingEdits === 1 && "(Final Edit)"}
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={isPending}
                className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isPending || activeFields.length === 0}
                className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isPending ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1" />
                    Submit Edit Request
                  </>
                ) : (
                  "Submit Edit Request"
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
```

```typescript
import type { CustomizeRequest } from "@/lib/supabase/customize";

import {

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { UserAddress } from "@/lib/supabase/addresses";
import { AddressManagerModal } from "@/components/crafit-compo/address-manager-modal";

interface ProfileDefaults {

  phone: string | null;
  houseNumber: string | null;
  street: string | null;
  barangay: string | null;
  municipality: string | null;
  province: string | null;
}

interface CheckoutCustomizeClientProps {
  request: CustomizeRequest;
  profile: ProfileDefaults;
  initialAddresses?: UserAddress[];
}

export default function CheckoutCustomizeClient({
  request,
  profile,
  initialAddresses = [],

  const isBalancePayment = request.status === "Production Done";

  const [addresses, setAddresses] = useState<UserAddress[]>(() => {
    if (initialAddresses.length > 0) return initialAddresses;
    if (profile.province && profile.municipality) {
      return [
        {
          id: "profile-default",
          user_id: "",
          label: "Home",
          full_name: profile.fullName ?? "",
          phone: profile.phone ?? "",
          house_number: profile.houseNumber ?? "",
          street: profile.street ?? "",
          barangay: profile.barangay ?? "",
          municipality: profile.municipality ?? "",
          province: profile.province ?? "",
          is_default: true,
        },
      ];
    }
    return [];
  });

  const [selectedAddress, setSelectedAddress] = useState<UserAddress | null>(
    () => {

      if (isBalancePayment && request.shipping_address) {
        return {
          id: "locked-order-address",
          user_id: "",
          label: "Confirmed Address",
          full_name: request.customer_name || profile.fullName || "Customer",
          phone: request.customer_phone || profile.phone || "",
          house_number: "",
          street: request.shipping_address,
          barangay: request.shipping_barangay || "",
          municipality: request.shipping_city || "",
          province: request.shipping_province || "",
          is_default: true,
        };
      }
      if (initialAddresses.length > 0) {
        return (
          initialAddresses.find((a) => a.is_default) ?? initialAddresses[0]
        );
      }
      if (profile.province && profile.municipality) {
        return {
          id: "profile-default",
          user_id: "",
          label: "Home",
          full_name: profile.fullName ?? "",
          phone: profile.phone ?? "",
          house_number: profile.houseNumber ?? "",
          street: profile.street ?? "",
          barangay: profile.barangay ?? "",
          municipality: profile.municipality ?? "",
          province: profile.province ?? "",
          is_default: true,
        };
      }
      return null;
    },
  );

  const [isAddressModalOpen, setIsAddressModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const [isPlacing, setIsPlacing] = useState(false);
  const [isConfirmed, setIsConfirmed] = useState(false);

  const [showMobileSummary, setShowMobileSummary] = useState(false);
  const [isClosing, setIsClosing] = useState(false);

  const { savedMethod, isLoaded: paymentLoaded } = useSavedPaymentMethod();
  const [selectedPaymentMethod, setSelectedPaymentMethod] =
    useState<PaymentMethodId>("gcash");
  const [savePaymentDefault, setSavePaymentDefault] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (paymentLoaded) {

      setSelectedPaymentMethod(savedMethod);
    }
  }, [paymentLoaded, savedMethod]);

  const closeMobileSummary = () => {
    setIsClosing(true);

      setShowMobileSummary(false);
      setIsClosing(false);
    }, 250);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.style.overflow = showMobileSummary ? "hidden" : "unset";
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = "unset";
    };
  }, [showMobileSummary]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isPlacing) {
      document.body.style.cursor = "wait";
    } else {
      document.body.style.cursor = "default";
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.cursor = "default";
    };
  }, [isPlacing]);

  const quantity = request.quantity || 1;

  const sizeSlots = useMemo(() => {
    switch (request.furniture_size) {
      case "sm":
      case "small":
        return 1;
      case "md":
      case "medium":
        return 2;
      case "lg":
      case "large":
        return 6;

        return 12;
      default:
        return 1;
    }
  }, [request.furniture_size]);

  const shipping = useMemo(() => {
    const totalSlots = sizeSlots * quantity;
    return calculateShipping(

      selectedAddress?.province || "",
    );
  }, [sizeSlots, quantity, selectedAddress]);

  const [deliveryMethod, setDeliveryMethod] = useState<"delivery" | "pickup">(

  );

  const [paymentOption, setPaymentOption] = useState<"70-30" | "full">("70-30");

  const effectiveShippingFee =
    deliveryMethod === "pickup" ? 0 : shipping.totalShippingFee;

  const downpaymentAmount = useMemo(() => {
    return price * 0.7;

    );
  }, [isBalancePayment, request.shipping_address, selectedAddress]);

  const handlePay = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isBalancePayment && (!selectedAddress || !isAddressValid)) {
      toast.error("Please add or select a valid delivery address.");
      setIsAddressModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }

        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(", ");

    try {
      if (savePaymentDefault) {
        savePaymentMethodPreference(selectedPaymentMethod);
      }

      const res = await fetch(`/api/client/customize/${request.id}/pay`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          customerName: isBalancePayment
            ? request.customer_name || selectedAddress?.full_name || ""
            : selectedAddress?.full_name.trim(),
          customerPhone: isBalancePayment
            ? request.customer_phone || selectedAddress?.phone || ""
            : selectedAddress?.phone.trim(),
          shippingAddress: fullAddress,
          shippingProvince: isBalancePayment
            ? request.shipping_province || ""
            : selectedAddress?.province.trim(),
          shippingCity: isBalancePayment
            ? request.shipping_city || ""

          shippingFee: isBalancePayment ? 0 : effectiveShippingFee,
          deliveryMethod: isBalancePayment ? undefined : deliveryMethod,
          paymentOption: isBalancePayment ? "70-30" : paymentOption,
          preferredMethod: selectedPaymentMethod,
        }),

  }, [

    request.customer_name,
    request.customer_phone,
    request.shipping_province,
```

```typescript
import Customize from "@/components/crafit-compo/customize-client";

      categoryPresets={categoryPresets}
    />
  );
```

## File: `app/(checkout-layout)/checkout-customize/page.tsx`

```typescript
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { getCustomizeRequestById } from "@/lib/supabase/customize";
import { getUserAddressesServer } from "@/lib/supabase/addresses";
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import CheckoutCustomizeClient from "@/components/crafit-compo/checkout-customize-client";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Checkout — Custom Furniture",
  description: "Complete payment for your custom furniture request",
};

export default async function CheckoutCustomizePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ request_id?: string }>;
}) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    redirect("/authentication");
  }

  const { request_id } = await searchParams;
  if (!request_id) {
    redirect("/customize");
  }

  const request = await getCustomizeRequestById(request_id);
  if (!request) {
    redirect("/customize");
  }

  if (request.customer_id !== user.id) {
    redirect("/customize");
  }

  const finalPrice = request.quote_amount ?? request.final_price ?? 0;
  const shippingFee = request.shipping_fee ?? 0;
  const totalAmount = finalPrice + shippingFee;
  const actualPaid = request.amount_paid ?? 0;

  const isFullyPaid =
    request.status === "Fully Paid" ||
    (request.payment_status === "Paid" &&
      actualPaid >= totalAmount &&
      totalAmount > 0);

  const isAllowedStatus =
    request.status === "Approved" || request.status === "Production Done";

  if (!isAllowedStatus || isFullyPaid) {
    redirect("/profile");
  }

  const [{ data: profile }, addresses] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select(
        "full_name, email, phone, house_number, street, barangay, municipality, province",
      )
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .single(),
    getUserAddressesServer(),
  ]);

  return (
    <CheckoutCustomizeClient
      request={request}
      initialAddresses={addresses}
      profile={{
        fullName: profile?.full_name ?? null,
        email: profile?.email ?? user.email ?? "",
        phone: profile?.phone ?? null,
        houseNumber: profile?.house_number ?? null,
        street: profile?.street ?? null,
        barangay: profile?.barangay ?? null,
        municipality: profile?.municipality ?? null,
        province: profile?.province ?? null,
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

```typescript
import Link from "next/link";
import { CheckCircle, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { verifyCustomizePaymentAction } from "@/app/actions/customize";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

interface SuccessPageProps {
  searchParams: Promise<{
    request_id?: string;
    id?: string;
  }>;
}

export default async function CheckoutCustomizeSuccessPage({
  searchParams,
}: SuccessPageProps) {
  const params = await searchParams;
  const requestId = params.request_id || params.id;

  let paymentVerified = false;
  let paymentError: string | null = null;

  if (requestId) {
    try {
      const result = await verifyCustomizePaymentAction(requestId);
      paymentVerified = result.paid ?? false;
      if (!result.success && result.error) {
        paymentError = result.error;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Payment verification error:", e);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-[90vh] flex items-center justify-center px-6 py-8 animate-in fade-in duration-700">
      <div className="max-w-lg w-full space-y-10">
        <div className="text-center space-y-4">
          <div className="flex justify-center mb-6">
            <div
              className={`w-16 h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center ring-4 ${
                paymentError
                  ? "bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/20 ring-red-200 dark:ring-red-800/40"
                  : paymentVerified
                    ? "bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/20 ring-green-200 dark:ring-green-800/40"
                    : "bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/20 ring-amber-200 dark:ring-amber-800/40"
              }`}
            >
              {paymentVerified ? (
                <CheckCircle
                  className="w-8 h-8 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400"
                  strokeWidth={1.5}
                />
              ) : (
                <AlertCircle
                  className={`w-8 h-8 ${
                    paymentError
                      ? "text-red-500"
                      : "text-amber-500 dark:text-amber-400"
                  }`}
                  strokeWidth={1.5}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
              {paymentError
                ? "Payment Verification Issue"
                : paymentVerified
                  ? "Payment Confirmed"
                  : "Payment Pending"}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-base lg:text-lg text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed max-w-sm mx-auto">
              {paymentError
                ? paymentError
                : paymentVerified
                  ? "Your payment has been confirmed! Your custom furniture request is now In Production."
                  : "Your payment is being processed. Check your requests for the latest status."}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 lg:gap-3">
          <Link href="/furniture">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              className="text-sm lg:text-base h-10 lg:h-12 px-6 rounded-full cursor-pointer"
            >
              Continue Shopping
            </Button>
          </Link>
          <Link href="/profile">
            <Button className="bg-blue-800 hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-sm lg:text-base h-10 lg:h-12 px-6 rounded-full cursor-pointer">
              View My Requests
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```typescript
function canCancelRequest(req: CustomizeRequest): boolean {
  if (
    req.status === "Cancelled" ||
    req.status === "Rejected" ||
    req.status === "Completed"
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (
    req.status === "In Production" ||
    req.status === "Production Done" ||
    req.status === "Fully Paid"
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (
    req.payment_status === "Downpayment Paid" ||
    req.payment_status === "Paid"
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (req.amount_paid != null && req.amount_paid > 0) {
    return false;
  }
  return req.status === "Pending Review" || req.status === "Approved";
}

function canEditRequest(req: CustomizeRequest): boolean {
  if (
    req.status === "Cancelled" ||
    req.status === "Rejected" ||
    req.status === "Completed" ||
    req.status === "In Production" ||
    req.status === "Production Done" ||
    req.status === "Fully Paid"
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (
    req.payment_status === "Downpayment Paid" ||
    req.payment_status === "Paid"
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (req.amount_paid != null && req.amount_paid > 0) {
    return false;
  }
  if (Number(req.edit_count ?? 0) >= 2) {
    return false;
  }
  if (
    req.pending_edit_request &&
    req.pending_edit_request.status === "pending"
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  return req.status === "Pending Review" || req.status === "Approved";
}

}

              <DialogTitle className="font-semibold text-base">
                Delete Request
              </DialogTitle>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="px-6 py-4 space-y-4">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Delete{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {deleteTarget.furniture_description ?? deleteTarget.item}
                  ?{" "}
                </span>
                It will be removed from your requests. This cannot be undone.
              </p>
              <div className="flex gap-3">
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  className="flex-1 h-10 text-base"
                  onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}
                  disabled={isDeleting}
                  type="button"
                >
                  Back
                </Button>
                <Button
                  className="flex-1 h-10 text-base relative"
                  variant="destructive"
                  onClick={async () => {
                    const targetId = deleteTarget.id;
                    const previousRequests = requests;
                    setIsDeleting(true);

                    mutate(
                      { requests: requests.filter((r) => r.id !== targetId) },
                      { revalidate: false },
                    );
                    setDeleteTarget(null);

                    try {
                      const result =
                        await deleteCustomizeRequestAction(targetId);
                      if (result.success) {
                        toast.success("Request deleted successfully.");
                        mutate();
                      } else {

                        mutate(
                          { requests: previousRequests },
                          { revalidate: false },
                        );
                        toast.error(
                          result.error ?? "Failed to delete request.",
                        );
                      }
                    } catch {

                      mutate(
                        { requests: previousRequests },
                        { revalidate: false },
                      );
                      toast.error("Failed to delete request.");
                    } finally {
                      setIsDeleting(false);
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={isDeleting}
                  type="button"
                >
                  <span className={isDeleting ? "invisible" : "visible"}>
                    Delete Request
                  </span>
                  {isDeleting && (
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                      <Spinner className="size-4 animate-spin text-red-500" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      )}

      {}
      {cancelTarget && (
        <Dialog
          open
          onOpenChange={(open) => {
            if (!open && !isCancelling) {
              setCancelTarget(null);
              setCancelReason("");
            }
          }}
        >
          <DialogContent className="max-w-lg w-full gap-0 p-0 rounded-lg bg-card border border-border text-card-foreground">
            <DialogHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 border-b border-border rounded-t-lg space-y-0">
              <DialogTitle className="font-semibold text-base md:text-lg text-card-foreground">
                Cancel Request
              </DialogTitle>
            </DialogHeader>

            <div className="px-6 py-5 space-y-5 rounded-lg">
              <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">

                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {cancelTarget.furniture_description ?? cancelTarget.item}
                </span>{" "}
                <span className="text-base text-muted-foreground">
                  ({cancelTarget.request_number})
                </span>
                ? This action cannot be undone.
              </p>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-base font-medium text-foreground block">
                  Reason for Cancellation{" "}
                </label>
                <Select
                  value={cancelReason}
                  onValueChange={(val) => setCancelReason(val)}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger className="w-full h-11 text-base rounded-sm border-border bg-card text-foreground">
                    <SelectValue placeholder="Select a reason" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent className="rounded-base bg-card border-border">
                    <SelectItem
                      value="Changed my mind / No longer needed"
                      className="text-base cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Changed my mind / No longer needed
                    </SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem
                      value="Price exceeds my budget"
                      className="text-base cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Price exceeds my budget
                    </SelectItem>

                    <SelectItem
                      value="Decided to purchase elsewhere"
                      className="text-base cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Decided to purchase elsewhere
                    </SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem
                      value="Need to change dimensions or design"
                      className="text-base cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Need to change specifications
                    </SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem
                      value="Other"
                      className="text-base cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Other
                    </SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-3">
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  className="flex-1 h-10 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setCancelTarget(null);
                    setCancelReason("");
                  }}
                  disabled={isCancelling}
                  type="button"
                >
                  Back
                </Button>
                <Button
                  className="flex-1 h-10 text-base font-s-semifont-semibold relative cursor-pointer"
                  variant="destructive"
                  disabled={isCancelling || !cancelReason}
                  onClick={async () => {
                    if (!cancelReason) {
                      toast.error("Please select a cancellation reason.");
                      return;
                    }
                    const targetId = cancelTarget.id;
                    const submittedReason = cancelReason;
                    setIsCancelling(true);
                    try {
                      const res = await cancelCustomizeRequestAction(
                        targetId,
                        submittedReason,
                      );
                      if (res.success) {
                        toast.success("Request cancelled successfully.");
                        setCancelTarget(null);
                        setCancelReason("");

                        mutate(
                          (current: any) => {
                            if (!current?.requests) return current;
                            return {
                              ...current,
                              requests: current.requests.map(
                                (r: CustomizeRequest) =>
                                  r.id === targetId
                                    ? {
                                        ...r,
                                        status: "Cancelled",
                                        cancellation_reason: submittedReason,
                                      }
                                    : r,
                              ),
                            };
                          },
                          { revalidate: true },
                        );
                      } else {
                        toast.error(res.error ?? "Failed to cancel request.");
                      }
                    } catch {
                      toast.error("Failed to cancel request.");
                    } finally {
                      setIsCancelling(false);
                    }
                  }}
                  type="button"
                >
                  <span className={isCancelling ? "invisible" : "visible"}>
                    Confirm Cancellation
                  </span>
                  {isCancelling && (
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                      <Spinner className="size-4 animate-spin text-white" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      )}

      {}
      {editTarget && (
        <CustomizeEditModal
          open
          onClose={() => setEditTarget(null)}

          onSuccess={(changes, reason) => {
            const targetId = editTarget.id;
            const nextEditNumber = Number(editTarget.edit_count ?? 0) + 1;

            mutate(
              (current: any) => {
                if (!current?.requests) return current;
                return {
                  ...current,
                  requests: current.requests.map((r: CustomizeRequest) => {
                    if (r.id !== targetId) return r;
                    return {
                      ...r,
                      pending_edit_request: {
                        edit_number: nextEditNumber,
                        requested_at: new Date().toISOString(),
                        status: "pending",
                        reason: reason || null,
                        changes,
                      },
                    };
                  }),
                };
              },
              { revalidate: true },
            );
            setEditTarget(null);
          }}
        />
      )}

      <div className="space-y-4">
        {}
        {pendingPaymentRequests.map((req) => {
          const isExpanded = expandedRequest === `pending-${req.id}`;

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0">

                        {(!req.pending_edit_request ||

                          <Button

        {}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {otherRequests.map((req) => {
            const isExpanded = expandedRequest === req.id;

            const displayStatus = getDisplayStatus(req);

            const badgeStyle =
              req.payment_status === "Downpayment Paid"
                ? "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400 font-semibold border border-amber-500/30"
                : req.status === "Completed"

                            productionProofUrl={req.production_proof_url}
                            productionProofUrl2={req.production_proof_url_2}
                            productionCompletedAt={
                              (req as any).production_completed_at ??

                            }
                            shippingMethod={req.shipping_method}
                            defaultExpanded={true}
                          />
                        )}

                        {}
                        <DamageBanner
                          deliveryId={req.id}
                          type="custom"

                        {}
                        {req.status === "Completed" && (
                          <div className="border-t pt-4">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border border-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-900/10 px-4 py-3">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                                  className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0"

                                  <span className="font-semibold">
                                    1-Year Craftsmanship Warranty
                                  </span>
                                </p>
                              </div>
                              <Button
                                type="button"
                                size="sm"
                                className="h-8 px-3 text-sm shrink-0 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                                onClick={() =>
                                  setWarrantyTarget({
                                    orderNumber: req.request_number,
                                    type: "Custom Made-to-Order Woodwork",

            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
      {}
      <WarrantyCertificateModal
        open={Boolean(warrantyTarget)}
        onClose={() => setWarrantyTarget(null)}

      />

      {}
      {selectedProofUrl && (
        <Dialog
          open
          onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setSelectedProofUrl(null)}
        >
          <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-xl max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] p-0 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-background">
            <DialogTitle className="sr-only">
              Finished Product Photo
            </DialogTitle>
            <div className="relative aspect-square w-full bg-black/5 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Image
                src={selectedProofUrl}
                alt="Finished Product Proof Fullscreen"
                fill
                className="object-contain"
                unoptimized
              />
            </div>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

function generateRequestNumber(): string {
  const date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, "");
  const random = Math.random().toString(36).toUpperCase().slice(2, 6);
  return `CUS-${date}-${random}`;
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {

    const authClient = await createClient();
    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await authClient.auth.getUser();
    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Please sign in to submit a request." },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }

    const formData = await req.formData();

    const furnitureType = formData.get("furnitureType") as string;
    const furnitureDescription = formData.get("furnitureDescription") as string;
    const woodType = formData.get("woodType") as string;
    const dimWidth = formData.get("dimWidth") as string | null;
    const dimDepth = formData.get("dimDepth") as string | null;
    const dimHeight = formData.get("dimHeight") as string | null;
    const quantity = parseInt(formData.get("quantity") as string) || 1;
    const targetDate = formData.get("targetDate") as string | null;
    const needsQuote = formData.get("needsQuote") === "true";

    if (!furnitureType || !furnitureDescription || !woodType) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Please fill out all required fields." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    if (furnitureDescription.trim().length > 500) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Furniture description must not exceed 500 characters." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    if (quantity < 1 || quantity > 100) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Quantity must be between 1 and 100." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const rawLeadDays = formData.get("leadTimeDays") as string | null;
    if (rawLeadDays) {
      const parsedDays = parseInt(rawLeadDays);
      if (isNaN(parsedDays) || parsedDays < 3 || parsedDays > 90) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Crafting lead time must be between 3 and 90 days." },
          { status: 400 },
        );
      }
    }

    const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
    const cleanWood = woodType.replace(/Lumber|Wood/gi, "").trim();
    const { data: woodMat } = await supabase
      .from("raw_materials")
      .select("status, stock, name")
      .ilike("name", `%${cleanWood}%`)
      .eq("is_archived", false)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (woodMat && (woodMat.status === "Out" || Number(woodMat.stock) <= 0)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: `Sorry, ${woodType} is currently out of stock. Please select another available wood material.`,
        },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const { data: profile } = await authClient
      .from("profiles")
      .select("full_name, email, phone")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .single();

    const customerName = profile?.full_name?.trim() || "Customer";

    const ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES = [
      "image/jpeg",
      "image/png",
      "image/webp",
      "image/gif",
      "image/heic",
      "image/heif",
    ];
    const ALLOWED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = [
      "jpg",
      "jpeg",
      "png",
      "webp",
      "gif",
      "heic",
      "heif",
    ];
    const MAX_IMAGE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
    const MAX_IMAGE_COUNT = 5;

    const imageFiles = formData.getAll("images") as File[];
    const validImages = imageFiles.filter((f) => f && f.size > 0);

    if (validImages.length > MAX_IMAGE_COUNT) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `You can only upload up to ${MAX_IMAGE_COUNT} images.` },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    for (const file of validImages) {
      const ext = file.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";

      const mimeOk =
        file.type === ""
          ? ALLOWED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.includes(ext)
          : ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES.includes(file.type);
      const extOk = ALLOWED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.includes(ext) || file.type === "";
      if (!mimeOk || (!extOk && file.type !== "")) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error: `Invalid file type: ${file.name}. Only JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and HEIC images are allowed.`,
          },
          { status: 400 },
        );
      }
      if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error: `File too large: ${file.name}. Maximum allowed size is 5MB per image.`,
          },
          { status: 400 },
        );
      }
    }

    const uploadedUrls: string[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < validImages.length; i++) {
      const file = validImages[i];

      const ext = file.name.split(".").pop() ?? "jpg";
      const path = `${user.id}/${Date.now()}-${i}.${ext}`;

      const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
        .from("customize-requests")
        .upload(path, file, {
          upsert: false,
          contentType: file.type || "image/jpeg",
        });

      if (uploadError) {
        console.error("Image upload error:", uploadError.message);
        continue;
      }

      const { data: urlData } = supabase.storage
        .from("customize-requests")
        .getPublicUrl(path);

      uploadedUrls.push(urlData.publicUrl);
    }

    const furnitureCategoryLabel: Record<string, string> = {
      chairs: "Chair",
      table: "Table",
      tables: "Table",
      cabinets: "Cabinet",
      "bed-frames": "Bed Frame",
      doors: "Door",
      other: "Custom Furniture",
    };

    const { data: materialMatch } = await supabase
      .from("raw_materials")
      .select("id")
      .ilike("name", `%${cleanWood}%`)
      .eq("is_archived", false)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    const { data: inserted, error: insertError } = await supabase
      .from("customize_requests")
      .insert({
        request_number: generateRequestNumber(),
        customer_id: user.id,
        customer_name: customerName,
        customer_email: profile?.email ?? user.email ?? "",
        customer_phone: profile?.phone ?? null,
        item: `${furnitureCategoryLabel[furnitureType] ?? "Furniture"} — ${furnitureDescription}`,
        furniture_type: furnitureType,
        furniture_description: furnitureDescription,
        wood_type: woodType,
        dim_width: dimWidth || null,
        dim_depth: dimDepth || null,
        dim_height: dimHeight || null,
        quantity,
        target_date: targetDate || null,
        is_rush: false,
        reference_images: uploadedUrls,
        status: "Pending Review",
        needs_quote: needsQuote,
        material_id: materialMatch?.id ?? null,
      })
      .select("id, request_number")
      .single();

    if (insertError) {
      console.error("Insert customize request error:", insertError);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Failed to submit request." },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    revalidatePath("/profile");

    const { notifyAdminNewCustomizeRequest } =
      await import("@/lib/supabase/notifications");
    const { sendCustomizeRequestAdmin } = await import("@/lib/email");

    await Promise.allSettled([
      notifyAdminNewCustomizeRequest({
        customerName,
        requestNumber: inserted.request_number,
        requestId: inserted.id,
      }),
      sendCustomizeRequestAdmin({
        customerName,
        customerEmail: profile?.email ?? user.email ?? "",
        customerPhone: profile?.phone ?? null,
        requestNumber: inserted.request_number,
        requestId: inserted.id,
      }),
    ]);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      id: inserted.id,
      request_number: inserted.request_number,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Client customize route error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Something went wrong. Please try again." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { getCustomizeRequestsForCustomer } from "@/lib/supabase/customize";
import { verifyPayMongoSessionPaid } from "@/lib/paymongo";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ requests: [] });
  }

  let requests = await getCustomizeRequestsForCustomer(user.id, user.email);

  const pending = requests.filter(
    (r) => r.payment_status !== "Paid" && r.paymongo_link_id,
  );

  if (pending.length > 0) {
    const adminSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
    await Promise.allSettled(
      pending.map(async (req) => {
        try {
          const isPaidOnPaymongo = await verifyPayMongoSessionPaid(
            req.paymongo_link_id!,
          );

          if (isPaidOnPaymongo) {
            const paymentOption = req.payment_option ?? "70-30";
            const isBalancePayment = req.status === "Production Done";

            const targetPaymentStatus = "Paid";
            const targetStatus = isBalancePayment
              ? "Fully Paid"
              : "In Production";

            const price = req.quote_amount ?? req.final_price ?? 0;
            const shippingFee = req.shipping_fee ?? 0;
            const amountPaid = isBalancePayment
              ? price + shippingFee
              : paymentOption === "70-30"
                ? price * 0.7 + shippingFee
                : price + shippingFee;

            const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
              payment_status: targetPaymentStatus,
              amount_paid: amountPaid,
              status: targetStatus,
              updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            };

            if (targetStatus === "In Production") {
              let leadDays = 7;
              if (req.target_date && req.created_at) {
                const created = new Date(req.created_at);
                created.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
                const target = new Date(req.target_date);
                target.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
                const diff = Math.round(
                  (target.getTime() - created.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24),
                );
                if (diff > 0) leadDays = diff;
              }
              const officialTarget = new Date();
              officialTarget.setDate(officialTarget.getDate() + leadDays);
              updateData.target_date = officialTarget.toISOString().split("T")[0];
              updateData.in_production_at = new Date().toISOString();
            }

            await adminSupabase
              .from("customize_requests")
              .update(updateData)
              .eq("id", req.id);

            if (targetStatus === "In Production" && req.total_board_feet && req.total_board_feet > 0) {
              const boardFeet = req.total_board_feet;
              const materialId = (req as { material_id?: string | null }).material_id ?? null;
              if (materialId) {
                const { data: mat } = await adminSupabase
                  .from("raw_materials")
                  .select("stock, total_used")
                  .eq("id", materialId)
                  .maybeSingle();
                if (mat) {
                  await adminSupabase
                    .from("raw_materials")
                    .update({
                      stock: Math.max(0, (mat.stock ?? 0) - boardFeet),
                      total_used: (mat.total_used ?? 0) + boardFeet,
                    })
                    .eq("id", materialId);
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Error auto-verifying pending request:", e);
        }
      }),
    );

    requests = await getCustomizeRequestsForCustomer(user.id);
  }

  const needsFullyPaidSync = requests.filter((r) => {
    if (r.status !== "Production Done") return false;
    if (r.payment_option !== "70-30") return false;
    const price = r.quote_amount ?? r.final_price ?? 0;
    const shippingFee = r.shipping_fee ?? 0;
    const totalAmount = price + shippingFee;
    const actualPaid = r.amount_paid ?? 0;

    return totalAmount > 0 && actualPaid >= totalAmount;
  });

  if (needsFullyPaidSync.length > 0) {
    const adminSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
    for (const req of needsFullyPaidSync) {
      const price = req.quote_amount ?? req.final_price ?? 0;
      const shippingFee = req.shipping_fee ?? 0;
      await adminSupabase
        .from("customize_requests")
        .update({
          status: "Fully Paid",
          amount_paid: price + shippingFee,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq("id", req.id);
    }
    requests = await getCustomizeRequestsForCustomer(user.id);
  }

  return NextResponse.json(
    { requests },
    {
      headers: {
        "Cache-Control": "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0",
      },
    },
  );
}
```
