```typescript
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { getCustomizeRequestById } from "@/lib/supabase/customize";
import { verifyPayMongoSessionPaid } from "@/lib/paymongo";

) {

    }

    if (req.payment_status !== "Paid" && req.paymongo_link_id) {
      try {
        const isPaidOnPaymongo = await verifyPayMongoSessionPaid(req.paymongo_link_id);

        if (isPaidOnPaymongo) {
          const paymentOption = req.payment_option ?? "70-30";
          const isBalancePayment = req.status === "Production Done";

          const targetPaymentStatus = "Paid";
          const targetStatus = isBalancePayment ? "Fully Paid" : "In Production";

          const price = req.quote_amount ?? req.final_price ?? 0;
          const shippingFee = req.shipping_fee ?? 0;
          const amountPaid = isBalancePayment
            ? price + shippingFee
            : paymentOption === "70-30"
              ? price * 0.7 + shippingFee
              : price + shippingFee;

          const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
            payment_status: targetPaymentStatus,
            amount_paid: amountPaid,
            status: targetStatus,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          };

          if (targetStatus === "In Production") {
            let leadDays = 7;
            if (req.target_date && req.created_at) {
              const created = new Date(req.created_at);
              created.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
              const target = new Date(req.target_date);
              target.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
              const diff = Math.round(
                (target.getTime() - created.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24),
              );
              if (diff > 0) leadDays = diff;
            }
            const officialTarget = new Date();
            officialTarget.setDate(officialTarget.getDate() + leadDays);
            updateData.target_date = officialTarget.toISOString().split("T")[0];
            updateData.in_production_at = new Date().toISOString();
          }

          const adminSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
          await adminSupabase
            .from("customize_requests")
            .update(updateData)
            .eq("id", req.id);

          if (targetStatus === "In Production" && req.total_board_feet && req.total_board_feet > 0) {
            const boardFeet = req.total_board_feet;
            const materialId = (req as { material_id?: string | null }).material_id ?? null;
            if (materialId) {
              const { data: mat } = await adminSupabase
                .from("raw_materials")
                .select("stock, total_used")
                .eq("id", materialId)
                .maybeSingle();
              if (mat) {
                await adminSupabase
                  .from("raw_materials")
                  .update({
                    stock: Math.max(0, (mat.stock ?? 0) - boardFeet),
                    total_used: (mat.total_used ?? 0) + boardFeet,
                  })
                  .eq("id", materialId);
              }
            }
          }

          req = {
            ...req,
            payment_status: targetPaymentStatus,
            amount_paid: amountPaid,
            status: targetStatus as any,
          };
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Error verifying customize payment from PayMongo:", e);
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ request: req });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Error in GET /api/client/customize/[id]:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "An unexpected error occurred." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { createPaymentLink } from "@/lib/paymongo";

export async function POST(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const { id } = await params;
    const authClient = await createClient();
    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await authClient.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
    const { data: req, error: fetchError } = await supabase
      .from("customize_requests")
      .select("*")
      .eq("id", id)
      .single();

    if (fetchError || !req) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Request not found" }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (req.customer_id !== user.id) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const finalPrice = req.quote_amount ?? req.final_price ?? 0;
    const shippingFeeProp = req.shipping_fee ?? 0;
    const totalAmount = finalPrice + shippingFeeProp;
    const actualPaid = req.amount_paid ?? 0;

    const isFullyPaid =
      req.payment_status === "Paid" &&
      actualPaid >= totalAmount &&
      totalAmount > 0;

    if (isFullyPaid) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Already paid in full" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const body = (await request.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
      customerName?: string;
      customerPhone?: string;
      shippingAddress?: string;
      shippingProvince?: string;
      shippingCity?: string;
      shippingBarangay?: string;
      shippingFee?: number;
      deliveryMethod?: "delivery" | "pickup";
      notes?: string;
      paymentOption?: "70-30" | "full";
      preferredMethod?: string;
    };

    const isBalancePayment = req.status === "Production Done";

    const paymentOption = isBalancePayment
      ? "70-30"
      : body.paymentOption ?? "70-30";

    const price = finalPrice;

    let partialPrice = price;
    let shippingFee = body.shippingFee ?? shippingFeeProp;

    if (body.deliveryMethod === "pickup") {
      shippingFee = 0;
    }

    if (isBalancePayment) {
      partialPrice = Math.round(price * 0.30);
      shippingFee = 0;
    } else if (paymentOption === "70-30") {
      partialPrice = price * 0.70;
    }

    const total = partialPrice + shippingFee;
    const baseUrl =
      process.env.NODE_ENV === "development"
        ? "http://localhost:3000"
        : process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || "http://localhost:3000";

    const descriptionText = isBalancePayment
      ? `Customize Request ${req.request_number} (30% Remaining Balance)`
      : `Customize Request ${req.request_number} (${paymentOption === "70-30" ? "70% Downpayment" : "Full Payment"})`;

    let paymongoLink;
    try {
      paymongoLink = await createPaymentLink({
        amountCentavos: Math.round(total * 100),
        description: descriptionText,
        remarks: req.request_number,
        successUrl: `${baseUrl}/checkout-customize/success?request_id=${id}`,
        cancelUrl: `${baseUrl}/checkout-customize?request_id=${id}`,
        preferredMethod: body.preferredMethod,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("PayMongo error:", e);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Failed to create payment link. Please try again." },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    const updatePayload = {
      payment_status: isBalancePayment ? req.payment_status : "Pending Payment",
      paymongo_link_id: paymongoLink.id,
      paymongo_reference: paymongoLink.referenceNumber,
      paymongo_checkout_url: paymongoLink.checkoutUrl,
      payment_option: isBalancePayment ? req.payment_option : paymentOption,
      shipping_address: isBalancePayment ? req.shipping_address : (body.shippingAddress ?? null),
      shipping_province: isBalancePayment ? req.shipping_province : (body.shippingProvince ?? null),
      shipping_city: isBalancePayment ? req.shipping_city : (body.shippingCity ?? null),
      shipping_barangay: isBalancePayment ? req.shipping_barangay : (body.shippingBarangay ?? null),
      shipping_fee: isBalancePayment ? (req.shipping_fee ?? 0) : (body.deliveryMethod === "pickup" ? 0 : (body.shippingFee ?? 0)),
      shipping_method: isBalancePayment
        ? req.shipping_method
        : body.deliveryMethod === "pickup"
          ? "pickup"
          : body.shippingProvince &&
            (body.shippingProvince.toLowerCase().includes("bulacan") ||
              body.shippingProvince.toLowerCase().includes("pampanga"))
            ? "free_local"
            : "standard_delivery",
      delivery_notes: body.notes ?? req.delivery_notes,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    const { error: updateError } = await supabase
      .from("customize_requests")
      .update(updatePayload)
      .eq("id", id);

    if (updateError) {
      console.error("Update customize request error:", updateError);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: updateError.message || "Failed to update request." },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      checkoutUrl: paymongoLink.checkoutUrl,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Customize pay route error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Something went wrong. Please try again." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { getCustomizeRequestsForAdmin } from "@/lib/supabase/customize";

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { ok: false as const };
  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();
  return { ok: profile?.role === "admin" };
}

export async function GET() {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const requests = await getCustomizeRequestsForAdmin();
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, requests });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("GET /api/admin/customize-requests error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to fetch customize requests." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { logAdminAction } from "@/lib/supabase/admin-logs";

}

export async function GET(
  _request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("customize_requests")
    .select("*")
    .eq("id", id)
    .single();

  if (error || !data) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Request not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ request: data });
}

export async function PATCH(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  const body = (await request.json()) as {
    status?: string;
    quote_amount?: number;
    delivery_status?: string;
    driver_id?: string | null;
    driver_name?: string | null;
    driver_phone?: string | null;
    scheduled_date?: string | null;
    delivery_notes?: string | null;
    proof_of_delivery_url?: string | null;
    proof_of_delivery_url_2?: string | null;

    dim_width?: string | null;
    dim_depth?: string | null;
    dim_height?: string | null;
    final_price?: number | null;
    ai_material_cost_per_unit?: number | null;
    ai_labor_cost_per_unit?: number | null;
    ai_reasoning?: string | null;
    rush_fee?: number | null;
    markup_amount?: number | null;
    labor_rate_used?: number | null;
    helper_rate_used?: number | null;
    markup_percent_used?: number | null;
    rejection_reason?: string | null;
    skilled_workers_count?: number | null;
    skilled_days?: number | null;
    helper_workers_count?: number | null;
    helper_days?: number | null;
    board_feet_per_unit?: number | null;
    total_board_feet?: number | null;
    complexity_level?: string | null;
    complexity_reasoning?: string | null;
    complexity_fee?: number | null;
    furniture_size?: string | null;
    preselected_skilled_workers?: string[] | null;
    preselected_helper_workers?: string[] | null;
  };

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const updatePayload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.status) {
    updatePayload.status = body.status;
    if (body.status === "Approved") {
      updatePayload.quote_reviewed_at = new Date().toISOString();
    }
    if (body.status === "In Production") {
      updatePayload.in_production_at = new Date().toISOString();
      const { data: currentReq } = await supabase
        .from("customize_requests")
        .select("target_date, created_at, status")
        .eq("id", id)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (currentReq && currentReq.status !== "In Production") {
        let leadDays = 7;
        if (currentReq.target_date && currentReq.created_at) {
          const created = new Date(currentReq.created_at);
          created.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
          const target = new Date(currentReq.target_date);
          target.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
          const diff = Math.round(
            (target.getTime() - created.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24),
          );
          if (diff > 0) leadDays = diff;
        }
        const officialTarget = new Date();
        officialTarget.setDate(officialTarget.getDate() + leadDays);
        updatePayload.target_date = officialTarget.toISOString().split("T")[0];
      }
    }
  }
  if (body.quote_amount !== undefined) {
    updatePayload.quote_amount = body.quote_amount;

    if (!body.status) {
      updatePayload.status = "Approved";
      updatePayload.quote_reviewed_at = new Date().toISOString();
    }
  }
  if (body.delivery_status) {
    updatePayload.delivery_status = body.delivery_status;
    if (body.delivery_status === "Out for Delivery") {
      updatePayload.out_for_delivery_at = new Date().toISOString();
    }
  }
  if (body.driver_id !== undefined)
    updatePayload.driver_id = body.driver_id;
  if (body.driver_name !== undefined) {
    updatePayload.driver_name = body.driver_name;
    if (body.driver_name) {
      updatePayload.driver_assigned_at = new Date().toISOString();
    }
  }
  if (body.driver_phone !== undefined)
    updatePayload.driver_phone = body.driver_phone;
  if (body.scheduled_date !== undefined)
    updatePayload.scheduled_date = body.scheduled_date;
  if (body.delivery_notes !== undefined)
    updatePayload.delivery_notes = body.delivery_notes;
  if (body.proof_of_delivery_url !== undefined)
    updatePayload.proof_of_delivery_url = body.proof_of_delivery_url;
  if (body.proof_of_delivery_url_2 !== undefined)
    updatePayload.proof_of_delivery_url_2 = body.proof_of_delivery_url_2;

  if (body.dim_width !== undefined) updatePayload.dim_width = body.dim_width;
  if (body.dim_depth !== undefined) updatePayload.dim_depth = body.dim_depth;
  if (body.dim_height !== undefined) updatePayload.dim_height = body.dim_height;
  if (body.final_price !== undefined)
    updatePayload.final_price = body.final_price;
  if (body.ai_material_cost_per_unit !== undefined)
    updatePayload.ai_material_cost_per_unit = body.ai_material_cost_per_unit;
  if (body.ai_labor_cost_per_unit !== undefined)
    updatePayload.ai_labor_cost_per_unit = body.ai_labor_cost_per_unit;
  if (body.ai_reasoning !== undefined)
    updatePayload.ai_reasoning = body.ai_reasoning;
  if (body.markup_amount !== undefined)
    updatePayload.markup_amount = body.markup_amount;
  if (body.labor_rate_used !== undefined)
    updatePayload.labor_rate_used = body.labor_rate_used;
  if (body.helper_rate_used !== undefined)
    updatePayload.helper_rate_used = body.helper_rate_used;
  if (body.markup_percent_used !== undefined)
    updatePayload.markup_percent_used = body.markup_percent_used;
  if (body.rejection_reason !== undefined)
    updatePayload.rejection_reason = body.rejection_reason;
  if (body.skilled_workers_count !== undefined)
    updatePayload.skilled_workers_count = body.skilled_workers_count;
  if (body.skilled_days !== undefined)
    updatePayload.skilled_days = body.skilled_days;
  if (body.helper_workers_count !== undefined)
    updatePayload.helper_workers_count = body.helper_workers_count;
  if (body.helper_days !== undefined)
    updatePayload.helper_days = body.helper_days;
  if (body.board_feet_per_unit !== undefined)
    updatePayload.board_feet_per_unit = body.board_feet_per_unit;
  if (body.total_board_feet !== undefined)
    updatePayload.total_board_feet = body.total_board_feet;
  if (body.complexity_level !== undefined)
    updatePayload.complexity_level = body.complexity_level;
  if (body.complexity_reasoning !== undefined)
    updatePayload.complexity_reasoning = body.complexity_reasoning;
  if (body.complexity_fee !== undefined)
    updatePayload.complexity_fee = body.complexity_fee;
  if (body.furniture_size !== undefined)
    updatePayload.furniture_size = body.furniture_size;
  if (body.preselected_skilled_workers !== undefined)
    updatePayload.preselected_skilled_workers = body.preselected_skilled_workers;
  if (body.preselected_helper_workers !== undefined)
    updatePayload.preselected_helper_workers = body.preselected_helper_workers;

  if (Object.keys(updatePayload).length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Nothing to update." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("customize_requests")
    .update(updatePayload)
    .eq("id", id)
    .select(
      "request_number, item, status, quote_amount, final_price, customer_name, customer_email, customer_id, delivery_status, driver_name, driver_phone, scheduled_date, delivery_notes, shipping_address, shipping_fee, rejection_reason",
    )
    .single();

  if (error) {
    console.error("PATCH customize request error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (body.status === "In Production") {
    await deductWoodStockForCustomizeRequest(id, supabase);
  }

  if (body.status === "Production Done" || body.status === "Completed") {
    try {
      const { data: activeAssignments } = await supabase
        .from("worker_assignments")
        .select("id")
        .eq("customize_request_id", id)
        .eq("status", "assigned");

      if (activeAssignments && activeAssignments.length > 0) {
        const assignmentIds = activeAssignments.map((a: any) => a.id);
        const { error: releaseError } = await supabase
          .from("worker_assignments")
          .update({
            status: "released",
            released_at: new Date().toISOString()
          })
          .in("id", assignmentIds);

        if (releaseError) {
          console.error("Failed to release workers:", releaseError);
        } else {
          console.log(`Released ${assignmentIds.length} worker(s) for request ${id}`);
        }
      }
    } catch (releaseError) {
      console.error("Error during worker release:", releaseError);
    }
  }
  const changes: string[] = [];
  if (body.status) changes.push(`Status → "${body.status}"`);
  if (body.quote_amount !== undefined)
    changes.push(`Quote → ₱${body.quote_amount.toLocaleString()}`);
  if (body.delivery_status)
    changes.push(`Delivery → "${body.delivery_status}"`);
  if (body.driver_name !== undefined)
    changes.push(`Driver → ${body.driver_name || "(cleared)"}`);
  if (body.driver_phone !== undefined)
    changes.push(`Phone → ${body.driver_phone || "(cleared)"}`);
  if (body.scheduled_date !== undefined)
    changes.push(`Scheduled → ${body.scheduled_date || "(cleared)"}`);
  if (body.delivery_notes !== undefined) changes.push(`Notes updated`);

  await logAdminAction({
    action: "UPDATE",
    entity: "Customize Requests",
    details: `${data.request_number}: ${changes.join(", ")}`,
  });

  const {
    sendCustomizeQuoted,
    sendCustomizeRejected,
    sendCustomizeOutForDelivery,
    sendCustomizeDelivered,
  } = await import("@/lib/email");

  if ((body.status === "Approved" || data.status === "Approved") && (data.final_price || data.quote_amount)) {
    sendCustomizeQuoted({
      customerName: data.customer_name,
      customerEmail: data.customer_email,
      requestNumber: data.request_number,
      requestId: id,
      furnitureDescription: data.item,
      quoteAmount: (data.final_price ?? data.quote_amount)!,
    }).catch(console.error);
  }

  if (body.status === "Rejected") {
    sendCustomizeRejected({
      customerName: data.customer_name,
      customerEmail: data.customer_email,
      requestNumber: data.request_number,
      furnitureDescription: data.item,
      rejectionReason: data.rejection_reason,
    }).catch(console.error);
  }

  if (body.delivery_status && data.customer_id) {
    if (body.delivery_status === "Ready for Pickup") {
      const { sendReadyForPickupCustomer } = await import("@/lib/email");
      sendReadyForPickupCustomer({
        customerName: data.customer_name,
        customerEmail: data.customer_email,
        orderNumber: data.request_number,
        total: data.final_price ?? data.quote_amount ?? 0,
      }).catch(console.error);
    }

    if (body.delivery_status === "Out for Delivery") {
      sendCustomizeOutForDelivery({
        customerName: data.customer_name,
        customerEmail: data.customer_email,
        requestNumber: data.request_number,
        furnitureDescription: data.item,
        shippingAddress: data.shipping_address ?? "",
        driverName: body.driver_name ?? data.driver_name,
        driverPhone: body.driver_phone ?? data.driver_phone,
        scheduledDate: body.scheduled_date ?? data.scheduled_date,
        deliveryNotes: body.delivery_notes ?? data.delivery_notes,
        finalPrice: data.final_price ?? data.quote_amount ?? 0,
        shippingFee: data.shipping_fee ?? 0,
      }).catch(console.error);
    }

    if (body.delivery_status === "Delivered") {
      sendCustomizeDelivered({
        customerName: data.customer_name,
        customerEmail: data.customer_email,
        requestNumber: data.request_number,
        furnitureDescription: data.item,
      }).catch(console.error);
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, data });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/supabase/auth-guard";
import {
  sendCustomizeProductionComplete,
  sendCustomizeProductionCompleteFullPayment,
} from "@/lib/email";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const adminAuth = await requireAdmin();
    if (!adminAuth.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Unauthorized: Admin privileges required." },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }

    const { requestId, productionProofUrl, productionProofUrl2 } = await req.json();

    if (!requestId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Request ID is required." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();

    const { data: request, error: fetchErr } = await supabase
      .from("customize_requests")
      .select("*")
      .eq("id", requestId)
      .single();

    if (fetchErr || !request) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Custom request not found." },
        { status: 404 },
      );
    }

    const is7030 = request.payment_option === "70-30";

    const updatePayload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      status: "Production Done",
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    if (productionProofUrl) {
      updatePayload.production_proof_url = productionProofUrl;
    }
    if (productionProofUrl2) {
      updatePayload.production_proof_url_2 = productionProofUrl2;
    }

    const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
      .from("customize_requests")
      .update(updatePayload)
      .eq("id", requestId);

    if (updateErr) {
      console.error("Failed to update production completion in database:", updateErr);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: updateErr.message || "Failed to update production status in database." },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    try {
      const { data: activeAssignments, error: fetchAssignmentsError } = await supabase
        .from("worker_assignments")
        .select("id")
        .eq("customize_request_id", requestId)
        .eq("status", "assigned");

      if (fetchAssignmentsError) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch worker assignments:", fetchAssignmentsError);
      } else if (activeAssignments && activeAssignments.length > 0) {
        const assignmentIds = activeAssignments.map((a: any) => a.id);
        const { error: releaseError } = await supabase
          .from("worker_assignments")
          .update({
            status: "released",
            released_at: new Date().toISOString()
          })
          .in("id", assignmentIds);

        if (releaseError) {
          console.error("Failed to release workers:", releaseError);
        }
      }
    } catch (releaseError) {
      console.error("Error during worker release:", releaseError);
    }

    const finalPrice = request.final_price ?? request.quote_amount ?? 0;
    const siteUrl =
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ??
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL ??
      "https://craftitfurniture.shop";

    if (request.customer_email) {
      if (is7030) {
        const remainingBalance = Math.round(finalPrice * 0.3);
        const checkoutUrl = `${siteUrl}/checkout-customize?request_id=${request.id}`;

        sendCustomizeProductionComplete({
          customerName: request.customer_name ?? "Customer",
          customerEmail: request.customer_email,
          requestNumber: request.request_number,
          furnitureDescription:
            request.furniture_description ?? request.item ?? "Custom Furniture",
          finalPrice,
          remainingBalance,
          checkoutUrl,
        }).catch(console.error);
      } else {
        const detailsUrl = `${siteUrl}/profile?tab=requests`;

        sendCustomizeProductionCompleteFullPayment({
          customerName: request.customer_name ?? "Customer",
          customerEmail: request.customer_email,
          requestNumber: request.request_number,
          furnitureDescription:
            request.furniture_description ?? request.item ?? "Custom Furniture",
          finalPrice,
          detailsUrl,
        }).catch(console.error);
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: is7030
        ? "Production marked as completed and 30% balance request email sent."
        : "Production marked as completed and finished proof email sent to client.",
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Error triggering production complete:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "An unexpected error occurred." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

## File: `app/api/admin/customize/upload-proof/route.ts`

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

const ALLOWED_TYPES = [
  "image/jpeg",
  "image/png",
  "image/webp",
  "image/gif",
  "image/heic",
  "image/heif",
];

const ALLOWED_EXTS = ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "webp", "gif", "heic", "heif"];
const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024;

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  if (!profile || profile.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden: Admins only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const formData = await request.formData();
    const file = formData.get("file") as File | null;
    const requestId = (formData.get("requestId") as string) || "proof";
    const suffix = (formData.get("suffix") as string) || "1";

    if (!file) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "No file provided" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "File exceeds 10MB limit." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const fileExt = (file.name.split(".").pop() || "jpg").toLowerCase();
    if (!ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type) && !ALLOWED_EXTS.includes(fileExt)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Invalid image format. Allowed: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient();
    const fileName = `production-proofs/${requestId}_proof_${suffix}_${Date.now()}.${fileExt}`;
    const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const buffer = Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);

    let targetBucket = "customize-requests";
    let { error: uploadError } = await serviceRole.storage
      .from(targetBucket)
      .upload(fileName, buffer, {
        contentType: file.type || "image/jpeg",
        upsert: true,
      });

    if (uploadError) {
      console.warn(`Upload to ${targetBucket} failed, trying delivery-proofs:`, uploadError.message);
      targetBucket = "delivery-proofs";
      const fallbackUpload = await serviceRole.storage
        .from(targetBucket)
        .upload(fileName, buffer, {
          contentType: file.type || "image/jpeg",
          upsert: true,
        });
      uploadError = fallbackUpload.error;
    }

    if (uploadError) {
      console.error("Storage upload error:", uploadError);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: uploadError.message },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    const { data: publicUrlData } = serviceRole.storage
      .from(targetBucket)
      .getPublicUrl(fileName);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      proofUrl: publicUrlData.publicUrl,
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Production proof upload error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to upload production proof photo." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { logAdminAction } from "@/lib/supabase/admin-logs";
import type { CustomizePresetCategoryId } from "@/lib/customize/preset-catalog";

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { ok: false as const };

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();
  return { ok: profile?.role === "admin" };
}

const VALID_CATEGORIES: CustomizePresetCategoryId[] = [
  "chairs",
  "tables",
  "cabinets",
  "bed-frames",
  "doors",
  "other",
];

export async function GET() {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("customize_preset_templates")
    .select("*")
    .eq("is_archived", false)
    .order("category")
    .order("sort_order")
    .order("label");

  if (error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, templates: data ?? [] });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const body = (await request.json()) as {
    category?: string;
    label?: string;
    description?: string;
    wood_type?: string | null;
    dim_width?: string;
    dim_height?: string;
    dim_depth?: string;
    complexity_level?: string | null;
    is_active?: boolean;
    sort_order?: number;
  };

  if (!body.category || !VALID_CATEGORIES.includes(body.category as CustomizePresetCategoryId)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid category." }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (!body.label?.trim() || !body.description?.trim()) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Label and description are required." },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }
  if (!body.dim_width?.trim() || !body.dim_height?.trim() || !body.dim_depth?.trim()) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Width, height, and depth are required." },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const row = {
    category: body.category,
    label: body.label.trim(),
    description: body.description.trim(),
    wood_type: body.wood_type?.trim() || null,
    dim_width: body.dim_width.trim(),
    dim_height: body.dim_height.trim(),
    dim_depth: body.dim_depth.trim(),
    complexity_level: body.complexity_level || null,
    is_active: body.is_active !== false,
    is_archived: false,
    sort_order: Number(body.sort_order) || 0,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("customize_preset_templates")
    .insert(row)
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });

  await logAdminAction({
    action: "CREATE",
    entity: "Customize Presets",
    details: `Added preset "${row.label}" (${row.category})`,
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, template: data });
}
```

```typescript
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  const body = (await request.json()) as {
    category?: string;
    label?: string;
    description?: string;
    wood_type?: string | null;
    dim_width?: string;
    dim_height?: string;
    dim_depth?: string;
    complexity_level?: string | null;
    is_active?: boolean;
    sort_order?: number;
    archive?: boolean;
  };

  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  if (body.archive) {
    patch.is_archived = true;
    patch.is_active = false;
  } else {
    if (body.category !== undefined) {
      if (!VALID_CATEGORIES.includes(body.category as CustomizePresetCategoryId)) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid category." }, { status: 400 });
      }
      patch.category = body.category;
    }
    if (typeof body.label === "string") patch.label = body.label.trim();
    if (typeof body.description === "string")
      patch.description = body.description.trim();
    if (body.wood_type !== undefined)
      patch.wood_type = body.wood_type?.trim() || null;
    if (typeof body.dim_width === "string") patch.dim_width = body.dim_width.trim();
    if (typeof body.dim_height === "string")
      patch.dim_height = body.dim_height.trim();
    if (typeof body.dim_depth === "string") patch.dim_depth = body.dim_depth.trim();
    if (body.complexity_level !== undefined)
      patch.complexity_level = body.complexity_level || null;
    if (typeof body.is_active === "boolean") patch.is_active = body.is_active;
    if (typeof body.sort_order === "number") patch.sort_order = body.sort_order;
  }

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data: prev } = await supabase
    .from("customize_preset_templates")
    .select("label, category")
    .eq("id", id)
    .single();

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("customize_preset_templates")
    .update(patch)
    .eq("id", id)
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });

  const name = prev?.label ?? id;
  if (body.archive) {
    await logAdminAction({
      action: "ARCHIVE",
      entity: "Customize Presets",
      details: `Archived preset "${name}"`,
    });
  } else {
    await logAdminAction({
      action: "UPDATE",
      entity: "Customize Presets",
      details: `Updated preset "${name}"`,
    });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, template: data });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { logAdminAction } from "@/lib/supabase/admin-logs";

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { ok: false as const };
  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();
  return { ok: profile?.role === "admin" };
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("customize_settings")
      .select("*")
      .maybeSingle();
    if (error) throw error;
    if (!data) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Settings not found." }, { status: 404 });
    return NextResponse.json(data);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("GET customize-settings:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to fetch settings." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}

export async function PATCH(request: Request) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const body = (await request.json()) as {
    labor_rate_per_day?: number;
    helper_rate_per_day?: number;
    markup_percent?: number;
    enabled_wood_types?: string[];
  };

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();

  const { data: existing } = await supabase
    .from("customize_settings")
    .select("*")
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!existing?.id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Settings not found." }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const updatePayload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.labor_rate_per_day !== undefined)
    updatePayload.labor_rate_per_day = Number(body.labor_rate_per_day);
  if (body.helper_rate_per_day !== undefined)
    updatePayload.helper_rate_per_day = Number(body.helper_rate_per_day);
  if (body.markup_percent !== undefined)
    updatePayload.markup_percent = Number(body.markup_percent);
  if (body.enabled_wood_types !== undefined)
    updatePayload.enabled_wood_types = body.enabled_wood_types;

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("customize_settings")
    .update(updatePayload)
    .eq("id", existing.id)
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });

  const logParts: string[] = [];

  if (
    body.labor_rate_per_day !== undefined &&
    Number(body.labor_rate_per_day) !== Number(existing.labor_rate_per_day)
  )
    logParts.push(
      `Skilled Labor Rate: ₱${existing.labor_rate_per_day} → ₱${body.labor_rate_per_day}/day`,
    );

  if (
    body.helper_rate_per_day !== undefined &&
    Number(body.helper_rate_per_day) !== Number(existing.helper_rate_per_day)
  )
    logParts.push(
      `Helper Labor Rate: ₱${existing.helper_rate_per_day ?? 450} → ₱${body.helper_rate_per_day}/day`,
    );

  if (
    body.markup_percent !== undefined &&
    Number(body.markup_percent) !== Number(existing.markup_percent)
  )
    logParts.push(
      `Markup: ${existing.markup_percent}% → ${body.markup_percent}%`,
    );

  if (body.enabled_wood_types !== undefined) {
    const prevWoods = [...(existing.enabled_wood_types ?? [])].sort();
    const nextWoods = [...body.enabled_wood_types].sort();
    if (JSON.stringify(prevWoods) !== JSON.stringify(nextWoods)) {
      const removed = prevWoods.filter((w) => !nextWoods.includes(w));
      const added = nextWoods.filter((w) => !prevWoods.includes(w));
      if (removed.length > 0)
        logParts.push(`Removed Wood Types: [${removed.join(", ")}]`);
      if (added.length > 0)
        logParts.push(`Added Wood Types: [${added.join(", ")}]`);
    }
  }

  if (logParts.length > 0) {
    await logAdminAction({
      action: "UPDATE",
      entity: "Customize Settings",
      details: `Updated pricing settings — ${logParts.join("; ")}`,
    });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(data);
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/supabase/auth-guard";

const DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL =
  process.env.DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL ?? "https://api.deepseek.com";

async function fetchWithRetry(
  url: string,
  options: RequestInit,
  retries = 2,
): Promise<Response> {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= retries; attempt++) {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 30_000);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { ...options, signal: controller.signal });
      clearTimeout(timeout);

      if (res.ok || (res.status < 500 && res.status !== 429)) {
        return res;
      }

      if (attempt < retries) {
        const delayMs = attempt === 0 ? 1_000 : 2_000;
        console.warn(
          `DeepSeek returned ${res.status}. Retrying in ${delayMs}ms… (attempt ${attempt + 1}/${retries})`,
        );
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, delayMs));
      } else {
        return res;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      if (attempt < retries) {
        const delayMs = attempt === 0 ? 1_000 : 2_000;
        console.warn(
          `DeepSeek request failed (${err}). Retrying in ${delayMs}ms… (attempt ${attempt + 1}/${retries})`,
        );
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, delayMs));
      } else {
        throw err;
      }
    }
  }
  throw new Error("Unexpected retry loop exit");
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const adminAuth = await requireAdmin();
    if (!adminAuth.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Unauthorized: Admin privileges required to analyze components." },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }

    const DEEPSEEK_API_KEY = process.env.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY;
    if (!DEEPSEEK_API_KEY) {
      console.error("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is not set");
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "AI service is not configured." },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    const body = await req.json();
    const { furnitureType, furnitureDescription, dimensions } = body;

    if (!furnitureType || !furnitureDescription) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Missing required fields." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const dimText = dimensions
      ? `${dimensions.width ?? 0}" wide × ${dimensions.depth ?? 0}" deep × ${dimensions.height ?? 0}" tall`
      : "standard dimensions";

    const prompt = `You are a professional Filipino furniture carpenter. Analyze the custom furniture request, perform a validation check, and decompose it into the individual physical wood components required to build it.

CUSTOMER REQUEST:
- Category: ${furnitureType}
- Description: ${furnitureDescription}
- Overall Dimensions: ${dimText}

TASK:

STEP 0 — DYNAMIC RELEVANCE & VALIDATION CHECK
First, dynamically evaluate if the customer request description is genuinely relevant to custom furniture design, woodworking, or furniture fabrication.
- Does the description talk about furniture items, structural components, design preferences, wood finishes, dimensions, seating/storage capacity, or custom woodworking modifications?
- REJECT immediately if: text is arbitrary keyboard mash/gibberish (e.g. "asdfghjkl"), off-topic (e.g. food, smartphones, vehicle repair, general chat), abusive, or completely unrelated to furniture making.
- If NOT relevant, respond ONLY with JSON:
{
  "is_relevant": false,
  "relevance_error": "The provided description is not relevant to custom furniture design or fabrication."
}

STEP 1 — IDENTIFY COMPONENTS
If and only if the request is relevant ("is_relevant": true), identify every structural wood part needed to fabricate this furniture (e.g. Top Board, Legs, Front Rail, Back Rail, Side Rails, Drawer fronts, Shelves, etc. depending on the design described).
For each component, estimate the raw/dressed wood dimensions in inches and the quantity required:
1. Name (Component Name)
2. Thickness (inches) - standard board thickness: e.g. 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3 inches.
3. Width (inches)
4. Height/Length (inches)
5. Qty (quantity of identical components, e.g., 4 legs, 2 side rails)

Ensure all components are physically realistic for a carpenter to fabricate and assemble, fitting within the overall dimensions provided. Do not overestimate thicknesses.

Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this format:
{
  "is_relevant": true,
  "components": [
    {
      "name": "string (Component Name)",
      "thickness": "string (Thickness in inches as a float/integer, e.g. 1 or 1.5)",
      "width": "string (Width in inches as a float/integer)",
      "height": "string (Height/Length in inches as a float/integer)",
      "qty": "string (Quantity of identical components as an integer)"
    }
  ]
}`;

    const response = await fetchWithRetry(
      `${DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL}/v1/chat/completions`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}`,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          model: "deepseek-chat",
          max_tokens: 3072,
          temperature: 0,
          response_format: { type: "json_object" },
          messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }],
        }),
      },
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
      console.error(`DeepSeek API returned error status: ${response.status}`);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "AI service error. Please try again." },
        { status: 502 },
      );
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    const raw = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content ?? "";
    const cleaned = raw.replace(/```json|```/g, "").trim();

    let parsed: any;
    try {
      let jsonStr = cleaned;
      const firstBrace = cleaned.indexOf("{");
      const lastBrace = cleaned.lastIndexOf("}");
      if (firstBrace !== -1 && lastBrace !== -1 && lastBrace > firstBrace) {
        jsonStr = cleaned.slice(firstBrace, lastBrace + 1);
      }
      parsed = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
    } catch (parseErr) {
      console.error(
        "JSON parse error on DeepSeek response:",
        parseErr,
        "Raw output:",
        raw,
      );
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "AI response was incomplete or invalid JSON. Please try clicking Analyze again.",
        },
        { status: 502 },
      );
    }

    if (parsed.is_relevant === false) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: parsed.relevance_error || "The description is not relevant.",
          is_relevant: false,
        },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    if (!parsed || !Array.isArray(parsed.components)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Invalid response format from AI service." },
        { status: 502 },
      );
    }

    const components = parsed.components.map((c: any) => ({
      name: String(c.name || "Component"),
      thickness: String(c.thickness || "1"),
      width: String(c.width || "1"),
      height: String(c.height || "1"),
      qty: String(c.qty || "1"),
    }));

    return NextResponse.json({ components });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Analyze components route error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to analyze components. Please try again." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
"use server";

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/supabase/auth-guard";
import {
  getCustomizeRequestById,
  deductWoodStockForCustomizeRequest,
  getActiveWoodMaterials,
  getCustomizeSettings,
  type WoodMaterial,
  type CustomizePendingEdit,
} from "@/lib/supabase/customize";
import { verifyPayMongoSessionPaid } from "@/lib/paymongo";
import {
  sendCustomizePaymentConfirmed,
  sendCustomizeBalancePaid,
  sendCustomizeEditRequestedAdmin,
  sendCustomizeEditApprovedCustomer,
} from "@/lib/email";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

async function assignWorkersForRequest(requestId: string, adminSupabase: any, preSelectedWorkers?: { skilled: string[], helper: string[] }) {
  try {

    const { data: request } = await adminSupabase
      .from("customize_requests")
      .select("skilled_workers_count, helper_workers_count")
      .eq("id", requestId)
      .single();

    if (!request) return;

    const skilledNeeded = request.skilled_workers_count || 0;
    const helperNeeded = request.helper_workers_count || 0;

    if (skilledNeeded === 0 && helperNeeded === 0) return;

    const { data: existingAssignments } = await adminSupabase
      .from("worker_assignments")
      .select("worker_id")
      .eq("customize_request_id", requestId);

    const existingWorkerIds = new Set(
      (existingAssignments || []).map((a: any) => a.worker_id)
    );

    const assignmentsToCreate: any[] = [];

    if (preSelectedWorkers && (preSelectedWorkers.skilled.length > 0 || preSelectedWorkers.helper.length > 0)) {

      for (const workerId of preSelectedWorkers.skilled) {
        if (!existingWorkerIds.has(workerId)) {
          const { data: activeAssignment } = await adminSupabase
            .from("worker_assignments")
            .select("id")
            .eq("worker_id", workerId)
            .eq("status", "assigned")
            .single();

          if (!activeAssignment) {
            assignmentsToCreate.push({
              worker_id: workerId,
              customize_request_id: requestId,
              status: "assigned",
            });
          }
        }
      }

      for (const workerId of preSelectedWorkers.helper) {
        if (!existingWorkerIds.has(workerId)) {
          const { data: activeAssignment } = await adminSupabase
            .from("worker_assignments")
            .select("id")
            .eq("worker_id", workerId)
            .eq("status", "assigned")
            .single();

          if (!activeAssignment) {
            assignmentsToCreate.push({
              worker_id: workerId,
              customize_request_id: requestId,
              status: "assigned",
            });
          }
        }
      }
    } else {

      const { data: skilledWorkers } = await adminSupabase
        .from("workers")
        .select("id")
        .eq("category", "skilled")
        .order("full_name", { ascending: true });

      const { data: helperWorkers } = await adminSupabase
        .from("workers")
        .select("id")
        .eq("category", "helper")
        .order("full_name", { ascending: true });

      let skilledAssigned = 0;
      for (const worker of skilledWorkers || []) {
        if (skilledAssigned >= skilledNeeded) break;
        if (!existingWorkerIds.has(worker.id)) {
          const { data: activeAssignment } = await adminSupabase
            .from("worker_assignments")
            .select("id")
            .eq("worker_id", worker.id)
            .eq("status", "assigned")
            .single();

          if (!activeAssignment) {
            assignmentsToCreate.push({
              worker_id: worker.id,
              customize_request_id: requestId,
              status: "assigned",
            });
            skilledAssigned++;
          }
        }
      }

      let helperAssigned = 0;
      for (const worker of helperWorkers || []) {
        if (helperAssigned >= helperNeeded) break;
        if (!existingWorkerIds.has(worker.id)) {
          const { data: activeAssignment } = await adminSupabase
            .from("worker_assignments")
            .select("id")
            .eq("worker_id", worker.id)
            .eq("status", "assigned")
            .single();

          if (!activeAssignment) {
            assignmentsToCreate.push({
              worker_id: worker.id,
              customize_request_id: requestId,
              status: "assigned",
            });
            helperAssigned++;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (assignmentsToCreate.length > 0) {
      await adminSupabase
        .from("worker_assignments")
        .insert(assignmentsToCreate);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error assigning workers for request:", error);
  }
}

export async function getCustomizeWoodMaterialsAction(): Promise<{
  materials: WoodMaterial[];
  enabledTypes: string[];
}> {
  try {
    const [materials, settings] = await Promise.all([
      getActiveWoodMaterials(),
      getCustomizeSettings(),
    ]);
    return {
      materials: materials || [],
      enabledTypes: settings?.enabled_wood_types || [],
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("getCustomizeWoodMaterialsAction error:", err);
    return { materials: [], enabledTypes: [] };
  }
}

export async function verifyCustomizePaymentAction(requestId: string): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  paid?: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return { success: false, error: "Unauthorized" };
  }

  const req = await getCustomizeRequestById(requestId);
  if (!req) {
    return { success: false, error: "Request not found" };
  }

  if (req.customer_id !== user.id) {
    return { success: false, error: "Unauthorized" };
  }

  const finalPrice = req.quote_amount ?? req.final_price ?? 0;
  const shippingFeeProp = req.shipping_fee ?? 0;
  const totalAmount = finalPrice + shippingFeeProp;
  const actualPaid = req.amount_paid ?? 0;

  const isFullyPaid =
    req.payment_status === "Paid" &&
    actualPaid >= totalAmount &&
    totalAmount > 0;

  const adminSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();

  if (
    isFullyPaid ||
    req.payment_status === "Paid" ||
    req.payment_status === "Downpayment Paid" ||
    req.status === "In Production"
  ) {
    if (!(req as { materials_deducted?: boolean }).materials_deducted) {
      await deductWoodStockForCustomizeRequest(req.id, adminSupabase);
    }
    if (isFullyPaid) {
      return { success: true, paid: true };
    }
  }

  if (req.paymongo_link_id) {
    try {
      const isPaidOnPaymongo = await verifyPayMongoSessionPaid(
        req.paymongo_link_id,
      );

      if (isPaidOnPaymongo) {
        const paymentOption = req.payment_option ?? "70-30";
        const isBalancePayment = req.status === "Production Done";

        const targetPaymentStatus = "Paid";
        const targetStatus = isBalancePayment ? "Fully Paid" : "In Production";

        const price = req.quote_amount ?? req.final_price ?? 0;
        const shippingFee = req.shipping_fee ?? 0;
        const amountPaid = isBalancePayment
          ? price + shippingFee
          : paymentOption === "70-30"
            ? price * 0.7 + shippingFee
            : price + shippingFee;

        const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
          payment_status: targetPaymentStatus,
          amount_paid: amountPaid,
          status: targetStatus,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        };

        if (!isBalancePayment) {
          let leadDays = 7;
          if (req.target_date && req.created_at) {
            const created = new Date(req.created_at);
            created.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
            const target = new Date(req.target_date);
            target.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
            const diff = Math.round(
              (target.getTime() - created.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24),
            );
            if (diff > 0) leadDays = diff;
          }
          const officialTarget = new Date();
          officialTarget.setDate(officialTarget.getDate() + leadDays);
          updateData.target_date = officialTarget.toISOString().split("T")[0];
          updateData.in_production_at = new Date().toISOString();
        }

        const adminSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
        await adminSupabase
          .from("customize_requests")
          .update(updateData)
          .eq("id", req.id);

        if (!isBalancePayment) {
          await deductWoodStockForCustomizeRequest(req.id, adminSupabase);

          const { data: requestWithPreselection } = await adminSupabase
            .from("customize_requests")
            .select("preselected_skilled_workers, preselected_helper_workers")
            .eq("id", req.id)
            .single();

          const preSelectedWorkers = requestWithPreselection ? {
            skilled: requestWithPreselection.preselected_skilled_workers || [],
            helper: requestWithPreselection.preselected_helper_workers || []
          } : undefined;

          await assignWorkersForRequest(req.id, adminSupabase, preSelectedWorkers);
        }

        if (req.customer_email) {
          if (isBalancePayment) {
            sendCustomizeBalancePaid({
              customerName: req.customer_name ?? "Customer",
              customerEmail: req.customer_email,
              requestNumber: req.request_number,
              furnitureDescription:
                req.furniture_description ?? req.item ?? "Custom Furniture",
              finalPrice: price,
              balancePaid: Math.round(price * 0.3),
            }).catch(console.error);
          } else {
            sendCustomizePaymentConfirmed({
              customerName: req.customer_name ?? "Customer",
              customerEmail: req.customer_email,
              requestNumber: req.request_number,
              furnitureDescription:
                req.furniture_description ?? req.item ?? "Custom Furniture",
              finalPrice: price,
              shippingFee,
              paymentOption,
              amountPaid,
            }).catch(console.error);
          }
        }

        console.log(
          "✅ Verified customize request payment directly from PayMongo for request:",
          req.request_number,
        );
        return { success: true, paid: true };
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Error verifying customize payment from PayMongo:", e);
    }
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    paid:
      req.payment_status === "Paid" ||
      req.payment_status === "Downpayment Paid",
  };
}

export async function deleteCustomizeRequestAction(requestId: string): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { success: false, error: "Unauthorized" };

  const { data: req } = await supabase
    .from("customize_requests")
    .select("id, payment_status, customer_id")
    .eq("id", requestId)
    .eq("customer_id", user.id)
    .single();

  if (!req) return { success: false, error: "Request not found" };
  if (req.payment_status !== "Pending Payment") {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "Only pending payment requests can be deleted",
    };
  }

  const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { error: deleteError } = await serviceRole
    .from("customize_requests")
    .delete()
    .eq("id", requestId);

  if (deleteError) return { success: false, error: deleteError.message };

  revalidatePath("/profile");
  revalidatePath("/admin/customize-furniture");
  return { success: true };
}

export async function requestCustomizeEditAction(
  requestId: string,
  changes: CustomizePendingEdit["changes"],
  reason?: string,
): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { success: false, error: "Unauthorized" };

  const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data: req, error: fetchErr } = await serviceRole
    .from("customize_requests")
    .select("*")
    .eq("id", requestId)
    .single();

  if (fetchErr || !req) {
    return { success: false, error: "Custom request not found." };
  }

  if (req.customer_id !== user.id) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "You are not authorized to edit this request.",
    };
  }

  const amountPaid = Number(req.amount_paid ?? 0);
  const isPaid =
    amountPaid > 0 ||
    req.payment_status === "Downpayment Paid" ||
    req.payment_status === "Paid";

  if (isPaid) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        "This request cannot be edited because payment has already been made.",
    };
  }

  if (req.status !== "Pending Review" && req.status !== "Approved") {
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        "Edits can only be requested while your order is Pending Review or Approved.",
    };
  }

  const currentEditCount = Number(req.edit_count ?? 0);
  if (currentEditCount >= 2) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        "You have reached the maximum limit of 2 specification edits for this request. Please cancel the request if you need further changes.",
    };
  }

  if (
    req.pending_edit_request &&
    (req.pending_edit_request as CustomizePendingEdit).status === "pending"
  ) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        "An edit request is already under review by our carpenter. Please wait for it to be processed.",
    };
  }

  if (!changes || Object.keys(changes).length === 0) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "Please select at least one field to change.",
    };
  }

  if (changes.wood_type?.new) {
    const cleanWood = changes.wood_type.new.replace(/Lumber|Wood/gi, "").trim();
    const { data: woodMat } = await serviceRole
      .from("raw_materials")
      .select("status, stock, name")
      .ilike("name", `%${cleanWood}%`)
      .eq("is_archived", false)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (woodMat && (woodMat.status === "Out" || Number(woodMat.stock) <= 0)) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `Sorry, ${changes.wood_type.new} is currently out of stock. Please choose another wood species.`,
      };
    }
  }

  const nextEditNumber = currentEditCount + 1;
  const pendingEdit: CustomizePendingEdit = {
    edit_number: nextEditNumber,
    requested_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: "pending",
    reason: reason?.trim() || null,
    changes,
  };

  const { error: updateErr } = await serviceRole
    .from("customize_requests")
    .update({
      pending_edit_request: pendingEdit,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq("id", requestId);

  if (updateErr) {
    return { success: false, error: updateErr.message };
  }

  try {
    const { notifyAdminCustomizeEditRequest } =
      await import("@/lib/supabase/notifications");
    await notifyAdminCustomizeEditRequest({
      customerName: req.customer_name ?? "Customer",
      requestNumber: req.request_number,
      requestId: req.id,
      editNumber: nextEditNumber,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to notify admin of customize edit request:", err);
  }

  try {
    await sendCustomizeEditRequestedAdmin({
      customerName: req.customer_name ?? "Customer",
      customerEmail: req.customer_email ?? "",
      customerPhone: req.customer_phone ?? null,
      requestNumber: req.request_number,
      editNumber: nextEditNumber,
      reason: reason?.trim() || null,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to send customize edit request email to admin:", err);
  }

  revalidatePath("/profile");
  revalidatePath("/admin/customize-furniture");
  return { success: true };
}

export async function approveCustomizeEditAction(requestId: string): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const adminAuth = await requireAdmin();
  if (!adminAuth.ok)
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "Unauthorized: Admin privileges required.",
    };

  const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data: req, error: fetchErr } = await serviceRole
    .from("customize_requests")
    .select("*")
    .eq("id", requestId)
    .single();

  if (fetchErr || !req) {
    return { success: false, error: "Custom request not found." };
  }

  if (
    !req.pending_edit_request ||
    (req.pending_edit_request as CustomizePendingEdit).status !== "pending"
  ) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "No pending edit request found for this item.",
    };
  }

  const pending = req.pending_edit_request as CustomizePendingEdit;
  const changes = pending.changes || {};

  const currentEditCount = Number(req.edit_count ?? 0);
  const nextEditCount = currentEditCount + 1;

  const approvedPending: CustomizePendingEdit = {
    ...pending,
    status: "approved",
    approved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  const hadPreviousReview = Boolean(
    req.quote_reviewed_at ||
      req.quote_amount ||
      req.final_price ||
      req.ai_material_cost_per_unit != null ||
      req.ai_labor_cost_per_unit != null,
  );

  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
    edit_count: nextEditCount,
    pending_edit_request: approvedPending,
    status: "Pending Review",
    needs_quote: true,
    payment_status: "Unpaid",
    paymongo_link_id: null,
    paymongo_checkout_url: null,
    paymongo_reference: null,
    quote_amount: null,
    final_price: null,
    ai_material_cost_per_unit: null,
    ai_labor_cost_per_unit: null,
    markup_amount: null,
    markup_percent_used: null,
    labor_rate_used: null,
    helper_rate_used: null,
    board_feet_per_unit: null,
    total_board_feet: null,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  if (changes.furniture_type) {
    updateData.furniture_type = changes.furniture_type.new;
  }

  if (changes.furniture_description) {
    updateData.furniture_description = changes.furniture_description.new;
    const fType = (updateData.furniture_type ?? req.furniture_type) as string;
    const furnitureCategoryLabel: Record<string, string> = {
      chairs: "Chair",
      table: "Table",
      tables: "Table",
      cabinets: "Cabinet",
      "bed-frames": "Bed Frame",
      doors: "Door",
      other: "Custom Furniture",
    };
    updateData.item = `${furnitureCategoryLabel[fType] ?? "Furniture"} — ${changes.furniture_description.new}`;
  }

  if (changes.wood_type) {
    updateData.wood_type = changes.wood_type.new;
    const cleanWood = (changes.wood_type.new || "")
      .replace(/Lumber|Wood/gi, "")
      .trim();
    const { data: woodMat } = await serviceRole
      .from("raw_materials")
      .select("id")
      .ilike("name", `%${cleanWood}%`)
      .eq("is_archived", false)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (woodMat?.id) {
      updateData.material_id = woodMat.id;
    }
  }

  if (changes.quantity) {
    updateData.quantity = changes.quantity.new;
  }

  if (changes.dim_width !== undefined) {
    updateData.dim_width = changes.dim_width.new;
  }
  if (changes.dim_depth !== undefined) {
    updateData.dim_depth = changes.dim_depth.new;
  }
  if (changes.dim_height !== undefined) {
    updateData.dim_height = changes.dim_height.new;
  }

  if (changes.target_date !== undefined) {
    updateData.target_date = changes.target_date.new;
  }

  if (changes.message !== undefined) {
    updateData.message = changes.message.new;
  }

  if (!hadPreviousReview) {
    updateData.ai_reasoning = null;
    updateData.complexity_level = null;
    updateData.complexity_reasoning = null;
    updateData.complexity_fee = 0;
    updateData.furniture_size = null;
    updateData.skilled_workers_count = null;
    updateData.skilled_days = null;
    updateData.helper_workers_count = null;
    updateData.helper_days = null;
  }

  const { error: updateErr } = await serviceRole
    .from("customize_requests")
    .update(updateData)
    .eq("id", requestId);

  if (updateErr) {
    return { success: false, error: updateErr.message };
  }

  if (req.customer_email) {
    try {
      const furnitureDesc =
        (updateData.furniture_description as string) ||
        req.furniture_description ||
        "Custom Furniture";
      await sendCustomizeEditApprovedCustomer({
        customerName: req.customer_name ?? "Customer",
        customerEmail: req.customer_email,
        requestNumber: req.request_number,
        furnitureDescription: furnitureDesc,
        editNumber: nextEditCount,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(
        "Failed to send customize edit approved email to customer:",
        err,
      );
    }
  }

  revalidatePath("/profile");
  revalidatePath("/admin/customize-furniture");
  return { success: true };
}

export async function declineCustomizeEditAction(
  requestId: string,
  declineReason?: string,
): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const adminAuth = await requireAdmin();
  if (!adminAuth.ok)
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "Unauthorized: Admin privileges required.",
    };

  const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data: req, error: fetchErr } = await serviceRole
    .from("customize_requests")
    .select("id, pending_edit_request, edit_count")
    .eq("id", requestId)
    .single();

  if (fetchErr || !req) {
    return { success: false, error: "Custom request not found." };
  }

  if (
    !req.pending_edit_request ||
    (req.pending_edit_request as CustomizePendingEdit).status !== "pending"
  ) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "No pending edit request found for this item.",
    };
  }

  const pending = req.pending_edit_request as CustomizePendingEdit;
  const nextEditCount = Math.max(1, Number(req.edit_count ?? 0) + 1);

  const updatedPending: CustomizePendingEdit = {
    edit_number: pending?.edit_number ?? nextEditCount,
    requested_at: pending?.requested_at ?? new Date().toISOString(),
    reason: pending?.reason ?? null,
    status: "declined",
    declined_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    decline_reason: declineReason?.trim() || null,
    changes: pending?.changes || {},
  };

  const { error: updateErr } = await serviceRole
    .from("customize_requests")
    .update({
      pending_edit_request: updatedPending,
      edit_count: nextEditCount,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq("id", requestId);

  if (updateErr) {
    return { success: false, error: updateErr.message };
  }

  revalidatePath("/profile");
  revalidatePath("/admin/customize-furniture");
  return { success: true };
}

export async function cancelCustomizeRequestAction(
  requestId: string,
  reason: string,
): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { success: false, error: "Unauthorized" };

  const trimmedReason = reason?.trim();
  if (!trimmedReason) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "Please provide a reason for cancelling this request.",
    };
  }

  const { data: req, error: fetchError } = await supabase
    .from("customize_requests")
    .select("id, status, payment_status, amount_paid, customer_id")
    .eq("id", requestId)
    .single();

  if (fetchError || !req) {
    return { success: false, error: "Custom request not found." };
  }

  if (req.customer_id !== user.id) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "You are not authorized to cancel this request.",
    };
  }

  const amountPaid = Number(req.amount_paid ?? 0);
  const isPaid =
    amountPaid > 0 ||
    req.payment_status === "Downpayment Paid" ||
    req.payment_status === "Paid";

  if (isPaid) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        "This request cannot be cancelled because a payment has already been made.",
    };
  }

  if (
    req.status === "In Production" ||
    req.status === "Production Done" ||
    req.status === "Fully Paid" ||
    req.status === "Completed"
  ) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        "This request cannot be cancelled as it is already in production or completed.",
    };
  }

  if (req.status === "Cancelled") {
    return { success: true };
  }

  if (req.status === "Rejected") {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "This request has already been rejected.",
    };
  }

  const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const { error: updateError } = await serviceRole
    .from("customize_requests")
    .update({
      status: "Cancelled",
      cancellation_reason: trimmedReason,
      rejection_reason: trimmedReason,
      updated_at: now,
    })
    .eq("id", requestId);

  if (updateError) {

    if (
      updateError.message?.includes("cancellation_reason") ||
      updateError.code === "42703" ||
      updateError.code === "PGRST204"
    ) {
      const { error: fallbackError } = await serviceRole
        .from("customize_requests")
        .update({
          status: "Cancelled",
          rejection_reason: trimmedReason,
          updated_at: now,
        })
        .eq("id", requestId);

      if (fallbackError) {
        return { success: false, error: fallbackError.message };
      }
    } else {
      return { success: false, error: updateError.message };
    }
  }

  revalidatePath("/profile");
  revalidatePath("/admin/customize-furniture");
  return { success: true };
}
```

```typescript
  let query = supabase.from("customize_requests").select("*");

  if (customerEmail) {
    query = query.or(
      `customer_id.eq.${customerId},customer_email.eq.${customerEmail}`,
    );
  } else {
    query = query.eq("customer_id", customerId);
  }

  const { data, error } = await query.order("updated_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) {
    console.error("getCustomizeRequestsForCustomer error:", error);
    return [];
  }

  return (data ?? []) as CustomizeRequest[];

export async function getActiveWoodMaterials(): Promise<WoodMaterial[]> {
  try {
    const supabase = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
      ? createServiceRoleClient()
      : await createClient();

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("raw_materials")
      .select("name, category, cost_per_unit, status, stock")
      .eq("is_archived", false)
      .order("name", { ascending: true });

    if (error) {
      console.error("getActiveWoodMaterials DB error:", error.message || error);
      return [];
    }

    if (!data) return [];

    return data.map((item) => ({
      name: item.name,
      cleanName: item.name.replace(/\s+Lumber$/i, "").trim(),
      cost_per_unit: Number(item.cost_per_unit) || 0,
      unit: "board foot",
      status: item.status ?? "Available",
      stock: Number(item.stock) ?? 0,
    }));
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("getActiveWoodMaterials exception:", err);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function getActiveWoodTypes(): Promise<string[]> {
  try {
    const supabase = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
      ? createServiceRoleClient()
      : await createClient();

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("raw_materials")
      .select("name")
      .eq("is_archived", false);

    if (error || !data) {
      console.error("getActiveWoodTypes error:", error?.message || error);
      return [];
    }

    return data.map((item) => item.name.replace(/\s+Lumber$/i, "").trim());
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("getActiveWoodTypes exception:", err);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function deductWoodStockForCustomizeRequest(
  requestId: string,
  supabaseClient?: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleClient>,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; deducted?: number; error?: string }> {
  const supabase = supabaseClient ?? createServiceRoleClient();

  const { data: req, error: reqErr } = await supabase
    .from("customize_requests")
    .select("*")
    .eq("id", requestId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (reqErr || !req) {
    console.error("deductWoodStockForCustomizeRequest request error:", reqErr);
    return { success: false, error: "Request not found" };
  }

  if ((req as { materials_deducted?: boolean }).materials_deducted === true) {
    console.log(
      `ℹ️ Wood stock already deducted for request ${req.request_number}`,
    );
    return { success: true, deducted: 0 };
  }

  let materialId = req.material_id;
  if (!materialId && req.wood_type) {
    const cleanWood = req.wood_type.replace(/Lumber|Wood/gi, "").trim();
    const { data: matMatch } = await supabase
      .from("raw_materials")
      .select("id")
      .ilike("name", `%${cleanWood}%`)
      .eq("is_archived", false)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (matMatch) {
      materialId = matMatch.id;

      await supabase
        .from("customize_requests")
        .update({ material_id: materialId })
        .eq("id", req.id);
    }
  }

  if (!materialId) {
    console.warn(
      `⚠️ Unable to match raw_material for wood_type "${req.wood_type}" on request ${req.request_number}`,
    );
    return { success: false, error: "Raw material not matched" };
  }

  let boardFeet = Number(req.total_board_feet) || 0;

  if (boardFeet <= 0 && req.board_feet_per_unit && req.quantity) {
    boardFeet = Number(req.board_feet_per_unit) * Number(req.quantity);
  }

  if (boardFeet <= 0) {

    const w = parseFloat(req.dim_width ?? "0") || 0;
    const d = parseFloat(req.dim_depth ?? req.dim_length ?? "0") || 0;
    const h = parseFloat(req.dim_height ?? "0") || 0;
    const qty = Number(req.quantity) || 1;
    if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
      const depthVal = d > 0 ? d : 12;
      boardFeet =
        Math.round(((w * depthVal * h) / 144) * qty * 1.1 * 100) / 100;
    }
  }

  if (boardFeet <= 0) {

    boardFeet = 15 * (Number(req.quantity) || 1);
  }

  const { data: mat, error: matErr } = await supabase
    .from("raw_materials")
    .select("stock, total_used, reorder_point, name")
    .eq("id", materialId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (matErr || !mat) {
    console.error(
      "deductWoodStockForCustomizeRequest material lookup error:",
      matErr,
    );
    return { success: false, error: "Material not found" };
  }

  const currentStock = Number(mat.stock) || 0;
  const currentUsed = Number(mat.total_used) || 0;
  const reorderPoint = Number(mat.reorder_point) || 10;
  const newStock = Math.max(0, currentStock - boardFeet);
  const newUsed = currentUsed + boardFeet;

  const newStatus =
    newStock <= 0 ? "Out" : newStock <= reorderPoint ? "Low" : "Available";

  const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
    .from("raw_materials")
    .update({
      stock: newStock,
      total_used: newUsed,
      status: newStatus,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq("id", materialId);

  if (updateErr) {
    console.error("Error updating raw material stock:", updateErr);
    return { success: false, error: updateErr.message };
  }

  await supabase
    .from("customize_requests")
    .update({
      materials_deducted: true,
      materials_deducted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq("id", req.id);

  console.log(
    `✅ SUCCESS: Deducted ${boardFeet} BF of ${mat.name} for customize request ${req.request_number}. Old Stock: ${currentStock} BF → New Stock: ${newStock} BF.`,
  );
  return { success: true, deducted: boardFeet };
}
```
