```typescript
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import {
  DEFAULT_CATEGORY_PRESETS,
  flattenDefaultPresetsForSeed,
  groupPresetRowsByCategory,
  type CustomizePresetTemplateRow,
  type PresetTemplate,
} from "@/lib/customize/preset-catalog";

export type { CustomizePresetTemplateRow };

export async function getCustomizePresetTemplatesForAdmin(): Promise<
  CustomizePresetTemplateRow[]
> {
  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("customize_preset_templates")
    .select("*")
    .eq("is_archived", false)
    .order("category", { ascending: true })
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
    .order("label", { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    console.error("getCustomizePresetTemplatesForAdmin:", error);
    return [];
  }
  return (data ?? []) as CustomizePresetTemplateRow[];
}

export async function getActiveCustomizePresetsGrouped(): Promise<
  Record<string, PresetTemplate[]>
> {
  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("customize_preset_templates")
    .select("*")
    .eq("is_archived", false)
    .eq("is_active", true)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
    .order("label", { ascending: true });

  if (error || !data?.length) {
    if (error) console.error("getActiveCustomizePresetsGrouped:", error);
    return DEFAULT_CATEGORY_PRESETS;
  }

  return groupPresetRowsByCategory(data as CustomizePresetTemplateRow[]);
}

export async function seedDefaultCustomizePresetTemplates(): Promise<{
  inserted: number;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { count, error: countErr } = await supabase
    .from("customize_preset_templates")
    .select("*", { count: "exact", head: true })
    .eq("is_archived", false);

  if (countErr) {
    return { inserted: 0, error: countErr.message };
  }
  if ((count ?? 0) > 0) {
    return { inserted: 0, error: "Templates already exist. Archive or clear first." };
  }

  const seedRows = flattenDefaultPresetsForSeed().map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  }));

  const { error } = await supabase
    .from("customize_preset_templates")
    .insert(seedRows);

  if (error) return { inserted: 0, error: error.message };
  return { inserted: seedRows.length };
}

export const CUSTOMIZE_PRESET_CATEGORY_LABELS: Record<
  CustomizePresetCategoryId,
  string
> = {
  chairs: "Chairs",
  tables: "Tables",
  cabinets: "Cabinets",
  "bed-frames": "Bed Frames",
  doors: "Doors",
  other: "Other",
};

export type CustomizePresetTemplateRow = {
  id: string;
  category: CustomizePresetCategoryId;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  wood_type: string | null;
  dim_width: string;
  dim_height: string;
  dim_depth: string;
  complexity_level: "Simple" | "Moderate" | "Complex" | null;
  is_active: boolean;
  is_archived: boolean;
  sort_order: number;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
};

export function presetRowToTemplate(
  row: CustomizePresetTemplateRow,
): PresetTemplate {
  return {
    label: row.label,
    description: row.description,
    woodType: row.wood_type ?? undefined,
    dimensions: {
      width: row.dim_width,
      height: row.dim_height,
      length: row.dim_depth,
    },
    complexityLevel: row.complexity_level ?? undefined,
  };
}

export function groupPresetRowsByCategory(
  rows: CustomizePresetTemplateRow[],
): Record<string, PresetTemplate[]> {
  const grouped: Record<string, PresetTemplate[]> = {};
  const sorted = [...rows].sort(
    (a, b) =>
      a.sort_order - b.sort_order ||
      a.label.localeCompare(b.label, undefined, { sensitivity: "base" }),
  );
  for (const row of sorted) {
    if (!grouped[row.category]) grouped[row.category] = [];
    grouped[row.category].push(presetRowToTemplate(row));
  }
  return grouped;
}

export function flattenDefaultPresetsForSeed(): Omit<
  CustomizePresetTemplateRow,
  "id" | "created_at" | "updated_at"
>[] {
  const rows: Omit<
    CustomizePresetTemplateRow,
    "id" | "created_at" | "updated_at"
  >[] = [];
  let sort = 0;
  for (const [category, presets] of Object.entries(DEFAULT_CATEGORY_PRESETS)) {
    for (const preset of presets) {
      rows.push({
        category: category as CustomizePresetCategoryId,
        label: preset.label,
        description: preset.description,
        wood_type: preset.woodType ?? null,
        dim_width: preset.dimensions.width,
        dim_height: preset.dimensions.height,
        dim_depth: preset.dimensions.length,
        complexity_level: preset.complexityLevel ?? null,
        is_active: true,
        is_archived: false,
        sort_order: sort++,
      });
    }
  }
  return rows;
}
```

import { Button, Section, Text, Row, Column } from "@react-email/components";
import { BaseTemplate } from "./components/base-template";

interface CustomizePaymentConfirmedProps {
  customerName?: string;
  requestNumber?: string;
  furnitureDescription?: string;
  finalPrice?: number;
  shippingFee?: number;
  paymentOption?: string | null;
  amountPaid?: number | null;
}

export default function CustomizePaymentConfirmed({
  customerName = "Juan dela Cruz",
  requestNumber = "CUS-20260515-TEST",
  furnitureDescription = "3-seater sofa with wooden legs",
  finalPrice = 25000,
  shippingFee = 0,
  paymentOption = "70-30",
  amountPaid = 17500,
}: CustomizePaymentConfirmedProps) {
  const isSplit = paymentOption === "70-30";
  const paidNow =
    amountPaid ??
    (isSplit ? finalPrice * 0.7 + shippingFee : finalPrice + shippingFee);
  const remainingBalance = isSplit ? finalPrice * 0.3 : 0;

  return (
    <BaseTemplate title="Payment Confirmed — Custom Furniture">
      <Text className="m-0 mb-4 text-base">
        Hi {customerName}, we&apos;ve received your payment!
      </Text>

      <Text className="m-0 mb-4 text-base">
        Request Number: <span className="font-bold">{requestNumber}</span>
      </Text>

      <Text className="m-0 mb-2 text-base font-bold">Order Summary</Text>

      <Section className="mb-4">
        <Row>
          <Column className="text-sm py-1.5 w-[160px]">Item:</Column>
          <Column className="text-sm py-1.5">{furnitureDescription}</Column>
        </Row>
        <Row>
          <Column className="text-sm py-1.5 w-[160px]">Total Price:</Column>
          <Column className="text-sm py-1.5">{formatPrice(finalPrice)}</Column>
        </Row>
        <Row>
          <Column className="text-sm py-1.5 w-[160px]">Delivery Fee:</Column>
          <Column className="text-sm py-1.5">
            {shippingFee === 0 ? "Free" : formatPrice(shippingFee)}
          </Column>
        </Row>

        {isSplit && (
          <>
            <Row>
              <Column className="text-sm py-1.5 w-[160px]">
                Downpayment (70%):
              </Column>
              <Column className="text-sm py-1.5">
                {formatPrice(finalPrice * 0.7)}
              </Column>
            </Row>
            <Row>
              <Column className="text-sm py-1.5 w-[160px] text-amber-600">
                Remaining Balance (30%):
              </Column>
              <Column className="text-sm py-1.5 text-amber-600">
                {formatPrice(remainingBalance)} (Due after production)
              </Column>
            </Row>
          </>
        )}

        <Row className="border-t mt-2">
          <Column className="text-base font-bold pt-2 w-[160px]">
            Amount Paid Now:
          </Column>
          <Column className="text-base font-bold pt-2 text-green-600">
            {formatPrice(paidNow)}
          </Column>
        </Row>
      </Section>

      <Text className="m-0 mb-6 text-base">
        {isSplit ? (
          <span>
            Your custom furniture down payment has been processed, and it is now{" "}
            <span className="font-bold">In Production</span>. The remaining
            balance of <strong>{formatPrice(remainingBalance)}</strong> will be
            collected in cash upon delivery.
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span>
            Your custom furniture has been fully paid, and it is now{" "}
            <span className="font-bold">In Production</span>.
          </span>
        )}
      </Text>

      <Section className="mt-6 text-center">
        <Button
          href="https://craftitfurniture.shop/profile"
          className="bg-blue-800 text-white text-base py-3 px-8 rounded-full"
        >
          Track Your Request
        </Button>
      </Section>
    </BaseTemplate>
  );
}

function formatDate(dateStr: string): string {
  return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    year: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    day: "numeric",
    timeZone: "Asia/Manila",
  });

const ordersFetcher = (url: string) =>

      revalidateOnFocus: true,

  );

  const { data: driversData, mutate: refreshDrivers } = useSWR<{
    drivers: Array<{
      id: string;
      full_name: string;
      phone: string;
      email: string;
      created_at?: string;
      initial_password?: string | null;
    }>;
  }>(

      revalidateOnMount: true,
    },
  );

  const [customizeSearch, setCustomizeSearch] = useState("");
  const [customizeStatusFilter, setCustomizeStatusFilter] = useState<
    DeliveryStatus | "All"

  const [pickupPhoto1, setPickupPhoto1] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [pickupPhoto2, setPickupPhoto2] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [pickupPreview1, setPickupPreview1] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pickupPreview2, setPickupPreview2] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uploadingPhotos, setUploadingPhotos] = useState(false);

  function handlePickupFilesSelected(slot: 1 | 2, fileList: FileList | null) {
    if (!fileList || fileList.length === 0) return;
    const files = Array.from(fileList);

    if (files.length >= 2) {
      if (pickupPreview1) URL.revokeObjectURL(pickupPreview1);
      if (pickupPreview2) URL.revokeObjectURL(pickupPreview2);
      setPickupPhoto1(files[0]);
      setPickupPreview1(URL.createObjectURL(files[0]));
      setPickupPhoto2(files[1]);
      setPickupPreview2(URL.createObjectURL(files[1]));
      toast.success("2 photos attached successfully.");
      return;
    }

    const file = files[0];
    if (slot === 1) {
      if (pickupPreview1) URL.revokeObjectURL(pickupPreview1);
      setPickupPhoto1(file);
      setPickupPreview1(URL.createObjectURL(file));
    } else {
      if (pickupPreview2) URL.revokeObjectURL(pickupPreview2);
      setPickupPhoto2(file);
      setPickupPreview2(URL.createObjectURL(file));
    }
  }

  function handleSetPickupPhoto1(file: File | null) {
    if (pickupPreview1) URL.revokeObjectURL(pickupPreview1);
    setPickupPhoto1(file);
    setPickupPreview1(file ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : null);
  }

  function handleSetPickupPhoto2(file: File | null) {
    if (pickupPreview2) URL.revokeObjectURL(pickupPreview2);
    setPickupPhoto2(file);
    setPickupPreview2(file ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : null);
  }

  function resetPickupPhotos() {
    if (pickupPreview1) URL.revokeObjectURL(pickupPreview1);
    if (pickupPreview2) URL.revokeObjectURL(pickupPreview2);
    setPickupPhoto1(null);
    setPickupPhoto2(null);
    setPickupPreview1(null);
    setPickupPreview2(null);
  }

  async function uploadPickupPhoto(
    file: File,
    path: string,
  ): Promise<string | null> {
    const supabase = createClient();
    const { error } = await supabase.storage
      .from("delivery-proofs")
      .upload(path, file, { upsert: true, contentType: file.type });
    if (error) return null;
    const { data } = supabase.storage
      .from("delivery-proofs")
      .getPublicUrl(path);
    return data.publicUrl;
  }

    phone: string;
    email: string;

    initial_password?: string | null;
    activeCount: number;
    completedCount: number;

  const [notifyModalDriver, setNotifyModalDriver] = useState<{

  const [notifyPreset, setNotifyPreset] = useState<string>("out_for_delivery");
  const [notifyTitle, setNotifyTitle] = useState<string>("Dispatch Reminder");
  const [notifyMessage, setNotifyMessage] = useState<string>(

  const [notifyDeliveryRef, setNotifyDeliveryRef] = useState<string | null>(

  const [isSendingNotification, setIsSendingNotification] = useState(false);

  const [showDriverCredentials, setShowDriverCredentials] = useState(false);
  const [showPlainPassword, setShowPlainPassword] = useState(false);
  const [copiedField, setCopiedField] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isResettingPassword, setIsResettingPassword] = useState(false);
  const [newDriverPasswordInput, setNewDriverPasswordInput] = useState("");
  const [isUpdatingPassword, setIsUpdatingPassword] = useState(false);

  const handleCopyText = (text: string, fieldName: string) => {
    if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.clipboard) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setCopiedField(fieldName);
      toast.success(`${fieldName} copied to clipboard`);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedField(null), 2000);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveNewPassword = async () => {
    if (!selectedDriverForView) return;
    if (!newDriverPasswordInput || newDriverPasswordInput.length < 6) {
      toast.error("Password must be at least 6 characters.");
      return;
    }

    setIsUpdatingPassword(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/drivers", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          driverId: selectedDriverForView.id,
          newPassword: newDriverPasswordInput,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        toast.error(data.error || "Failed to update password.");
        setIsUpdatingPassword(false);
        return;
      }

      toast.success(
        `Password for ${selectedDriverForView.full_name} updated successfully!`,
      );
      setSelectedDriverForView((prev) =>
        prev ? { ...prev, initial_password: newDriverPasswordInput } : null,
      );
      setIsResettingPassword(false);
      setNewDriverPasswordInput("");
      setShowPlainPassword(true);
      await refreshDrivers();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to update password. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setIsUpdatingPassword(false);
    }
  };

  const [isAddDriverOpen, setIsAddDriverOpen] = useState(false);
  const [addDriverName, setAddDriverName] = useState("");
  const [addDriverPhone, setAddDriverPhone] = useState("");
  const [addDriverEmail, setAddDriverEmail] = useState("");
  const [addDriverPassword, setAddDriverPassword] = useState("");
  const [showAddPassword, setShowAddPassword] = useState(false);
  const [addDriverBusy, setAddDriverBusy] = useState(false);
  const [addDriverError, setAddDriverError] = useState("");

  const handleOpenAddDriver = () => {
    setAddDriverName("");
    setAddDriverPhone("");
    setAddDriverEmail("");
    setAddDriverPassword("");
    setShowAddPassword(false);
    setAddDriverError("");
    setIsAddDriverOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCreateDriver = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const trimmedName = addDriverName.trim();
    const trimmedPhone = addDriverPhone.trim();
    const trimmedEmail = addDriverEmail.trim();

    if (!trimmedName || !trimmedPhone || !trimmedEmail || !addDriverPassword) {
      setAddDriverError("All fields are required.");
      return;
    }

    if (trimmedName.length < 2 || !/^[a-zA-ZñÑ\s.'-]+$/.test(trimmedName)) {
      setAddDriverError(
        "Full name must have at least 2 characters with letters only.",
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!/^09\d{9}$/.test(trimmedPhone)) {
      setAddDriverError(
        "Phone number must start with 09 and be exactly 11 digits.",
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(trimmedEmail)) {
      setAddDriverError("Please enter a valid email address.");
      return;
    }

    if (addDriverPassword.length < 6) {
      setAddDriverError("Password must be at least 6 characters.");
      return;
    }

    setAddDriverBusy(true);
    setAddDriverError("");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/driver-register", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          fullName: trimmedName,
          phone: trimmedPhone,
          email: trimmedEmail,
          password: addDriverPassword,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        setAddDriverError(data.error || "Failed to create driver account.");
        setAddDriverBusy(false);
        return;
      }

      toast.success(`Driver account for ${trimmedName} created successfully!`);
      setIsAddDriverOpen(false);
      await refreshDrivers();
    } catch {
      setAddDriverError("An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setAddDriverBusy(false);
    }
  };

  // ── Compute full driver statistics and active assignments ─────────────────
  const driverStatsList = useMemo(() => {
    return registeredDrivers.map((driver) => {
      const driverOrders = orders.filter(
        (o) =>
          o.driver_id === driver.id ||
          (o.driver_name &&
            o.driver_name.toLowerCase().trim() ===
              driver.full_name.toLowerCase().trim()),
      );
      const driverCustomize = customizeRequests.filter(
        (r) =>
          r.driver_id === driver.id ||
          (r.driver_name &&
            r.driver_name.toLowerCase().trim() ===
              driver.full_name.toLowerCase().trim()),
      );

      const allDeliveries = [
        ...driverOrders.map((o) => ({
          id: o.id,
          type: "order" as const,
          trackingNumber: o.order_number,
          customerName: o.customer_name,
          customerPhone: o.customer_phone,
          shippingAddress: o.shipping_address || "No address provided",
          scheduledDate: o.scheduled_date,
          deliveryStatus: o.delivery_status || "Preparing",
          deliveredAt: o.delivered_at,
          itemCount: o.order_items?.length || 1,
          rawOrder: o,
        })),
        ...driverCustomize.map((r) => ({
          id: r.id,
          type: "customize" as const,
          trackingNumber: r.request_number,
          customerName: r.customer_name,
          customerPhone: r.customer_phone,
          shippingAddress: r.shipping_address || "No address provided",
          scheduledDate: r.scheduled_date,
          deliveryStatus: r.delivery_status || "Preparing",
          deliveredAt: r.delivered_at,
          itemCount: 1,
          rawCustomize: r,
        })),
      ];

      const activeDeliveries = allDeliveries.filter(
        (d) =>
          d.deliveryStatus === "Preparing" ||
          d.deliveryStatus === "Out for Delivery",
      );
      const completedDeliveries = allDeliveries.filter(
        (d) => d.deliveryStatus === "Delivered",
      );
      const effectivePhone =
        driver.phone ||
        driverOrders.find((o) => !!o.driver_phone)?.driver_phone ||
        driverCustomize.find((r) => !!r.driver_phone)?.driver_phone ||
        "";

      return {
        ...driver,
        phone: effectivePhone,
        allDeliveries,
        activeDeliveries,
        completedDeliveries,
        activeCount: activeDeliveries.length,
        completedCount: completedDeliveries.length,
        totalAssigned: allDeliveries.length,
        isOnRoad: activeDeliveries.length > 0,
      };
    });
  }, [registeredDrivers, orders, customizeRequests]);

  // Keep selected driver synced with live data
  const selectedDriverId = selectedDriverForView?.id;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedDriverId) {
      const updated = driverStatsList.find((d) => d.id === selectedDriverId);
      if (updated) {
        setSelectedDriverForView((prev) => {
          if (!prev) return updated;
          if (
            prev.initial_password !== updated.initial_password ||
            prev.activeCount !== updated.activeCount ||
            prev.completedCount !== updated.completedCount ||
            prev.allDeliveries.length !== updated.allDeliveries.length ||
            prev.full_name !== updated.full_name ||
            prev.phone !== updated.phone
          ) {
            return updated;
          }
          return prev;
        });
      }
    }
  }, [driverStatsList, selectedDriverId]);

  // Filtered drivers for the drivers tab
  const filteredDrivers = useMemo(() => {
    return driverStatsList.filter((d) => {
      const q = driverSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesSearch =
        !q ||
        d.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        d.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        d.phone?.toLowerCase().includes(q);

      if (!matchesSearch) return false;

      if (driverStatusFilter === "active") return d.isOnRoad;
      if (driverStatusFilter === "available") return !d.isOnRoad;
      return true;
    });
  }, [driverStatsList, driverSearch, driverStatusFilter]);

  // Overall driver statistics metrics
  const totalRegisteredDrivers = registeredDrivers.length;
  const activeDriversCount = driverStatsList.filter((d) => d.isOnRoad).length;
  const totalOngoingDeliveries = driverStatsList.reduce(
    (acc, d) => acc + d.activeCount,
    0,
  );
  const totalCompletedDeliveries = driverStatsList.reduce(
    (acc, d) => acc + d.completedCount,
    0,
  );

  const handleOpenNotifyModal = (
    driver: { id: string; full_name: string; phone: string },
    deliveryNumber?: string,
  ) => {
    setNotifyModalDriver(driver);
    setNotifyDeliveryRef(deliveryNumber || null);
    if (deliveryNumber) {
      setNotifyPreset("out_for_delivery");
      setNotifyTitle(`Delivery Update - ${deliveryNumber}`);
      setNotifyMessage(
        `Hi ${driver.full_name.split(" ")[0]}, please check delivery ${deliveryNumber} and update status to Out for Delivery once on the way.`,
      );
    } else {
      setNotifyPreset("out_for_delivery");
      setNotifyTitle("Dispatch Reminder");
      setNotifyMessage(
        `Hi ${driver.full_name.split(" ")[0]}, please prepare assigned deliveries and set status to Out for Delivery when departing.`,
      );
    }
  };

  const handleSendDriverNotification = async () => {
    if (!notifyModalDriver) return;
    if (!notifyTitle.trim() || !notifyMessage.trim()) {
      toast.error("Please provide a notification title and message.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSendingNotification(true);
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/drivers/notify", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          driverId: notifyModalDriver.id,
          title: notifyTitle.trim(),
          message: notifyMessage.trim(),
          link: "/driver/deliveries",
          metadata: {
            delivery_ref: notifyDeliveryRef,
            sent_by_admin: true,
          },
        }),
      });

      const json = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || json.error) {
        throw new Error(json.error || "Failed to send notification");
      }

      toast.success(`Notification sent to ${notifyModalDriver.full_name}!`);
      setNotifyModalDriver(null);
      setNotifyDeliveryRef(null);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to notify driver",
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSendingNotification(false);
    }
  };

  // Realtime Subscriptions for Orders & Customize Requests
  useEffect(() => {
    const supabase = createClient();
    const uniqueId = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);

    const ordersChannel = supabase
      .channel(`admin_delivery_orders_${uniqueId}`)
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "orders" },
        () => {
          refreshOrders();
        },
      )
      .subscribe();

    const customizeChannel = supabase
      .channel(`admin_delivery_customize_${uniqueId}`)
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "customize_requests" },
        () => {
          refreshCustomize();
        },
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      supabase.removeChannel(ordersChannel);
      supabase.removeChannel(customizeChannel);
    };
  }, [refreshOrders, refreshCustomize]);

  // Keep open modals synced with real-time updates
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedOrder) {
      const updated = orders.find((o) => o.id === selectedOrder.id);
      if (
        updated &&
        (updated.delivery_status !== selectedOrder.delivery_status ||
          updated.order_status !== selectedOrder.order_status ||
          updated.updated_at !== selectedOrder.updated_at)
      ) {
        setSelectedOrder(updated);
      }
    }
  }, [orders, selectedOrder]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedCustomize) {
      const updated = customizeRequests.find(
        (r) => r.id === selectedCustomize.id,
      );
      if (
        updated &&
        (updated.delivery_status !== selectedCustomize.delivery_status ||
          updated.status !== selectedCustomize.status ||
          updated.updated_at !== selectedCustomize.updated_at)
      ) {
        setSelectedCustomize(updated);
      }
    }
  }, [customizeRequests, selectedCustomize]);

  // Lock state is based on the SAVED DB status
  const isDelivered = selectedOrder?.delivery_status === "Delivered";
  const isCustomizeDelivered =
    selectedCustomize?.delivery_status === "Delivered";

  const hasChanges = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedOrder || !formState) return false;
    return (
      (formState.driver_id ?? null) !== (selectedOrder.driver_id ?? null) ||
      (formState.driver_name ?? "") !== (selectedOrder.driver_name ?? "") ||
      (formState.driver_phone ?? "") !== (selectedOrder.driver_phone ?? "") ||
      (formState.scheduled_date ?? null) !==
        (selectedOrder.scheduled_date ?? null)
    );
  }, [selectedOrder, formState]);

  const hasCustomizeDeliveryChanges = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedCustomize || !customizeDeliveryForm) return false;
    return (
      (customizeDeliveryForm.driver_id ?? null) !==
        (selectedCustomize.driver_id ?? null) ||
      (customizeDeliveryForm.driver_name ?? "") !==
        (selectedCustomize.driver_name ?? "") ||
      (customizeDeliveryForm.driver_phone ?? "") !==
        (selectedCustomize.driver_phone ?? "") ||
      (customizeDeliveryForm.scheduled_date ?? null) !==
        (selectedCustomize.scheduled_date ?? null)
    );
  }, [selectedCustomize, customizeDeliveryForm]);

  const isDriverSelected = useMemo(() => {
    return !!formState?.driver_name && formState.driver_name.trim().length >= 2;
  }, [formState]);

  const isScheduledDateValid = useMemo(() => {
    return !!formState?.scheduled_date;
  }, [formState]);

  const isCustomizeDriverSelected = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      !!customizeDeliveryForm?.driver_name &&
      customizeDeliveryForm.driver_name.trim().length >= 2
    );
  }, [customizeDeliveryForm]);

  // Auto-open from query param — orders
  useEffect(() => {
    const isSubdomain = window.location.hostname.startsWith("admin.");
    const base = isSubdomain ? "" : "/admin";

    const orderNumber = searchParams.get("order");
    const orderId = searchParams.get("order_id");
    if (orderNumber || orderId) {
      const match = orders.find((o) =>
        orderNumber ? o.order_number === orderNumber : o.id === orderId,
      );
      if (match) {
        openOrderForDelivery(match, setSelectedOrder, setFormState);
        router.replace(`${base}/delivery-status`, { scroll: false });
        return;
      }
    }
    // Auto-open from query param — customize request
    const requestNumber = searchParams.get("request");
    if (requestNumber) {
      // Use live SWR data so newly-Completed requests are found immediately
      const matchCustomize = (rawCustomize ?? []).find(
        (r) => r.request_number === requestNumber,
      );
      if (matchCustomize) {
        openCustomizeForDelivery(
          matchCustomize,
          setSelectedCustomize,
          setCustomizeDeliveryForm,
        );
        setActiveTab("customize");
        router.replace(`${base}/delivery-status`, { scroll: false });
      }
    }
  }, [searchParams, orders, rawCustomize, router]);

  // ── Filtered lists ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const filteredOrders = useMemo(
    () =>
      orders.filter((o) => {
        const q = search.toLowerCase();
        const matchSearch =
          o.customer_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          o.order_number.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          o.shipping_address.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchStatus =
          statusFilter === "All" || o.delivery_status === statusFilter;
        return matchSearch && matchStatus;
      }),
    [orders, search, statusFilter],
  );

  const filteredCustomize = useMemo(
    () =>
      customizeRequests.filter((r) => {
        const q = customizeSearch.toLowerCase();
        const matchSearch =
          r.customer_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          r.request_number.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (r.furniture_description ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchStatus =
          customizeStatusFilter === "All" ||
          r.delivery_status === customizeStatusFilter;
        return matchSearch && matchStatus;
      }),
    [customizeRequests, customizeSearch, customizeStatusFilter],
  );

  // ── Handlers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async function handleSaveDelivery() {
    if (!selectedOrder || !formState) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const result = await updateOrderStatusAction(selectedOrder.id, {
        driver_id: formState.driver_id ?? null,
        driver_name: formState.driver_name,
        driver_phone: formState.driver_phone,
        scheduled_date: formState.scheduled_date,
        delivery_status: selectedOrder.delivery_status || "Preparing",
      });
      if (result.success) {
        toast.success("Driver assigned and delivery scheduled.");
        setSelectedOrder(null);
        setFormState(null);
      } else throw new Error(result.error);
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to save.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleMarkOrderPickupReady() {
    if (!selectedOrder) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const result = await updateOrderStatusAction(selectedOrder.id, {
        delivery_status: "Ready for Pickup",
      });
      if (result.success) {
        toast.success("Order marked as Ready for Pickup! Customer notified.");
        setSelectedOrder(null);
        setFormState(null);
      } else throw new Error(result.error);
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to update status.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleMarkOrderPickedUp() {
    if (!selectedOrder) return;
    if (!pickupPhoto1 || !pickupPhoto2) {
      toast.error("Please upload both proof photos before confirming pickup.");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setUploadingPhotos(true);
    try {
      const ts = Date.now();
      const url1 = await uploadPickupPhoto(
        pickupPhoto1,
        `orders/${selectedOrder.id}/pickup-proof-1-${ts}.jpg`,
      );
      const url2 = await uploadPickupPhoto(
        pickupPhoto2,
        `orders/${selectedOrder.id}/pickup-proof-2-${ts}.jpg`,
      );
      setUploadingPhotos(false);
      if (!url1 || !url2) {
        toast.error("Failed to upload photos.");
        return;
      }
      const result = await updateOrderStatusAction(selectedOrder.id, {
        delivery_status: "Delivered",
        order_status: "Delivered",
        proof_of_delivery_url: url1,
        proof_of_delivery_url_2: url2,
      });
      if (result.success) {
        toast.success("Order marked as Picked Up!");
        resetPickupPhotos();
        setSelectedOrder(null);
        setFormState(null);
      } else throw new Error(result.error);
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to update status.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      setUploadingPhotos(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleMarkCustomizePickupReady() {
    if (!selectedCustomize) return;
    setCustomizeBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/admin/customize-requests/${selectedCustomize.id}`,
        {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            delivery_status: "Ready for Pickup",
          }),
        },
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
      refreshCustomize();
      toast.success("Custom furniture marked as Ready for Pickup!");
      setSelectedCustomize(null);
      setCustomizeDeliveryForm(null);
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to update status.");
    } finally {
      setCustomizeBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleMarkCustomizePickedUp() {
    if (!selectedCustomize) return;
    if (!pickupPhoto1 || !pickupPhoto2) {
      toast.error("Please upload both proof photos before confirming pickup.");
      return;
    }
    setCustomizeBusy(true);
    setUploadingPhotos(true);
    try {
      const ts = Date.now();
      const url1 = await uploadPickupPhoto(
        pickupPhoto1,
        `customize/${selectedCustomize.id}/pickup-proof-1-${ts}.jpg`,
      );
      const url2 = await uploadPickupPhoto(
        pickupPhoto2,
        `customize/${selectedCustomize.id}/pickup-proof-2-${ts}.jpg`,
      );
      setUploadingPhotos(false);
      if (!url1 || !url2) {
        toast.error("Failed to upload photos.");
        return;
      }
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/admin/customize-requests/${selectedCustomize.id}`,
        {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            delivery_status: "Delivered",
            status: "Completed",
            proof_of_delivery_url: url1,
            proof_of_delivery_url_2: url2,
          }),
        },
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
      refreshCustomize();
      toast.success("Custom furniture marked as Picked Up!");
      resetPickupPhotos();
      setSelectedCustomize(null);
      setCustomizeDeliveryForm(null);
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to update status.");
    } finally {
      setCustomizeBusy(false);
      setUploadingPhotos(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSaveCustomizeDelivery() {
    if (!selectedCustomize || !customizeDeliveryForm) return;
    setCustomizeBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/admin/customize-requests/${selectedCustomize.id}`,
        {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            status: "Completed",
            driver_id: customizeDeliveryForm.driver_id ?? null,
            driver_name: customizeDeliveryForm.driver_name,
            driver_phone: customizeDeliveryForm.driver_phone,
            scheduled_date: customizeDeliveryForm.scheduled_date,
            delivery_status: "Preparing",
          }),
        },
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
      refreshCustomize();
      toast.success("Driver assigned and delivery scheduled.");
      setSelectedCustomize(null);
      setCustomizeDeliveryForm(null);
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to save delivery details.");
    } finally {
      setCustomizeBusy(false);
    }
  }

  // ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5 pb-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
            Delivery Status
          </h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-base mt-0.5">
            Assign drivers and manage delivery schedules for customer orders.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Tabs & Content ── */}
      <Tabs
        value={activeTab}
        onValueChange={(val) =>
          setActiveTab(val as "orders" | "customize" | "drivers")
        }
        className="w-full space-y-4"
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-2.5 items-stretch lg:items-center justify-between">
          <TabsList className="w-full sm:w-auto grid grid-cols-3 h-11 p-1 bg-muted rounded-xl">
            <TabsTrigger
              value="orders"
              className="text-base font-semibold px-3 sm:px-4 h-9 rounded-lg data-[state=active]:bg-card data-[state=active]:text-foreground data-[state=active]:shadow-xs cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <span>Orders</span>
              {initialOrders.length > 0 && (
                <span className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-semibold">
                  ({initialOrders.length})
                </span>
              )}
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger
              value="customize"
              className="text-base font-semibold px-3 sm:px-4 h-9 rounded-lg data-[state=active]:bg-card data-[state=active]:text-foreground data-[state=active]:shadow-xs cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <span>Customize</span>
              {customizeRequests.length > 0 && (
                <span className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-semibold">
                  ({customizeRequests.length})
                </span>
              )}
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger
              value="drivers"
              className="text-base font-semibold px-3 sm:px-4 h-9 rounded-lg data-[state=active]:bg-card data-[state=active]:text-foreground data-[state=active]:shadow-xs cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <span>Drivers</span>
              {registeredDrivers.length > 0 && (
                <span className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-semibold">
                  ({registeredDrivers.length})
                </span>
              )}
            </TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>

          {activeTab === "orders" ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2.5 flex-1 max-w-xl">
              <div className="relative flex-1">
                <Search
                  size={16}
                  className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
                />
                <Input
                  type="search"
                  placeholder="Search by customer or order number"
                  value={search}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                  className="pl-9 h-10 text-base w-full placeholder:text-base"
                />
              </div>
              <Select
                value={statusFilter}
                onValueChange={(v) =>
                  setStatusFilter(v as DeliveryStatus | "All")
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="cursor-pointer w-full sm:w-[170px] h-10 shrink-0 text-base">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="All Status" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="All" className="text-base">
                    All Status
                  </SelectItem>
                  {allDeliveryStatuses.map((s) => (
                    <SelectItem key={s} value={s} className="text-base">
                      {s}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          ) : activeTab === "customize" ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2.5 flex-1 max-w-xl">
              <div className="relative flex-1">
                <Search
                  size={16}
                  className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
                />
                <Input
                  type="search"
                  placeholder="Search by customer or request number"
                  value={customizeSearch}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomizeSearch(e.target.value)}
                  className="pl-9 h-10 text-base w-full placeholder:text-base"
                />
              </div>
              <Select
                value={customizeStatusFilter}
                onValueChange={(v) =>
                  setCustomizeStatusFilter(v as DeliveryStatus | "All")
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="cursor-pointer w-full sm:w-[170px] h-10 shrink-0 text-base">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="All Status" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="All" className="text-base">
                    All Status
                  </SelectItem>
                  {allDeliveryStatuses.map((s) => (
                    <SelectItem key={s} value={s} className="text-base">
                      {s}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2.5 flex-1 max-w-2xl justify-end">
              <div className="relative flex-1">
                <Search
                  size={16}
                  className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
                />
                <Input
                  type="search"
                  placeholder="Search driver by name or phone"
                  value={driverSearch}
                  onChange={(e) => setDriverSearch(e.target.value)}
                  className="pl-9 h-10 text-base w-full placeholder:text-base"
                />
              </div>
              <Select
                value={driverStatusFilter}
                onValueChange={(v) =>
                  setDriverStatusFilter(v as "all" | "active" | "available")
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="cursor-pointer w-full sm:w-[170px] h-10 shrink-0 text-base">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="All Drivers" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all" className="text-base">
                    All Drivers
                  </SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="active" className="text-base">
                    On Delivery
                  </SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="available" className="text-base">
                    Available
                  </SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <Button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleOpenAddDriver}
                className="h-10 px-4 text-base font-semibold shrink-0 cursor-pointer "
              >
                <span>Add Driver</span>
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ── ORDERS TAB ── */}
        {activeTab === "orders" && (
          <div className="border border-border bg-card rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
            <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-base text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-border text-muted-foreground text-sm font-semibold bg-muted/40">
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap w-px">
                      Image
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                      Order Number
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                      Customer
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                      Time Order
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                      Assigned Driver
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                      Status
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                      Actions
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-border text-foreground">
                  {filteredOrders.length === 0 ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td
                        colSpan={7}
                        className="px-4 py-14 text-center text-base text-muted-foreground"
                      >
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                          <Truck className="h-9 w-9 text-muted-foreground/50" />
                          <p className="font-bold text-foreground text-lg">
                            No matching deliveries found
                          </p>
                          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            Try adjusting your search query or delivery status
                            filter.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : (
                    filteredOrders.map((order) => {
                      const firstItem = order.order_items?.[0];
                      const imageSrc =
                        firstItem?.product?.primary_image_url ||
                        firstItem?.product_image;
                      const isWide = firstItem?.product?.is_wide ?? false;
                      return (
                        <tr
                          key={order.id}
                          className="hover:bg-muted/40 transition-colors"
                        >
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle">
                            <div
                              className={cn(
                                "relative shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg",
                                isWide ? "w-16 h-11" : "w-11 h-14",
                              )}
                            >
                              {imageSrc ? (
                                <Image
                                  src={getImageUrl(imageSrc)}
                                  alt={
                                    firstItem?.product_name ?? "Product image"
                                  }
                                  fill
                                  sizes="80px"
                                  className="object-cover"
                                  unoptimized
                                />
                              ) : (
                                <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                                  <ImageIcon
                                    size={16}
                                    className="text-muted-foreground/50"
                                  />
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold text-foreground align-middle whitespace-nowrap text-base">
                            {order.order_number}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-muted-foreground font-semibold text-base align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                            {order.customer_name}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-muted-foreground font-medium text-base align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                            {new Date(order.created_at).toLocaleString(
                              "en-US",
                              {
                                month: "short",
                                day: "2-digit",
                                year: "numeric",
                                hour: "2-digit",
                                minute: "2-digit",
                                hour12: true,
                              },
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-muted-foreground font-semibold text-base align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                            {order.shipping_method === "pickup" ? (
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center text-base font-semibold ">
                                Store Pickup
                              </span>
                            ) : order.driver_name ? (
                              <span>{order.driver_name}</span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground/60 text-base font-semibold">
                                Unassigned
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">
                            {order.delivery_status ? (
                              <span
                                className={cn(
                                  "inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 text-base font-semibold rounded-lg border",
                                  deliveryStatusStyles[
                                    order.delivery_status as DeliveryStatus
                                  ] || "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
                                )}
                              >
                                {order.delivery_status}
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">-</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap align-middle">
                            <Button
                              variant="outline"

                <p className="text-2xl font-semibold text-foreground">

                      <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">

                      </th>

                      <th className="px-4 py-3.5 align-middle whitespace-nowrap">

                      </th>

                              size={36}
                              className="text-muted-foreground/50"

                            <p className="font-bold text-foreground text-lg">

                  "inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 text-base font-semibold rounded-lg border",
                  deliveryStatusStyles[
                    selectedOrder.delivery_status as DeliveryStatus

                        </span>{" "}

                      </p>
                      <p>
                        <span className="font-medium text-foreground">

                              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">

                              <input
                                type="file"
                                accept="image/*,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp"

                                className="hidden"
                                onChange={(e) => {
                                  handlePickupFilesSelected(1, e.target.files);
                                  e.target.value = "";

                              <div className="size-9 rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center">
                                <ImageIcon size={18} />
                              </div>
                              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">

                              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">

                                  e.target.value = "";

                                className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 size-7 rounded-full shadow-md cursor-pointer"
                              >
                                <X size={14} />
                              </Button>
                            </div>

                          driver_id: d.id,

                          driver_phone: d.phone || formState.driver_phone,

                        </SelectItem>

                  <DatePicker

                    onChange={(date) =>
                      setFormState({ ...formState, scheduled_date: date })

                </div>
              </div>

            if (!customizeBusy) {

              setCustomizeDeliveryForm(null);
            }
          }}

              "space-y-5",

              <CustomizeDetailPreview

                hidePaidSection

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-lg border bg-card text-sm">

              </span>

                  "inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 text-base font-semibold rounded-lg border",

                  ] ?? "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
                )}
              >
                {selectedCustomize.delivery_status ?? "Preparing"}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Store Pickup Mode vs Driver Delivery Mode */}
            {selectedCustomize.shipping_method === "pickup" ||
            // Fallback: treat as pickup if fee is 0 and no delivery address (DB constraint may have nulled shipping_method)

                      <h3 className="font-semibold text-foreground text-base">
                        Store Pickup - Custom Woodwork
                      </h3>
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
