```typescript
                    <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1 pt-2 border-t border-border">
                      <p>
                        <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                          Location:
                        </span>{" "}
                        0043 Duyong Concepcion, San Simon, Pampanga
                      </p>
                      <p>
                        <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                          Pickup Hours:
                        </span>{" "}
                        Monday – Saturday (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM)
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                  {selectedCustomize.delivery_status !== "Ready for Pickup" &&
                    selectedCustomize.delivery_status !== "Delivered" && (
                      <Button
                        onClick={handleMarkCustomizePickupReady}
                        disabled={customizeBusy}
                        className="w-full h-10 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                        type="button"
                      >
                        {customizeBusy && (
                          <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
                        )}
                        Mark as Ready for Pickup &amp; Notify Customer
                      </Button>
                    )}

                  {selectedCustomize.delivery_status === "Ready for Pickup" && (
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                          Proof of Pickup Photos (2 Required){" "}
                          <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          Please attach photos of the customer receiving the
                          order before marking as picked up.
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                        {/* Slot 1 */}
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-1.5">
                            Photo 1
                          </p>
                          {!pickupPreview1 ? (
                            <label className="border border-dashed border-border hover:border-primary/50 bg-muted/20 hover:bg-muted/40 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors text-center aspect-[4/3]">
                              <div className="size-9 rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center">
                                <Camera size={18} />
                              </div>
                              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                                Upload Photo
                              </p>
                              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                Picked up item
                              </p>
                              <input
                                type="file"
                                accept="image/*,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp"
                                multiple
                                className="hidden"
                                onChange={(e) => {
                                  handlePickupFilesSelected(1, e.target.files);
                                  e.target.value = "";
                                }}
                              />
                            </label>
                          ) : (
                            <div className="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden border bg-muted aspect-[4/3] flex items-center justify-center">
                              <Image
                                src={pickupPreview1}
                                alt="Proof Photo 1"
                                fill
                                className="object-cover"
                              />
                              <Button
                                type="button"
                                size="icon"
                                variant="destructive"
                                onClick={() => handleSetPickupPhoto1(null)}
                                className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 size-7 rounded-full shadow-md cursor-pointer"
                              >
                                <X size={14} />
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {/* Slot 2 */}
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-1.5">
                            Photo 2
                          </p>
                          {!pickupPreview2 ? (
                            <label className="border border-dashed border-border hover:border-primary/50 bg-muted/20 hover:bg-muted/40 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors text-center aspect-[4/3]">
                              <div className="size-9 rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center">
                                <ImageIcon size={18} />
                              </div>
                              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                                Upload Photo
                              </p>
                              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                Customer Claim
                              </p>
                              <input
                                type="file"
                                accept="image/*,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp"
                                multiple
                                className="hidden"
                                onChange={(e) => {
                                  handlePickupFilesSelected(2, e.target.files);
                                  e.target.value = "";
                                }}
                              />
                            </label>
                          ) : (
                            <div className="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden border bg-muted aspect-[4/3] flex items-center justify-center">
                              <Image
                                src={pickupPreview2}
                                alt="Proof Photo 2"
                                fill
                                className="object-cover"
                              />
                              <Button
                                type="button"
                                size="icon"
                                variant="destructive"
                                onClick={() => handleSetPickupPhoto2(null)}
                                className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 size-7 rounded-full shadow-md cursor-pointer"
                              >
                                <X size={14} />
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <Button
                        onClick={handleMarkCustomizePickedUp}
                        disabled={
                          customizeBusy || !pickupPhoto1 || !pickupPhoto2
                        }
                        className="w-full h-10 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                        type="button"
                      >
                        {(customizeBusy || uploadingPhotos) && (
                          <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
                        )}
                        {uploadingPhotos
                          ? "Uploading Photos"
                          : "Confirm Claimed & Mark as Picked Up"}
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {selectedCustomize.delivery_status === "Delivered" && (
                    <div className="p-3  text-base font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 rounded-lg border border-emerald-300">
                      This custom furniture has been claimed &amp; completed.
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              /* Driver Assignment & Schedule Date for Delivery */
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <Field className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                    Assign Driver
                  </Field>
                  <Select
                    disabled={isCustomizeDelivered}
                    value={customizeDeliveryForm.driver_id ?? ""}
                    onValueChange={(val) => {
                      const d = registeredDrivers.find(
                        (driver) => driver.id === val,
                      );
                      if (d) {
                        setCustomizeDeliveryForm((prev) => ({
                          ...(prev ?? {
                            driver_id: null,
                            driver_name: null,
                            driver_phone: null,
                            scheduled_date: null,
                          }),
                          driver_id: d.id,
                          driver_name: d.full_name,
                          driver_phone:
                            d.phone || selectedCustomize.driver_phone,
                        }));
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger className="w-full h-10 bg-card">
                      <SelectValue placeholder="Select Available Driver" />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      {registeredDrivers.length > 0 ? (
                        registeredDrivers.map((d) => (
                          <SelectItem key={d.id} value={d.id}>
                            {d.full_name} ({d.phone || "No phone"})
                          </SelectItem>
                        ))
                      ) : (
                        <SelectItem value="none" disabled>
                          No registered drivers found
                        </SelectItem>
                      )}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <Field className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                    Scheduled Date
                  </Field>
                  <DatePicker
                    value={customizeDeliveryForm.scheduled_date}
                    minDate={new Date()}
                    disabled={isCustomizeDelivered}
                    onChange={(date) =>
                      setCustomizeDeliveryForm((prev) => ({
                        ...(prev ?? {
                          driver_id: null,
                          driver_name: null,
                          driver_phone: null,
                          scheduled_date: null,
                        }),
                        scheduled_date: date,
                      }))
                    }
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Action buttons (Only for delivery orders) */}
            {!(
              selectedCustomize.shipping_method === "pickup" ||
              (selectedCustomize.shipping_method == null &&
                (selectedCustomize.shipping_fee ?? 1) === 0 &&
                !selectedCustomize.shipping_address)
            ) && (
              <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-3.5 -mb-0.5 border-t border-border">
                <Button
                  onClick={() => {
                    resetPickupPhotos();
                    setSelectedCustomize(null);
                    setCustomizeDeliveryForm(null);
                  }}
                  variant="outline"
                  className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                  disabled={customizeBusy}
                  type="button"
                >
                  Close
                </Button>
                <Button
                  onClick={handleSaveCustomizeDelivery}
                  disabled={
                    customizeBusy ||
                    isCustomizeDelivered ||
                    !hasCustomizeDeliveryChanges ||
                    !isCustomizeDriverSelected ||
                    !customizeDeliveryForm.scheduled_date
                  }
                  className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
                  type="button"
                >
                  {customizeBusy ? (
                    <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
                  ) : null}
                  Save &amp; Assign
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* ── DRIVER DELIVERIES BREAKDOWN MODAL ── */}
      {selectedDriverForView && (
        <Modal
          title={`Assigned Deliveries - ${selectedDriverForView.full_name}`}
          onClose={() => {
            setSelectedDriverForView(null);
            setShowDriverCredentials(false);
            setShowPlainPassword(false);
            setIsResettingPassword(false);
            setNewDriverPasswordInput("");
          }}
        >
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* Driver Profile Summary Card */}
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card/60 overflow-hidden">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 p-4">
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg text-foreground">
                  {selectedDriverForView.full_name}
                </h3>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    className="h-8 px-3 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer "
                    onClick={() => {
                      setShowDriverCredentials((prev) => !prev);
                      setIsResettingPassword(false);
                    }}
                  >
                    <span>
                      {showDriverCredentials
                        ? "Hide Credentials"
                        : "View Credentials"}
                    </span>
                  </Button>

                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    className="h-8 px-3 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                    onClick={() => handleOpenNotifyModal(selectedDriverForView)}
                  >
                    <span>Alert</span>
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Collapsible Credentials Panel with Framer Motion Animation */}
              <AnimatePresence>
                {showDriverCredentials && (
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                    animate={{ height: "auto", opacity: 1 }}
                    exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: "easeInOut" }}
                    className="overflow-hidden border-t border-border"
                  >
                    <div className="p-4 space-y-3">
                      {/* Single Row: Email and Password (2 columns) */}
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-sm">
                        {/* Email */}
                        <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg border bg-card flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                              Email Address
                            </p>
                            <p className="font-medium text-foreground truncate select-all text-base">
                              {selectedDriverForView.email ||
                                "No email assigned"}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          {selectedDriverForView.email && (
                            <Button
                              type="button"
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="icon"
                              className="size-7 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground cursor-pointer"
                              onClick={() =>
                                handleCopyText(
                                  selectedDriverForView.email,
                                  "Email",
                                )
                              }
                            >
                              {copiedField === "Email" ? (
                                <Check size={14} className="text-emerald-500" />
                              ) : (
                                <Copy size={14} />
                              )}
                            </Button>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {/* Password */}
                        <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg border bg-card flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                              Password
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-foreground font-medium truncate select-all text-base">
                              {selectedDriverForView.initial_password ? (
                                showPlainPassword ? (
                                  selectedDriverForView.initial_password
                                ) : (
                                  "••••••"
                                )
                              ) : (
                                <span className="text-muted-foreground text-sm font-normal italic">
                                  Not set (click Change password below)
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0">
                            {selectedDriverForView.initial_password ? (
                              <>
                                <Button
                                  type="button"
                                  variant="ghost"
                                  size="icon"
                                  className="size-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground cursor-pointer"
                                  onClick={() =>
                                    setShowPlainPassword((prev) => !prev)
                                  }
                                >
                                  {showPlainPassword ? (
                                    <EyeOff size={14} />
                                  ) : (
                                    <Eye size={14} />
                                  )}
                                </Button>
                                <Button
                                  type="button"
                                  variant="ghost"
                                  size="icon"
                                  className="size-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground cursor-pointer"
                                  onClick={() =>
                                    handleCopyText(
                                      selectedDriverForView.initial_password!,
                                      "Password",
                                    )
                                  }
                                >
                                  {copiedField === "Password" ? (
                                    <Check
                                      size={14}
                                      className="text-emerald-500"
                                    />
                                  ) : (
                                    <Copy size={14} />
                                  )}
                                </Button>
                              </>
                            ) : null}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Centered Change Password text button below container */}
                      <div className="flex justify-center pt-0.5">
                        {!isResettingPassword ? (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setIsResettingPassword(true);
                              setNewDriverPasswordInput("");
                            }}
                            className="text-base text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground underline underline-offset-2 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                          >
                            Change password
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card space-y-2.5 w-full">
                            <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                              Set New Password for{" "}
                              {selectedDriverForView.full_name}
                            </p>
                            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
                              <Input
                                type="text"
                                placeholder="Enter new password"
                                value={newDriverPasswordInput}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                  setNewDriverPasswordInput(e.target.value)
                                }
                                className="h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base"
                                disabled={isUpdatingPassword}
                              />
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 justify-end">
                                <Button
                                  type="button"
                                  className="h-10 px-3 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                                  onClick={handleSaveNewPassword}
                                  disabled={
                                    isUpdatingPassword ||
                                    newDriverPasswordInput.length < 6
                                  }
                                >
                                  {isUpdatingPassword ? (
                                    <Spinner className="size-4 mr-1" />
                                  ) : null}
                                  Save Password
                                </Button>
                                <Button
                                  type="button"
                                  variant="outline"
                                  className="h-10 px-3 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    setIsResettingPassword(false);
                                    setNewDriverPasswordInput("");
                                  }}
                                  disabled={isUpdatingPassword}
                                >
                                  Cancel
                                </Button>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </motion.div>
                )}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>

            {(() => {
              const list = selectedDriverForView.allDeliveries;

              if (list.length === 0) {
                return (
                  <div className="text-center py-10 border border-dashed border-border rounded-xl p-6 text-muted-foreground">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                      No assigned deliveries found
                    </p>
                  </div>
                );
              }

              return list.map((item) => (
                <div
                  key={`${item.type}-${item.id}`}
                  className="border border-border rounded-xl p-4 bg-card hover:bg-muted/20 transition-all space-y-3 shadow-xs"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="space-y-1.5 flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span
                          className={cn(
                            "inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg border",
                            item.type === "order"
                              ? "bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30"
                              : "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30",
                          )}
                        >
                          {item.type === "order" ? "Furniture" : "Customize"}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                          {item.trackingNumber}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                          Name & Contact:{" "}
                        </span>
                        {item.customerName}
                        {item.customerPhone ? ` - ${item.customerPhone}` : ""}
                      </p>

                      <p className="text-base text-foreground/90 font-medium">
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Address: </span>
                        {item.shippingAddress}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                      <span
                        className={cn(
                          "inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg border",
                          deliveryStatusStyles[item.deliveryStatus] ||
                            "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
                        )}
                      >
                        {item.deliveryStatus}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2.5 border-t border-border/60">
                    <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                      {item.deliveryStatus === "Delivered" && item.deliveredAt
                        ? `Delivered on ${new Date(
                            item.deliveredAt,
                          ).toLocaleDateString("en-PH", {
                            month: "short",
                            day: "numeric",
                            hour: "2-digit",
                            minute: "2-digit",
                          })}`
                        : item.deliveryStatus === "Out for Delivery"
                          ? "Currently on delivery"
                          : "Preparing for delivery"}
                    </span>

                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      className="h-8 px-3 text-sm font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                      onClick={() =>
                        handleOpenNotifyModal(
                          selectedDriverForView,
                          item.trackingNumber,
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      <span>Send Alert</span>
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ));
            })()}
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* ── NOTIFY DRIVER MODAL ── */}
      {notifyModalDriver && (
        <Dialog
          open
          onOpenChange={(open) => {
            if (!open && !isSendingNotification) {
              setNotifyModalDriver(null);
              setNotifyDeliveryRef(null);
            }
          }}
        >
          <DialogContent
            className="sm:max-w-lg w-full p-0 rounded-sm overflow-hidden shadow-xl border border-border"
            showCloseButton={false}
          >
            <div className="flex flex-col">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 border-b shrink-0">
                <DialogTitle className="font-semibold text-base md:text-lg text-foreground">
                  Notify {notifyModalDriver.full_name}
                </DialogTitle>
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  className="size-8 p-0 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (!isSendingNotification) {
                      setNotifyModalDriver(null);
                      setNotifyDeliveryRef(null);
                    }
                  }}
                  type="button"
                >
                  <X className="size-5 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
                </Button>
              </div>

              <div className="p-6 space-y-4 text-base">
                <div>
                  <Field className="mb-2 text-base">
                    Quick Preset Template
                  </Field>
                  <Select
                    value={notifyPreset}
                    onValueChange={(val) => {
                      setNotifyPreset(val);
                      const firstName =
                        notifyModalDriver.full_name.split(" ")[0];
                      if (val === "out_for_delivery") {
                        setNotifyTitle(
                          notifyDeliveryRef
                            ? `Dispatch Order ${notifyDeliveryRef}`
                            : "Dispatch & Out for Delivery Reminder",
                        );
                        setNotifyMessage(
                          `Hi ${firstName}, please update status to Out for Delivery and start your delivery route${
                            notifyDeliveryRef ? ` for ${notifyDeliveryRef}` : ""
                          }.`,
                        );
                      } else if (val === "prepare") {
                        setNotifyTitle("Prepare Item for Delivery");
                        setNotifyMessage(
                          `Hi ${firstName}, your assigned delivery${
                            notifyDeliveryRef ? ` (${notifyDeliveryRef})` : ""
                          } is ready for pickup and preparation.`,
                        );
                      } else if (val === "priority") {
                        setNotifyTitle("Priority Delivery Alert");
                        setNotifyMessage(
                          `Hi ${firstName}, please prioritize delivery${
                            notifyDeliveryRef ? ` ${notifyDeliveryRef}` : ""
                          } today as requested by the customer.`,
                        );
                      } else if (val === "custom") {
                        setNotifyTitle("Notice from CraftIt Admin");
                        setNotifyMessage(`Hi ${firstName}, `);
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger className="w-full h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base cursor-pointer">
                      <SelectValue placeholder="Select template" />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      <SelectItem
                        value="out_for_delivery"
                        className="text-base"
                      >
                        Dispatch &amp; Out for Delivery
                      </SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="prepare" className="text-base">
                        Prepare Package for Delivery
                      </SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="priority" className="text-base">
                        Priority Delivery Alert
                      </SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="custom" className="text-base">
                        Custom Message
                      </SelectItem>
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <Field className="mb-2 text-base ">Notification Title</Field>
                  <Input
                    value={notifyTitle}
                    onChange={(e) => setNotifyTitle(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Enter notification title"
                    className="h-10 text-base placeholder:text-base"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <Field className="mb-2 text-base ">
                    Notification Message
                  </Field>
                  <Textarea
                    value={notifyMessage}
                    onChange={(e) => setNotifyMessage(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Enter message for the driver"
                    className="h-20 text-base placeholder:text-base resize-none"
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Action buttons */}
                <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-4 -mb-2 border-t border-border">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setNotifyModalDriver(null);
                      setNotifyDeliveryRef(null);
                    }}
                    disabled={isSendingNotification}
                    type="button"
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold"
                    onClick={handleSendDriverNotification}
                    disabled={
                      isSendingNotification ||
                      !notifyTitle.trim() ||
                      !notifyMessage.trim()
                    }
                    type="button"
                  >
                    {isSendingNotification && (
                      <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
                    )}
                    Send Notification
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      )}

      {/* ── ADD DRIVER MODAL ── */}
      {isAddDriverOpen && (
        <Dialog
          open={isAddDriverOpen}
          onOpenChange={(open) => {
            if (!open && !addDriverBusy) {
              setIsAddDriverOpen(false);
              setAddDriverError("");
            }
          }}
        >
          <DialogContent
            className="sm:max-w-lg w-full p-0 rounded-sm overflow-hidden shadow-xl border border-border"

                      }}
                      placeholder="Minimum 6 characters"

                      className="h-10 pr-10 text-base placeholder:text-base"
                      disabled={addDriverBusy}
                    />
                    <button

                      disabled={addDriverBusy}

                        <EyeOff size={18} />

                        <Eye size={18} />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  {addDriverPassword.length > 0 &&
                    addDriverPassword.length < 6 && (
                      <p className="text-sm text-red-500 font-medium mt-1">
                        Password must be at least 6 characters.
                      </p>
                    )}
                </div>

                {addDriverError && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-red-500 font-medium">
                    {addDriverError}
                  </p>
                )}

                {}
                <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-4 -mb-2 border-t border-border">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setIsAddDriverOpen(false);
                      setAddDriverError("");
                    }}
                    disabled={addDriverBusy}
                    type="button"
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    className="h-10 px-5 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={
                      addDriverBusy ||
                      !addDriverName.trim() ||
                      !addDriverPhone.trim() ||
                      !addDriverEmail.trim() ||
                      addDriverPassword.length < 6
                    }
                  >
                    {addDriverBusy && (
                      <Spinner className="size-5 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0" />
                    )}
                    Create Driver Account
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { ok: false as const };
  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();
  return { ok: profile?.role === "admin", user };
}

export async function GET() {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data: drivers, error } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("id, full_name, email, phone, role, created_at")
    .eq("role", "driver")
    .order("full_name", { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  try {
    const authResults = await Promise.all(
      (drivers || []).map(async (d) => {
        try {
          const { data } = await supabase.auth.admin.getUserById(d.id);
          return { id: d.id, user: data?.user || null };
        } catch {
          return { id: d.id, user: null };
        }
      }),
    );

    const userMap = new Map(authResults.map((r) => [r.id, r.user]));

    const enrichedDrivers = (drivers || []).map((d) => {
      const authUser = userMap.get(d.id);
      const initialPassword =
        (authUser?.user_metadata?.initial_password as string) || null;
      return {
        ...d,
        initial_password: initialPassword,
      };
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ drivers: enrichedDrivers });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Failed to fetch auth users for drivers:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ drivers: drivers || [] });
  }
}

export async function PATCH(req: Request) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const { driverId, newPassword } = await req.json();

    if (!driverId || !newPassword || typeof newPassword !== "string") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Driver ID and new password are required." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    if (newPassword.length < 6) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Password must be at least 6 characters long." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
    const { data: userData, error: getUserError } =
      await supabase.auth.admin.getUserById(driverId);

    if (getUserError || !userData?.user) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Driver user not found." },
        { status: 404 },
      );
    }

    const currentMetadata = userData.user.user_metadata || {};
    const { error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.admin.updateUserById(
      driverId,
      {
        password: newPassword,
        user_metadata: {
          ...currentMetadata,
          initial_password: newPassword,
        },
      },
    );

    if (updateError) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: updateError.message },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "Password updated successfully.",
      newPassword,
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Driver password update error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to update driver password." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { ok: false as const };
  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();
  return { ok: profile?.role === "admin", user };
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  if (!admin.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { driverId, title, message, link, metadata } = body;

    if (!driverId || !title || !message) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "driverId, title, and message are required" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();

    const { data: driver, error: driverError } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("id, full_name, email, role")
      .eq("id", driverId)
      .single();

    if (driverError || !driver) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Driver not found" },
        { status: 404 },
      );
    }

    const { data: notification, error: notifError } = await supabase
      .from("notifications")
      .insert({
        user_id: driverId,
        type: "delivery",
        title: title.trim(),
        description: message.trim(),
        link: link || "/driver/deliveries",
        metadata: metadata || {},
        is_read: false,
      })
      .select()
      .single();

    if (notifError) {
      console.error("Error creating driver notification:", notifError);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: notifError.message },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      notification,
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("POST /api/admin/drivers/notify error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Internal Server Error" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

## File: `app/api/admin/damage-reports/route.ts`

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  if (!profile || profile.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Forbidden: Admins only" },
      { status: 403 },
    );
  }

  try {
    const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient();

    const { data: damageReports, error } = await serviceRole
      .from("damage_reports")
      .select("*")
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

    if (error) {
      console.error("Damage reports fetch error:", error);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: error.message },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    const enrichedReports = await Promise.all(
      (damageReports || []).map(async (report) => {
        let deliveryInfo = null;

        if (report.delivery_type === "standard") {
          const { data: order } = await serviceRole
            .from("orders")
            .select("id, order_number, customer_name, customer_email")
            .eq("id", report.delivery_id)
            .single();
          deliveryInfo = order;
        } else if (report.delivery_type === "custom") {
          const { data: request } = await serviceRole
            .from("customize_requests")
            .select("id, request_number, customer_name, customer_email")
            .eq("id", report.delivery_id)
            .single();
          deliveryInfo = request;
        }

        return {
          ...report,
          orders: report.delivery_type === "standard" ? deliveryInfo : null,
          customize_requests: report.delivery_type === "custom" ? deliveryInfo : null,
        };
      })
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      damageReports: enrichedReports,
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Damage reports error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to fetch damage reports" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import useSWR from "swr";
import { Search, Package, Hand, Truck } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { DeliveryCard, type DriverDeliveryData } from "./delivery-card";
import { SectionHeader } from "./section-header";
import { useRealtimeOrders } from "@/hooks/use-realtime-orders";
import { DriverNotificationBell } from "./driver-notification-bell";
import type { DriverDeliveriesServerData } from "@/lib/supabase/driver";

const fetcher = async (url: string) => {
  const res = await fetch(url);
  if (!res.ok) {
    if (res.status === 401) {
      const isSubdomain =
        typeof window !== "undefined" &&
        (window.location.hostname.startsWith("deliver.") ||
          window.location.hostname.startsWith("driver."));
      window.location.href = isSubdomain
        ? "/authentication"
        : "/driver-authentication";
    }
    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to fetch deliveries");
  }
  return res.json();
};

export default function DriverDeliveriesClient({
  initialData,
}: {
  initialData?: DriverDeliveriesServerData;
}) {
  const { data, mutate } = useSWR<{
    deliveries: DriverDeliveryData[];
    driver: { id?: string; full_name?: string; phone?: string };
  }>("/api/driver/deliveries", fetcher, {
    fallbackData: initialData
      ? { deliveries: initialData.deliveries, driver: initialData.driver || {} }
      : undefined,
    revalidateOnFocus: true,
    revalidateOnReconnect: true,
  });

  useRealtimeOrders({
    onUpdate: () => mutate(),
  });

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [filterTab, setFilterTab] = useState<"all" | "out" | "preparing">(
    "all",
  );

  const effectiveDriver = data?.driver ?? initialData?.driver;

  const activeDeliveries = useMemo(() => {
    const all = data?.deliveries ?? initialData?.deliveries ?? [];
    return all.filter((d) => d.deliveryStatus !== "Delivered");
  }, [data?.deliveries, initialData?.deliveries]);

  const filteredDeliveries = useMemo(() => {
    return activeDeliveries.filter((d) => {
      const matchesSearch =
        d.trackingNumber.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
        d.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
        d.shippingAddress.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());

      if (!matchesSearch) return false;

      if (filterTab === "out") return d.deliveryStatus === "Out for Delivery";
      if (filterTab === "preparing") return d.deliveryStatus === "Preparing";
      return true;
    });
  }, [activeDeliveries, search, filterTab]);

  const outCount = activeDeliveries.filter(
    (d) => d.deliveryStatus === "Out for Delivery",
  ).length;
  const preparingCount = activeDeliveries.filter(
    (d) => d.deliveryStatus === "Preparing",
  ).length;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 pb-4">
      {}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
            Welcome back {effectiveDriver?.full_name?.split(" ")[0] || "Driver"}{" "}
            <Hand className="size-6 text-amber-500" />
          </h1>
          <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground font-medium mt-1">
            Ready to manage and deliver your assignments today.
          </p>
        </div>
        <DriverNotificationBell driverId={effectiveDriver?.id} />
      </div>

      {}
      <div className="relative">
        <Search
          size={18}
          className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
        />
        <Input
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Search by name, address, or order number"
          className="h-11 pl-10 text-base placeholder:text-base"
        />
      </div>

      {}
      <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-0.5 no-scrollbar">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setFilterTab("all")}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            filterTab === "all"
              ? "bg-foreground text-background shadow-2xs"
              : "bg-muted/60 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted"
          }`}
        >
          All Active ({activeDeliveries.length})
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setFilterTab("out")}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            filterTab === "out"
              ? "bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-2xs"
              : "bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/20 hover:bg-purple-500/15"
          }`}
        >
          Out for Delivery ({outCount})
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setFilterTab("preparing")}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            filterTab === "preparing"
              ? "bg-amber-600 text-white shadow-2xs"
              : "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/15"
          }`}
        >
          Preparing ({preparingCount})
        </button>
      </div>

      {}
      <section className="space-y-3.5">
        <SectionHeader title="Assigned Deliveries" />

        {}
        {filteredDeliveries.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border bg-card p-10 text-center space-y-3 shadow-xs">
            <div className="size-12 rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary mx-auto flex items-center justify-center">
              <Truck size={24} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="font-semibold text-base text-foreground">
                No Deliveries Found
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1 max-w-[260px] mx-auto">
                {search
                  ? "No deliveries match your search query."
                  : "You have no active deliveries in this status right now."}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3.5">
            {filteredDeliveries.map((delivery) => (
              <DeliveryCard
                key={`${delivery.type}-${delivery.id}`}
                delivery={delivery}
                onRefresh={() => mutate()}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import React, { useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import useSWR from "swr";
import { useRouter, usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useTheme } from "next-themes";
import {
  User,
  Mail,
  Phone,
  LogOut,
  ShieldCheck,
  Moon,
  Sun,
  Loader2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { SectionHeader } from "./section-header";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useRealtimeOrders } from "@/hooks/use-realtime-orders";
import type { DriverProfileServerData } from "@/lib/supabase/driver";

const emptySubscribe = () => () => {};
const fetcher = async (url: string) => {
  const res = await fetch(url);
  if (!res.ok) {
    if (res.status === 401) {
      const isSubdomain =
        typeof window !== "undefined" &&
        (window.location.hostname.startsWith("deliver.") ||
          window.location.hostname.startsWith("driver."));
      window.location.href = isSubdomain
        ? "/authentication"
        : "/driver-authentication";
    }
    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to fetch profile");
  }
  return res.json();
};

export default function DriverProfileClient({
  initialData,
}: {
  initialData?: DriverProfileServerData;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();
  const [loggingOut, setLoggingOut] = useState(false);

  const mounted = useSyncExternalStore(
    emptySubscribe,
    () => true,
    () => false,
  );

  const { data, mutate } = useSWR<{
    driver: { full_name?: string; email?: string; phone?: string; role?: string };
    activeCount: number;
    completedCount: number;
  }>("/api/driver/profile", fetcher, {
    fallbackData: initialData ? {
      driver: initialData.driver || {},
      activeCount: initialData.activeCount,
      completedCount: initialData.completedCount,
    } : undefined,
    revalidateOnFocus: true,
    revalidateOnReconnect: true,
  });

  useRealtimeOrders({
    onUpdate: () => mutate(),
  });

  const driver = data?.driver ?? initialData?.driver;
  const activeCount = data?.activeCount ?? initialData?.activeCount ?? 0;
  const completedCount = data?.completedCount ?? initialData?.completedCount ?? 0;

  async function handleLogout() {
    if (loggingOut) return;
    setLoggingOut(true);
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      await supabase.auth.signOut();
      const isSubdomain =
        typeof window !== "undefined" &&
        (window.location.hostname.startsWith("deliver.") ||
          window.location.hostname.startsWith("driver."));
      router.push(isSubdomain ? "/authentication" : "/driver-authentication");
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to log out.");
      setLoggingOut(false);
    }
  }

  const isDarkMode = mounted && theme === "dark";
  const isSubdomain = !pathname.startsWith("/driver");
  const deliveriesHref = isSubdomain ? "/deliveries" : "/driver/deliveries";

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 pb-6">
      {}
      <section>
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4 space-y-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <SectionHeader
            title="Performance Summary"
            actionLabel="View Deliveries"
            actionHref={deliveriesHref}
          />

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-purple-500/20 bg-purple-500/5 dark:bg-purple-500/10 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
              <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">
                {activeCount}
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium mt-1">
                Active Deliveries
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/5 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
              <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                {completedCount}
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium mt-1">
                Completed
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {}
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-3.5">
        <SectionHeader title="Account Details" />

        <Card className="p-4 border border-border bg-card rounded-xl shadow-xs flex flex-col gap-3.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
            <div className="size-10 rounded-xl bg-muted/60 border border-border flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground shrink-0">
              <User size={18} />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground leading-none">Full Name</p>
              <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground truncate mt-1">
                {driver?.full_name || "Logistics Driver"}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="border-t border-border/40 my-0.5" />

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
            <div className="size-10 rounded-xl bg-muted/60 border border-border flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground shrink-0">
              <Mail size={18} />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground leading-none">Email Address</p>
              <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground truncate mt-1">
                {driver?.email || "—"}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="border-t border-border/40 my-0.5" />

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
            <div className="size-10 rounded-xl bg-muted/60 border border-border flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground shrink-0">
              <Phone size={18} />

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
```
