```typescript
import { useRealtimeDamageReports } from "@/hooks/use-realtime-damage-reports";
import useSWR from "swr";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { ProofOfDeliveryModal } from "./proof-of-delivery-modal";
import { DamageReportModal } from "./damage-report-modal";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  updateDriverDeliveryStatusAction,
  addDriverCheckpointAction,
} from "@/app/actions/driver";
import {
  extractMunicipality,
  parseDriverCheckpoints,
} from "@/lib/utils/delivery-timeline";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface DeliveryItem {
  name: string;
  quantity: number;
  price: number;
  material?: string | null;
  imageUrl?: string | null;
}

export interface DriverDeliveryData {
  id: string;
  trackingNumber: string;
  type: "standard" | "custom";
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  customerPhone: string | null;
  shippingAddress: string;
  shippingMethod: string;
  shippingFee: number;
  total: number;
  deliveryStatus:
    | "Preparing"
    | "Out for Delivery"
    | "Delivered"
    | "Failed Delivery";
  scheduledDate: string | null;
  deliveryNotes: string | null;
  proofOfDeliveryUrl?: string | null;
  proofOfDeliveryUrl2?: string | null;
  deliveredAt?: string | null;
  recipientName?: string | null;
  notes?: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  items: DeliveryItem[];
}

export function DeliveryCard({
  delivery,
  onRefresh,
}: {
  delivery: DriverDeliveryData;
  onRefresh: () => void;
}) {
  const [isUpdating, setIsUpdating] = useState(false);
  const [showProofModal, setShowProofModal] = useState(false);
  const [showDamageModal, setShowDamageModal] = useState(false);
  const [showProofViewer, setShowProofViewer] = useState(false);
  const [selectedProofImage, setSelectedProofImage] = useState<string | null>(
    delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl || delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl2 || null,
  );
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [isTransitExpanded, setIsTransitExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [localStatus, setLocalStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [localSentCheckpoints, setLocalSentCheckpoints] = useState<string[]>(
    [],
  );
  const [checkpointText, setCheckpointText] = useState("");
  const [isPostingCheckpoint, setIsPostingCheckpoint] = useState(false);

  useRealtimeOrders({
    enabled: true,
    onUpdate: onRefresh,
  });

  useRealtimeDamageReports({
    enabled: true,
    onUpdate: () => mutateDamageReport(),
  });

  const damageReportFetcher = async (url: string) => {
    const res = await fetch(url);
    return res.json();
  };

  const { data: damageReportData, mutate: mutateDamageReport } = useSWR(
    `/api/driver/check-damage-report/${delivery.id}`,
    damageReportFetcher,
    {
      revalidateOnFocus: true,
      revalidateOnReconnect: true,
    }
  );

  const hasDamageReport = damageReportData?.hasReport ?? false;
  const damageReportStatus = damageReportData?.report?.status ?? null;

  const mapsUrl = `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(
    delivery.shippingAddress,
  )}`;

  const effectiveStatus = localStatus || delivery.deliveryStatus;
  const isDelivered = effectiveStatus === "Delivered";
  const isOutForDelivery = effectiveStatus === "Out for Delivery";
  const isPreparing = effectiveStatus === "Preparing";

  async function handleStartDelivery() {
    setIsUpdating(true);
    try {
      const result = await updateDriverDeliveryStatusAction({
        deliveryId: delivery.id,
        type: delivery.type,
        deliveryStatus: "Out for Delivery",
      });

      if (!result.success) {
        throw new Error(result.error || "Failed to start delivery.");
      }

      setLocalStatus("Out for Delivery");
      toast.success(
        `Delivery #${delivery.trackingNumber} is now Out for Delivery!`,
      );
      onRefresh();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Error starting delivery.",
      );
    } finally {
      setIsUpdating(false);
    }
  }

  async function handlePostCheckpoint() {
    const textToPost = checkpointText.trim();
    if (!textToPost) return;
    setIsPostingCheckpoint(true);
    setLocalSentCheckpoints((prev) => [...prev, textToPost]);
    try {
      const res = await addDriverCheckpointAction({
        deliveryId: delivery.id,
        type: delivery.type,
        title: textToPost,
      });

      if (!res.success) {
        throw new Error(res.error || "Failed to post tracking update.");
      }

      toast.success("Delivery tracking checkpoint posted!");
      setCheckpointText("");
      onRefresh();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to post checkpoint.",
      );
    } finally {
      setIsPostingCheckpoint(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
      {}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-border bg-muted/20">
        <span className="font-semibold text-base text-foreground">
          {delivery.trackingNumber}
        </span>

        <span className="text-sm px-2.5 py-1 rounded-sm font-semibold bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
          {delivery.type === "standard" ? "Furniture" : "Customized"}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="p-4 space-y-3.5 -mt-1">
        {}
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg text-foreground truncate">
            {delivery.customerName}
          </h3>

          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <MapPin size={16} className="shrink-0 text-primary mt-0.5" />
            <span className="leading-snug line-clamp-2">
              {delivery.shippingAddress}
            </span>
          </div>

          {delivery.scheduledDate && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground pt-0.5">
              <Calendar size={15} className="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
              <span>
                Scheduled:{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {new Date(delivery.scheduledDate).toLocaleDateString(
                    "en-US",
                    {
                      month: "short",
                      day: "numeric",
                      year: "numeric",
                    },
                  )}
                </span>
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-0.5">
          {delivery.customerPhone ? (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              asChild
              className="h-10 text-base font-semibold rounded-lg gap-2 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <a href={`tel:${delivery.customerPhone}`}>
                <Phone
                  size={15}
                  className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                />
                Call Customer
              </a>
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              disabled
              className="h-10 text-base font-semibold rounded-lg gap-2 cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              <Phone size={15} />
              No Phone
            </Button>
          )}

          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            asChild
            className="h-10 text-base font-semibold rounded-lg gap-2 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <a href={mapsUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
              <Navigation
                size={15}
                className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"
              />
              Open Maps
            </a>
          </Button>
        </div>

        {}
        <div className="border border-border/80 rounded-lg bg-muted/20 overflow-hidden text-base">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsExpanded(!isExpanded)}
            className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between font-semibold text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <span>
              {delivery.items.length} Item
              {delivery.items.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} to Deliver
            </span>
            <ChevronDown
              size={16}
              className={`transition-transform duration-200 ${
                isExpanded ? "rotate-180" : ""
              }`}
            />
          </button>

          {isExpanded && (
            <div className="px-3.5 pb-3 pt-2 border-t border-border/60 space-y-2">
              {delivery.items.map((item, idx) => (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  className="flex justify-between items-center text-foreground text-sm"
                >
                  <span className=" max-w-[290px] font-medium">
                    {item.name} {item.material ? `(${item.material})` : ""}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground font-semibold">
                    x{item.quantity}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {}
        {isOutForDelivery && (
          <>
            {hasDamageReport ? (
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border bg-emerald-500/5 border-emerald-500/20 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-base font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
                    Damage Report Submitted
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground capitalize">
                    {damageReportStatus}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  A damage report has been submitted for this delivery.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Button
                onClick={() => setShowDamageModal(true)}
                variant="outline"
                className="w-full h-10 text-base font-semibold border-amber-500/30 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-500/10 rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
              >
                Report Damage Issue
              </Button>
            )}
          </>
        )}

        {}
        {isDelivered && (
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border bg-emerald-500/5 border-emerald-500/20 space-y-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-base font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
                Successfully Delivered
              </span>
              {delivery.deliveredAt && (
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                  {new Date(delivery.deliveredAt).toLocaleTimeString("en-US", {
                    hour: "numeric",
                    minute: "2-digit",
                  })}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {(delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl || delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl2) && (
              <div className="space-y-2 pt-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                  {delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl && (
                    <div
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedProofImage(delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl!);
                        setShowProofViewer(true);
                      }}
                      className="relative w-20 h-16 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity bg-muted shrink-0"
                    >
                      <Image
                        src={delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl}
                        alt="Proof 1"
                        fill
                        className="object-cover"
                        unoptimized
                      />
                      <span className="absolute bottom-1 right-1 bg-black/70 text-[10px] text-white font-semibold px-1 rounded">
                        1
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl2 && (
                    <div
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedProofImage(delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl2!);
                        setShowProofViewer(true);
                      }}
                      className="relative w-20 h-16 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity bg-muted shrink-0"
                    >
                      <Image
                        src={delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl2}
                        alt="Proof 2"
                        fill
                        className="object-cover"
                        unoptimized
                      />
                      <span className="absolute bottom-1 right-1 bg-black/70 text-[10px] text-white font-semibold px-1 rounded">
                        2
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSelectedProofImage(
                        delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl ||
                          delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl2!,
                      );
                      setShowProofViewer(true);
                    }}
                    className="h-9 px-3 text-base font-semibold cursor-pointer ml-auto"
                  >
                    View Proof
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {}
        {!isDelivered && (
          <div className="border border-border/80 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-muted/20">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsTransitExpanded(!isTransitExpanded)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-muted/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-foreground font-semibold">
                Post Delivery Transit Update
              </span>
              <ChevronDown
                size={16}
                className={`transition-transform duration-200 text-muted-foreground ${
                  isTransitExpanded ? "rotate-180" : ""
                }`}
              />
            </button>

            {isTransitExpanded && (
              <div className="px-3.5 pb-3.5 pt-1 space-y-2.5 border-t border-border/60">
                {}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-1">
                  {(() => {
                    const fromNotes = parseDriverCheckpoints(
                      delivery.deliveryNotes,
                    ).map((cp) => cp.title.trim().toLowerCase());
                    const allSent = [
                      ...fromNotes,
                      ...localSentCheckpoints.map((t) =>
                        t.trim().toLowerCase(),
                      ),
                    ];

                    const muni = extractMunicipality(delivery.shippingAddress);
                    const presets = [
                      "Furniture has departed to the CraftIt Workshop",
                      `Driver is on route to ${muni}`,
                      "Driver has arrived near the delivery address",
                      "Slight delivery delay due to heavy traffic",
                    ];

                    return presets.map((preset, i) => {
                      const pClean = preset
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
                      const isUsed = allSent.some((s) => {
                        const sClean = s
                          .toLowerCase()
                          .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
                        return (
                          sClean.includes(pClean) || pClean.includes(sClean)
                        );
                      });

                      return (
                        <button
                          key={i}
                          type="button"
                          disabled={isUsed || isPostingCheckpoint}
                          onClick={() => setCheckpointText(preset)}
                          className={cn(
                            "text-sm font-medium px-2.5 py-1 rounded border transition-colors text-left flex items-center gap-1.5",
                            isUsed
                              ? "bg-muted/40 border-border/40 text-muted-foreground/60 cursor-not-allowed opacity-60"
                              : "border-border bg-card hover:bg-muted/60 text-foreground cursor-pointer",
                          )}
                        >
                          {isUsed && (
                            <CheckCircle2
                              size={12}
                              className="text-emerald-500 shrink-0"
                            />
                          )}
                          <span>{preset}</span>
                        </button>
                      );
                    });
                  })()}
                </div>

                {}
                <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
                  <Input
                    value={checkpointText}
                    onChange={(e) => setCheckpointText(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Or enter custom transit / location update"
                    className="h-9 text-sm placeholder:text-sm bg-card"
                    disabled={isPostingCheckpoint}
                  />
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="default"
                    className="h-9 px-3 text-sm font-semibold cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                    onClick={handlePostCheckpoint}
                    disabled={isPostingCheckpoint || !checkpointText.trim()}
                  >
                    {isPostingCheckpoint ? (
                      <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      "Post"
                    )}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {}
        {!isDelivered && (
          <div className="pt-1">
            {isPreparing && (
              <Button
                onClick={handleStartDelivery}
                disabled={isUpdating}
                className="w-full h-11 text-base font-semibold bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isUpdating ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                    <Loader2 className="size-5 animate-spin" />
                    <span>Updating status</span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <span>Start Delivery (Out for Delivery)</span>
                )}
              </Button>
            )}

            {isOutForDelivery && (
              <Button
                onClick={() => setShowProofModal(true)}
                className="w-full h-11 text-base font-semibold bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
              >
                Complete Delivery & Upload Proof
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {}
      <ProofOfDeliveryModal
        open={showProofModal}
        onOpenChange={setShowProofModal}
        deliveryId={delivery.id}
        trackingNumber={delivery.trackingNumber}
        customerName={delivery.customerName}
        type={delivery.type}
        onSuccess={onRefresh}
      />

      {}
      <DamageReportModal
        open={showDamageModal}
        onOpenChange={setShowDamageModal}
        deliveryId={delivery.id}
        trackingNumber={delivery.trackingNumber}
        type={delivery.type}
        onSuccess={() => {

          mutateDamageReport();
          onRefresh();
        }}
      />

      {}
      {(delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl || delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl2) && (
        <Dialog open={showProofViewer} onOpenChange={setShowProofViewer}>
          <DialogContent className="max-w-md p-0 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-background">
            <DialogTitle className="sr-only">Proof of Delivery</DialogTitle>
            <div className="relative aspect-square w-full bg-black/5 flex items-center justify-center">
              {selectedProofImage && (
                <Image
                  src={selectedProofImage}
                  alt="Proof of Delivery Fullscreen"
                  fill
                  className="object-contain"
                  unoptimized
                />
              )}
            </div>

            {}
            {delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl && delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl2 && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 p-3 border-t bg-muted/20">
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant={
                    selectedProofImage === delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl
                      ? "default"
                      : "outline"
                  }
                  onClick={() =>
                    setSelectedProofImage(delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl!)
                  }
                  className="h-8 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Photo 1
                </Button>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant={
                    selectedProofImage === delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl2
                      ? "default"
                      : "outline"
                  }
                  onClick={() =>
                    setSelectedProofImage(delivery.proofOfDeliveryUrl2!)
                  }
                  className="h-8 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Photo 2
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import React, { useState, useRef } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import { Camera, X, ImageIcon } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogHeader,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { updateDriverDeliveryStatusAction } from "@/app/actions/driver";

interface ProofOfDeliveryModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  deliveryId: string;
  trackingNumber: string;
  customerName: string;
  type: "standard" | "custom";
  onSuccess: () => void;
}

export function ProofOfDeliveryModal({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  deliveryId,
  trackingNumber,
  customerName: _customerName,
  type,
  onSuccess,
}: ProofOfDeliveryModalProps) {
  const fileInputRef1 = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef2 = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const [file1, setFile1] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [previewUrl1, setPreviewUrl1] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [file2, setFile2] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [previewUrl2, setPreviewUrl2] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  function handleFilesSelected(slot: 1 | 2, fileList: FileList) {
    const ALLOWED_TYPES = [
      "image/jpeg",
      "image/png",
      "image/webp",
      "image/gif",
      "image/heic",
      "image/heif",
    ];
    const ALLOWED_EXTS = ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "webp", "gif", "heic", "heif"];
    const MAX_SINGLE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024;

    const rawFiles = Array.from(fileList);
    const validFiles: File[] = [];

    for (const file of rawFiles) {
      const ext = file.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
      const mimeOk =
        file.type === ""
          ? ALLOWED_EXTS.includes(ext)
          : ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type);
      const extOk = ALLOWED_EXTS.includes(ext) || file.type === "";

      if (!mimeOk || (!extOk && file.type !== "")) {
        toast.error(
          `"${file.name}" is not allowed. Only JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF images are accepted.`,
        );
        continue;
      }

      if (file.size > MAX_SINGLE_SIZE) {
        toast.error(`"${file.name}" exceeds the 10MB size limit.`);
        continue;
      }

      validFiles.push(file);
    }

    if (validFiles.length === 0) return;

    if (validFiles.length >= 2) {
      if (previewUrl1) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl1);
      if (previewUrl2) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl2);

      setFile1(validFiles[0]);
      setPreviewUrl1(URL.createObjectURL(validFiles[0]));

      setFile2(validFiles[1]);
      setPreviewUrl2(URL.createObjectURL(validFiles[1]));

      toast.success("2 photos attached successfully.");
      return;
    }

    const singleFile = validFiles[0];
    if (slot === 1) {
      if (previewUrl1) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl1);
      setFile1(singleFile);
      setPreviewUrl1(URL.createObjectURL(singleFile));
    } else {
      if (previewUrl2) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl2);
      setFile2(singleFile);
      setPreviewUrl2(URL.createObjectURL(singleFile));
    }
  }

  function handleClearImage(slot: 1 | 2) {
    if (slot === 1) {
      if (previewUrl1) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl1);
      setFile1(null);
      setPreviewUrl1(null);
      if (fileInputRef1.current) fileInputRef1.current.value = "";
    } else {
      if (previewUrl2) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl2);
      setFile2(null);
      setPreviewUrl2(null);
      if (fileInputRef2.current) fileInputRef2.current.value = "";
    }
  }

  function resetAll() {
    handleClearImage(1);
    handleClearImage(2);
  }

  async function uploadImage(
    fileToUpload: File,
    suffix: string,
  ): Promise<string> {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", fileToUpload);
    formData.append("deliveryId", `${type}_${deliveryId}_${suffix}`);

    const uploadRes = await fetch("/api/driver/upload-proof", {
      method: "POST",
      body: formData,
    });

    const uploadData = await uploadRes.json();
    if (!uploadRes.ok || !uploadData.proofUrl) {
      throw new Error(uploadData.error || `Failed to upload photo ${suffix}.`);
    }

    return uploadData.proofUrl;
  }

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!file1 || !file2) {
      toast.error(
        "Please upload both proof of delivery photos (Photo 1 and Photo 2).",
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {

      const [url1, url2] = await Promise.all([
        uploadImage(file1, "proof1"),
        uploadImage(file2, "proof2"),
      ]);

      const updateResult = await updateDriverDeliveryStatusAction({
        deliveryId,
        type,
        deliveryStatus: "Delivered",
```

```typescript
          : ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type);
      const extOk = ALLOWED_EXTS.includes(ext) || file.type === "";

      if (!mimeOk || (!extOk && file.type !== "")) {
        toast.error(
          `"${file.name}" is not allowed. Only JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF images are accepted.`,
        );

      if (file.size > MAX_SINGLE_SIZE) {

      );
```

```typescript
import React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type DriverStatusVariant =
  | "preparing"
  | "out-for-delivery"
  | "delivered"
  | "failed"
  | "pending";

const variantStyles: Record<DriverStatusVariant, string> = {
  preparing:
    "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30",
  "out-for-delivery":
    "bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30",
  delivered:
    "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30",
  failed:
    "bg-red-500/10 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 border-red-500/30",
  pending:
    "bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30",
};

export function DriverStatusBadge({
  variant,
  children,
  className,
}: {
  variant: DriverStatusVariant;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors",
        variantStyles[variant],
        className,
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import React from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { Truck, Clock, User } from "lucide-react";

export function DriverBottomNav() {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const isSubdomain = !pathname.startsWith("/driver");
  const p = (path: string) => (isSubdomain ? path : `/driver${path}`);

  const navItems = [
    {
      href: p("/deliveries"),
      label: "Deliveries",
      icon: Truck,
      isActive:
        pathname === "/driver/deliveries" ||
        pathname === "/deliveries" ||
        pathname === "/driver" ||
        pathname === "/",
    },
    {
      href: p("/history"),
      label: "History",
      icon: Clock,
      isActive:
        pathname === "/driver/history" || pathname === "/history",
    },
    {
      href: p("/profile"),
      label: "Profile",
      icon: User,
      isActive:
        pathname === "/driver/profile" || pathname === "/profile",
    },
  ] as const;

  return (
    <nav className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 border-t border-border bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div className="mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-md items-center justify-around pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]">
        {navItems.map(({ href, label, icon: Icon, isActive }) => {
          return (
            <Link
              key={href}
              href={href}
              className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-5 py-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                isActive
                  ? "text-foreground font-semibold"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground font-medium"
              }`}
            >
              <Icon
                className={`size-5.5 ${
                  isActive ? "stroke-[2.5] text-primary" : "stroke-[1.75]"
                }`}
              />
              <span className="text-xs">{label}</span>
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Bell, Truck, Check, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { formatDistanceToNow } from "date-fns";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import useSWR from "swr";
import { toast } from "sonner";

const fetcher = (url: string) => fetch(url).then((res) => res.json());

interface DriverNotification {
  id: string;
  is_read: boolean;
  type?: string;
  link?: string;
  title?: string;
  message?: string;
  description?: string;
  created_at: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

export function DriverNotificationBell({ driverId }: { driverId?: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isMarking, setIsMarking] = useState(false);

  const { data, mutate } = useSWR<{ notifications: DriverNotification[] }>(
    "/api/driver/notifications",
    fetcher,
    {
      refreshInterval: 10000,
      revalidateOnFocus: true,
    },
  );

  const notifications = useMemo(
    () => data?.notifications || [],
    [data?.notifications],
  );
  const unreadCount = useMemo(
    () => notifications.filter((n) => !n.is_read).length,
    [notifications],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!driverId) return;

    const supabase = createClient();
    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`driver_notifications_${driverId}`)
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        {
          event: "INSERT",
          schema: "public",
          table: "notifications",
          filter: `user_id=eq.${driverId}`,
        },
        (payload: any) => {
          const newNotif = payload.new as DriverNotification;
          mutate();

          toast(newNotif.title || "New Notification from Admin", {
            description: newNotif.description || newNotif.message || "",
            duration: 6000,
          });
        },
      )
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        {
          event: "UPDATE",
          schema: "public",
          table: "notifications",
          filter: `user_id=eq.${driverId}`,
        },
        () => {
          mutate();
        },
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [driverId, mutate]);

  const handleMarkAllRead = async () => {
    if (unreadCount === 0 || isMarking) return;
    try {
      setIsMarking(true);
      await fetch("/api/driver/notifications", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({}),
      });
      mutate(
        {
          notifications: notifications.map((n) => ({ ...n, is_read: true })),
        },
        false,
      );
    } catch {

    } finally {
      setIsMarking(false);
    }
  };

  const handleNotificationClick = async (notif: DriverNotification) => {
    if (!notif.is_read) {
      fetch("/api/driver/notifications", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ notificationId: notif.id }),
      }).catch(() => {});

      mutate(
        {
          notifications: notifications.map((n) =>
            n.id === notif.id ? { ...n, is_read: true } : n,
          ),
        },
        false,
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="icon"
          className="relative size-10 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card shadow-2xs hover:bg-muted cursor-pointer shrink-0 transition-colors"
          aria-label="Notifications"
        >
          <Bell className="size-5 text-foreground" />
          {unreadCount > 0 && (
            <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-5 min-w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-600 px-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-white shadow-xs animate-in zoom-in-50 duration-200">
              {unreadCount > 9 ? "9+" : unreadCount}
            </span>
          )}
        </Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>

      <PopoverContent
        align="end"
        sideOffset={8}
        className="w-[320px] sm:w-[360px] p-0 rounded-xl shadow-xl border border-border bg-card overflow-hidden"
      >
        {}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-border bg-muted/30">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-foreground">
              Notifications
            </h3>
            {unreadCount > 0 && (
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 -mt-0.5 rounded bg-primary/10 text-primary">
                {unreadCount} new
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {unreadCount > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleMarkAllRead}
              disabled={isMarking}
              className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isMarking && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />}
              <span>Mark all read</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {}
        <ScrollArea className="max-h-[340px]">
          {notifications.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-10 px-4 text-center space-y-2 text-muted-foreground">
              <div className="size-10 rounded-full bg-muted flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-muted-foreground">
                <Bell size={18} />
              </div>
              <p className="font-semibold text-base text-foreground">
                No notifications yet
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Delivery updates and notices from admin will appear here.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="divide-y divide-border/60">
              {notifications.map((n) => {
                const timeAgo = formatDistanceToNow(new Date(n.created_at), {
                  addSuffix: true,
                });

                return (
                  <div
                    key={n.id}
                    onClick={() => handleNotificationClick(n)}
                    className={cn(
                      "p-3.5 flex gap-3 items-start transition-colors cursor-pointer text-left hover:bg-muted/40",
                      !n.is_read && "bg-primary/[0.04]",
                    )}
                  >
                    <div
                      className={cn(
                        "size-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5",
                        !n.is_read
                          ? "bg-primary/10 text-primary"
                          : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
                      )}
                    >
                      <Truck size={16} />
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-0.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                        <p
                          className={cn(
                            "text-base leading-tight truncate",
                            !n.is_read
                              ? "font-bold text-foreground"
                              : "font-medium text-foreground/90",
                          )}
                        >
                          {n.title || "Delivery Notice"}
                        </p>
                        {!n.is_read && (
                          <span className="text-base font-semibold text-primary shrink-0">
                            Unread
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ">
                        {n.description || n.message}
                      </p>

                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/80 text-right pt-0.5">
                        {timeAgo}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </ScrollArea>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import Image from "next/image";
import { Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, X } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "../ui/button";
import { Input } from "../ui/input";
import { Field, FieldGroup, FieldLabel } from "../ui/field";
import { Spinner } from "../ui/spinner";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export default function DriverAuth() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [isLeaving, setIsLeaving] = useState(false);

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");

  const isInteractionBlocked = loading || isLeaving;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isInteractionBlocked) {
      document.body.style.cursor = "wait";
    } else {
      document.body.style.cursor = "default";
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.cursor = "default";
    };
  }, [isInteractionBlocked]);

  async function handleLogin(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!email.trim() || !password) {
      setError("Please fill in both email and password.");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    const supabase = createClient();

    try {
      const { data, error: signInError } =
        await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
          email: email.trim(),
          password,
        });

      if (signInError || !data.user) {
        setError("Invalid email or password.");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("role")
        .eq("id", data.user.id)
        .single();

      if (profile?.role !== "driver" && profile?.role !== "admin") {
        await supabase.auth.signOut();
        setError(
          "Access restricted. This portal is for authorized drivers only.",
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const isSubdomain =
        window.location.hostname.startsWith("deliver.") ||
        window.location.hostname.startsWith("driver.");
      router.push(isSubdomain ? "/deliveries" : "/driver/deliveries");
      router.refresh();
      return;
    } catch {
      setError("Authentication failed. Please try again.");
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      {isInteractionBlocked && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] cursor-wait pointer-events-auto" />
      )}

      <div className="bg-card border shadow-lg rounded-t-lg w-full max-w-md mx-auto overflow-hidden">
        {}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 border-b">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Image
              src="/android-chrome-120x120.png"
              alt="CraftIt Logo"
              width={24}
              height={24}
              className="rounded-md"
            />
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Driver Portal</h2>
          </div>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            className="h-8 w-8 p-0 rounded-full cursor-pointer"
            type="button"
            disabled={isInteractionBlocked}
            onClick={() => {
              setIsLeaving(true);
              window.location.href = "https://craftitfurniture.shop";
            }}
          >
            {isLeaving ? (
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            )}
            <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
          </Button>
        </div>

        {}
        <div className="p-6">
          <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={handleLogin}>
            <FieldGroup>
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel
                  htmlFor="driver-email"
                  className="text-base font-medium -mb-1"
                >
                  Driver Email Address
                </FieldLabel>
                <Input
                  type="email"
                  id="driver-email"
                  required
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setEmail(e.target.value);
                    if (error) setError("");
                  }}
                  className={cn(
                    "h-11 placeholder:text-base transition-colors",
                    error
                      ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                      : "",
                  )}
                  placeholder="driver@example.com"
                  disabled={isInteractionBlocked}
                />
              </Field>

              <Field>
                <FieldLabel
                  htmlFor="driver-password"
                  className="text-base font-medium -mb-1"
                >
                  Password
                </FieldLabel>
                <div className="relative">
                  <Input
                    type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                    id="driver-password"
                    required
                    value={password}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setPassword(e.target.value);
                      if (error) setError("");
                    }}
                    className={cn(
                      "h-11 pr-10 placeholder:text-base transition-colors",
                      error
                        ? "border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive"
                        : "",
                    )}
                    placeholder="••••••••"
                    disabled={isInteractionBlocked}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                    className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground cursor-pointer"
                    disabled={isInteractionBlocked}
                  >
                    {showPassword ? <EyeOff size={18} /> : <Eye size={18} />}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </Field>

              {error && (
                <p className="text-sm text-red-500 font-medium -mt-2">
                  {error}
                </p>
              )}

              <Field>
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  className="w-full h-11 text-base font-semibold relative mt-1 cursor-pointer"
                  disabled={isInteractionBlocked}
                >
                  <span className={loading ? "invisible" : "visible"}>
                    Sign In
                  </span>
                  {loading && (
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                      <Spinner />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </Field>
            </FieldGroup>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ isDriver: false }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { data: profile, error } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ isDriver: false }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ isDriver: profile?.role === "driver" });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { email } = await request.json();
    if (!email || typeof email !== "string") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { isDriver: false, error: "Please enter a valid email address." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const serviceSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
    const { data: profile, error } = await serviceSupabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("role")
      .ilike("email", email.trim())
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error || !profile || profile.role !== "driver") {
      return NextResponse.json({
        isDriver: false,
        error: "No driver account found with this email address.",
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ isDriver: true });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { isDriver: false, error: "Failed to verify driver email." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

## File: `app/api/auth/driver-register/route.ts`

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/supabase/auth-guard";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const adminAuth = await requireAdmin();
    if (!adminAuth.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Unauthorized: Only administrators can register driver accounts." },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }

    const { email, password, fullName, phone } = await req.json();

    if (!email || !password || !fullName || !phone) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "All fields are required." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const adminSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();

    const { data: userData, error: createError } =
      await adminSupabase.auth.admin.createUser({
        email: email.trim(),
        password,
        email_confirm: true,
        user_metadata: {
          full_name: fullName.trim(),
          phone: phone.trim(),
          role: "driver",
          initial_password: password,
        },
      });

    if (createError) {
      if (createError.message.toLowerCase().includes("already registered")) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "An account with this email address already exists." },
          { status: 400 },
        );
      }
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: createError.message },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    if (!userData.user) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Failed to create driver account." },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    const { error: profileError } = await adminSupabase.from("profiles").upsert({
      id: userData.user.id,
      email: email.trim(),
      full_name: fullName.trim(),
      phone: phone.trim(),
      role: "driver",
      is_onboarded: true,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    if (profileError) {
      console.error("Profile upsert error:", profileError);
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, userId: userData.user.id });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Driver register error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Server error occurred. Please try again." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

async function requireDriver() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { ok: false as const };

  const serviceSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data: profile } = await serviceSupabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("id, full_name, email, phone, role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  const isDriverOrAdmin = profile?.role === "driver" || profile?.role === "admin";
  return { ok: isDriverOrAdmin, user, profile };
}

export async function GET() {
  const auth = await requireDriver();
  if (!auth.ok || !auth.user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const driverId = auth.user.id;

  const { data: orders, error: ordersError } = await supabase
    .from("orders")
    .select(`
      id,
      order_number,
      customer_id,
      customer_name,
      customer_email,
      customer_phone,
      shipping_address,
      shipping_method,
      shipping_fee,
      total,
      delivery_status,
      driver_id,
      driver_name,
      driver_phone,
      scheduled_date,
      delivery_notes,
      driver_notes,
      proof_of_delivery_url,
      proof_of_delivery_url_2,
      delivered_at,
      recipient_name,
      notes,
      created_at,
      order_items:order_details (
        id,
        product_name,
        quantity,
        total_price,
        material,
        product:products (
          id,
          name,
          primary_image_url
        )
      )
    `)
    .eq("driver_id", driverId)
    .neq("shipping_method", "pickup")
    .neq("delivery_status", "Delivered")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (ordersError) {
    console.error("Error fetching driver orders:", ordersError);
  }

  const { data: customRequests, error: customError } = await supabase
    .from("customize_requests")
    .select(`
      id,
      request_number,
      customer_id,
      customer_name,
      customer_email,
      customer_phone,
      shipping_address,
      shipping_method,
      shipping_fee,
      final_price,
      quote_amount,
      delivery_status,
      driver_id,
      driver_name,
      driver_phone,
      scheduled_date,
      delivery_notes,
      driver_notes,
      proof_of_delivery_url,
      proof_of_delivery_url_2,
      delivered_at,
      recipient_name,
      item,
      furniture_type,
      furniture_description,
      wood_type,
      quantity,
      reference_images,
      created_at
    `)
    .eq("driver_id", driverId)
    .neq("shipping_method", "pickup")
    .neq("delivery_status", "Delivered")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (customError) {
    console.error("Error fetching driver customize requests:", customError);
  }

  const formattedOrders = (orders || []).map((o) => ({
    id: o.id,
    trackingNumber: o.order_number,
    type: "standard" as const,
    customerName: o.customer_name,
    customerEmail: o.customer_email,
    customerPhone: o.customer_phone,
    shippingAddress: o.shipping_address,
    shippingMethod: o.shipping_method,
    shippingFee: o.shipping_fee,
    total: o.total,
    deliveryStatus: o.delivery_status || "Preparing",
    scheduledDate: o.scheduled_date,
    deliveryNotes: o.driver_notes || o.delivery_notes,
    proofOfDeliveryUrl: o.proof_of_delivery_url,
    proofOfDeliveryUrl2: o.proof_of_delivery_url_2,
    deliveredAt: o.delivered_at,
    recipientName: o.recipient_name,
    notes: o.notes,
    createdAt: o.created_at,
    items: (o.order_items || []).map((item) => ({
      name: item.product_name,
      quantity: item.quantity,
      price: item.total_price,
      material: item.material,
      imageUrl: (item.product as { primary_image_url?: string } | null)?.primary_image_url || null,
    })),
  }));

  const formattedCustom = (customRequests || []).map((c) => ({
    id: c.id,
    trackingNumber: c.request_number,
    type: "custom" as const,
    customerName: c.customer_name,
    customerEmail: c.customer_email,
    customerPhone: c.customer_phone,
    shippingAddress: c.shipping_address || "",
    shippingMethod: c.shipping_method || "Delivery",
    shippingFee: c.shipping_fee || 0,
    total: (c.final_price || c.quote_amount || 0) + (c.shipping_fee || 0),
    deliveryStatus: c.delivery_status || "Preparing",
    scheduledDate: c.scheduled_date,
    deliveryNotes: c.driver_notes || c.delivery_notes,
    proofOfDeliveryUrl: c.proof_of_delivery_url,
    proofOfDeliveryUrl2: c.proof_of_delivery_url_2,
    deliveredAt: c.delivered_at,
    recipientName: c.recipient_name,
    notes: null,
    createdAt: c.created_at,
    items: [
      {
        name: c.item || c.furniture_type || "Custom Furniture",
        quantity: c.quantity || 1,
        price: c.final_price || c.quote_amount || 0,
        material: c.wood_type || null,
        imageUrl: c.reference_images?.[0] || null,
      },
    ],
  }));

  const allDeliveries = [...formattedOrders, ...formattedCustom].sort((a, b) => {
    return new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();
  });

  return NextResponse.json({
    deliveries: allDeliveries,
    driver: auth.profile,
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { notifyDeliveryUpdate } from "@/lib/supabase/notifications";
import {
  sendCustomizeOutForDelivery,
  sendCustomizeDelivered,
} from "@/lib/email";

async function requireDriver() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { ok: false as const };

  const serviceSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data: profile } = await serviceSupabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("id, full_name, email, phone, role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  const isDriverOrAdmin = profile?.role === "driver" || profile?.role === "admin";
  return { ok: isDriverOrAdmin, user, profile };
}

export async function PATCH(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const auth = await requireDriver();
  if (!auth.ok || !auth.user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const body = await request.json();
  const {
    type = "standard",
    deliveryStatus,
    proofOfDeliveryUrl,
    proofOfDeliveryUrl2,
    recipientName,
    driverNotes,
  } = body;

  if (!deliveryStatus) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Delivery status is required." },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
    delivery_status: deliveryStatus,
    updated_at: now,
  };

  if (proofOfDeliveryUrl) updateData.proof_of_delivery_url = proofOfDeliveryUrl;
  if (proofOfDeliveryUrl2) updateData.proof_of_delivery_url_2 = proofOfDeliveryUrl2;
  if (recipientName) updateData.recipient_name = recipientName;
  if (driverNotes !== undefined) updateData.driver_notes = driverNotes;

  if (deliveryStatus === "Delivered") {
    updateData.delivered_at = now;
    if (type === "standard") {
      updateData.order_status = "Delivered";
    }
  }

  const isAdmin = auth.profile?.role === "admin";
  const driverId = auth.user.id;

  if (type === "standard") {
    let orderQuery = supabase
      .from("orders")
      .update(updateData)
      .eq("id", id);

    if (!isAdmin) {
      orderQuery = orderQuery.eq("driver_id", driverId);
    }

    const { data: order, error } = await orderQuery
      .select("*, order_items:order_details(*)")
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }

    if (!order) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Order not found or not assigned to you." },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }

    if (order) {
      await notifyDeliveryUpdate(
        {
          id: order.id,
          order_number: order.order_number,
          customer_name: order.customer_name,
          customer_email: order.customer_email,
          customer_id: order.customer_id,
          shipping_address: order.shipping_address,
          driver_name: order.driver_name,
          driver_phone: order.driver_phone,
          scheduled_date: order.scheduled_date,
          delivery_notes: order.delivery_notes,
          order_items: order.order_items || [],
          subtotal: order.subtotal,
          shipping_fee: order.shipping_fee,
          total: order.total,
        },
        deliveryStatus,
        {
          driver_name: order.driver_name,
          driver_phone: order.driver_phone,
          scheduled_date: order.scheduled_date,
          delivery_notes: order.delivery_notes,
        },
      ).catch(console.error);
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, data: order });
  } else {

    let customQuery = supabase
      .from("customize_requests")
      .update(updateData)
      .eq("id", id);

    if (!isAdmin) {
      customQuery = customQuery.eq("driver_id", driverId);
    }

    const { data: customReq, error } = await customQuery
      .select("*")
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }

    if (!customReq) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Custom request not found or not assigned to you." },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }

    if (customReq && customReq.customer_email) {
      if (deliveryStatus === "Out for Delivery") {
        sendCustomizeOutForDelivery({
          customerName: customReq.customer_name,
          customerEmail: customReq.customer_email,
          requestNumber: customReq.request_number,
          furnitureDescription: customReq.item || customReq.furniture_type || "Custom Furniture",
          shippingAddress: customReq.shipping_address || "",
          driverName: customReq.driver_name,
          driverPhone: customReq.driver_phone,
          scheduledDate: customReq.scheduled_date,
          deliveryNotes: customReq.delivery_notes,
          finalPrice: customReq.final_price || customReq.quote_amount || 0,
          shippingFee: customReq.shipping_fee || 0,
        }).catch(console.error);
      } else if (deliveryStatus === "Delivered") {
        sendCustomizeDelivered({
          customerName: customReq.customer_name,
          customerEmail: customReq.customer_email,
          requestNumber: customReq.request_number,
          furnitureDescription: customReq.item || customReq.furniture_type || "Custom Furniture",
        }).catch(console.error);
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, data: customReq });
  }
}
```

```typescript
async function requireDriver() {

    .from("profiles")

  return { ok: isDriverOrAdmin, user, profile };
}

export async function GET() {
  const auth = await requireDriver();
  if (!auth.ok || !auth.user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const driverId = auth.user.id;

  const { data: orders } = await supabase
    .from("orders")
    .select(`
      id,
      order_number,
      customer_id,
      customer_name,
      customer_email,
      customer_phone,
      shipping_address,
      shipping_method,
      shipping_fee,
      total,
      delivery_status,
      driver_id,
      driver_name,
      driver_phone,
      scheduled_date,
      delivery_notes,
      proof_of_delivery_url,
      proof_of_delivery_url_2,
      delivered_at,
      recipient_name,
      notes,
      created_at,
      order_items:order_details (
        id,
        product_name,
        quantity,
        total_price,
        material,
        product:products (
          id,
          name,
          primary_image_url
        )
      )
    `)
    .eq("driver_id", driverId)
    .eq("delivery_status", "Delivered")
    .order("delivered_at", { ascending: false });

  const { data: customRequests } = await supabase
    .from("customize_requests")
    .select(`
      id,
      request_number,
      customer_id,
      customer_name,
      customer_email,
      customer_phone,
      shipping_address,
      shipping_method,
      shipping_fee,
      final_price,
      quote_amount,
      delivery_status,
      driver_id,
      driver_name,
      driver_phone,
      scheduled_date,
      delivery_notes,
      proof_of_delivery_url,
      proof_of_delivery_url_2,
      delivered_at,
      recipient_name,
      item,
      furniture_type,
      furniture_description,
      wood_type,
      quantity,
      reference_images,
      created_at
    `)
    .eq("driver_id", driverId)
    .eq("delivery_status", "Delivered")
    .order("delivered_at", { ascending: false });

  const formattedOrders = (orders || []).map((o) => ({
    id: o.id,
    trackingNumber: o.order_number,
    type: "standard" as const,
    customerName: o.customer_name,
    customerEmail: o.customer_email,
    customerPhone: o.customer_phone,
    shippingAddress: o.shipping_address,
    shippingMethod: o.shipping_method,
    shippingFee: o.shipping_fee,
    total: o.total,
    deliveryStatus: "Delivered" as const,
    scheduledDate: o.scheduled_date,
    deliveryNotes: o.delivery_notes,
    proofOfDeliveryUrl: o.proof_of_delivery_url,
    proofOfDeliveryUrl2: o.proof_of_delivery_url_2,
    deliveredAt: o.delivered_at,
    recipientName: o.recipient_name,
    notes: o.notes,
    createdAt: o.created_at,
    items: (o.order_items || []).map((item) => ({
      name: item.product_name,
      quantity: item.quantity,
      price: item.total_price,
      material: item.material,
      imageUrl: (item.product as { primary_image_url?: string } | null)?.primary_image_url || null,
    })),
  }));

  const formattedCustom = (customRequests || []).map((c) => ({
    id: c.id,
    trackingNumber: c.request_number,
    type: "custom" as const,
    customerName: c.customer_name,
    customerEmail: c.customer_email,
    customerPhone: c.customer_phone,
    shippingAddress: c.shipping_address || "",
    shippingMethod: c.shipping_method || "Delivery",
    shippingFee: c.shipping_fee || 0,
    total: (c.final_price || c.quote_amount || 0) + (c.shipping_fee || 0),
    deliveryStatus: "Delivered" as const,
    scheduledDate: c.scheduled_date,
    deliveryNotes: c.delivery_notes,
    proofOfDeliveryUrl: c.proof_of_delivery_url,
    proofOfDeliveryUrl2: c.proof_of_delivery_url_2,
    deliveredAt: c.delivered_at,
    recipientName: c.recipient_name,
    notes: null,
    createdAt: c.created_at,
    items: [
      {
        name: c.item || c.furniture_type || "Custom Furniture",
        quantity: c.quantity || 1,
        price: c.final_price || c.quote_amount || 0,
        material: c.wood_type || null,
        imageUrl: c.reference_images?.[0] || null,
      },
    ],
  }));

  const allCompleted = [...formattedOrders, ...formattedCustom].sort((a, b) => {
    const timeA = a.deliveredAt ? new Date(a.deliveredAt).getTime() : new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();
    const timeB = b.deliveredAt ? new Date(b.deliveredAt).getTime() : new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();
    return timeB - timeA;
  });

  return NextResponse.json({
    deliveries: allCompleted,
  });
}
```

```typescript
  return { ok: isDriverOrAdmin, user, profile };
}

export async function GET() {
  const auth = await requireDriver();
  if (!auth.ok || !auth.user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const driverId = auth.user.id;

  const [
    { count: activeOrdersCount },
    { count: completedOrdersCount },
    { count: activeCustomCount },
    { count: completedCustomCount },
  ] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from("orders")
      .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
      .eq("driver_id", driverId)
      .neq("delivery_status", "Delivered"),
    supabase
      .from("orders")
      .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
      .eq("driver_id", driverId)
      .eq("delivery_status", "Delivered"),
    supabase
      .from("customize_requests")
      .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
      .eq("driver_id", driverId)
      .neq("delivery_status", "Delivered"),
    supabase
      .from("customize_requests")
      .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
      .eq("driver_id", driverId)
      .eq("delivery_status", "Delivered"),
  ]);

  const activeCount = (activeOrdersCount || 0) + (activeCustomCount || 0);
  const completedCount = (completedOrdersCount || 0) + (completedCustomCount || 0);

  return NextResponse.json({
    driver: auth.profile,
    activeCount,
    completedCount,
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

async function requireDriver() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { ok: false as const };

  const serviceSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data: profile } = await serviceSupabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("id, full_name, email, phone, role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  const isDriverOrAdmin = profile?.role === "driver" || profile?.role === "admin";
  return { ok: isDriverOrAdmin, user, profile };
}

export async function GET() {
  const auth = await requireDriver();
  if (!auth.ok || !auth.user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
  const { data: notifications, error } = await supabase
    .from("notifications")
    .select("*")
    .eq("user_id", auth.user.id)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(30);

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ notifications: notifications || [] });
}

export async function PATCH(req: Request) {
  const auth = await requireDriver();
  if (!auth.ok || !auth.user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const { notificationId } = body;
    const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();

    if (notificationId) {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("notifications")
        .update({ is_read: true })
        .eq("id", notificationId)
        .eq("user_id", auth.user.id);

      if (error) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
      }
    } else {

      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("notifications")
        .update({ is_read: true })
        .eq("user_id", auth.user.id)
        .eq("is_read", false);

      if (error) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Internal Server Error" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

## File: `app/api/driver/upload-proof/route.ts`

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const formData = await request.formData();
    const file = formData.get("file") as File | null;
    const deliveryId = (formData.get("deliveryId") as string) || "proof";

    if (!file) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "No file provided" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient();
    const fileExt = file.name.split(".").pop() || "jpg";
    const fileName = `${deliveryId}_${Date.now()}.${fileExt}`;
    const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const buffer = Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);

    const { error: uploadError } = await serviceRole.storage
      .from("delivery-proofs")
      .upload(fileName, buffer, {
        contentType: file.type || "image/jpeg",
        upsert: true,
      });

    if (uploadError) {
      console.error("Storage upload error:", uploadError);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: uploadError.message },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    const { data: publicUrlData } = serviceRole.storage
      .from("delivery-proofs")
      .getPublicUrl(fileName);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      proofUrl: publicUrlData.publicUrl,
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Proof upload error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to upload proof of delivery photo" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  if (!profile || profile.role !== "driver") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Forbidden: Drivers only" },
      { status: 403 },
    );
  }

  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { deliveryId, type, reason, proofUrl1, proofUrl2 } = body;

    if (!deliveryId || !type || !reason || !proofUrl1 || !proofUrl2) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Missing required fields" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient();

    const { error: insertError } = await serviceRole
      .from("damage_reports")
      .insert({
        delivery_id: deliveryId,
        delivery_type: type,
        reason,
        proof_url_1: proofUrl1,
        proof_url_2: proofUrl2,
        status: "pending",
        reported_by: user.id,
      });

    if (insertError) {
      console.error("Damage report insert error:", insertError);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: insertError.message },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "Damage report submitted successfully",
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Damage report error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to submit damage report" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

export async function GET(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ deliveryId: string }> }
) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  if (!profile || profile.role !== "driver") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Forbidden: Drivers only" },
      { status: 403 },
    );
  }

  try {
    const { deliveryId } = await params;

    const { data: damageReport, error } = await supabase
      .from("damage_reports")
      .select("id, status, created_at")
      .eq("delivery_id", deliveryId)
      .single();

    if (error && error.code !== "PGRST116") {

      console.error("Error checking damage report:", error);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: error.message },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      hasReport: !!damageReport,
      report: damageReport || null,
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Check damage report error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to check damage report" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```
