```typescript
"use client";

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { buildDeliveryTimeline } from "@/lib/utils/delivery-timeline";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { ScrollArea, ScrollBar } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area";

const customSteps7030 = [
  "Pending Review",
  "Approved",
  "In Production",
  "Production Done",
  "Fully Paid",
  "Preparing",
  "Out for Delivery",
  "Delivered",
] as const;

const customStepsFullPayment = [
  "Pending Review",
  "Approved",
  "In Production",
  "Production Done",
  "Preparing",
  "Out for Delivery",
  "Delivered",
] as const;

const customPickupSteps7030 = [
  "Pending Review",
  "Approved",
  "In Production",
  "Production Done",
  "Fully Paid",
  "Preparing",
  "Ready for Pickup",
  "Picked Up",
] as const;

const customPickupStepsFullPayment = [
  "Pending Review",
  "Approved",
  "In Production",
  "Production Done",
  "Preparing",
  "Ready for Pickup",
  "Picked Up",
] as const;

const standardSteps = ["Preparing", "Out for Delivery", "Delivered"] as const;

const standardPickupSteps = ["Preparing", "Ready for Pickup", "Picked Up"] as const;

interface DeliveryTimelineViewProps {
  orderNumber: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt?: string | null;
  type?: "standard" | "custom";
  customStatus?: string | null;
  deliveryStatus?: string | null;
  paymentStatus?: string | null;
  paymentOption?: string | null;
  driverName?: string | null;
  driverNotes?: string | null;
  scheduledDate?: string | null;
  deliveredAt?: string | null;
  proofUrl?: string | null;
  proofUrl2?: string | null;
  productionProofUrl?: string | null;
  productionProofUrl2?: string | null;
  productionCompletedAt?: string | null;
  quoteReviewedAt?: string | null;
  inProductionAt?: string | null;
  driverAssignedAt?: string | null;
  outForDeliveryAt?: string | null;
  shippingMethod?: string | null;
  defaultExpanded?: boolean;
}

export function DeliveryTimelineView({
  createdAt,
  updatedAt,
  type = "standard",
  customStatus,
  deliveryStatus = null,
  paymentStatus = null,
  paymentOption = null,
  driverName,
  driverNotes,
  scheduledDate,
  deliveredAt,
  proofUrl,
  proofUrl2,
  productionProofUrl,
  productionProofUrl2,
  productionCompletedAt,
  quoteReviewedAt,
  inProductionAt,
  driverAssignedAt,
  outForDeliveryAt,
  shippingMethod,
  defaultExpanded = true,
}: DeliveryTimelineViewProps) {
  const isPickup = shippingMethod === "pickup";
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(defaultExpanded);
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const [modalTitle, setModalTitle] = useState(
    isPickup ? "Proof of Pickup" : "Proof of Delivery",
  );
  const [modalPhotos, setModalPhotos] = useState<{
    photo1: string | null;
    photo2: string | null;
  }>({
    photo1: null,
    photo2: null,
  });
  const [selectedPhoto, setSelectedPhoto] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const activeStepRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  const effectiveDeliveryStatus =
    deliveryStatus ?? (type === "standard" ? "Preparing" : null);
  const effectivePaymentStatus =
    paymentStatus ?? (type === "standard" ? "Paid" : null);

  const timelineEvents = useMemo(() => {
    return buildDeliveryTimeline({
      createdAt,
      updatedAt,
      type,
      customStatus,
      deliveryStatus: effectiveDeliveryStatus,
      paymentStatus: effectivePaymentStatus,
      paymentOption,
      driverName,
      driverNotes,
      scheduledDate,
      deliveredAt,
      proofUrl,
      proofUrl2,
      productionProofUrl,
      productionProofUrl2,
      productionCompletedAt,
      quoteReviewedAt,
      inProductionAt,
      driverAssignedAt,
      outForDeliveryAt,
      shippingMethod,
    });
  }, [
    createdAt,
    updatedAt,
    type,
    customStatus,
    effectiveDeliveryStatus,
    effectivePaymentStatus,
    paymentOption,
    driverName,
    driverNotes,
    scheduledDate,
    deliveredAt,
    proofUrl,
    proofUrl2,
    productionProofUrl,
    productionProofUrl2,
    productionCompletedAt,
    quoteReviewedAt,
    inProductionAt,
    driverAssignedAt,
    outForDeliveryAt,
    shippingMethod,
  ]);

  const isDelivered = effectiveDeliveryStatus === "Delivered";
  const isReady = effectiveDeliveryStatus === "Ready for Pickup";
  const isOut = effectiveDeliveryStatus === "Out for Delivery";

  const is7030 = paymentOption === "70-30";
  const isCustomPickup = isPickup && type === "custom";
  const steps =
    isCustomPickup
      ? is7030
        ? customPickupSteps7030
        : customPickupStepsFullPayment
      : isPickup
        ? standardPickupSteps
        : type === "custom"
          ? is7030
            ? customSteps7030
            : customStepsFullPayment
          : standardSteps;

  const currentStep = useMemo(() => {
    if (isCustomPickup) {

      if (effectiveDeliveryStatus === "Delivered") return is7030 ? 7 : 6;
      if (effectiveDeliveryStatus === "Ready for Pickup") return is7030 ? 6 : 5;
      if (customStatus === "Completed") return is7030 ? 5 : 4;
      if (customStatus === "Fully Paid") return is7030 ? 4 : 3;
      if (customStatus === "Production Done") return 3;
      if (customStatus === "In Production") return 2;
      if (customStatus === "Approved") return 1;
      return 0;
    }
    if (isPickup) {
      if (effectiveDeliveryStatus === "Delivered") return 2;
      if (effectiveDeliveryStatus === "Ready for Pickup") return 1;
      return 0;
    }
    if (type === "custom") {
      if (effectiveDeliveryStatus === "Delivered") return is7030 ? 7 : 6;
      if (effectiveDeliveryStatus === "Out for Delivery") return is7030 ? 6 : 5;
      if (customStatus === "Completed") return is7030 ? 5 : 4;

  }, [isCustomPickup, isPickup, type, effectiveDeliveryStatus, customStatus, is7030]);

  useEffect(() => {

  }, [type, currentStep]);

  const latestHeadline = useMemo(() => {
    if (isCustomPickup) {

          return `Picked up on ${dayStr}`;

      if (customStatus === "Completed") return "Preparing for Pickup";
      if (customStatus === "Fully Paid") return is7030 ? "Fully Paid" : "Production Complete";
      if (customStatus === "Production Done") return is7030 ? "Production Done" : "Production Complete";
      if (customStatus === "In Production") return "In Production";
      if (customStatus === "Approved") return "Project Approved";
      return "Pending Review";

      if (customStatus === "Production Done") return is7030 ? "Production Done" : "Production Complete";
      if (customStatus === "In Production") return "In Production";
```

```typescript
          onOpenChange={setShowResolveModal}
          damageReport={selectedReport}
          onSuccess={() => {
            mutate();
            onRefresh?.();
          }}
        />
      )}

      {}
      <Dialog open={showImageModal} onOpenChange={setShowImageModal}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-2xl max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] w-full p-0 rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-background">
          <DialogTitle className="sr-only">Damage Proof</DialogTitle>
          <div className="relative aspect-[4/3] w-full bg-black/5 flex items-center justify-center">
            {selectedImage && (
              <Image
                src={selectedImage}
                alt="Damage proof"
                fill
                className="object-contain"
                unoptimized
              />
            )}
          </div>

          {}
          {modalImages.photo1 && modalImages.photo2 && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 p-3 border-t bg-muted/20">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant={
                  selectedImage === modalImages.photo1 ? "default" : "outline"
                }
                onClick={() => setSelectedImage(modalImages.photo1)}
                className="h-8 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
              >
                Photo 1
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant={
                  selectedImage === modalImages.photo2 ? "default" : "outline"
                }
                onClick={() => setSelectedImage(modalImages.photo2)}
                className="h-8 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
              >
                Photo 2
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}

function ResolveDamageModal({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  damageReport,
  onSuccess,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  damageReport: DamageReport;
  onSuccess: () => void;
}) {
  const [file1, setFile1] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [previewUrl1, setPreviewUrl1] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [file2, setFile2] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [previewUrl2, setPreviewUrl2] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resolveReason, setResolveReason] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const fileInputRef1 = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef2 = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  function handleFilesSelected(slot: 1 | 2, fileList: FileList) {
    const ALLOWED_TYPES = [
      "image/jpeg",
      "image/png",
      "image/webp",
      "image/gif",
      "image/heic",
      "image/heif",
    ];
    const ALLOWED_EXTS = ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "webp", "gif", "heic", "heif"];
    const MAX_SINGLE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024;

    const rawFiles = Array.from(fileList);
    const validFiles: File[] = [];

    for (const file of rawFiles) {
      const ext = file.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
      const mimeOk =
        file.type === ""
          ? ALLOWED_EXTS.includes(ext)
          : ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type);
      const extOk = ALLOWED_EXTS.includes(ext) || file.type === "";

      if (!mimeOk || (!extOk && file.type !== "")) {
        toast.error(
          `"${file.name}" is not allowed. Only JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF images are accepted.`,
        );
        continue;
      }

      if (file.size > MAX_SINGLE_SIZE) {
        toast.error(`"${file.name}" exceeds the 10MB size limit.`);
        continue;
      }

      validFiles.push(file);
    }

    if (validFiles.length === 0) return;

    if (validFiles.length >= 2) {
      if (previewUrl1) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl1);
      if (previewUrl2) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl2);

      setFile1(validFiles[0]);
      setPreviewUrl1(URL.createObjectURL(validFiles[0]));

      setFile2(validFiles[1]);
      setPreviewUrl2(URL.createObjectURL(validFiles[1]));

      toast.success("2 photos attached successfully.");
      return;
    }

    const singleFile = validFiles[0];
    if (slot === 1) {
      if (previewUrl1) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl1);
      setFile1(singleFile);
      setPreviewUrl1(URL.createObjectURL(singleFile));
    } else {
      if (previewUrl2) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl2);
      setFile2(singleFile);
      setPreviewUrl2(URL.createObjectURL(singleFile));
    }
  }

  function handleClearImage(slot: 1 | 2) {
    if (slot === 1) {
      if (previewUrl1) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl1);
      setFile1(null);
      setPreviewUrl1(null);
      if (fileInputRef1.current) fileInputRef1.current.value = "";
    } else {
      if (previewUrl2) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl2);
      setFile2(null);
      setPreviewUrl2(null);
      if (fileInputRef2.current) fileInputRef2.current.value = "";
    }
  }

  function resetAll() {
    handleClearImage(1);
    handleClearImage(2);
    setResolveReason("");
  }

  async function uploadImage(
    fileToUpload: File,
    suffix: string,
  ): Promise<string> {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", fileToUpload);
    formData.append("damageReportId", `${damageReport.id}_${suffix}`);

    const uploadRes = await fetch("/api/client/upload-resolve-proof", {
      method: "POST",
      body: formData,
    });

    const uploadData = await uploadRes.json();
    if (!uploadRes.ok || !uploadData.proofUrl) {
      throw new Error(uploadData.error || `Failed to upload photo ${suffix}.`);
    }

    return uploadData.proofUrl;
  }

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!file1 || !file2) {
      toast.error("Please upload both proof photos.");
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const [url1, url2] = await Promise.all([
        uploadImage(file1, "proof1"),
        uploadImage(file2, "proof2"),
      ]);

      const res = await fetch("/api/client/resolve-damage", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          damageReportId: damageReport.id,
          resolveProofUrl1: url1,
          resolveProofUrl2: url2,
          resolveReason: resolveReason || null,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.error || "Failed to resolve damage report.");
      }

      toast.success("Damage report resolved successfully!");
      resetAll();
      onOpenChange(false);
      onSuccess();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Error resolving damage report.",
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(val) => !isSubmitting && onOpenChange(val)}
    >
      <DialogContent
        showCloseButton={false}
        className="max-w-md p-0 gap-0 rounded-xl bg-card border-border overflow-hidden"
      >
        {isSubmitting && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] cursor-wait pointer-events-auto" />
        )}

        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-border space-y-0">
          <DialogTitle className="text-base font-semibold ">
            Resolve Damage Report
          </DialogTitle>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6 space-y-4 -mt-2">
          {}
          <div>
            <label className="text-base font-semibold mb-2 block text-foreground">
              Resolution Note (Optional)
            </label>
            <Textarea
              value={resolveReason}
              onChange={(e) => setResolveReason(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Describe how the issue was resolved"
              className="min-h-[80px] resize-none"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            />
          </div>

          {}
          <div>
            <label className="text-base font-semibold mb-2.5 block text-foreground">
              Resolution Proof Photos (2 Required){" "}
            </label>

            <input
              ref={fileInputRef1}
              type="file"
              accept="image/*,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp,.gif,.heic,.heif"
              multiple
              className="hidden"
              onChange={(e) => {
                if (e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) {
                  handleFilesSelected(1, e.target.files);
                }
                e.target.value = "";
              }}
            />
            <input
              ref={fileInputRef2}
              type="file"
              accept="image/*,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp,.gif,.heic,.heif"
              multiple
              className="hidden"
              onChange={(e) => {
                if (e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) {
                  handleFilesSelected(2, e.target.files);
                }
                e.target.value = "";
              }}
            />

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-1.5">
                  Photo 1
                </p>
                {!previewUrl1 ? (
                  <div
                    onClick={() => fileInputRef1.current?.click()}
                    className="border border-dashed border-border hover:border-primary/50 bg-muted/20 hover:bg-muted/40 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors text-center aspect-[4/3]"
                  >
                    <div className="size-9 rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center">
                      <Camera size={18} />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                      Take / Upload
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      Fixed item photo 1
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden border bg-muted aspect-[4/3] flex items-center justify-center">
                    <Image
                      src={previewUrl1}
                      alt="Resolve Photo 1"
                      fill
                      className="object-cover"
                    />
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      size="icon"
                      variant="destructive"
                      onClick={() => handleClearImage(1)}
                      className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 size-7 rounded-full shadow-md cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <X size={14} />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-1.5">
                  Photo 2
                </p>
                {!previewUrl2 ? (
                  <div
                    onClick={() => fileInputRef2.current?.click()}
                    className="border border-dashed border-border hover:border-primary/50 bg-muted/20 hover:bg-muted/40 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors text-center aspect-[4/3]"
                  >
                    <div className="size-9 rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center">
                      <Camera size={18} />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                      Take / Upload
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      Fixed item photo 2
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden border bg-muted aspect-[4/3] flex items-center justify-center">
                    <Image
                      src={previewUrl2}
                      alt="Resolve Photo 2"
                      fill
                      className="object-cover"
                    />
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      size="icon"
                      variant="destructive"
                      onClick={() => handleClearImage(2)}
                      className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 size-7 rounded-full shadow-md cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <X size={14} />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-5 -mb-0.5 border-t border-border">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="h-9 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting || !file1 || !file2}
              className="h-9 px-5 text-base font-semibold leading-none cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center"
            >
              {isSubmitting && (
                <div className="size-4 animate-spin mr-1 inline-block shrink-0 border-2 border-current border-t-transparent rounded-full" />
              )}
              Confirm Resolution
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

export async function GET(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ deliveryId: string }> }
) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const { deliveryId } = await params;
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const type = searchParams.get("type") || "standard";

    const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient();

    const { data: damageReports, error } = await serviceRole
      .from("damage_reports")
      .select("*")
      .eq("delivery_id", deliveryId)
      .eq("delivery_type", type)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

    if (error) {
      console.error("Damage reports fetch error:", error);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: error.message },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      damageReports: damageReports || [],
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Damage reports error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to fetch damage reports" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { damageReportId, resolveProofUrl1, resolveProofUrl2, resolveReason } = body;

    if (!damageReportId || !resolveProofUrl1 || !resolveProofUrl2) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Missing required fields" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient();

    const { error: updateError } = await serviceRole
      .from("damage_reports")
      .update({
        status: "resolved",
        resolved_by: user.id,
        resolve_proof_url_1: resolveProofUrl1,
        resolve_proof_url_2: resolveProofUrl2,
        resolve_reason: resolveReason || null,
        resolved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq("id", damageReportId);

    if (updateError) {
      console.error("Damage report resolve error:", updateError);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: updateError.message },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "Damage report resolved successfully",
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Damage resolve error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to resolve damage report" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const formData = await request.formData();
    const file = formData.get("file") as File | null;
    const damageReportId = (formData.get("damageReportId") as string) || "resolve";

    if (!file) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "No file provided" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient();
    const fileExt = file.name.split(".").pop() || "jpg";
    const fileName = `resolve_${damageReportId}_${Date.now()}.${fileExt}`;
    const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const buffer = Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);

    const { error: uploadError } = await serviceRole.storage
      .from("damage-proofs")
      .upload(fileName, buffer, {
        contentType: file.type || "image/jpeg",
        upsert: true,
      });

    if (uploadError) {
      console.error("Storage upload error:", uploadError);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: uploadError.message },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    const { data: publicUrlData } = serviceRole.storage
      .from("damage-proofs")
      .getPublicUrl(fileName);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      proofUrl: publicUrlData.publicUrl,
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Resolve proof upload error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to upload resolve proof photo" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import { notifyDeliveryUpdate } from "@/lib/supabase/notifications";
import {
  sendCustomizeOutForDelivery,
  sendCustomizeDelivered,
} from "@/lib/email";

export async function updateDriverDeliveryStatusAction(payload: {
  deliveryId: string;
  type: "standard" | "custom";
  deliveryStatus: string;
  proofOfDeliveryUrl?: string;
  proofOfDeliveryUrl2?: string;
  recipientName?: string;
  driverNotes?: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const supabase = await createClient();
    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      return { success: false, error: "Unauthorized. Please log in." };
    }

    const serviceSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
    const { data: profile } = await serviceSupabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("id, full_name, email, phone, role")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .single();

    const isDriverOrAdmin =
      profile?.role === "driver" || profile?.role === "admin";
    if (!isDriverOrAdmin) {
      return { success: false, error: "Forbidden: Driver access required." };
    }

    const {
      deliveryId,
      type = "standard",
      deliveryStatus,
      proofOfDeliveryUrl,
      proofOfDeliveryUrl2,
      recipientName,
      driverNotes,
    } = payload;

    if (!deliveryStatus) {
      return { success: false, error: "Delivery status is required." };
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
      delivery_status: deliveryStatus,
      updated_at: now,
    };

    if (proofOfDeliveryUrl) updateData.proof_of_delivery_url = proofOfDeliveryUrl;
    if (proofOfDeliveryUrl2) updateData.proof_of_delivery_url_2 = proofOfDeliveryUrl2;
    if (recipientName) updateData.recipient_name = recipientName;
    if (driverNotes !== undefined) updateData.driver_notes = driverNotes;

    if (deliveryStatus === "Out for Delivery") {
      updateData.out_for_delivery_at = now;
      if (type === "standard") {
        updateData.order_status = "Out for Delivery";
      }
    }

    if (deliveryStatus === "Delivered") {
      updateData.delivered_at = now;
      if (type === "standard") {
        updateData.order_status = "Delivered";
      }
    }

    if (type === "standard") {
      const { data: order, error } = await serviceSupabase
        .from("orders")
        .update(updateData)
        .eq("id", deliveryId)
        .select("*, order_items:order_details(*)")
        .single();

      if (error) {
        console.error("Error updating order delivery status:", error);
        return { success: false, error: error.message };
      }

      if (order) {

        notifyDeliveryUpdate(
          {
            id: order.id,
            order_number: order.order_number,
            customer_name: order.customer_name,
            customer_email: order.customer_email,
            customer_id: order.customer_id,
            shipping_address: order.shipping_address,
            driver_name: order.driver_name,
            driver_phone: order.driver_phone,
            scheduled_date: order.scheduled_date,
            delivery_notes: order.delivery_notes,
            order_items: order.order_items || [],
            subtotal: order.subtotal,
            shipping_fee: order.shipping_fee,
            total: order.total,
          },
          deliveryStatus,
          {
            driver_name: order.driver_name,
            driver_phone: order.driver_phone,
            scheduled_date: order.scheduled_date,
            delivery_notes: order.delivery_notes,
          },
        ).catch(console.error);
      }
    } else {
      const { data: customReq, error } = await serviceSupabase
        .from("customize_requests")
        .update(updateData)
        .eq("id", deliveryId)
        .select("*")
        .single();

      if (error) {
        console.error("Error updating custom delivery status:", error);
        return { success: false, error: error.message };
      }

      if (customReq && customReq.customer_email) {
        if (deliveryStatus === "Out for Delivery") {
          sendCustomizeOutForDelivery({
            customerName: customReq.customer_name,
            customerEmail: customReq.customer_email,
            requestNumber: customReq.request_number,
            furnitureDescription:
              customReq.item ||
              customReq.furniture_type ||
              "Custom Furniture",
            shippingAddress: customReq.shipping_address || "",
            driverName: customReq.driver_name,
            driverPhone: customReq.driver_phone,
            scheduledDate: customReq.scheduled_date,
            deliveryNotes: customReq.delivery_notes,
            finalPrice: customReq.final_price || customReq.quote_amount || 0,
            shippingFee: customReq.shipping_fee || 0,
          }).catch(console.error);
        } else if (deliveryStatus === "Delivered") {
          sendCustomizeDelivered({
            customerName: customReq.customer_name,
            customerEmail: customReq.customer_email,
            requestNumber: customReq.request_number,
            furnitureDescription:
              customReq.item ||
              customReq.furniture_type ||
              "Custom Furniture",
          }).catch(console.error);
        }
      }
    }

    revalidatePath("/driver/deliveries");
    revalidatePath("/driver/history");
    revalidatePath("/driver/profile");
    revalidatePath("/deliveries");
    revalidatePath("/history");
    revalidatePath("/profile");
    revalidatePath("/admin/delivery-status");

    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("updateDriverDeliveryStatusAction error:", err);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to update delivery status",
    };
  }
}

export async function addDriverCheckpointAction(payload: {
  deliveryId: string;
  type: "standard" | "custom";
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  location?: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const supabase = await createClient();
    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      return { success: false, error: "Unauthorized. Please log in." };
    }

    const serviceSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
    const { data: profile } = await serviceSupabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("id, full_name, role")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .single();

    const isDriverOrAdmin =
      profile?.role === "driver" || profile?.role === "admin";
    if (!isDriverOrAdmin) {
      return { success: false, error: "Forbidden: Driver access required." };
    }

    const { deliveryId, type = "standard", title, description, location } = payload;

    if (!title?.trim()) {
      return { success: false, error: "Update title is required." };
    }

    const table = type === "standard" ? "orders" : "customize_requests";
    const { data: record, error: fetchErr } = await (serviceSupabase
      .from(table) as any)
      .select("id, driver_notes, customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, " + (type === "standard" ? "order_number" : "request_number"))
      .eq("id", deliveryId)
      .single();

    if (fetchErr || !record) {
      return { success: false, error: "Delivery record not found." };
    }

    let checkpoints: Array<{
      id: string;
      title: string;
      description?: string;
      location?: string;
      status: string;
      timestamp: string;
    }> = [];

    const rawDriverNotes = (record as any)?.driver_notes;
    if (rawDriverNotes) {
      try {
        const trimmed = String(rawDriverNotes).trim();
        if (trimmed.startsWith("[") && trimmed.endsWith("]")) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
            checkpoints = parsed;
          }
        } else if (trimmed) {
          checkpoints.push({
            id: `legacy-${Date.now()}`,
            title: trimmed,
            status: "In Transit",
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          });
        }
      } catch {

      }
    }

    const newCheckpoint = {
      id: `cp-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
      title: title.trim(),
      description: description?.trim() || undefined,
      location: location?.trim() || undefined,
      status: "In Transit",
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    checkpoints.push(newCheckpoint);

    const { error: updateErr } = await serviceSupabase
      .from(table)
      .update({
        driver_notes: JSON.stringify(checkpoints),
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq("id", deliveryId);

    if (updateErr) {
      return { success: false, error: updateErr.message };
    }

    if (record.customer_id) {
      const trackingNo = (record as any).order_number || (record as any).request_number || "";
      await serviceSupabase.from("notifications").insert({
        user_id: record.customer_id,
        title: title.trim(),
        description: `Delivery update for #${trackingNo}: ${description?.trim() || title.trim()}`,
        type: "delivery",
        link: type === "standard" ? "/my-orders" : "/my-request",
        is_read: false,
      });
    }

    revalidatePath("/driver/deliveries");
    revalidatePath("/driver/history");
    revalidatePath("/my-orders");
    revalidatePath("/my-request");

    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("addDriverCheckpointAction error:", err);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to add checkpoint",
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceRoleClient } from "@/lib/supabase/service-role";
import type { DriverDeliveryData } from "@/components/driver-compo/delivery-card";

export interface DriverOption {
  id: string;
  full_name: string;
  phone: string;
  email: string;
  created_at?: string;
  initial_password?: string | null;
}

export async function getDriversForAdmin(): Promise<DriverOption[]> {
  try {
    const supabase = createServiceRoleClient();
    const { data: drivers, error } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("id, full_name, phone, email, created_at")
      .eq("role", "driver")
      .order("full_name", { ascending: true });

    if (error || !drivers || drivers.length === 0) {
      if (error) console.error("getDriversForAdmin error:", error);
      return [];
    }

    const authResults = await Promise.all(
      drivers.map(async (d) => {
        try {
          const { data } = await supabase.auth.admin.getUserById(d.id);
          return { id: d.id, user: data?.user || null };
        } catch {
          return { id: d.id, user: null };
        }
      }),
    );

    const userMap = new Map(authResults.map((r) => [r.id, r.user]));

    return drivers.map((d) => {
      const authUser = userMap.get(d.id);
      return {
        id: d.id,
        full_name: d.full_name || "Unnamed Driver",
        phone: d.phone || "",
        email: d.email || "",
        created_at: d.created_at,
        initial_password:
          (authUser?.user_metadata?.initial_password as string) || null,
      };
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("getDriversForAdmin exception:", err);
    return [];
  }
}

      shippingAddress: o.shipping_address,

      shippingFee: o.shipping_fee,
      total: o.total,
      deliveryStatus: (o.delivery_status as "Preparing" | "Out for Delivery" | "Delivered" | "Failed Delivery") || "Preparing",
      scheduledDate: o.scheduled_date,
      deliveryNotes: o.driver_notes || o.delivery_notes,

      })),
    }));

    const formattedCustom: DriverDeliveryData[] = (customRequests || []).map((c) => ({
      id: c.id,
      trackingNumber: c.request_number,
      type: "custom" as const,
      customerName: c.customer_name,
      customerEmail: c.customer_email,
      customerPhone: c.customer_phone,
      shippingAddress: c.shipping_address || "",
      shippingMethod: c.shipping_method || "Delivery",
      shippingFee: c.shipping_fee || 0,
      total: (c.final_price || c.quote_amount || 0) + (c.shipping_fee || 0),
      deliveryStatus: (c.delivery_status as "Preparing" | "Out for Delivery" | "Delivered" | "Failed Delivery") || "Preparing",
      scheduledDate: c.scheduled_date,
      deliveryNotes: c.driver_notes || c.delivery_notes,
      proofOfDeliveryUrl: c.proof_of_delivery_url,
      proofOfDeliveryUrl2: c.proof_of_delivery_url_2,
      deliveredAt: c.delivered_at,
      recipientName: c.recipient_name,
      notes: null,
      createdAt: c.created_at,
      items: [
        {
          name: c.item || c.furniture_type || "Custom Furniture",
          quantity: c.quantity || 1,
          price: c.final_price || c.quote_amount || 0,
          material: c.wood_type || null,
          imageUrl: c.reference_images?.[0] || null,
        },
      ],
    }));

    const allDeliveries = [...formattedOrders, ...formattedCustom].sort((a, b) => {
      return new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();
    });

    return {
      deliveries: allDeliveries,
      driver: profile || null,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Error in getDriverDeliveriesServer:", err);
    return { deliveries: [], driver: null };
  }
}

export async function getDriverProfileServer(): Promise<DriverProfileServerData> {
  try {
    const supabase = await createClient();
    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      return { driver: null, activeCount: 0, completedCount: 0 };
    }

    const serviceSupabase = createServiceRoleClient();
    const { data: profile } = await serviceSupabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("id, full_name, email, phone, role")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .single();

    const isDriverOrAdmin = profile?.role === "driver" || profile?.role === "admin";
    if (!isDriverOrAdmin) {
      return { driver: null, activeCount: 0, completedCount: 0 };
    }

    const driverId = user.id;

    const [
      { count: activeOrdersCount },
      { count: completedOrdersCount },
      { count: activeCustomCount },
      { count: completedCustomCount },
    ] = await Promise.all([
      serviceSupabase
        .from("orders")
        .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
        .eq("driver_id", driverId)
        .neq("delivery_status", "Delivered"),
      serviceSupabase
        .from("orders")
        .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
        .eq("driver_id", driverId)
        .eq("delivery_status", "Delivered"),
      serviceSupabase
        .from("customize_requests")
        .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
        .eq("driver_id", driverId)
        .neq("delivery_status", "Delivered"),
      serviceSupabase
        .from("customize_requests")
        .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
        .eq("driver_id", driverId)
        .eq("delivery_status", "Delivered"),
    ]);

    const activeCount = (activeOrdersCount || 0) + (activeCustomCount || 0);
    const completedCount = (completedOrdersCount || 0) + (completedCustomCount || 0);

    return {
      driver: profile || null,
      activeCount,
      completedCount,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Error in getDriverProfileServer:", err);
    return { driver: null, activeCount: 0, completedCount: 0 };
  }
}
```

## File: `lib/utils/delivery-timeline.ts`

```typescript
export interface DeliveryTimelineEvent {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  status?:
    | "Preparing"
    | "Driver Assigned"
    | "In Transit"
    | "Out for Delivery"
    | "Delivered"
    | string;
  timestamp: string;
  location?: string;
  actor?: "system" | "driver" | "admin";
  isLatest?: boolean;
  actionType?: "view_proof" | "view_production_proof";
  proofUrl?: string | null;
  proofUrl2?: string | null;
}

export function extractMunicipality(address?: string | null): string {
  if (!address) return "local";
  const parts = address.split(",").map((p) => p.trim());
  if (parts.length >= 2) {
    const candidate = parts[parts.length - 2] || parts[1];
    return (
      candidate
        .replace(/\b(City|Municipality|Bulacan|Pampanga|Metro Manila)\b/gi, "")
        .trim() || parts[0]
    );
  }
  return parts[0] || "local";
}

export function parseDriverCheckpoints(
  rawNotes?: string | null,
): DeliveryTimelineEvent[] {
  if (!rawNotes) return [];
  try {
    const trimmed = rawNotes.trim();
    if (trimmed.startsWith("[") && trimmed.endsWith("]")) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        return parsed.map((item, idx) => ({
          id: item.id || `cp-${idx}`,
          title: item.title || item.text || "Tracking Update",
          status: item.status || "In Transit",
          timestamp: item.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
          location: item.location,
          actor: "driver",
        }));
      }
    }
  } catch {
    if (rawNotes.trim()) {
      return [
        {
          id: "legacy-note",
          title: rawNotes.trim(),
          status: "In Transit",
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          actor: "driver",
        },
      ];
    }
  }
  return [];
}

interface BuildTimelineParams {
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt?: string | null;
  type?: "standard" | "custom";
  customStatus?: string | null;
  deliveryStatus?: string | null;
  paymentStatus?: string | null;
  paymentOption?: string | null;
  driverName?: string | null;
  driverNotes?: string | null;
  scheduledDate?: string | null;
  deliveredAt?: string | null;
  proofUrl?: string | null;
  proofUrl2?: string | null;
  productionProofUrl?: string | null;
  productionProofUrl2?: string | null;
  productionCompletedAt?: string | null;
  quoteReviewedAt?: string | null;
  inProductionAt?: string | null;
  driverAssignedAt?: string | null;
  outForDeliveryAt?: string | null;
  shippingMethod?: string | null;
}

export function buildDeliveryTimeline(
  params: BuildTimelineParams,
): DeliveryTimelineEvent[] {
  const events: DeliveryTimelineEvent[] = [];
  const createdTime = new Date(params.createdAt);
  const updatedTime = params.updatedAt
    ? new Date(params.updatedAt)
    : createdTime;

  const isPickup = params.shippingMethod === "pickup";
  const isCustomPickup = isPickup && params.type === "custom";

  if (isCustomPickup) {
    events.push({
      id: "req-placed",
      title: "Customize request is submitted for Store Pickup",
      status: "Submitted",
      timestamp: createdTime.toISOString(),
      actor: "system",
    });

    const isQuoteReviewed =
      params.customStatus && params.customStatus !== "Pending Review";

    if (isQuoteReviewed) {
      const quoteTime = params.quoteReviewedAt
        ? new Date(params.quoteReviewedAt).toISOString()
        : new Date(createdTime.getTime() + 1000).toISOString();
      events.push({
        id: "req-quote",
        title: "Received project cost breakdown",
        status: "Approved",
        timestamp: quoteTime,
        actor: "system",
      });
    }

    const isDownpaymentPaid =
      params.customStatus === "In Production" ||
      params.customStatus === "Production Done" ||
      params.customStatus === "Fully Paid" ||
      params.customStatus === "Completed" ||
      params.paymentStatus === "Downpayment Paid" ||
      params.paymentStatus === "Paid";

    if (isDownpaymentPaid) {
      const prodStartTime = params.inProductionAt
        ? new Date(params.inProductionAt).toISOString()
        : updatedTime.toISOString();
      const is7030 = params.paymentOption === "70-30";
      events.push({
        id: "req-downpayment",
        title: is7030
          ? "Downpayment (70%) confirmed, CraftIt workshop is crafting your customized furniture"
          : "Full payment (100%) confirmed, CraftIt workshop is crafting your customized furniture",
        status: "In Production",
        timestamp: prodStartTime,
        actor: "system",
      });
    }

    const isProductionDone =
      params.customStatus === "Production Done" ||
      params.customStatus === "Fully Paid" ||
      params.customStatus === "Completed" ||
      Boolean(params.productionProofUrl);

    if (isProductionDone) {
      const doneTime = params.productionCompletedAt
        ? new Date(params.productionCompletedAt).toISOString()
        : updatedTime.toISOString();
      events.push({
        id: "req-prod-done",
        title: "Production completed & passed quality inspection",
        status: "Production Done",
        timestamp: doneTime,
        actor: "system",
        actionType: params.productionProofUrl ? "view_production_proof" : undefined,
        proofUrl: params.productionProofUrl,
        proofUrl2: params.productionProofUrl2,
      });
    }

    const is7030 = params.paymentOption === "70-30";
    const is30PercentPaid =
      is7030 &&
      (params.customStatus === "Fully Paid" || params.customStatus === "Completed");

    if (is30PercentPaid) {
      const prepTime = params.productionCompletedAt
        ? new Date(new Date(params.productionCompletedAt).getTime() + 1000).toISOString()
        : updatedTime.toISOString();
      events.push({
        id: "req-completed-prep",
        title: "Remaining 30% balance confirmed, CraftIt is preparing your furniture for pickup",
        status: "Preparing",
        timestamp: prepTime,
        actor: "system",
      });
    } else if (!is7030 && params.customStatus === "Completed") {
      events.push({
        id: "req-full-completed-prep",
        title: "CraftIt is preparing your furniture for pickup",
        status: "Preparing",
        timestamp: updatedTime.toISOString(),
        actor: "system",
      });
    }

    const isPickupPhase =
      params.customStatus === "Completed" ||
      params.deliveryStatus === "Ready for Pickup" ||
      params.deliveryStatus === "Delivered" ||
      (is7030 && params.customStatus === "Fully Paid" && params.deliveryStatus === "Ready for Pickup");

    if (isPickupPhase) {
      const isReadyForPickup =
        params.deliveryStatus === "Ready for Pickup" || params.deliveryStatus === "Delivered";
      const isDelivered = params.deliveryStatus === "Delivered";

      if (isReadyForPickup) {
        events.push({
          id: "pickup-ready",
          title: "Your custom furniture is ready for pickup at CraftIt Workshop",
          status: "Ready for Pickup",
          timestamp: updatedTime.toISOString(),
          actor: "admin",
        });
      }

      if (isDelivered) {
        const claimedRaw = params.deliveredAt
          ? new Date(params.deliveredAt).getTime()
          : updatedTime.getTime() + 2000;
        const readyRaw = updatedTime.getTime();
        const finalClaimedTime =
          claimedRaw <= readyRaw
            ? new Date(readyRaw + 2000).toISOString()
            : new Date(claimedRaw).toISOString();

        events.push({
          id: "pickup-claimed",
          title: "Custom furniture has been picked up & claimed",
          status: "Delivered",
          timestamp: finalClaimedTime,
          actor: "admin",
          actionType: params.proofUrl || params.proofUrl2 ? "view_proof" : undefined,
          proofUrl: params.proofUrl,
          proofUrl2: params.proofUrl2,
        });
      }
    }

    const customPickupStageOrder: Record<string, number> = {
      "req-placed": 1,
      "req-quote": 2,
      "req-downpayment": 3,
      "req-prod-done": 4,
      "req-completed-prep": 5,
      "req-full-completed-prep": 5,
      "pickup-ready": 6,
      "pickup-claimed": 7,
    };

    events.sort((a, b) => {
      const orderA = customPickupStageOrder[a.id] ?? 0;
      const orderB = customPickupStageOrder[b.id] ?? 0;
      if (orderA !== orderB) return orderB - orderA;
      return new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime();
    });

    for (let i = events.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
      const prevTime = new Date(events[i + 1].timestamp).getTime();
      const currTime = new Date(events[i].timestamp).getTime();
      if (currTime < prevTime) {
        events[i].timestamp = new Date(prevTime + 1000).toISOString();
      }
    }

    if (events.length > 0) events[0].isLatest = true;
    return events;
  }

  if (isPickup) {
    const isDelivered = params.deliveryStatus === "Delivered";
    const isReadyForPickup =
      params.deliveryStatus === "Ready for Pickup" || isDelivered;

    events.push({
      id: "pickup-order-placed",
      title: "Order placed for Store Pickup",
      status: "Preparing",
      timestamp: createdTime.toISOString(),
      actor: "system",
    });

    events.push({
      id: "pickup-order-prep",
      title: "CraftIt workshop is preparing your order",
      status: "Preparing",
      timestamp: new Date(createdTime.getTime() + 1000).toISOString(),
      actor: "system",
    });

    if (isReadyForPickup) {
      events.push({
        id: "pickup-ready",
        title: "Ready for Pickup at CraftIt Workshop",
        status: "Ready for Pickup",
        timestamp: updatedTime.toISOString(),
        actor: "admin",
      });
    }

    if (isDelivered) {
      const claimedRaw = params.deliveredAt
        ? new Date(params.deliveredAt).getTime()
        : updatedTime.getTime() + 2000;
      const readyRaw = updatedTime.getTime();
      const finalClaimedTime =
        claimedRaw <= readyRaw ? new Date(readyRaw + 2000).toISOString() : new Date(claimedRaw).toISOString();

      events.push({
        id: "pickup-claimed",
        title: "Order has been picked up & claimed",
        status: "Delivered",
        timestamp: finalClaimedTime,
        actor: "admin",
        actionType:
          params.proofUrl || params.proofUrl2 ? "view_proof" : undefined,
        proofUrl: params.proofUrl,
        proofUrl2: params.proofUrl2,
      });
    }

    const pickupStageOrder: Record<string, number> = {
      "pickup-order-placed": 1,
      "pickup-order-prep": 2,
      "pickup-ready": 3,
      "pickup-claimed": 4,
    };

    events.sort((a, b) => {
      const orderA = pickupStageOrder[a.id] ?? 0;
      const orderB = pickupStageOrder[b.id] ?? 0;
      if (orderA !== orderB) return orderB - orderA;
      return new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime();
    });

    for (let i = events.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
      const prevTime = new Date(events[i + 1].timestamp).getTime();
      const currTime = new Date(events[i].timestamp).getTime();
      if (currTime < prevTime) {
        events[i].timestamp = new Date(prevTime + 1000).toISOString();
      }
    }

    if (events.length > 0) events[0].isLatest = true;
    return events;
  }

  if (params.type === "custom") {

    events.push({
      id: "req-placed",
      title: "Customize request is submitted",
      status: "Submitted",
      timestamp: createdTime.toISOString(),
      actor: "system",
    });

    const isQuoteReviewed =
      params.customStatus && params.customStatus !== "Pending Review";

    if (isQuoteReviewed) {
      const quoteTime = params.quoteReviewedAt
        ? new Date(params.quoteReviewedAt).toISOString()
        : new Date(createdTime.getTime() + 1000).toISOString();
      events.push({
        id: "req-quote",
        title: "Received project cost breakdown",
        status: "Approved",
        timestamp: quoteTime,
        actor: "system",
      });
    }

    const isDownpaymentPaid =
      params.customStatus === "In Production" ||
      params.customStatus === "Production Done" ||
      params.customStatus === "Fully Paid" ||
      params.customStatus === "Completed" ||
      params.paymentStatus === "Downpayment Paid" ||
      params.paymentStatus === "Paid";

    if (isDownpaymentPaid) {
      const prodStartTime = params.inProductionAt
        ? new Date(params.inProductionAt).toISOString()
        : updatedTime.toISOString();
      const is7030 = params.paymentOption === "70-30";
      events.push({
        id: "req-downpayment",
        title: is7030
          ? "Downpayment (70%) confirmed, CraftIt workshop is crafting your customized furniture"
          : "Full payment (100%) confirmed, CraftIt workshop is crafting your customized furniture",
        status: "In Production",
        timestamp: prodStartTime,
        actor: "system",
      });
    }

    const isProductionDone =
      params.customStatus === "Production Done" ||
      params.customStatus === "Fully Paid" ||
      params.customStatus === "Completed" ||
      Boolean(params.productionProofUrl);

    if (isProductionDone) {
      const doneTime = params.productionCompletedAt
        ? new Date(params.productionCompletedAt).toISOString()
        : updatedTime.toISOString();
      events.push({
        id: "req-prod-done",
        title: "Production completed & passed quality inspection",
        status: "Production Done",
        timestamp: doneTime,
        actor: "system",
        actionType: params.productionProofUrl
          ? "view_production_proof"
          : undefined,
        proofUrl: params.productionProofUrl,
        proofUrl2: params.productionProofUrl2,
      });
    }

    const is7030 = params.paymentOption === "70-30";
    const is30PercentPaid =
      is7030 &&
      (params.customStatus === "Fully Paid" || params.customStatus === "Completed");

    if (is30PercentPaid) {
      const prepTime = params.productionCompletedAt
        ? new Date(new Date(params.productionCompletedAt).getTime() + 1000).toISOString()
        : updatedTime.toISOString();

      events.push({
        id: "req-completed-prep",
        title: "Remaining 30% balance confirmed, CraftIt is preparing your furniture",
        status: "Preparing",
        timestamp: prepTime,
        actor: "system",
      });
    } else if (
      !is7030 &&
      params.customStatus === "Completed"
    ) {
      events.push({
        id: "req-full-completed-prep",
        title: "CraftIt is preparing your furniture",
        status: "Preparing",
        timestamp: updatedTime.toISOString(),
        actor: "system",
      });
    }

    const isDeliveryPhase =
      params.customStatus === "Completed" ||
      Boolean(params.driverName) ||
      params.deliveryStatus === "Out for Delivery" ||
      params.deliveryStatus === "Delivered" ||
      (is7030 &&
        params.customStatus === "Fully Paid" &&
        (Boolean(params.driverName) || params.deliveryStatus === "Preparing"));

    if (isDeliveryPhase) {
      if (params.driverName) {
        const assignedTime = params.driverAssignedAt
          ? new Date(params.driverAssignedAt).toISOString()
          : updatedTime.toISOString();
        events.push({
          id: "driver-assigned",
          title: `CraftIt assigned the furniture to ${params.driverName}`,
          status: "Driver Assigned",
          timestamp: assignedTime,
          actor: "admin",
        });
      }

      const driverCheckpoints = parseDriverCheckpoints(params.driverNotes);
      for (const cp of driverCheckpoints) {
        events.push(cp);
      }

      if (
        params.deliveryStatus === "Out for Delivery" ||
        params.deliveryStatus === "Delivered"
      ) {
        const outTime = params.outForDeliveryAt
          ? new Date(params.outForDeliveryAt).toISOString()
          : params.deliveryStatus === "Delivered" && params.deliveredAt
            ? new Date(params.deliveredAt).toISOString()
            : updatedTime.toISOString();
        events.push({
          id: "out-for-delivery",
          title: "Furniture is out for delivery",
          status: "Out for Delivery",
          timestamp: outTime,
          actor: "driver",
        });
      }

      if (params.deliveryStatus === "Delivered") {
        const deliveryTime = params.deliveredAt
          ? new Date(params.deliveredAt).toISOString()
          : updatedTime.toISOString();
        events.push({
          id: "delivered-milestone",
          title: "Furniture has been delivered",
          status: "Delivered",
          timestamp: deliveryTime,
          actor: "driver",
          actionType:
            params.proofUrl || params.proofUrl2 ? "view_proof" : undefined,
          proofUrl: params.proofUrl,
          proofUrl2: params.proofUrl2,
        });
      }
    }
  } else {

    const isDelivered = params.deliveryStatus === "Delivered";
    const isOutForDelivery =
      params.deliveryStatus === "Out for Delivery" || isDelivered;
    const isDriverAssigned = Boolean(params.driverName);

    events.push({
      id: "order-placed",
      title: "Order is placed",
      status: "Preparing",
      timestamp: createdTime.toISOString(),
      actor: "system",
    });

    events.push({
      id: "order-preparing",
      title: "CraftIt is preparing your furniture",
      status: "Preparing",
      timestamp: new Date(createdTime.getTime() + 1000).toISOString(),
      actor: "system",
    });

    if (isDriverAssigned) {
      const assignedTime = params.driverAssignedAt
        ? new Date(params.driverAssignedAt).toISOString()
        : updatedTime.toISOString();
      events.push({
        id: "driver-assigned",
        title: `CraftIt assigned the furniture to ${params.driverName}`,
        status: "Driver Assigned",
        timestamp: assignedTime,
        actor: "admin",
      });
    }

    const driverCheckpoints = parseDriverCheckpoints(params.driverNotes);
    for (const cp of driverCheckpoints) {
      events.push(cp);
    }

    if (isOutForDelivery) {
      const outTime = params.outForDeliveryAt
        ? new Date(params.outForDeliveryAt).toISOString()
        : isDelivered && params.deliveredAt
          ? new Date(params.deliveredAt).toISOString()
          : updatedTime.toISOString();
      events.push({
        id: "out-for-delivery",
        title: "Furniture is out for delivery",
        status: "Out for Delivery",
        timestamp: outTime,
        actor: "driver",
      });
    }

    if (isDelivered) {
      const deliveryTime = params.deliveredAt
        ? new Date(params.deliveredAt).toISOString()
        : updatedTime.toISOString();
      events.push({
        id: "delivered-milestone",
        title: "Furniture has been delivered",
        status: "Delivered",
        timestamp: deliveryTime,
        actor: "driver",
        actionType:
          params.proofUrl || params.proofUrl2 ? "view_proof" : undefined,
        proofUrl: params.proofUrl,
        proofUrl2: params.proofUrl2,
      });
    }
  }

  const stageOrder: Record<string, number> = {
    "req-placed": 1,
    "order-placed": 1,
    "order-preparing": 2,
    "req-quote": 2,
    "req-downpayment": 3,
    "req-prod-done": 4,
    "req-completed-prep": 5,
    "driver-assigned": 6,
    "out-for-delivery": 8,
    "delivered-milestone": 9,
  };

  events.sort((a, b) => {
    const orderA = stageOrder[a.id] ?? 7;
    const orderB = stageOrder[b.id] ?? 7;
    if (orderA !== orderB) {
      return orderB - orderA;
    }
    return new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime();
  });

  for (let i = events.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
    const prevTime = new Date(events[i + 1].timestamp).getTime();
    const currTime = new Date(events[i].timestamp).getTime();
    if (currTime < prevTime) {
      events[i].timestamp = new Date(prevTime + 1000).toISOString();
    }
  }

  if (events.length > 0) {
    events[0].isLatest = true;
  }

  return events;
}
```

```typescript
  'las pinas':      { fee: 500, zone: 'Metro Manila' },
  'pasay':          { fee: 500, zone: 'Metro Manila' },
  'pateros':        { fee: 500, zone: 'Metro Manila' },

export const MANUAL_ZONES = [
  { value: 'other_luzon',       label: 'Other Luzon',        fee: 800 },
  { value: 'visayas_mindanao',  label: 'Visayas / Mindanao', fee: 1500 },
] as const;

export const VEHICLES = [
  { type: 'tricycle', label: 'Small Item Tier',       capacity: 1, rate: 100 },
  { type: 'sedan',    label: 'Medium Item Tier',      capacity: 2, rate: 200 },
  { type: 'van',      label: 'Large Item Tier',       capacity: 6, rate: 600 },
  { type: 'truck',    label: 'Extra Large Item Tier',      capacity: 12, rate: 1000 },
] as const;

export const DELIVERY_TIERS = VEHICLES;
export type VehicleType = typeof VEHICLES[number]['type'];
export type DeliveryTierType = VehicleType;

function normalize(value: string): string {
  return value.toLowerCase().trim();
}

export function isFreeShippingProvince(province: string): boolean {
  return FREE_SHIPPING_PROVINCES.includes(normalize(province));
}

export function getProvinceRegion(province: string): 'luzon' | 'visayas' | 'mindanao' | 'unknown' {
  return PROVINCE_REGIONS[normalize(province)] || 'unknown';
}

export function getDestinationFee(municipality: string, province: string): number {
  const key = normalize(municipality);
  const provKey = normalize(province);

  if (isFreeShippingProvince(provKey)) return 0;

  if (key in DESTINATION_ZONES) return DESTINATION_ZONES[key].fee;

  const region = getProvinceRegion(province);
  if (region === 'visayas' || region === 'mindanao') return 1500;
  if (region === 'luzon') return 500;

  return 500;
}

export function getDestinationZoneLabel(municipality: string, province: string): string {
  const key = normalize(municipality);
  const provKey = normalize(province);

  if (isFreeShippingProvince(provKey)) {
    const cleanProv = province.trim();
    return cleanProv.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + cleanProv.slice(1);
  }

  if (key in DESTINATION_ZONES) return DESTINATION_ZONES[key].zone;

  const region = getProvinceRegion(province);
  if (region === 'visayas') return 'Visayas';
  if (region === 'mindanao') return 'Mindanao';
  if (region === 'luzon') return 'Luzon';

  return 'Other Luzon';
}

export interface ShippingResult {
  vehicleType: VehicleType;
  vehicleLabel: string;
  vehiclesNeeded: number;
  ratePerVehicle: number;
  vehicleFee: number;
  destinationFee: number;
  totalShippingFee: number;
  isFreeLocal: boolean;
  zoneLabel: string;
}

export function calculateShipping(
  totalSlots: number,
  municipality: string,
  province?: string
): ShippingResult {

  if (province && isFreeShippingProvince(province)) {
    const singleVehicle = VEHICLES.find((v) => v.capacity >= totalSlots);
    const vehicleType = singleVehicle ? singleVehicle.type : 'truck';
    const vehicleLabel = singleVehicle ? singleVehicle.label : 'Extra Large Tier';
    const count = singleVehicle
      ? 1
      : Math.ceil(totalSlots / VEHICLES[VEHICLES.length - 1].capacity);
    const cleanProv = province.trim();
    const formattedProv = cleanProv.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + cleanProv.slice(1);

    return {
      vehicleType,
      vehicleLabel,
      vehiclesNeeded: count,
      ratePerVehicle: 0,
      vehicleFee: 0,
      destinationFee: 0,
      totalShippingFee: 0,
      isFreeLocal: true,
      zoneLabel: formattedProv,
    };
  }

  const destinationFee = getDestinationFee(municipality, province || '');
  const zoneLabel = getDestinationZoneLabel(municipality, province || '');

  const singleVehicle = VEHICLES.find(v => v.capacity >= totalSlots);

  if (singleVehicle) {
    return {
      vehicleType: singleVehicle.type,
      vehicleLabel: singleVehicle.label,
      vehiclesNeeded: 1,
      ratePerVehicle: singleVehicle.rate,
      vehicleFee: singleVehicle.rate,
      destinationFee,
      totalShippingFee: singleVehicle.rate + destinationFee,
      isFreeLocal: false,
      zoneLabel,
    };
  }

  const truck = VEHICLES[VEHICLES.length - 1];
  const count = Math.ceil(totalSlots / truck.capacity);

  return {
    vehicleType: 'truck',
    vehicleLabel: 'Extra Large Tier',
    vehiclesNeeded: count,
    ratePerVehicle: truck.rate,
    vehicleFee: count * truck.rate,
    destinationFee,
    totalShippingFee: count * truck.rate + destinationFee,
    isFreeLocal: false,
    zoneLabel,
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { Section, Text, Row, Column } from "@react-email/components";

function formatDate(dateStr?: string | null): string {
  if (!dateStr) return "";
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return dateStr;
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    year: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    day: "numeric",
    timeZone: "Asia/Manila",
  });
}

}

        {deliveryNotes && (

      </Text>
      <ItemsTable items={items} />
      <TotalsSection subtotal={subtotal} shippingFee={shippingFee} total={total} />
    </BaseTemplate>
  );
}
```
